mv-k01-v01.label: AgMsv_1.1
cite_parts:

prathamaḥ kāṇḍaḥ

vimalakalāśrayābhinavasṛṣṭimahā jananī bharitatanuś ca pañcamukhaguptarucir janakaḥ /
tadubhayayāmalasphuritabhāvavisargamayaṃ hṛdayam anuttarāmṛtakulaṃ mama saṃsphuratāt // [AgMsv_1.1]
mv-k01-v01.quick_english: May the first section shine, with its divine parents and heart as the family of supreme nectar.

mv-k01-v02.label: AgMsv_1.2
cite_parts:
yadīyabodhakiraṇair ullasadbhiḥ samantataḥ /
vikāsihṛdayāmbhojā vayaṃ sa jayatād guruḥ // [AgMsv_1.2]
mv-k01-v02.quick_english: May that teacher conquer, whose shining rays of knowledge make our hearts blossom everywhere.

mv-k01-v03.label: AgMsv_1.3
cite_parts:
sābhimarśaṣaḍardhārthapañcasrotaḥsamujjvalān /
yaḥ prādān mahyam arthaughān daurgatyadalanavratān // [AgMsv_1.3]
mv-k01-v03.quick_english: He gave me floods of meanings, bright with reflection and streams, that destroy poverty.

mv-k01-v04.label: AgMsv_1.4
cite_parts:
śrīmatsumatisaṃśuddhaḥ sadbhaktajanadakṣiṇaḥ /
śambhunāthaḥ prasanno me bhūyād vākpuṣpatoṣitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.4]
mv-k01-v04.quick_english: May Shambhunatha, pure and skilled toward true devotees, be pleased with me through speech-flowers.

mv-k01-v05.label: AgMsv_1.5
cite_parts:
gurubhyo 'pi garīyāṃsaṃ yuktaṃ śrīcukhalābhidham /
vande yatkṛtasaṃskāraḥ sthito 'smi galitagrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.5]
mv-k01-v05.quick_english: I salute Shricukhala, greater than teachers, by whose purification I stand freed from grasping.

mv-k01-v06.label: AgMsv_1.6
cite_parts:
tato gurutaraḥ śrīmān bhūtirājo mahāmatiḥ /
jayatād bhaktajanatāsamuddharaṇasāhasaḥ // [AgMsv_1.6]
mv-k01-v06.quick_english: May glorious great-minded Bhutiraja conquer, bolder than the guru in rescuing devotees.

mv-k01-v07.label: AgMsv_1.7
cite_parts:
śrīsomānandasaṃbodhaśrīmadutpalaniḥsṛtāḥ /
jayanti saṃvidāmodasaṃdarbhā dikprasarpiṇaḥ // [AgMsv_1.7]
mv-k01-v07.quick_english: The joyful consciousness compositions arising from Shri Somananda and Utpala conquer, spreading in all directions.

mv-k01-v08.label: AgMsv_1.8
cite_parts:
taddṛṣṭisaṃsṛticchedipratyabhijñopadeśinaḥ /
śrīmallakṣmaṇaguptasya guror vijayate vacaḥ // [AgMsv_1.8]
mv-k01-v08.quick_english: The speech of teacher Shriman Lakshmanagupta conquers, teaching recognition that cuts the world cycle.

mv-k01-v09.label: AgMsv_1.9
cite_parts:
apy asaṃkhyanavāsvādacamatkāraikadurmadā /
yenānuttarasaṃbhogatṛptā me matiṣaṭpadī // [AgMsv_1.9]
mv-k01-v09.quick_english: Even my bee-mind, intoxicated by the wonder of countless new tastes, is satisfied in supreme enjoyment.

mv-k01-v10.label: AgMsv_1.10
cite_parts:
tadekamayatām āpya svātmany eva tathā sthitā /
tad asyāḥ pronmiṣanty eva vividhā nādasaṃpadaḥ // [AgMsv_1.10]
mv-k01-v10.quick_english: Having attained unity with that in one's own self, various sound-riches indeed blossom from it.

mv-k01-v11.label: AgMsv_1.11
cite_parts:
sacchiṣyakarṇamandrābhyām arthito 'haṃ punaḥ punaḥ /
vākyārthaṃ vartaye śrīmanmālinyāṃ yat kva cit kva cit // [AgMsv_1.11]
mv-k01-v11.quick_english: Requested by good disciples' ears, I explain sentence meaning again and again in Shrimanmalini, here and there.

mv-k01-v12.label: AgMsv_1.12
cite_parts:
aucityenetaratyāgād vācyavācakayor mithaḥ /
vartanāvarta etasmin sādhu śāstraṃ ca vārttikam // [AgMsv_1.12]
mv-k01-v12.quick_english: By fitness and abandoning the other, scripture and commentary circulate well in this mutual usage of expressed and expressor.

mv-k01-v13.label: AgMsv_1.13
cite_parts:
ye 'harniśaṃ prakāśante sarvasya ca na gocare /
numo 'bhinavaguptāṃs tāñ śivacandrāṃśusaṃcayān // [AgMsv_1.13]
mv-k01-v13.quick_english: We bow day and night to those Abhinavaguptas, collections of Shiva moon rays, shining beyond all range.

mv-k01-v14.label: AgMsv_1.14
cite_parts:
jayanti jagadānandavipakṣakṣapaṇakṣamāḥ /
parameśamukhodbhūtajñānacandramarīcayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.14]
mv-k01-v14.quick_english: The moon rays of knowledge born from Paramesha's face conquer, able to destroy opponents of world bliss.

mv-k01-v15.label: AgMsv_1.15
cite_parts:
aniyantritasadbhāvād bhāvābhedaikabhāginaḥ /
yat prāg jātaṃ mahājñānaṃ tadraśmibharavaibhavam // [AgMsv_1.15]
mv-k01-v15.quick_english: From unrestrained true being, sharing one nature with beings, great knowledge born before has the glory of its rays.

mv-k01-v16.label: AgMsv_1.16
cite_parts:
tataṃ tādṛk svamāyīyaheyopādeyavarjitam /
vitatībhāvanācitraraśmitāmātrabheditam // [AgMsv_1.16]
mv-k01-v16.quick_english: Spread and such, it is free from maya's rejectable and acceptable, differentiated only by various thought rays.

mv-k01-v17.label: AgMsv_1.17
cite_parts:
abhimarśasvabhāvaṃ tad dhṛdayaṃ parameśituḥ /
tatrāpi śaktyā satataṃ svātmamayyā maheśvaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.17]
mv-k01-v17.quick_english: That heart of the supreme lord has the nature of reflection; even there Maheshvara always acts by power made of his own self.

mv-k01-v18.label: AgMsv_1.18
cite_parts:
yadā saṃghaṭṭam āsādya samāpattiṃ parāṃ vrajet /
tadāsya paramaṃ vaktraṃ visargaprasarāspadam // [AgMsv_1.18]
mv-k01-v18.quick_english: When, having reached contact, he would go to supreme absorption, then his supreme face becomes the seat of emission expansion.

mv-k01-v19.label: AgMsv_1.19
cite_parts:
anuttaravikāsodyajjagadānandasundaram /
bhāvivaktrāvibhāgena bījaṃ sarvasya yat sthitam // [AgMsv_1.19]
mv-k01-v19.quick_english: The seed of all stands, beautiful world bliss rising from supreme expansion, by non-difference of future face.

mv-k01-v20.label: AgMsv_1.20
cite_parts:
hṛtspandadṛkparāsāranirnāmormyādi tan matam /
etat paraṃ trikaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvaśaktyavibhāgavat // [AgMsv_1.20]
mv-k01-v20.quick_english: That opinion, heart pulse vision supreme flow wave etc, is the supreme trika before, undivided from all powers.

mv-k01-v21.label: AgMsv_1.21
cite_parts:
atra bhāvasamullāsaśaṅkāsaṃkocavicyuteḥ /
svānandalīnatāmātramātricchākarmadṛktrayam // [AgMsv_1.21]
mv-k01-v21.quick_english: Here, from release of expansion and contraction doubt, only the three of will, knowledge, and action remain in absorption in own bliss.

mv-k01-v22.label: AgMsv_1.22
cite_parts:
tathā ca guravaḥ śaivadṛṣṭāv itthaṃ nyarūpayan /
sa yad āste cidāhlādamātrānubhavatallayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.22]
mv-k01-v22.quick_english: Thus teachers described it in the Shaiva view: he stands absorbed in experience of consciousness bliss only.

mv-k01-v23.label: AgMsv_1.23
cite_parts:
tad icchā tāvatī jñānaṃ tāvat tāvat kriyā hi sā /
susūkṣmaśaktitritayasāmarasyena vartate // [AgMsv_1.23]
mv-k01-v23.quick_english: That will, so much knowledge, and so much action indeed occur by harmony of three subtle powers.

mv-k01-v24.label: AgMsv_1.24
cite_parts:
cidrūpāhlādaparamas tadābhinno bhaved iti /
nanu cedṛśi viśvātmabhūte saṃkocavarjanāt // [AgMsv_1.24]
mv-k01-v24.quick_english: Supreme in consciousness-form bliss would be undivided from that; but, it is asked, in such a world-self, from abandoning contraction?

mv-k01-v25.label: AgMsv_1.25
cite_parts:
vikalpakalpanāmūlāḥ kathaṃ śāstrādisaṃpadaḥ /
ucyate sarva evāyaṃ bodhaḥ saṃvitprabhāmayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.25]
mv-k01-v25.quick_english: How are scripture and other riches said to be rooted in conceptual construction? All this knowledge is made of consciousness radiance.

mv-k01-v26.label: AgMsv_1.26
cite_parts:
prakāśarūpatāyogāc cidāmarśaghanātmakaḥ /
tatrāmarśasvabhāvo 'yaṃ yaḥ prakāśaḥ prakāśate // [AgMsv_1.26]
mv-k01-v26.quick_english: Because it is of the nature of light, awareness is essentially dense with conscious self-reflection; and that light which shines has reflective awareness as its very nature.

tokens.grounds: compound: prakāśa + rūpatā + yoga; ablative of reason
compound: cit + āmarśa + ghana + ātmaka; describes bodhaḥ/prakāśaḥ

mv-k01-v27.label: AgMsv_1.27
cite_parts:
sa eva kiṃ na śāstraughaḥ kim anyair yuktiḍambaraiḥ /
paravāgdevatāviddhas tatrāsau kevalaṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.27]
mv-k01-v27.quick_english: Why should that very light not be the flood of scriptures? What need is there for other displays of reasoning? One who is pierced by the supreme goddess of speech would simply abide in that.

tokens.grounds: compound: para + vāc + devatā + viddha; describes the qualified person

mv-k01-v28.label: AgMsv_1.28
cite_parts:
na tu laukikamāyīyavarṇapuñjavicitritaḥ /
uktaṃ śrīpratyabhijñāyām ātmasaṃsthasya bhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.28]
mv-k01-v28.quick_english: But it is not variegated by masses of ordinary, māyic letters. As it is said in the revered Pratyabhijñā, what abides in the self shines forth of itself.

tokens.grounds: compound: laukika + māyīya + varṇa + puñja + vicitrita; negated description
compound: śrī + pratyabhijñā; locative of source

mv-k01-v29.label: AgMsv_1.29
cite_parts:
asty eva na vinā tasmād icchāmarśaḥ pravartate /
svabhāvam avabhāsasya vimarśaṃ vidur anyathā // [AgMsv_1.29]
mv-k01-v29.quick_english: Reflective awareness of will does indeed proceed and is not absent from that. The wise know reflective awareness to be the very nature of manifestation; otherwise, manifestation would not be what it is.

tokens.grounds: governs tasmād in sense of separation from that

mv-k01-v30.label: AgMsv_1.30
cite_parts:
prakāśo 'rthoparakto 'pi tulyo ratnādikair iti /
kiṃca yaḥ kaś canāmarśaś ciccamatkāragocaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.30]
mv-k01-v30.quick_english: Even if light tinged by an object seems similar to jewels and the like, any reflective awareness at all belongs to the domain of the wonder of consciousness.

tokens.grounds: compound: ratna + ādi; instrumental of comparison

mv-k01-v31.label: AgMsv_1.31
cite_parts:
hlādatāpādiviṣayas tadāsau bhavati sphuṭaḥ /
tadvimarśāntarālambasamucchalanayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.31]
mv-k01-v31.quick_english: When reflective awareness has joy, pain, and the like as its objects, it becomes clear through the surging inner grasp that arises within that reflection.

tokens.grounds: compound: hlāda + tāpa + ādi + viṣaya; describes āmarśaḥ
compound: tad + vimarśa + antarālamba + samucchalana + yoga; ablative of cause

mv-k01-v32.label: AgMsv_1.32
cite_parts:
paścāt susphuṭatām eti tathā ca gurur ūcivān /
yathā svasaṃvidā siddhaṃ sukhādi vyavatiṣṭhate // [AgMsv_1.32]
mv-k01-v32.quick_english: Afterward it attains full clearness. And so the teacher has said: pleasure and the like are established by one's own awareness and stand firm on that basis.

mv-k01-v33.label: AgMsv_1.33
cite_parts:
na hi vyavasthāsamaye vedyate tat svasaṃvidā /
tathāvaśyopagantavyaṃ svasaṃvitsādhanād iti // [AgMsv_1.33]
mv-k01-v33.quick_english: For at the time of later determination it is not known in that same way by self-awareness; even so, it must necessarily be accepted as established by self-awareness.

tokens.grounds: compound: vyavasthā + samaya; locative of time
compound: svasaṃvit + sādhana; ablative of reason

mv-k01-v34.label: AgMsv_1.34
cite_parts:
evam atrāpi paścād yaj jñānādyullāsavartmani /
sarvābhedamayī bhūmir yāvad āmṛśyatāṃ vrajet // [AgMsv_1.34]
mv-k01-v34.quick_english: So too here: afterward, on the path where knowledge and the other powers rise, the level consisting of universal non-difference comes to be reflectively apprehended.

tokens.grounds: compound: jñāna + ādi + ullāsa + vartman; locative
compound: sarva + abheda + maya; describes bhūmiḥ
correlative with tāvat in next verse

mv-k01-v35.label: AgMsv_1.35
cite_parts:
tāvat taducitodāravimarśāṃśasphuṭatvataḥ /
tādṛk sa eva śāstratvaṃ prāgvisargaḥ prapadyate // [AgMsv_1.35]
mv-k01-v35.quick_english: Then, because a noble reflective portion fitting that level becomes clear, that very primordial emission attains the status of scripture.

tokens.grounds: compound: tad + ucita + udāra + vimarśa + aṃśa + sphuṭatva; ablative of cause

mv-k01-v36.label: AgMsv_1.36
cite_parts:
etad eva tu yuktaṃ syāt tathā hy anupadhau pare /
śāstrārthe 'pi samācāraleśaḥ ko 'pi vibhāvyate // [AgMsv_1.36]
mv-k01-v36.quick_english: This indeed would be fitting, for even in the unconditioned supreme meaning of scripture some trace of practice can be discerned.

mv-k01-v37.label: AgMsv_1.37
cite_parts:
sa nūnaṃ sphuṭatādhāmabhāvijñānādiśaktimān /
uparāgāt tatas tattadvaicitryaparibṛṃhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.37]
mv-k01-v37.quick_english: That trace surely possesses the powers of knowledge and the rest that will arise in the abode of clearness; and from conditioning it becomes expanded into various manifold distinctions.

tokens.grounds: refers to the trace of practice
compound: sphuṭatā + dhāman + bhāvin + jñāna + ādi + śaktimat

mv-k01-v38.label: AgMsv_1.38
cite_parts:
yathā mukhasya tadvyaktisthāne 'psu mukure maṇau /
khaḍge cañcalasadvṛttasūkṣmadīrghādikā sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.38]
mv-k01-v38.quick_english: Just as a face appears in water, a mirror, a jewel, or a sword as trembling, round, subtle, long, and so on, so its manifestation varies with the medium.

tokens.grounds: elided apsu; locative plural used for medium
compound: cañcala + sadvṛtta + sūkṣma + dīrgha + ādi; describes sthitiḥ

mv-k01-v39.label: AgMsv_1.39
cite_parts:
tad itthaṃ parame rūpe prodbhūtā jñānasaṃpadaḥ /
anavacchinnahṛdayabījātmatrayasundarāḥ // [AgMsv_1.39]
mv-k01-v39.quick_english: Thus, in the supreme form, the treasures of knowledge arise, beautiful with the unlimited triad of heart, seed, and self.

tokens.grounds: compound: anavacchinna + hṛdaya + bīja + ātman + traya + sundara

mv-k01-v40.label: AgMsv_1.40
cite_parts:
yadā tūcchaladākārasvataraṅgāntarātmakān /
visisṛkṣati bhāvaughān bhairavaḥ śaktibṛṃhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.40]
mv-k01-v40.quick_english: But when Bhairava, expanded by power, desires to emit the floods of beings as inner waves of his own surging form,

tokens.grounds: tu + ucchalat + ākāra + sva + taraṅga + antar + ātmaka; describes bhāvaughān

mv-k01-v41.label: AgMsv_1.41
cite_parts:
tadā tā eva vijñānasaṃpadas tadupādhijām /
īṣatkriyāsamācārayantraṇāṃ saṃśritā iva // [AgMsv_1.41]
mv-k01-v41.quick_english: Then those very treasures of cognition, as if taking on a constraint of slight activity and practice born from that limiting condition,

tokens.grounds: compound: tad + upādhi + ja; describes īṣatkriyāsamācārayantraṇām
compound: īṣat + kriyā + samācāra + yantraṇā; object of saṃśritāḥ

mv-k01-v42.label: AgMsv_1.42
cite_parts:
paritas tattaraṅgaughasātmatāṃ samupāśrite /
tathāpi jagadānandasundare bodhabhairave // [AgMsv_1.42]
mv-k01-v42.quick_english: having assumed all around an identity with the flood of those waves, still remain within awareness-Bhairava, who is beautiful with the bliss of the world.

tokens.grounds: compound: tad + taraṅga + ogha + sātmatā; object of samupāśrite
locative absolute participle contextually; describes the state
compound: jagat + ānanda + sundara; locative describing bodhabhairave

mv-k01-v43.label: AgMsv_1.43
cite_parts:
bhāvanirbharatāmātrasaṃtṛpte śaktiśālini /
pūrṇayā nijaśaktyaiva nyakkṛte śaktimatpade // [AgMsv_1.43]
mv-k01-v43.quick_english: In that powerful awareness, satisfied with the mere fullness of being, the state of the power-holder is set aside by its own full power alone.

tokens.grounds: compound: bhāva + nirbharatā + mātra + saṃtṛpta; locative describing bodhabhairave/śaktiśālini
nija + śaktyā + eva; sandhi in text

mv-k01-v44.label: AgMsv_1.44
cite_parts:
tādṛg eva vimarśātmā jñānadhārā vijṛmbhate /
yasyāṃ bhogopadeśena ko 'pi hlādaḥ pravartate // [AgMsv_1.44]
mv-k01-v44.quick_english: Such a stream of knowledge, whose nature is reflective awareness, unfolds; and in it some delight arises through the teaching of enjoyment.

mv-k01-v45.label: AgMsv_1.45
cite_parts:
yadīyasaṃvidācāracaryāvisrambhabhāvitaḥ /
bhogavrāto 'pi dhanyānāṃ niḥśreyasapadāyate // [AgMsv_1.45]
mv-k01-v45.quick_english: For the fortunate, even the multitude of enjoyments, nourished by confidence in the practice of that awareness, becomes a state of supreme liberation.

tokens.grounds: compound: yadīya + saṃvid + ācāra + caryā + visrambha + bhāvita; describes bhogavrātaḥ

mv-k01-v46.label: AgMsv_1.46
cite_parts:
yatrocyate svaśaktyādikṣobhasaṃraṃbhanirbharā /
devasya yāgapriyatā viśeṣān mātṛmadhyataḥ // [AgMsv_1.46]
mv-k01-v46.quick_english: Here it is said that the deity's delight in worship is full of the stirring arousal of its own primordial power, especially arising from among the Mothers.

tokens.grounds: compound: sva + śakti + ādi + kṣobha + saṃraṃbha + nirbhara; describes yāgapriyatā
compound: yāga + priyatā; subject of cited statement

mv-k01-v47.label: AgMsv_1.47
cite_parts:
aiśvaryaśaktyudrekeṇa labdheśvarapadābhidhaḥ /
devo vijñānamahimā prodbhūto 'yaṃ prapañcitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.47]
mv-k01-v47.quick_english: By the surge of sovereign power, this deity, whose greatness is cognition and who has obtained the name of the lordly state, has become manifested and unfolded.

tokens.grounds: compound: aiśvarya + śakti + udreka; instrumental of cause
compound: labdha + īśvara + pada + abhidhā; describes devaḥ

mv-k01-v48.label: AgMsv_1.48
cite_parts:
atrāpy anantabhāvāṃśasaṃyojanaviyojane /
prāgdaśābhedasaṃdhānād asaṃkhyatvam upāśrite // [AgMsv_1.48]
mv-k01-v48.quick_english: Here too, in the joining and separating of infinite portions of beings, countlessness is attained because of the connection with the non-difference of the prior state.

tokens.grounds: compound: ananta + bhāva + aṃśa + saṃyojana + viyojana; locative dual/topic
compound: prāk + daśā + abheda + saṃdhāna; ablative of cause
locative/participial form expressing attainment; contextually predicate

mv-k01-v49.label: AgMsv_1.49
cite_parts:
tadupādhivaśād eva saṃvijjñānapadojjhitāḥ /
tāyante vividhāḥ śāstrakriyājñānavibhūtayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.49]
mv-k01-v49.quick_english: Simply by force of that adjunct, devoid of the state of consciousness-knowledge, are spread the various powers of scripture, action, and knowledge.

tokens.grounds: upādhi with vaśa ablative plus eva
ujjhita devoid with saṃvijjñānapada adj m.nom.pl
vibhūti with the triple compound f.nom.pl

mv-k01-v50.label: AgMsv_1.50
cite_parts:
mukhyas tv eṣa prapañco 'yaṃ pañcātmatvena carcitaḥ /
tathā ca vakṣyate tattvam abhinnam api pañcadhā // [AgMsv_1.50]
mv-k01-v50.quick_english: This main world is discussed as fivefold, yet the truth remains undivided.

mv-k01-v51.label: AgMsv_1.51
cite_parts:
savyāpārādhipatvena taddhīnaprerakatvataḥ /
icchānivṛtteḥ svasthatvād ityādyair vākyasaṃcayaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.51]
mv-k01-v51.quick_english: By active lordship, directing what lacks, desire cessation, and self-abiding, such sentence collections establish the point.

mv-k01-v52.label: AgMsv_1.52
cite_parts:
nanv etāvati sandarbhe deśakālakalākṛtāḥ /
bhedā na saṃbhavanty eva bāḍham om iti vacmahe // [AgMsv_1.52]
mv-k01-v52.quick_english: In this context, differences made by place, time, and art do not arise; granted, we say so.

mv-k01-v53.label: AgMsv_1.53
cite_parts:
na hy atra kālatattvasya nāmamātraṃ vibhāvyate /
vaibhavy api mahākālī śaktir nātra vijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.53]
mv-k01-v53.quick_english: Here time principle is not merely a name, and even great time power does not expand.

mv-k01-v54.label: AgMsv_1.54
cite_parts:
tarhy abhinne svasaṃpūrṇe tadā paścāt punar yadā /
parataś ceti ko nv eṣa vācoyuktiparigrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.54]
mv-k01-v54.quick_english: Then, in the undivided self-full state, what is this grasp of speech reasoning?

mv-k01-v55.label: AgMsv_1.55
cite_parts:
atra brūmaḥ satyam eva vastutas tu sphuṭātmani /
jṛmbhite tattvasarge 'pi kāle 'py unmiṣitātmani // [AgMsv_1.55]
mv-k01-v55.quick_english: Here we say truth indeed; in reality, in clear self, even in expanded principle creation and time.

mv-k01-v56.label: AgMsv_1.56
cite_parts:
bodhasya naiva santy etāḥ pūrvāparavikalpanāḥ /
kālo viśeṣaṇatvena yasmād bhavati bhedakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.56]
mv-k01-v56.quick_english: For awareness, these prior and later alternatives do not exist, because time becomes a differentiator only as qualifier.

mv-k01-v57.label: AgMsv_1.57
cite_parts:
viśeṣaṇaṃ ca tat proktaṃ samaśīrṣikayaiva yat /
bhedena vedyatām eti yathā nīlaṃ saroruhaṃ // [AgMsv_1.57]
mv-k01-v57.quick_english: That qualifier is said to become knowability by difference, as a blue lotus.

mv-k01-v58.label: AgMsv_1.58
cite_parts:
na ca bodhasya vedyatvaṃ kadācid upapadyate /
vedyatvaṃ bhāsamānatvaṃ tat prakāśaprasādataḥ // [AgMsv_1.58]
mv-k01-v58.quick_english: Awareness is never knowable; knowability is appearing-ness by clarity grace.

mv-k01-v59.label: AgMsv_1.59
cite_parts:
prakāśaḥ sa sa bodhaś ca na ced bodhāntarasthiteḥ /
prakāśaniyamān nūnam anavasthā pravartate // [AgMsv_1.59]
mv-k01-v59.quick_english: Clarity is that awareness; if another awareness stood, surely regress would proceed from clarity rules.

mv-k01-v60.label: AgMsv_1.60
cite_parts:
ata eva vimūḍhā ye bodham aprathamānakam /
arthaprathātmakaṃ brūyuḥ svavacovañcitās tu te // [AgMsv_1.60]
mv-k01-v60.quick_english: Deluded ones who call awareness non-first-appearing and object-appearance-natured are cheated by their own words.

mv-k01-v61.label: AgMsv_1.61
cite_parts:
tasmāt kālo na bodhasya bhedakatvāya kalpate /
nāpi vedyasya kālo 'sau bhedakībhavituṃ kṣamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.61]
mv-k01-v61.quick_english: Therefore time is not fit to differentiate awareness, nor is that time able to become differentiator of the knowable.

mv-k01-v62.label: AgMsv_1.62
cite_parts:
viśvaṃ hi bodhābhinnaṃ tad atathātve na bhāsate /
prakāśena samāviṣṭaś citraṃ bhāvaḥ prakāśate // [AgMsv_1.62]
mv-k01-v62.quick_english: The universe is not different from awareness; otherwise it would not shine; pervaded by clarity, variegated being shines.

mv-k01-v63.label: AgMsv_1.63
cite_parts:
viśvaprakāśa evaṃ syāt sarvasyaiva sadātanaḥ /
sati prakāśe bodhākhye sa prakāśatvam aśnute // [AgMsv_1.63]
mv-k01-v63.quick_english: Thus universe clarity would be eternal for all; when clarity named awareness is present, it attains clarity-ness.

mv-k01-v64.label: AgMsv_1.64
cite_parts:
aprakāśo 'pi bhāvaś cet prakāśātmā sa vedyate /
aprakāśas tv asau bhāva ity atra śaraṇaṃ tamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.64]
mv-k01-v64.quick_english: Even if an unlit being is clarity-self and known, that unlit being is darkness as refuge here.

mv-k01-v65.label: AgMsv_1.65
cite_parts:
yaś cāprakāśo bhāvātmā prakāśātmā sa cet kṛtaḥ /
nūnaṃ sa bhāvo naṣṭaḥ syāt svāprakāśatvavicyuteḥ // [AgMsv_1.65]
mv-k01-v65.quick_english: If an unlit being-self is made clarity-self, surely that being would be destroyed from loss of self-clarity.

mv-k01-v66.label: AgMsv_1.66
cite_parts:
nātadrūpaṃ prakāśaṃ ca kartuṃ vidhir api kṣamaḥ /
nanv etāvad idaṃbhāvaḥ prakāśe sati bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.66]
mv-k01-v66.quick_english: Even rule cannot make clarity not of that form; but this being shines when clarity is present.

mv-k01-v67.label: AgMsv_1.67
cite_parts:
astv etad eva kiṃtv ittham aprakāśaḥ prakāśatām /
bhāvasya cāprakāśatve prakāśībhāvite sati // [AgMsv_1.67]
mv-k01-v67.quick_english: Let this be indeed; but thus unlit clarity-ness, of being and in unlit-ness, when made clear and present.

mv-k01-v68.label: AgMsv_1.68
cite_parts:
naivaṃ prakāśito bhāva iti vastusthitir bhavet /
tad alaṃ vyatiriktena prakāśena śivas tathā // [AgMsv_1.68]
mv-k01-v68.quick_english: Thus a separately manifested entity is not the state of things; enough of separate light, for shiva is so.

mv-k01-v69.label: AgMsv_1.69
cite_parts:
tasmāt prakāśa evāsau gīto yaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ /
sa evācintyamahimā svātantryoddāmaghūrṇitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.69]
mv-k01-v69.quick_english: Therefore that light is sung as supreme shiva, whose inconceivable glory is swayed by freedom.

mv-k01-v70.label: AgMsv_1.70
cite_parts:
prakāśate tathā tais taiḥ svabhāvair acyutasthitiḥ /
nātra sarvatra sarvajñabhāvaḥ kaś cana śaṅkyate // [AgMsv_1.70]
mv-k01-v70.quick_english: So it shines through those natures in unfailing state; here all-knowingness is not suspected everywhere.

mv-k01-v71.label: AgMsv_1.71
cite_parts:
ahaṃ caitro ghaṭaṃ vedmi na paṭaṃ, veda taṃ tv ayaṃ. /
nāyaṃ vetti paṭaḥ, so 'haṃ jāne ghaṭapaṭāv iti // [AgMsv_1.71]
mv-k01-v71.quick_english: I, Caitra, know the pot not the cloth; but this one knows that; this one does not know the cloth; I know both pot and cloth.

mv-k01-v72.label: AgMsv_1.72
cite_parts:
vediṣyāmi na vā, pūrvam ajānāṃ naiva vā kva cit, /
krameṇa vedmi yugapad dvābhyām ubhayavarjitam. // [AgMsv_1.72]
mv-k01-v72.quick_english: I will know or not; before, not knowing; not anywhere; gradually I know, simultaneously, devoid of both.

mv-k01-v73.label: AgMsv_1.73
cite_parts:
sarvaṃ vedmi, na kiṃ cic ca jāne. naivāsmi kaś cana /
bhāvātmā, nanu naivāham. ahaṃ sarvaṃ ca sarvadā. // [AgMsv_1.73]
mv-k01-v73.quick_english: I know all, yet I know nothing; I am not any entity-self; indeed not I; I am all always.

mv-k01-v74.label: AgMsv_1.74
cite_parts:
sarvam asmy aham evaikaḥ kiṃ sarvam itarad bhavet /
ityādir eka evāyaṃ prakāśaḥ pravijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.74]
mv-k01-v74.quick_english: All am I alone; what else could all be? Thus one light unfolds.

mv-k01-v75.label: AgMsv_1.75
cite_parts:
nanv eko yady asaḥ kaś cit, prakāśo na tadā paraḥ /
kathaṃ bhaved. aho mūḍhaḥ kathaṃ vyutpādyatām ayam // [AgMsv_1.75]
mv-k01-v75.quick_english: If one were nonexistent, light would not then be supreme; how could it be? Alas fool, how is this to be instructed?

mv-k01-v76.label: AgMsv_1.76
cite_parts:
ekaḥ prakāśaḥ svātantryāc citrarūpaḥ prakāśate. /
vastutaś ca na citro 'sau, nācitro bhedadūṣaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.76]
mv-k01-v76.quick_english: One light shines in varied form from freedom; in reality it is neither varied nor unvaried, because of the fault of difference.

mv-k01-v77.label: AgMsv_1.77
cite_parts:
ghaṭaprakāśe vastrasya prakāśo yadi saṃbhavet /
nāsau ghaṭaprakāśaḥ syād dviprakāśo hy asau bhavet // [AgMsv_1.77]
mv-k01-v77.quick_english: If cloth's light arose in pot's light, that would not be pot-light; it would be two lights.

mv-k01-v78.label: AgMsv_1.78
cite_parts:
so 'pi cāstv eva, no nāsti tad idaṃ tvatpracoditam /
ghaṭātmanā prakāśo 'sya mā bhūd ity avatiṣṭhate // [AgMsv_1.78]
mv-k01-v78.quick_english: Let that be or not; this is urged by you; light should not be as pot-self, so it stands.

mv-k01-v79.label: AgMsv_1.79
cite_parts:
tac cāyuktaṃ prakāśasya bodhatvāt svātmajṛmbhaṇam /
lakṣaṇaṃ yadi tat ko 'yaṃ vṛthā vāgjālaḍambaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.79]
mv-k01-v79.quick_english: That is improper, since light's cognition-nature is self-unfolding; if that is the definition, what is this vain word-net pomp?

mv-k01-v80.label: AgMsv_1.80
cite_parts:
paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam /
jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate // [AgMsv_1.80]
mv-k01-v80.quick_english: Limited light is the definition of inert; cognition is distinct from inert, because it is not measured.

mv-k01-v81.label: AgMsv_1.81
cite_parts:
tasmād arkasya sadbhāve siddhe kaḥ khalu bāliśaḥ /
brūyāt katham ayaṃ svāṃśuśubhritāśeṣabhūr iti // [AgMsv_1.81]
mv-k01-v81.quick_english: Therefore, since the sun's existence is established, what fool would say how this all-earth-bearing ray is?

mv-k01-v82.label: AgMsv_1.82
cite_parts:
tasmāt siddhe prakāśe 'smin yāḥ prakāśavikalpanāḥ /
sarvās tāḥ sarvasaṃbhuktayoṣiccāritrapālanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.82]
mv-k01-v82.quick_english: Therefore, since light is established, all its variations are keepers of all enjoyment and conduct.

mv-k01-v83.label: AgMsv_1.83
cite_parts:
asiddhau ca prakāśasya ko 'haṃ kiṃ tvaṃ tamo 'pi kim /
na kiṃ cid api vā kiṃ syāt tūṣṇīṃ syād api vā katham // [AgMsv_1.83]
mv-k01-v83.quick_english: If light were unestablished, who am I, what are you, what darkness? Nothing at all, or silence, or how?

mv-k01-v84.label: AgMsv_1.84
cite_parts:
tasmāt prakāśatādātmyalabdhabhairavabhāginām /
bhāvānām api kālo 'yaṃ na kiṃ cit kartum arhati // [AgMsv_1.84]
mv-k01-v84.quick_english: Therefore time cannot do anything to beings who share bhairava's light-identity.

mv-k01-v85.label: AgMsv_1.85
cite_parts:
hanta tarhi kathaṃkāraṃ tadetyādivacaḥkramaḥ /
śrūyatām uktam apy etat punar nirbhajya bhaṇyate // [AgMsv_1.85]
mv-k01-v85.quick_english: Alas, then how is the sequence of words like 'tad eti' made? Let it be heard; what was said is spoken again after separation.

tokens.quick_gloss: sequence of words like tad eti

mv-k01-v86.label: AgMsv_1.86
cite_parts:
yaḥ prakāśaḥ sa evāyaṃ pratibhāti tathā tathā /
naiva cānyasya kasyāpi sa tu bhāty eva kevalam // [AgMsv_1.86]
mv-k01-v86.quick_english: The light that is this very one appears thus and thus; no other's light shines, but that alone shines.

mv-k01-v87.label: AgMsv_1.87
cite_parts:
sa eva paramodāraḥ sarvasyaivāvabhāsakaḥ /
svatantra iti tasyecchāśaktiḥ svātantryasaṃjñitā // [AgMsv_1.87]
mv-k01-v87.quick_english: That very one is supremely generous and illuminator of all; being free, his will-power is called freedom.

mv-k01-v88.label: AgMsv_1.88
cite_parts:
sa ca svātmani viśrāntas tadanyābhāvayogataḥ /
svātmaviśrāntir evaiṣā devasyānanda ucyate // [AgMsv_1.88]
mv-k01-v88.quick_english: Resting in self through absence of other, that very rest in self is called the god's bliss.

mv-k01-v89.label: AgMsv_1.89
cite_parts:
svātantryamahimaivāsya svarūpād apṛthaksthitiḥ /
svaprakāśe nije dhāmni bhāsayed bhāvavibhramān // [AgMsv_1.89]
mv-k01-v89.quick_english: The greatness of his freedom, non-separate from own form, would illuminate confusions of beings in his own light-abode.

mv-k01-v90.label: AgMsv_1.90
cite_parts:
bhāsanā ca kriyāśaktir iti śāstreṣu kathyate /
yayā vicitratattvādikalanā pravibhajyate // [AgMsv_1.90]
mv-k01-v90.quick_english: Illumination is called the power of action in scriptures, by which manifold principle-creation is divided.

mv-k01-v91.label: AgMsv_1.91
cite_parts:
bhāsanānavabhāte ca kathaṃ nāma prakalpate /
tad asyāntaḥsthitaṃ bhānaṃ jñānaśaktir ahaṃ smṛtā // [AgMsv_1.91]
mv-k01-v91.quick_english: When illumination does not shine, how is anything conceived? That knowing situated within it is remembered as knowledge-power.

mv-k01-v92.label: AgMsv_1.92
cite_parts:
etāvad asya devasya yad rūpaṃ svātmamātrataḥ /
sa unmeṣa iti proktaḥ pañcaśaktis tato vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.92]
mv-k01-v92.quick_english: This much is the god's form from self alone; that is called opening, then five powers, then the all-pervading.

mv-k01-v93.label: AgMsv_1.93
cite_parts:
triśaktir ekaśaktir vā devo vā kevalaḥ sthitaḥ /
śaktir evātha devī sā sāraśāstre nirūpyate // [AgMsv_1.93]
mv-k01-v93.quick_english: Whether as three powers, one power, or god alone standing, that power then is the goddess determined in essence-scripture.

mv-k01-v94.label: AgMsv_1.94
cite_parts:
vakṣyate ca jagaddhātuḥ kathitetyāditaḥ param /
saivaikā saty anekatvaṃ gacchatīti maheśinā // [AgMsv_1.94]
mv-k01-v94.quick_english: The world-substance will be said from 'said' onward as supreme; that one alone, being, goes to manyness, says the great lord.

mv-k01-v95.label: AgMsv_1.95
cite_parts:
sa cāyaṃ nirbharānandaviśrāntisvātmasusthitaḥ /
sodaryaiḥ śabdasaṃdarbhair bhāṣyate bhairavādibhiḥ // [AgMsv_1.95]
mv-k01-v95.quick_english: This one, firmly bliss-rested in self, is described by sisterly word-arrangements by bhairava and others.

mv-k01-v96.label: AgMsv_1.96
cite_parts:
savidhaṃ dūragaṃ vāpi yady apy asya na vastutaḥ /
śabdajātaṃ bhavet kiṃ cid anyad apy atha vā prabhoḥ // [AgMsv_1.96]
mv-k01-v96.quick_english: Whether near or far-going, in reality nothing of this is other; what word-collection could there be, or anything else, of the lord?

mv-k01-v97.label: AgMsv_1.97
cite_parts:
tathā ca bhāsayaty eva deva eṣa tathā tathā /
tatas tadanusāreṇa sarvo 'yaṃ kalpanākramaḥ // [AgMsv_1.97]
mv-k01-v97.quick_english: Thus the god illuminates thus and thus; then according to that, all this sequence of construction follows.

mv-k01-v98.label: AgMsv_1.98
cite_parts:
na ca tat kalpanāmātraṃ tathātve 'py atha kā kṣitiḥ /
tathā saṃkalpatāṃ devo yad vā kalpayatāṃ tathā // [AgMsv_1.98]
mv-k01-v98.quick_english: Nor is that mere construction in such a state; then what ground? Thus the god's intentionality, or thus of those constructing.

mv-k01-v99.label: AgMsv_1.99
cite_parts:
evaṃ caiṣa prakāśātmā saptatriṃśātmakāt paraḥ /
vaicitryabhāsanāṃ kurvan kālaṃ bhāsayati prabhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.99]
mv-k01-v99.quick_english: Thus this light-self, beyond the thirty-seven-fold, doing manifold illumination, the lord illuminates time.

mv-k01-v100.label: AgMsv_1.100
cite_parts:
vaicitryabhāsanaiveyaṃ kālaśaktir udāhṛtā /
tato 'vabhāsamānaitatkālaśaktyanurodhataḥ // [AgMsv_1.100]
mv-k01-v100.quick_english: This very manifold illumination is declared as time-power; then according to the shining time-power.

mv-k01-v101.label: AgMsv_1.101
cite_parts:
āsmākīnāt tadetyādir uparāgaḥ pravartate /
na cāsau tatra nāsty eva tatra yan nāsti tat kutaḥ // [AgMsv_1.101]
mv-k01-v101.quick_english: From ours the coloring 'tad eti' and so on proceeds; that is not there; indeed what is not there, whence is that?

mv-k01-v102.label: AgMsv_1.102
cite_parts:
anyatra tanyatāṃ nāma tat prakāśavaśaṃ sthitam /
nanv evam apare tattvajāle śuddhetarasthitau // [AgMsv_1.102]
mv-k01-v102.quick_english: Let it be elsewhere; that stands under light's control. Indeed thus others are in the net of principles in pure-impure state.

mv-k01-v103.label: AgMsv_1.103
cite_parts:
śuddhāśuddhapade vāpi vidyādau tattvamaṇḍale /
śuddhabhairavasadbhāvād aviśeṣo bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_1.103]
mv-k01-v103.quick_english: In the circle of principles, pure Bhairava existence makes no distinction remain.

mv-k01-v104.label: AgMsv_1.104
cite_parts:
narīnṛtyāmahe hanta yatnād vyākhyeyam eva naḥ /
āyuṣmato yad dhṛdaye svayaṃ viparivartate // [AgMsv_1.104]
mv-k01-v104.quick_english: We dance, alas; the teaching must be explained with effort, since it turns in the heart of the long-lived one.

mv-k01-v105.label: AgMsv_1.105
cite_parts:
śuddhāśuddhavibhedo hi paramārthakathāsu no /
sa tu tatkṛta evāste mūḍhānāṃ dhiyi niścalaḥ // [AgMsv_1.105]
mv-k01-v105.quick_english: In ultimate speech there is no pure-impure distinction; yet that distinction remains fixed in fools' minds.

mv-k01-v106.label: AgMsv_1.106
cite_parts:
nanu śuddhetaratvākhyo yadi bhedo na vāstavaḥ /
vyācikīrṣitam evaitac chāstraṃ vivadate tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.106]
mv-k01-v106.quick_english: If the pure-otherness difference is unreal, then scripture disputes only the intended apparent distinction.

mv-k01-v107.label: AgMsv_1.107
cite_parts:
aśuddhatvaṃ hi tattvānāṃ dīkṣayā śodhanaṃ tataḥ /
ityādi bahudhā bhedapradhānātra yataḥ sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.107]
mv-k01-v107.quick_english: Impurity of principles is purified by initiation; hence difference-dominant positions are only local.

mv-k01-v108.label: AgMsv_1.108
cite_parts:
ucyate nādvaye 'muṣmin dvaitaṃ nāsty eva sarvathā /
uktaṃ hi bhedavandhye 'pi vibhau bhedāvabhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.108]
mv-k01-v108.quick_english: In the nondual there is no duality at all; yet difference appears even in the all-pervading.

mv-k01-v109.label: AgMsv_1.109
cite_parts:
tad eva khalu saṃsāre māyāvidyādibhiḥ padaiḥ /
bandha ity ucyate tatra rūḍhāḥ saṃsāriṇo matāḥ // [AgMsv_1.109]
mv-k01-v109.quick_english: That is truly called bondage in samsara by maya, knowledge, and related terms; worldly beings are established as such.

mv-k01-v110.label: AgMsv_1.110
cite_parts:
taccintānusṛter eṣāṃ śuddhāśuddhādiniścayaḥ /
kiṃ ca śāstram idaṃ samyag bhagavadyogadeśakam // [AgMsv_1.110]
mv-k01-v110.quick_english: Following that thought gives these beings certainty of pure and impure; and this scripture properly teaches bhagavat yoga.

mv-k01-v111.label: AgMsv_1.111
cite_parts:
bhagavadyogam advaitaṃ nirdvandvaṃ ca pracakṣate /
tasyopadeśa itthaṃ syād yadi yāvadvibhedavat // [AgMsv_1.111]
mv-k01-v111.quick_english: They call bhagavat yoga nondual and free from pairs; its teaching would be thus if difference still appears.

mv-k01-v112.label: AgMsv_1.112
cite_parts:
saṃbhāvyate tan nirbhajya nirbhajyaiva nirūpyate /
advaite bhairavavibhau yat praveśopaveśayoḥ // [AgMsv_1.112]
mv-k01-v112.quick_english: That is imagined and determined by separating; in nondual Bhairava all-pervading, entry and seating are considered.

mv-k01-v113.label: AgMsv_1.113
cite_parts:
ābhyāsikī sthitir nāsti tau hi bhedaikajīvitau /
ataḥ saṃbhāvyanikhiladvaitaśaṅkāvyapohane // [AgMsv_1.113]
mv-k01-v113.quick_english: Habitual position is absent, for those two live by difference alone; therefore doubt of universal nonduality is removed.

mv-k01-v114.label: AgMsv_1.114
cite_parts:
gurūṇāṃ ca śiśūnāṃ ca yatnaḥ sarvo vijṛmbhate /
ato dvaitam ihāśaṅkyāśaṅkya sarvaṃ pratanyate // [AgMsv_1.114]
mv-k01-v114.quick_english: All effort unfolds for teachers and children; therefore duality is spread here by doubting and not doubting.

mv-k01-v115.label: AgMsv_1.115
cite_parts:
tad yāvadgati saṃbhāvya na tu kutrāpy udāsyate /
tathā hi yadi nāmṛṣṭaṃ dvaitaṃ tarhy ekam eva sat // [AgMsv_1.115]
mv-k01-v115.quick_english: That is imagined as far as going, not neglected anywhere; if duality is unrefuted, then one being alone remains.

mv-k01-v116.label: AgMsv_1.116
cite_parts:
cidbrahma tad alaṃ tattvasaṃkhyākalpananirṇayaiḥ /
pañcatriṃśatitā kasmāt tattvānāṃ tan nirūpyate // [AgMsv_1.116]
mv-k01-v116.quick_english: Consciousness-Brahman is enough; why is the thirty-fiveness of principles determined?

mv-k01-v117.label: AgMsv_1.117
cite_parts:
tasmād dvaitasya bhedātmasthiter yāvadgati graham /
kṛtvā yas tatpratikṣepas tena niḥśaṅkatā bhavet // [AgMsv_1.117]
mv-k01-v117.quick_english: Therefore, having grasped duality's difference-nature as far as it goes, one who rejects it becomes fearless.

mv-k01-v118.label: AgMsv_1.118
cite_parts:
etad eva ca vijñāne nirbhidyaivopadeśanam /
yathāsaṃbhavi yad vajrapakṣāṇāṃ tad vidāraṇam // [AgMsv_1.118]
mv-k01-v118.quick_english: This indeed is teaching pierced in knowledge; as possible, it tears the diamond wings.

mv-k01-v119.label: AgMsv_1.119
cite_parts:
tathā hi śrīmatā stotre bhaṭṭanārāyaṇena tat /
namas te bhavasaṃbhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate // [AgMsv_1.119]
mv-k01-v119.quick_english: Thus in the glorious hymn by Bhatta Narayana, salutation to you manifests and breaks worldly delusion.

mv-k01-v120.label: AgMsv_1.120
cite_parts:
jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate /
nirdvandvam iti nirdvaitaṃ prakaṭīkriyate padam // [AgMsv_1.120]
mv-k01-v120.quick_english: They reveal knowledge-bliss free from pairs, O god; the word free-from-pairs is made manifest as nondual.

mv-k01-v121.label: AgMsv_1.121
cite_parts:
udbhāvyante bhramāś ceti cakāro 'trādbhutāvahaḥ /
iha cādvaitam eveti purataḥ prataniṣyate // [AgMsv_1.121]
mv-k01-v121.quick_english: Delusions are manifested, and the ca here is wonder-bringing; here nondual is spread before.

mv-k01-v122.label: AgMsv_1.122
cite_parts:
adhvaśuddhyādikaṃ dvaite 'nupapattīti vakṣyate /
abhedena vinā naitan nanu bhedaṃ vināpi kim // [AgMsv_1.122]
mv-k01-v122.quick_english: Path-purification and the like — its incongruence in dualism will be stated: not this without non-difference. But surely, what even without difference?

tokens.grounds: śuddhi with adhvan and ādi n.acc.sg
anupapatti with elided a plus iti

mv-k01-v123.label: AgMsv_1.123
cite_parts:
satyaṃ kiṃtv advaye tattve bhedo 'pi na na yujyate /
idaṃ hi tat parādvaitaṃ bhedatyāgagrahau na yat // [AgMsv_1.123]
mv-k01-v123.quick_english: True — but in the nondual principle even difference is not unfitting; for this is that supreme nondualism, which is no abandoning-and-grasping of difference.

mv-k01-v124.label: AgMsv_1.124
cite_parts:
bhede tu viśvabhāvānāṃ svasvabhāvavyavasthiteḥ /
abheda iti śabdo 'yaṃ manye bhedayate rasāt // [AgMsv_1.124]
mv-k01-v124.quick_english: But in difference, with world-beings settled each in its own nature — this word non-difference, I think, divides them out of sheer relish.

mv-k01-v125.label: AgMsv_1.125
cite_parts:
tad alaṃ prakṛtaṃ nirūpyate parameśaḥ kila bhedakalpanām /
prakaṭīkurute yathā tathā nanu kālo 'pi vijṛmbhate tathā // [AgMsv_1.125]
mv-k01-v125.quick_english: Enough of that — the matter at hand is answered: as the Lord indeed manifests the imagining of difference, so too surely does time expand likewise.

mv-k01-v126.label: AgMsv_1.127
cite_parts:
na tathāpi ca yāti bhinnatāṃ
paramārthena kadācid eva saḥ /
yugapat sa hi saṃvidātmakaḥ

nanv ittham ekaghanabhāvavimarśasār saṃvedane yad aham eṣa karomi citraḥ /
jānāmi vā tad apare 'pi na maitracaitraprāyā vidadhyur athavāpi kathaṃ na vidyuḥ // [AgMsv_1.127]
mv-k01-v126.quick_english: Yet even so he never at any time attains separateness in the ultimate sense — for he is all-at-once, of the nature of consciousness. But surely — O essence of densely packed being-awareness — in awareness, that what I do here is strange, or that I know: would not others too, ordinary Mitras and Caitras, do the same? Or how would they not know?

mv-k01-v127.label: AgMsv_1.128
cite_parts:
aho māyāgranthir nibiḍatama eṣo 'tra bhavatām idaṃ hi prabrūmaḥ svaparam iha nāsty ekam abhidam /
ahaṃ vedmīty eṣā ghaṭatanuviśeṣaprakaṭatā prathāś citrākārāḥ paramahasi bhāntīti kathitam // [AgMsv_1.128]
mv-k01-v127.quick_english: 'Ah! Here, good sirs, is the very dense knot of māyā. This we declare: here there is neither own nor other, one undivided. 'I know' — that is but the manifestation of a pot-particular; manifold variegated forth-arisings shine in the supreme, thus it is told.

tokens.grounds: granthi with māyā visarga to r

mv-k01-v128.label: AgMsv_1.129
cite_parts:
tasmād ghaṭaṃ vedmy aham ity amutra bhedo na kaścin nanu me ghaṭo 'yam /
bhātīti bhedapratibhānam asti naitan na tasyaiṣa śivas tathāyam // [AgMsv_1.129]
mv-k01-v128.quick_english: Therefore in 'I know the pot' there is no difference at all. But surely — 'this pot appears to me' — difference does manifest! Not so — for him this very pot is Śiva, just so.

mv-k01-v129.label: AgMsv_1.130
cite_parts:
ata eva dvaipāyanamukhyās teṣu svaśāstradeśeṣu /
mamakāram eva mṛtyuṃ khaṇḍanadāyitvataḥ prāhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.130]
mv-k01-v129.quick_english: Therefore those headed by Dvaipāyana declared in their own scriptural domains that mine-making itself is death — by way of giving refutation.

mv-k01-v130.label: AgMsv_1.131
cite_parts:
tad evaṃ kālakalanopādhijātoparāgajāḥ /
tadetyādi pratāyante paratattve 'pi saṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_1.131]
mv-k01-v130.quick_english: Thus, born of the coloring produced by the time-reckoning adjunct, set forth beginning with 'that' — consciousnesses, even in the supreme principle.

tokens.grounds: jāta born with the long compound adj m.nom.pl

mv-k01-v131.label: AgMsv_1.132
cite_parts:
tatra pūrṇaikarūpatvāt sarvaṃ sarvatra cāpi tat /
anyathā khaṇḍanāyogān na pūrṇā pūrṇatā bhavet // [AgMsv_1.132]
mv-k01-v131.quick_english: Therein, from being of full one nature, all is everywhere too — for otherwise, division being inapplicable, fullness would not be full.

mv-k01-v132.label: AgMsv_1.133
cite_parts:
tataḥ pūrṇatayā sarvaṃsahabhairavadhāmani /
pañcātmako 'yaṃ śāstrārthaḥ śāmbhavaḥ. śaktyaṇusthitim // [AgMsv_1.133]
mv-k01-v132.quick_english: Thence, in fullness, in the abode of all-enduring Bhairava: this five-natured teaching-meaning is the Śāmbhavas — on the abiding of śakti and atom-soul.

tokens.grounds: sentence-period token relating to Śambhu predicate

mv-k01-v133.label: AgMsv_1.134
cite_parts:
nyakkṛtyaiṣa parāṃ devīṃ svātmany udrecya vartate /
itthaṃ sa visisṛkṣuḥ san bhāvān visraṣṭṛtāpadāt // [AgMsv_1.134]
mv-k01-v133.quick_english: Having established the supreme goddess, this one abides, surpassed in himself; thus, desirous of emitting beings, from the state of the emitter.

mv-k01-v134.label: AgMsv_1.135
cite_parts:
pūrvam ucchalitānandaghanām abhajata sthitim /
visraṣṭṛtāpade tv eṣa visargāveśabhāg api // [AgMsv_1.135]
mv-k01-v134.quick_english: Formerly he resorted to the surging-bliss-dense state; but in the emitter-state this one shares even in emission-absorption.

tokens.grounds: ghana dense with ucchalita-ānanda adj f.acc.sg

mv-k01-v135.label: AgMsv_1.136
cite_parts:
riktībhaviṣyann ānandaghanayā pūrṇayā citā /
tāvad ānandaśaktyaṃśavisargāveśanirbharaḥ // [AgMsv_1.136]
mv-k01-v135.quick_english: While about to become empty, he is still filled with the entry of bliss-power's partial emission.

mv-k01-v136.label: AgMsv_1.137
cite_parts:
vartamānaḥ svaśaktyoghapūrṇaś cābhūd bhaviṣyati /
riktaśaktir iti tryātmacitrasaṃvedanātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.137]
mv-k01-v136.quick_english: Present and full of his own power-flow, he became and will be power-depleted, as triple-self varied experience.

mv-k01-v137.label: AgMsv_1.138
cite_parts:
tadāsau devadevaḥ syād visraṣṭari pade sphuṭam /
nanu kiṃ vartamānāṃśe saṃsto bhūtabhaviṣyatī // [AgMsv_1.138]
mv-k01-v137.quick_english: Then he, god of gods, would clearly stand in the creator station; what stands in the present portion, past and future?

mv-k01-v138.label: AgMsv_1.139
cite_parts:
kiṃ nāma bhavatā jñātaṃ te svatantre 'pi ke cana /
vartamānāvadher bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyac ca vibhajyate // [AgMsv_1.139]
mv-k01-v138.quick_english: What indeed is known by you? Even in independence, can past and future be divided by a present boundary?

mv-k01-v139.label: AgMsv_1.140
cite_parts:
yac ca yatra na viśrāntaṃ tad vibhajyeta vai kutaḥ /
kathaṃ cāvadhibhāvaḥ syād vartamānasya te prati // [AgMsv_1.140]
mv-k01-v139.quick_english: That which has not rested where cannot be divided; whence and how could a boundary state of the present be toward you?

mv-k01-v140.label: AgMsv_1.141
cite_parts:
tayor avadhimattvaṃ vā tat praty api kathaṃ bhavet /
viśvasya viśvam avadhis tadvad vā jāyate na kim // [AgMsv_1.141]
mv-k01-v140.quick_english: How could boundedness of those two be, even toward that? Is the universe a boundary, or does it arise similarly? Not what?

mv-k01-v141.label: AgMsv_1.142
cite_parts:
tasmād bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyac ca vartamānākhyasaṃvidi /
rūḍham eveti tatraiva yadi viśrāntim āvahet // [AgMsv_1.142]
mv-k01-v141.quick_english: Therefore past and future are rooted in present-named consciousness; if one brings rest there only.

mv-k01-v142.label: AgMsv_1.143
cite_parts:
yadi cātraiva nikhilakalpanāraśmimaṇḍalam /
avisphārya kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhet saṃniruddhanijasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.143]
mv-k01-v142.quick_english: If here only the whole array of conceptual rays is not expanded, for a moment one would stand with restrained own state.

mv-k01-v143.label: AgMsv_1.144
cite_parts:
tan nijāmṛtavisphāracamatkāraikacarvaṇām /
labhate paramānandasudhāsandohavāhinīm // [AgMsv_1.144]
mv-k01-v143.quick_english: That obtains a single tasting of own nectar-expansion wonder, carrying supreme bliss-nectar abundance.

mv-k01-v144.label: AgMsv_1.145
cite_parts:
tathā hi sūryaraśmyoghapūrṇaḥ syāc candramā yadā /
tadā sūryakarān bhūyo yāvan na visisṛkṣati // [AgMsv_1.145]
mv-k01-v144.quick_english: Thus indeed the moon would be full of sun-ray union; when then it does not again wish to emit sun-rays.

mv-k01-v145.label: AgMsv_1.146
cite_parts:
tāvat svamaṇḍalābhoge kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntisusthitaḥ /
antaḥsthaviśvadevāṃśatarpaṇāpātram ucyate // [AgMsv_1.146]
mv-k01-v145.quick_english: So long, resting well in enjoyment of its own orb for a moment, it is called a vessel for satisfying portions of inner world-gods.

mv-k01-v146.label: AgMsv_1.147
cite_parts:
evaṃ bhāvaprakāśārkamarīcinicayāñcite /
svabodhacandramahasi vartamāne hṛdantare // [AgMsv_1.147]
mv-k01-v146.quick_english: Thus, in the heart interior, the moon of own awareness is present, shone upon by the cluster of rays of the sun of being-light.

mv-k01-v147.label: AgMsv_1.148
cite_parts:
viśrānto 'ntaḥsthitodāracitsudhāsārasundare /
antaḥsthasvāmṛtāpūro vamyate na bahir yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.148]
mv-k01-v147.quick_english: Rested in the beautiful inner abundant nectar of consciousness, filled with inner own nectar, it is not vomited outside, because.

mv-k01-v148.label: AgMsv_1.149
cite_parts:
tata evāntar evāsau ghūrṇamānaḥ samucchalan /
svāntaḥsthadevatācakratarpaṇāhaṃvidātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.149]
mv-k01-v148.quick_english: From that, only inside, that one, revolving and rising, consists of I-awareness satisfying the inner wheel of gods.

mv-k01-v149.label: AgMsv_1.150
cite_parts:
jāyate yāvad uddāmyet tāvat svakaraṇakramaḥ /
niruddhe raśmipaṭale vibhavābhāvayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.150]
mv-k01-v149.quick_english: As long as it is raised, so long the own sense-process arises, while restrained in the ray-sheet by union of prosperity and absence.

mv-k01-v150.label: AgMsv_1.151
cite_parts:
na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyac ca vartamānād vibhajyate /
avibhāgas tayor yāvat tāvat kā vartamānatā // [AgMsv_1.151]
mv-k01-v150.quick_english: Past and future are not divided from the present; as long as there is non-division of those two, what is present-ness?

mv-k02-v151.label: AgMsv_1.152
cite_parts:
bhūtabhāvisvabhāvābhyāṃ sā hi yāti vibhāgitām /
tad asmin saṃvidavadhau viśramya tuṭimātrakam // [AgMsv_1.152]
mv-k02-v151.quick_english: Time is divided by past and future; therefore, having rested in this limit of consciousness, one abides in a mere instant.

tokens.grounds: refers to time/tuṭi or consciousness-division in context
locative, refers to the limit of consciousness
absolutive, resting in the limit of awareness
accusative object, a bare moment of time

mv-k02-v152.label: AgMsv_1.153
cite_parts:
kālagrāsaparo yogī jāyate khecaraḥ kṣaṇāt /
uktaṃ hi bhāvābhāso yaḥ kālaḥ sa kalanātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.153]
mv-k02-v152.quick_english: The yogin devoted to devouring time becomes a sky-mover in an instant; for time is the appearance of things, and that is of the nature of limitation.

tokens.grounds: one who moves in the void of consciousness

mv-k02-v153.label: AgMsv_1.154
cite_parts:
svasaṃvidraśmisaṃsphāro bhāvābhāvaḥ sa nāparaḥ /
tasmāt svaraśmisaṃrodhadvāraruddhādhvamaṇḍalaḥ // [AgMsv_1.154]
mv-k02-v153.quick_english: Being and nonbeing are nothing other than the expansion of the rays of one's own consciousness; therefore, by stopping one's own rays, the whole sphere of paths is blocked.

tokens.grounds: compound bhāva-abhāva, the play of manifestation

mv-k02-v154.label: AgMsv_1.155
cite_parts:
kālagrāsaikarasiko jāyate khecaraḥ svayam /
tad uktaṃ parameśena tantre śrīḍāmarābhidhe // [AgMsv_1.155]
mv-k02-v154.quick_english: One who solely relishes the devouring of time becomes a sky-mover by himself; this is said by the Supreme Lord in the tantra called Śrīḍāmara.

tokens.grounds: compound śrī-ḍāmara-abhidha, name of the tantra

mv-k02-v155.label: AgMsv_1.156
cite_parts:
niruddhya raśmicakraṃ svaṃ pītvāmṛtam anuttamam /
kālobhayāparicchinne vartamāne sukhī bhavet // [AgMsv_1.156]
mv-k02-v155.quick_english: Having restrained one's own circle of rays and drunk the unsurpassed nectar, one becomes happy in the present that is not limited by time or by both its extremes.

tokens.grounds: absolutive, act of stopping the rays
compound raśmi-cakra, the radiance of consciousness
compound kāla-ubhaya-aparicchinna, locative of the present
present participle used as locative noun

mv-k02-v156.label: AgMsv_1.157
cite_parts:
rodho 'pi nāma naitasmin saṃkocaparivarjite /
tadabhāvān na visphāro grāsatṛptī tathātra ke // [AgMsv_1.157]
mv-k02-v156.quick_english: Even restraint does not truly exist in that state free from contraction; and because of that absence, expansion does not exist either—so how could devouring and satisfaction exist there?

tokens.grounds: compound saṃkoca-parivarjita, describes the absolute state

mv-k02-v157.label: AgMsv_1.158
cite_parts:
kiṃ tūktanītyā saṃrodhasphāragrāsādi bhāsate /
na tathābhāsanāc cānyad vastu viśvatra kiṃ cana // [AgMsv_1.158]
mv-k02-v157.quick_english: But by the method already described, restraint, expansion, devouring, and the rest do appear; yet from such appearance no other thing exists anywhere in the universe.

mv-k02-v158.label: AgMsv_1.159
cite_parts:
ity alaṃ khecarīcakragoṣṭhyālāpena bhūyasā /
ko vābhinavagupte 'smin yogaḥ saṃvedanakrame // [AgMsv_1.159]
mv-k02-v158.quick_english: Thus, enough of this extensive talk about the assembly of the khecarī circle; for in this teaching of Abhinavagupta, what yoga is there apart from the process of awareness?

tokens.grounds: vā + Abhinavagupta, locative of the author/self-reference

mv-k02-v159.label: AgMsv_1.160
cite_parts:
prakṛtaṃ brūmahe devīvisṛṣṭāś citrasaṃvidaḥ /
yāvat tāvad tad ūrdhvordhvaṃ sroto yad bhedavarjitam // [AgMsv_1.160]
mv-k02-v159.quick_english: Let us return to the topic: as far as the variegated consciousnesses emitted by the Goddess extend, so far above them is that higher and higher stream which is free from division.

tokens.grounds: accusative object, what was being discussed
compound devī-visṛṣṭa with elided nominative plural ending

mv-k02-v160.label: AgMsv_1.161
cite_parts:
saurabhargaśikhādīni tataḥ śāstrāṇi tenire /
uktaṃ bhargaśikhāyāṃ ca devena parameṣṭhinā // [AgMsv_1.161]
mv-k02-v160.quick_english: From that stream arose scriptures such as the Saura and the Bhargaśikhā; and this is said in the Bhargaśikhā by the Supreme Lord.

tokens.grounds: compound naming scriptures beginning with Bhargaśikhā

mv-k02-v161.label: AgMsv_1.162
cite_parts:
ūrdhvasrotodbhavaṃ jñānam idaṃ tat paramaṃ priye /
paramadhvaninordhvordhvasaṃvidrūpābhidhāyinā // [AgMsv_1.162]
mv-k02-v161.quick_english: ‘O beloved, this knowledge born of the upper stream is that supreme knowledge’—so it is taught by that which expresses higher and higher forms of consciousness on the supreme path.

tokens.grounds: vocative address in the cited scripture

mv-k02-v162.label: AgMsv_1.163
cite_parts:
īśānavaktraniryātāt siddhāntād bhedam ādiśat /
atrāpi pūrvabhedāṃśavyāmiśrībhāvacitritāḥ // [AgMsv_1.163]
mv-k02-v162.quick_english: It indicated a distinction from the Siddhānta issued from the face of Īśāna; and even here there are variegations produced by the unmixed aspects of earlier divisions.

tokens.grounds: ablative, the dualist Śaiva scripture stream

mv-k02-v163.label: AgMsv_1.164
cite_parts:
vijñānasaṃpadas tāṃs tāṃs tanvate śāstravibhramān /
iha yāvat tu mukhyeyaṃ ṣaḍātmā śāstrasaṃtatiḥ // [AgMsv_1.164]
mv-k02-v163.quick_english: Those various treasures of knowledge extend into diverse scriptural manifestations; but here the chief lineage of scriptures is sixfold in nature.

mv-k02-v164.label: AgMsv_1.165
cite_parts:
etatpūrvārdhabhāgīni trikaśāstrāṇi yāni tu /
ṣaḍardhasaṃjñayā tāni gurubhir bhāṣitāny alam // [AgMsv_1.165]
mv-k02-v164.quick_english: Those Trika scriptures that belong to the first half of this lineage are the ones the teachers have clearly spoken of under the name Ṣaḍardha.

tokens.grounds: past passive participle with elided nominative plural ending

mv-k02-v165.label: AgMsv_1.166
cite_parts:
na tu gūḍharahasyatvād evaiṣa vacanakramaḥ /
evaṃ hi dvādaśārdhārdham ityādy api na kiṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.166]
mv-k02-v165.quick_english: But this mode of expression is not used merely because the doctrine is deeply secret; for in that case, why could one not also say ‘half of half of twelve’ and so on?

mv-k02-v166.label: AgMsv_1.167
cite_parts:
atra śaktitrayaṃ mukhyaṃ saṃpūrṇasthiti kalpate /
ananyonyoparodhena pūrṇaṃ pūrṇacidātmakam // [AgMsv_1.167]
mv-k02-v166.quick_english: Here the triad of powers is primary; it constitutes a complete abiding without mutual obstruction, full and of the nature of full consciousness.

mv-k02-v167.label: AgMsv_1.168
cite_parts:
tataḥ paraṃ tu tritayaṃ kasyāṃcid guṇitājuṣi /
anyasyāṃ guṇatābhāji yāmalaṃ paribhāṣyate // [AgMsv_1.168]
mv-k02-v167.quick_english: Beyond that, when in one power the triad takes on subordination and in another it partakes of subordination, that configuration is described as the yāmala.

tokens.grounds: subject, the same triad in another mode
locative of an indefinite feminine referent (power)
compound guṇitā-juṣ, taking the role of a secondary quality

mv-k02-v168.label: AgMsv_1.169
cite_parts:
paścād visṛṣṭe 'rthaughe tadvaicitryopādhiyogataḥ /
pṛthagbhāvaviyogāsu svātmaśaktiṣu pañcasu // [AgMsv_1.169]
mv-k02-v168.quick_english: Afterward, when the mass of objects has been emitted, through connection with the conditions of its variegation it appears in the five powers of one's own self, which are not divided into separate beings.

tokens.grounds: artha-ogha with elided a, locative absolute

mv-k02-v169.label: AgMsv_1.170
cite_parts:
citspandecchāvidākarmarūpāsu svaucitīvaśāt /
pañcabrahmāṅgasubhagāt sphuradbhāvāṃśabodhajam // [AgMsv_1.170]
mv-k02-v169.quick_english: In those five powers whose forms are consciousness, vibration, will, knowledge, and action, by the force of their own appropriateness and through the grace of the five Brahman-limbs, there arises what is born from the awareness of the flashing aspects of being.

mv-k02-v170.label: AgMsv_1.171
cite_parts:
rūpaṃ śāstrātmatāṃ prāptaṃ pañcadhaiva vijṛmbhate /
tathā hi prāg anantāntaḥsthitabhāvaughajṛmbhaṇam // [AgMsv_1.171]
mv-k02-v170.quick_english: That form, having attained the nature of scripture, unfolds indeed in a fivefold way; for first there is the unfolding of the mass of beings situated within Ananta.

tokens.grounds: temporal adverb, at the prior stage

mv-k02-v171.label: AgMsv_1.172
cite_parts:
yāvat karoti bhagavāṃs tāvad īśamukhasthitiḥ /
antaḥsthāyā abhinnāyāḥ kriyāśakter vijṛmbhaṇe // [AgMsv_1.172]
mv-k02-v171.quick_english: As long as the Lord brings about that unfolding, there is abiding in the face of Īśa, in the unfolding of the inward, undivided power of action.

mv-k02-v172.label: AgMsv_1.173
cite_parts:
kramād unmiṣite tāvān eṣa sphāraḥ pratāyate /
kriyāśakteḥ sphuṭaḥ sphāro māyātvaṃ pratipatsyate // [AgMsv_1.173]
mv-k02-v172.quick_english: As it opens gradually, this expansion extends; and when the expansion of the power of action becomes clear, it will attain the state of māyā.

mv-k02-v173.label: AgMsv_1.174
cite_parts:
māyātattvasvarūpe hi śiveśānīti vakṣyate /
śuddhaśuddhetarāśuddhaviśvanirmāṇakāriṇaḥ // [AgMsv_1.174]
mv-k02-v173.quick_english: In the own form of maya-tattva, it will be said of shiva and ishani as makers of pure, pure-other, impure universes.

mv-k02-v174.label: AgMsv_1.175
cite_parts:
pañcamantratanoḥ śambhor nirmeyāśuddhasaṃgatiḥ /
asty eva pūrvakoṭyāṃ hi sarvam eva vyavasthitam // [AgMsv_1.175]
mv-k02-v174.quick_english: For the five-mantra-bodied shambhu, measurable impure association exists; indeed all is established at the prior extreme.

mv-k02-v175.label: AgMsv_1.176
cite_parts:
tathā hi svagṛhāt kvāpi yiyāsoḥ prathamakṣaṇe /
yāvat kiṃ cana gantavyaṃ yac ca tanmadhyavṛtti tu // [AgMsv_1.176]
mv-k02-v175.quick_english: Thus, for one wishing to go somewhere from his own house, at the first moment, whatever is to be gone, and the middle course, but.

mv-k02-v176.label: AgMsv_1.177
cite_parts:
tuṭipāte 'pi sarvajñasarvakartṛtvalabdhṛtā /
tata eva viśeṣāṃśaniṣkampakuśalātmanām // [AgMsv_1.177]
mv-k02-v176.quick_english: Even at an instant's fall, all-knowing all-making power is gained from that for the steady skillful selves of special parts.

mv-k02-v177.label: AgMsv_1.178
cite_parts:
tathā hi jātyakhaḍgāgradhārāsaṃsparśasaṃmitā /
sphurattvasamakālaṃ dhīr viśeṣāṃśān prakarṣati // [AgMsv_1.178]
mv-k02-v177.quick_english: Thus, measured by birth-sword-edge touch, at the same time as shining, intellect draws forth special parts.

mv-k02-v178.label: AgMsv_1.179
cite_parts:
ratnatattvasphuṭaprajño vidyuttatkāladarśitān /
tāṃs tān viśeṣāṃś cinute ratnānāṃ bhūyasām api // [AgMsv_1.179]
mv-k02-v178.quick_english: The clear knower of jewel-tattva gathers those special parts seen like lightning, even among many jewels.

mv-k02-v179.label: AgMsv_1.180
cite_parts:
anekasvarasaṃbhārasparśalāghavayojite /
vīṇāyām ekavistāre vaicitryaṃ vetti tanmayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.180]
mv-k02-v179.quick_english: In the vina joined with many sound-material touches, variety is known in one expansion by one made of that.

mv-k02-v180.label: AgMsv_1.181
cite_parts:
nibiḍābhyāsadhārāgraviśrāntaśravaṇendriyaḥ /
vetty eva tatsvarāṃśāntaḥśrutyūnādhikatām api // [AgMsv_1.181]
mv-k02-v180.quick_english: The hearing sense rested at the tip of dense practice stream indeed knows even that sound-part inner hearing less-more-ness.

mv-k02-v181.label: AgMsv_1.182
cite_parts:
āstām abhedavāde 'sminn ayatnenaiva siddhyati /
etad yatra vibhāte 'pi bhede vāstavam advayam // [AgMsv_1.182]
mv-k02-v181.quick_english: Let it be; in this nondifference doctrine, this succeeds effortlessly, where even in difference shining real nondual.

mv-k02-v182.label: AgMsv_1.183
cite_parts:
bhedaikajīvite śāstre yāvad etad sthitaṃ sphuṭam /
tathā hi pātañjalinā pāde vaibhūtanāmani // [AgMsv_1.183]
mv-k02-v182.quick_english: In difference-only-living scripture, this is clearly stood; for by Patanjali in the pada named powers.

mv-k02-v183.label: AgMsv_1.184
cite_parts:
nyarūpyata `prātibhād vā sarvam' atra mayāpi ca /
prātibhe prathamonmeṣe saṃvidrūpiṇy akhaṇḍite // [AgMsv_1.184]
mv-k02-v183.quick_english: It was formed, 'from intuition or all'; here by me too, in intuition at first opening, consciousness-formed undivided.

mv-k02-v184.label: AgMsv_1.185
cite_parts:
sthitaḥ sarvasphurattātmā sarvasiddhiphalodayaḥ /
evaṃ jagati nirmeye nirmitsāsvīkṛtaṃ balāt // [AgMsv_1.185]
mv-k02-v184.quick_english: Thus the all-shining self, source of all accomplishment, stands in the created world, where creation is accepted by force.

mv-k02-v185.label: AgMsv_1.186
cite_parts:
aśuddham api tadrūpanānāvaicitryayogy api /
sāmānyākārarūpeṇa dalaṃ bhedātmasundaram // [AgMsv_1.186]
mv-k02-v185.quick_english: Even impurity, fit for varied forms of that shape, appears in common form as a part beautiful as difference-self.

mv-k02-v186.label: AgMsv_1.187
cite_parts:
āste pronmiṣitaṃ saiṣā bhedābhedātmikā sthitiḥ /
ata eva hi sādākhye jñānaśaktisvarūpiṇi // [AgMsv_1.187]
mv-k02-v186.quick_english: This difference-nondifference state stands bloomed; therefore it is in sadākhya, the nature of knowledge-power.

mv-k02-v187.label: AgMsv_1.188
cite_parts:
aśuddhileśakāluṣyāt parāparatayā sthitiḥ /
teneśabhuktād etasmād apy ūrdhvapadabhāginaḥ // [AgMsv_1.188]
mv-k02-v187.quick_english: From impurity-particle-stain, state becomes higher-lower; even those reaching higher station arise from what is enjoyed by the lord.

mv-k02-v188.label: AgMsv_1.189
cite_parts:
māyāprakaṭanautsukyāt tatsaṃskārajuṣas tathā /
bahukriyāsamārambhamayaṃ vividhamantraṇam // [AgMsv_1.189]
mv-k02-v188.quick_english: From eagerness to manifest māyā, those enjoying its impressions thus receive various counsel full of many action-beginnings.

mv-k02-v189.label: AgMsv_1.190
cite_parts:
prādurbhūtaṃ mahājñānasantateś ca śivapradam /
sa hi tatrāparo bhāvaḥ parabhāvanimīlitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.190]
mv-k02-v189.quick_english: Manifested from the great knowledge continuum and giving śiva, that state is there; another state is merged in the supreme state.

mv-k02-v190.label: AgMsv_1.191
cite_parts:
na tu rūḍhim upāgacched aśuddhordhvavidhāv iva /
tena vaiṣṇavabauddhādiśāsanāntaraniṣṭhitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.191]
mv-k02-v190.quick_english: But growth would not be attained in impure higher rite, like those fixed in other doctrines such as Vaiṣṇava and Buddhist.

mv-k02-v191.label: AgMsv_1.192
cite_parts:
yathā samyaṅ na mucyante na tathā śaivasaṃskṛtāḥ /
atimārgakramakulatrikasrotontarādiṣu // [AgMsv_1.192]
mv-k02-v191.quick_english: As others are not properly liberated, so Śaiva-purified ones are not; they are in streams beyond path, order, triad, and others.

mv-k02-v192.label: AgMsv_1.193
cite_parts:
parameśānaśāstre tu ye samyag dīkṣitā narāḥ /
teṣāṃ naivāpavargasya lābhe bhedo 'sti kaś cana // [AgMsv_1.193]
mv-k02-v192.quick_english: But for men properly initiated in the supreme lord's scripture, there is no difference at all in obtaining liberation.

mv-k02-v193.label: AgMsv_1.194
cite_parts:
na caitadatirikto 'pi mokṣopāyo 'sti kaś cana /
kevalaṃ kvāpy anāyāsāj jīvanmuktikrameṇa ca // [AgMsv_1.194]
mv-k02-v193.quick_english: Nor is there any means of liberation beyond this; only somewhere by effortless living-liberation order.

mv-k02-v194.label: AgMsv_1.195
cite_parts:
śīghram eva parā siddhir yathāsmaddarśaneṣv iti /
kvāpi tattvāvalīyogaparipāṭīkramāc cirāt // [AgMsv_1.195]
mv-k02-v194.quick_english: Supreme accomplishment is indeed quick, as in our views; but somewhere, by the order of truth-series yoga, it comes only after long time.

mv-k02-v195.label: AgMsv_1.196
cite_parts:
tais taiḥ kriyākalāpaiś ca labhyate paramaṃ phalam /
ata evāsti saṃhāradṛśām kauliky apīha dṛk // [AgMsv_1.196]
mv-k02-v195.quick_english: By those ritual parts the supreme fruit is obtained; therefore even here there is a kaulika view for destruction-seers.

mv-k02-v196.label: AgMsv_1.197
cite_parts:
yathoktaṃ kālapādādau dīkṣayec chvapacān iti /
cidunmeṣādikāḥ pañca yāḥ pūrvaṃ prāgabhedataḥ // [AgMsv_1.197]
mv-k02-v196.quick_english: As stated, one should initiate dog-cookers at the beginning of time; the five consciousness-unfoldings formerly existed before difference.

mv-k02-v197.label: AgMsv_1.198
cite_parts:
proktāḥ parasmiṃś cinnāthe bhairave samavāyataḥ /
tā eva bhāvopādhyaṃśalabdhabhedavibhāvitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.198]
mv-k02-v197.quick_english: Declared in supreme Bhairava by union, those powers are differentiated through parts of being-limitation.

mv-k02-v198.label: AgMsv_1.199
cite_parts:
bhedāṃśam eva puṣṇanti prāgabhedajuṣo 'py alam /
tathā hy odanasaṃbhogo yo dehasyopacāyakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.199]
mv-k02-v198.quick_english: The difference-part alone is nourished, even by those enjoying before difference; thus rice-enjoyment nourishes the body.

mv-k02-v199.label: AgMsv_1.200
cite_parts:
kaphasaṃcayapātena sa dehasyāpacāyakaḥ /
nanu devasya viśvātmābhede 'pi svāparicyuteḥ // [AgMsv_1.200]
mv-k02-v199.quick_english: By phlegm accumulation that depletes the body; but even in god's world-self nondifference, from one's own fall.

mv-k02-v200.label: AgMsv_1.201
cite_parts:
vikāriṣv eva yogyānām upādhīnāṃ gatiḥ kutaḥ /
tadupādhivaśād bhedo bhairave bhāvasaṃbhavāt // [AgMsv_1.201]
mv-k02-v200.quick_english: Whence movement of capable limitations among changing things? Difference in Bhairava arises from being through that limitation-control.

mv-k02-v201.label: AgMsv_1.202
cite_parts:
iti nāsmanmanobhūmāv upāroḍhum ivārhati /
tūṣṇīṃ vikāriṇo bhāvāḥ santīti hy atisāhasam // [AgMsv_1.202]
mv-k02-v201.quick_english: Thus it is not fitting to ascend our mind-ground; to say changing beings exist silently is indeed rashness.

mv-k02-v202.label: AgMsv_1.203
cite_parts:
devaḥ sa eva viśvātmā tathārūpeṇa bhāsate /
anupādher abhinnasya bhinnam aupādhibhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.203]
mv-k02-v202.quick_english: That god is indeed world-self and appears in such form; the undivided without limitation has divided limitation-appearance.

mv-k02-v203.label: AgMsv_1.204
cite_parts:
nanv itthaṃ tad asatyaṃ syāt kathaṃ satyaṃ tad eva hi /
tathāvabhāsanād anyat kva kiṃ satyaṃ nirūpyatām // [AgMsv_1.204]
mv-k02-v203.quick_english: But thus that would be unreal; how is that very thing real? From such appearance, where is another real thing to be determined?

mv-k02-v204.label: AgMsv_1.205
cite_parts:
nanv evaṃ svapnasaṃsāraḥ kiṃ satyaṃ kiṃtv asau kila /
abhīṣṭārthakriyāvandhyo 'satyo vyavahṛtaḥ param // [AgMsv_1.205]
mv-k02-v204.quick_english: But thus is dream-world-cycle real? That indeed is devoid of desired action, unreal, yet conventionally used supremely.

mv-k02-v205.label: AgMsv_1.206
cite_parts:
etac cāgre prapañcena yuktiyuktaṃ nirūpyate /
tasmād unmeṣaśaktir yā pūrvam āsīd abhedinī // [AgMsv_1.206]
mv-k02-v205.quick_english: This is determined in detail ahead; therefore the unfolding power that was formerly undivided.

mv-k02-v206.label: AgMsv_1.207
cite_parts:
bhāvonmeṣasvarūpāsau yātā tatpuruṣasthitim /
yad abhinnaṃ tad agrāhyaṃ yac ca grāhakam īśvaram // [AgMsv_1.207]
mv-k02-v206.quick_english: That being-unfolding nature has gone to that-person state; what is undivided is ungraspable, and what is grasping is the lord.

mv-k02-v207.label: AgMsv_1.208
cite_parts:
adhunā tat sthitaṃ grāhyaṃ bhedāt tadgrāhakaṃ bhidaḥ /
puruṣākhyaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ sṛṣṭeḥ prārambhayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.208]
mv-k02-v207.quick_english: Now that standing is graspable from difference, its grasper of difference; called person, then declared from creation's beginning union.

mv-k02-v208.label: AgMsv_1.209
cite_parts:
susphuṭapratyabhijñānān mukhyaṃ vaktraṃ ca bhaṇyate /
ata evātra visarabhāvasthitivighātakam // [AgMsv_1.209]
mv-k02-v208.quick_english: From clear recognition the chief face is spoken; therefore here it destroys dispersion-being-state.

mv-k02-v209.label: AgMsv_1.210
cite_parts:
nānāruggrahasaṃghātaviṣādi paricarcyate /
anekayuktidalitavyādhisaṃśāntasusthitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.210]
mv-k02-v209.quick_english: Various disease-grasp aggregates and poisons are treated; many reasons split disease, calming and well-establishing.

mv-k02-v210.label: AgMsv_1.211
cite_parts:
atra susphuṭatāṃ yānti bhāvā bhedaikavṛttayaḥ /
bhāvatvam eva yat sarvaṃ tat tv idaṃ pūrvajaṃ mukham // [AgMsv_1.211]
mv-k02-v210.quick_english: Here beings that occur only in difference go to clarity; all being-ness indeed is this former-born face.

mv-k02-v211.label: AgMsv_1.212
cite_parts:
sarvataś ca guṇotkarṣād īśānasyordhvavaktratā /
dikkālakalanāśūnye na tu digbhedakalpanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.212]
mv-k02-v211.quick_english: From all and from excellence-rise, Ishana's upward-face-ness; in space-time-calculation void, not direction-difference imaginations.

mv-k02-v212.label: AgMsv_1.213
cite_parts:
yo hi yasmād guṇotkṛṣṭa iti cordhvo bhaviṣyati /
tato bhāvān yadā samyag icchatīcchāvibhūtitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.213]
mv-k02-v212.quick_english: Who indeed from which excellence-surpassing, thus upward will be; then beings when properly from desire-power.

mv-k02-v213.label: AgMsv_1.214
cite_parts:
tadecchāyāṃ samārūḍhāḥ sā cecchā caiva nirmalā /
yena tanmayatāyogāt saṃvidaikyaṃ spṛśanty amī // [AgMsv_1.214]
mv-k02-v213.quick_english: Ascended in that desire; if that desire is pure, by which through identity-union these touch consciousness-unity.

mv-k02-v214.label: AgMsv_1.215
cite_parts:
kiṃtūpādhyuparaktecchāsaṃchādanatirohitāḥ /
te tadānīṃ sthitā bhāvā devas tu svaiṣaṇāsthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.215]
mv-k02-v214.quick_english: But beings hidden by limitation-superior desire-covering; then those beings stand, but god stands in own desire.

mv-k02-v215.label: AgMsv_1.216
cite_parts:
parācīnitasaṃvittivaktro na ca parāṃ sthitim /
pūrṇām adhyuṣitas tena suṣupta iva bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.216]
mv-k02-v215.quick_english: One who knows only outer consciousness does not dwell in the supreme full state, so he appears as if in deep sleep.

mv-k02-v216.label: AgMsv_1.217
cite_parts:
asuptaś ca prabuddhatvāt tasya svāpo nimīlanam /
na hy asti paramārthena bhairavānandasaṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_1.217]
mv-k02-v216.quick_english: He is not truly asleep, for his sleep is only a closing; ultimate Bhairava-bliss consciousness never sleeps.

mv-k02-v217.label: AgMsv_1.218
cite_parts:
tasmin paraprakāśe hi nimīlattvam upāgate /
pralayāt tannimīlattvamitir vā kutra bhāsatām // [AgMsv_1.218]
mv-k02-v217.quick_english: When supreme light is present, where could closing shine except as its own measure?

mv-k02-v218.label: AgMsv_1.219
cite_parts:
anābhātaṃ ca no vastu vyomasadmagavākṣavat /
so 'pi vā kalpitākāraś citprakāśe prakāśate // [AgMsv_1.219]
mv-k02-v218.quick_english: No thing is unilluminated; even an imagined form shines in consciousness-light.

mv-k02-v219.label: AgMsv_1.220
cite_parts:
tad amīlita evāyaṃ nimīlann iva tiṣṭhati /
prabhūṇām avikalpyā hi śaktir durghaṭakāriṇām // [AgMsv_1.220]
mv-k02-v219.quick_english: This unblinking reality stands as if closing, for lords have unimaginable power that performs difficult things.

mv-k02-v220.label: AgMsv_1.221
cite_parts:
idaṃ sukhena ghaṭate duḥkhena ghaṭate tv idaṃ /
ity ābhāsanavaicitrye svatantro hi sa eva naḥ // [AgMsv_1.221]
mv-k02-v220.quick_english: Some things happen with ease and some with difficulty; in this variety of appearance, he alone is autonomous.

mv-k02-v221.label: AgMsv_1.222
cite_parts:
tad eva tasya svātantryaṃ śaktir niyatināmikā /
yayā ruddhaḥ paśur jātu svātantryaṃ naiva vindati // [AgMsv_1.222]
mv-k02-v221.quick_english: His autonomy is the power called niyati; by it the bound soul is restrained and never finds autonomy.

mv-k02-v222.label: AgMsv_1.223
cite_parts:
tadapekṣābalāt proktā patyau durghaṭakāritā /
na hi viśvātmanaḥ kiṃ cit sughaṭaṃ vātha durghaṭam // [AgMsv_1.223]
mv-k02-v222.quick_english: Because of dependence on that, difficult action is attributed to the lord; for the self of the universe nothing is easy or difficult.

mv-k02-v223.label: AgMsv_1.224
cite_parts:
kiṃ muhur muhur etenāsakṛn nanu nirūpitam /
hantāvismṛtiśīlaṃ tvāṃ praty etat syād apārthakam // [AgMsv_1.224]
mv-k02-v223.quick_english: Why repeat this again and again when it is already established? Alas, for your forgetful nature, otherwise it would be useless.

mv-k02-v224.label: AgMsv_1.225
cite_parts:
ekam uddiśya kiṃtv etatsaṃrambho na virājate /
kiṃ hy ekāṅkurasaṃpattyai prāvṛṣeṇyāḥ payomucaḥ // [AgMsv_1.225]
mv-k02-v224.quick_english: Effort aimed at one thing does not shine; rainy-season clouds do not arise for the prosperity of a single sprout.

mv-k02-v225.label: AgMsv_1.226
cite_parts:
marmasthānam idaṃ cātra vyutpādyo hi janaḥ sa ca /
vyāpto hṛdbhuvi karmaughakṛṣṭāyāṃ saukumāryataḥ // [AgMsv_1.226]
mv-k02-v225.quick_english: This is the vital spot here; the person to be instructed is pervaded in the heart-ground, drawn by a mass of action, through delicacy.

mv-k02-v226.label: AgMsv_1.227
cite_parts:
māyābījotthitānantavikalpāṅkurakandalaiḥ /
bhedābhimānajanitavācanaucityasevitaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.227]
mv-k02-v226.quick_english: Endless sprouts and shoots rise from the maya seed, served by speech-fitness born of pride in difference.

mv-k02-v227.label: AgMsv_1.228
cite_parts:
yāvad vidyāmahādāvajvālayaiṣā punaḥ punaḥ /
nālabdhā tāvad asyaitad dvaitaṃ rohet punaḥ punaḥ // [AgMsv_1.228]
mv-k02-v227.quick_english: As long as the great forest-fire of knowledge is not obtained, his duality grows again and again.

mv-k02-v228.label: AgMsv_1.229
cite_parts:
tīkṣṇayuktikuṭhāraughaiḥ sadvidyāvahnidīpitaiḥ /
nirbhinno bhedaviṭapī punar naiva prarohati // [AgMsv_1.229]
mv-k02-v228.quick_english: Split by sharp reason-axes kindled by true knowledge fire, the difference-tree never sprouts again.

mv-k02-v229.label: AgMsv_1.230
cite_parts:
evaṃ deve suṣuptāṃśamadhyāsīne sthitā api /
asaddeśīyatāṃ yānti bhāvāḥ śvabhrakapitthavat // [AgMsv_1.230]
mv-k02-v229.quick_english: Even when god is seated in the deep-sleep portion, things go to false locality, like cavity and wood-apple.

mv-k02-v230.label: AgMsv_1.231
cite_parts:
atra tādṛśam eva svaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyanirbharam /
nirupākhyaṃ nirālambaṃ vyajṛmbhata vibhāgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.231]
mv-k02-v230.quick_english: Here such own knowledge, laden with detachment, indescribable and unsupported, blooms by distinction.

mv-k02-v231.label: AgMsv_1.232
cite_parts:
kapālamālābharaṇāḥ śmaśānapadavāsinaḥ /
asmātparāṅmukhībhūtā bhūtasaṃghātagocarāḥ // [AgMsv_1.232]
mv-k02-v231.quick_english: Those ornamented with skull garlands, dwelling in cremation grounds, and perceiving element aggregates turn away from this.

mv-k02-v232.label: AgMsv_1.233
cite_parts:
bhogyaṃ jugupsāvadhi sarvam eva bhoktā hy ahaṃ kaḥ kila deha eṣaḥ /
carmāsthimātraṃ na ca sāram atra leśāṃśabhāge 'pi kadācid asti // [AgMsv_1.233]
mv-k02-v232.quick_english: All enjoyable reaches the limit of disgust; the enjoyer is I. This body is only skin and bone, with no essence even in the smallest part.

mv-k02-v233.label: AgMsv_1.234
cite_parts:
ittham abhyasyamānās te parāṃ vairāgyasampadam /
pratikṣaṇam upāruhya nimīlanti tadāhatāḥ // [AgMsv_1.234]
mv-k02-v233.quick_english: Thus practicing, they ascend the supreme wealth of detachment every moment and close, struck by that.

mv-k02-v234.label: AgMsv_1.235
cite_parts:
kim etad iti dhāvanti duḥkhe 'pīndriyavṛttayaḥ /
etad evam iti prāyo virajyante sukhād api // [AgMsv_1.235]
mv-k02-v234.quick_english: Even sense-faculties rush toward suffering, yet mostly turn away from pleasure.

tokens.grounds: root dhāv third plural active present
root viraj third plural middle present

mv-k02-v235.label: AgMsv_1.236
cite_parts:
dṛṣṭānuśravikārthaughavaitṛṣṇye vaśatādhiyaḥ /
tatparaṃ puruṣakhyāter guṇavaitṛṣṇyam ity api // [AgMsv_1.236]
mv-k02-v235.quick_english: With controlled mind, desirelessness toward seen and heard objects leads to desirelessness toward guṇas through knowledge of puruṣa.

mv-k02-v236.label: AgMsv_1.237
cite_parts:
nanv akāṇḍe 'pi pṛcchāmaḥ kiṃ cid yadi na kupyate /
* kim akāṇḍe bhedakāṇḍabhedakāṇḍaghaṭāvadhau // [AgMsv_1.237]
mv-k02-v236.quick_english: We ask, even without cause, what happens if anger does not arise, and what of the division-boundary.

tokens.grounds: root pṛcch first plural active present
root kup third singular passive present

mv-k02-v237.label: AgMsv_1.238
cite_parts:
tarhi saṃvid iyaṃ śuddhā svabhāvād eva cet katham /
aśucibhyo 'pi bhogebhyo rasāt spṛhayatetarām // [AgMsv_1.238]
mv-k02-v237.quick_english: If this consciousness is pure by nature, how does it exceedingly desire taste from impure enjoyments?

tokens.grounds: root spṛh third singular active optative

mv-k02-v238.label: AgMsv_1.239
cite_parts:
nanv avismṛtiśīlatvābhimānaḥ kvādhunā gataḥ /
alaṃ vā buddhyupālabdhair uktam apy etad ucyate // [AgMsv_1.239]
mv-k02-v238.quick_english: Where has pride in the habit of non-forgetting gone now? Enough, or even this is said with intellect's reproaches.

tokens.grounds: root vac third singular passive present

mv-k02-v239.label: AgMsv_1.240
cite_parts:
svabhāvād eva saṃvittiḥ prakāśaparamārthikā /
viśvāvabhāsayogena bhātīti hi vipañcitam // [AgMsv_1.240]
mv-k02-v239.quick_english: Consciousness is supremely real and luminous by nature; by union with world-illumination it appears, as explained.

tokens.grounds: root bhā third singular active present plus iti

mv-k02-v240.label: AgMsv_1.241
cite_parts:
ataś ca saṃvido devyā viśvasmin bhāvamaṇḍale /
svātmany evocchalattvaṃ kiṃ khaṇḍanādāyi jāyate // [AgMsv_1.241]
mv-k02-v240.quick_english: Therefore, in the world-circle of the consciousness-goddess, what arises from refutation in her rising within her own self?

tokens.grounds: root jan third singular active present

mv-k02-v241.label: AgMsv_1.242
cite_parts:
yadāpi parameśānaśaktyā bhedo 'vabhāsyate /
tadāpi saṃvid bhāveṣu dhāvatīti vivicyate // [AgMsv_1.242]
mv-k02-v241.quick_english: Even when difference is manifested by the supreme lord's power, consciousness runs in beings and is distinguished.

tokens.grounds: root bhā third singular passive present
root dhāv third singular active present plus iti
root vic third singular passive present

mv-k02-v242.label: AgMsv_1.243
cite_parts:
yathā loṣṭahradajvālāśvāsakumbhaviyatsthitiḥ /
dharāmbudhimahātejaḥsamīrānantakhātmatām // [AgMsv_1.243]
mv-k02-v242.quick_english: As the state of clod, pool, flame, breath, pot, and sky, so earth, ocean, great fire, wind, and infinite sky nature.

mv-k02-v243.label: AgMsv_1.244
cite_parts:
yāty eva mitirūpeyaṃ saṃvit svocchalitā kramāt /
saṃvidrūpasajātīyān bhāvān evānudhāvati // [AgMsv_1.244]
mv-k02-v243.quick_english: This measure-formed consciousness, risen in itself, gradually follows beings of the same consciousness-formed class.

tokens.grounds: root yā third singular active present
root dhāv third singular active present

mv-k02-v244.label: AgMsv_1.245
cite_parts:
nyarūpyata tathā caitat kenāpi parameśinā /
nimnaṃ taḍāgapānīyaṃ kaḥ pravartayituṃ kṣamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.245]
mv-k02-v244.quick_english: Just as this was shaped by some supreme lord, who is able to set low pond-water in motion?

mv-k02-v245.label: AgMsv_1.246
cite_parts:
paripūrṇe punas tasmin pravāhāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ /
nanu kiṃ kāṃś cid evetthaṃ saiṣā svaniyater balāt // [AgMsv_1.246]
mv-k02-v245.quick_english: When that is full, streams flow in every direction; indeed, what and which ones flow thus by the force of their own nature?

mv-k02-v246.label: AgMsv_1.247
cite_parts:
itthaṃ dhāvati tac cāsyā rāgatattvātmakaṃ vapuḥ /
tatrāpi ca tathā rāgābhāsa eva sa dhāryatām // [AgMsv_1.247]
