mv-k02-v246.quick_english: Thus that runs, and her body is the essence of attachment; there too only a reflection of attachment should be held.

mv-k02-v247.label: AgMsv_1.248
cite_parts:
cidātmani tu rāgo 'stu ko 'py anyārūṣaṇātmakaḥ /
nanv itthaṃ cet kathaṃ nāma sā kutrāpi virajyate // [AgMsv_1.248]
mv-k02-v247.quick_english: But let attachment exist in the conscious self, even of another color; if so, how indeed can she become detached anywhere?

mv-k02-v248.label: AgMsv_1.249
cite_parts:
hanta prakṛta evāyaṃ vādaḥ saṃgatim āgataḥ /
yadā hi citir evaiṣā sarvataḥ saṃkucatsthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.249]
mv-k02-v248.quick_english: Alas, this original argument has reached agreement: when consciousness itself is in a contracted state everywhere.

mv-k02-v249.label: AgMsv_1.250
cite_parts:
krameṇa bhogopāyebhyo bhogyebhyo dehato bhujaḥ /
bhogād bhoktus tathā śūnyā mahāpralayabhāg iva // [AgMsv_1.250]
mv-k02-v249.quick_english: Gradually from means of enjoyment, objects, and body, the enjoyer becomes empty like a part of great dissolution.

mv-k02-v250.label: AgMsv_1.251
cite_parts:
jāyate rudrarūpaiṣā daśā sāṃhārikī yataḥ /
sadyojātaś ca yad rudraḥ puruṣaś ceśvarātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.251]
mv-k02-v250.quick_english: This destructive state arises in Rudra form because Sadyojata, Rudra, and Purusha are lord-natured.

mv-k02-v251.label: AgMsv_1.252
cite_parts:
śrīmān sadāśivo deva īśānaś ceti gīyate /
viṣṇur vāmaḥ kajy aghora iti caitad bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_1.252]
mv-k02-v251.quick_english: Glorious Sadashiva, Deva, and Ishana are sung; Vishnu, Vama, Kajy, and Aghora will also be.

mv-k02-v252.label: AgMsv_1.253
cite_parts:
antaḥsthasarvaśaktitvenaikaikasyāpi bṛṃhaṇāt /
brahmāṇy etāni kathyante bṛhattvād viśvabṛṃhaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.253]
mv-k02-v252.quick_english: Because each has all power within, these Brahmas are called so by expansion, greatness, and universal expansion.

mv-k02-v253.label: AgMsv_1.254
cite_parts:
tadanyaśaktyudrekāṃśe hy ata eva vivakṣite /
pratyekam asti brahmādihetupañcakayogitā // [AgMsv_1.254]
mv-k02-v253.quick_english: Indeed, when other power is in excess and intended, each has a five-cause union.

mv-k02-v254.label: AgMsv_1.255
cite_parts:
saiva śāstreṣu bhedena teṣu teṣu pratanyate /
ataś ca sadyojāte 'smin mukhyā raudradaśā sthitā // [AgMsv_1.255]
mv-k02-v254.quick_english: That same power spreads distinctly in scriptures; therefore the primary fierce state stands in sadyojata.

mv-k02-v255.label: AgMsv_1.256
cite_parts:
sā ca saṃkocarūpāpi cidvikāse bhaviṣyati /
yallīnau brahmaviṣṇvaṃśau tenādhaḥkurute balāt // [AgMsv_1.256]
mv-k02-v255.quick_english: Even in contracted form it will be in consciousness expansion; the absorbed brahma and vishnu parts are forcibly lowered.

mv-k02-v256.label: AgMsv_1.257
cite_parts:
vastvabhāvamayītyādidaśā rudrādhidevatā /
bhinnaprameyeti śrīmadutpalena nyarūpyata // [AgMsv_1.257]
mv-k02-v256.quick_english: The state of absence of thing is the rudra presiding deity; it was described as a distinct object by Srimad Utpala.

mv-k02-v257.label: AgMsv_1.258
cite_parts:
jāto 'pi bhedatanmātre saṃkocaṃ yad upāgataḥ /
tato vyatinimīlete bhoktṛbhogyāv iha sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.258]
mv-k02-v257.quick_english: Even when born in mere distinction, contraction is approached; then enjoyer and enjoyed are clearly exchanged here.

mv-k02-v258.label: AgMsv_1.259
cite_parts:
ajātam iva tad viśvam atra sadyo 'vabhāsate /
sadyojātapadaṃ tena śūnyasaṃvedanātmakam // [AgMsv_1.259]
mv-k02-v258.quick_english: That universe appears here immediately as if unborn; therefore the sadyojata term is of empty consciousness nature.

mv-k02-v259.label: AgMsv_1.260
cite_parts:
tataḥ śūnyapadasyāntar yāvat sa ca vivikṣati /
devas tāvat svayaṃ bodhe viśvaṃ procchalati sthitam // [AgMsv_1.260]
mv-k02-v259.quick_english: As long as he wishes to distinguish within the empty term, the god himself makes the universe rise, standing in awareness.

mv-k02-v260.label: AgMsv_1.259
cite_parts:
jānāti seyaṃ nāthasya jñānaśaktir vikāsinī /
tayor vikāsiciddhāmni līnatvam upapāditam // [AgMsv_1.259]
mv-k02-v260.quick_english: This expanding knowledge-power of the lord knows; absorption in the expanded consciousness abode is established for those two.

mv-k02-v261.label: AgMsv_1.262
cite_parts:
saṃvidaḥ śūnyarūpāyā vikāso viśvam eva tat /
tathā hi ghanasauṣuptaviśrāntivaśanirbharaḥ // [AgMsv_1.262]
mv-k02-v261.quick_english: The expansion of empty-form consciousness is indeed the universe; for it is full of deep sleep rest.

mv-k02-v262.label: AgMsv_1.263
cite_parts:
tāṃs tān gṛhāpaṇādyaṃśān vetti svapnapadābhidhān /
ata eva na sā sṛṣṭiḥ sthitir eva tu sā tathā // [AgMsv_1.263]
mv-k02-v262.quick_english: Those house and shop parts called dream state are known; therefore that is not creation but maintenance.

mv-k02-v263.label: AgMsv_1.264
cite_parts:
pūrvasṛṣṭeṣu bhāveṣu tad dhi vijñānamātrakam /
tathā ca jāgrato rūpāt svapno bhedena jāyate // [AgMsv_1.264]
mv-k02-v263.quick_english: In previously created beings that is indeed mere consciousness; thus dream arises by distinction from waking form.

mv-k02-v264.label: AgMsv_1.265
cite_parts:
kiṃtu jāgratpadādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ bahubhedatā /
nirṇeṣyate tato yuktaṃ sṛṣṭirūpeṇa bhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.265]
mv-k02-v264.quick_english: But the waking state and the others each have many divisions, which will be determined later; therefore it is fitting that their shining forth takes the form of emanation.

tokens.grounds: adverb of consequence; sandhi form of tataḥ

mv-k02-v265.label: AgMsv_1.266
cite_parts:
ato nijavibodhena tān bhāvān vyāpnuvan vibhuḥ /
etais tyājayate tāṃ svām audāsīnyadaśāṃ vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.266]
mv-k02-v265.quick_english: Therefore, pervading those entities by his own awareness, the Lord causes that state of indifference of his to be abandoned through them.

tokens.grounds: adverb of consequence; sandhi form of ataḥ

mv-k02-v266.label: AgMsv_1.267
cite_parts:
jñānaśakter iyaṃ jṛmbhā tajjñānasthitibhāvinaḥ /
bhāvāḥ prayānti pūrṇatvaṃ vikāsinijatejasaḥ // [AgMsv_1.267]
mv-k02-v266.quick_english: This is the expansion of the power of knowledge: entities abiding in the state of that knowledge attain fullness, with their own radiance unfolding.

mv-k02-v267.label: AgMsv_1.268
cite_parts:
paramaḥ khalu saṃkocaḥ sadyojātapade bhavet /
yad eṣāṃ svasvarūpasya niṣṭhā naiva sma jāyate // [AgMsv_1.268]
mv-k02-v267.quick_english: At the level of Sadyojāta there would indeed be supreme contraction, because firm abiding in their own nature does not arise for them.

mv-k02-v268.label: AgMsv_1.269
cite_parts:
vinā saṃvidupārohaṃ sattāsattā jaḍo 'jaḍaḥ /
anīlaṃ nīlam ityādivyavasthā kalpatāṃ katham // [AgMsv_1.269]
mv-k02-v268.quick_english: Without rising into consciousness, how could distinctions like existence and nonexistence, inert and non-inert, or blue and non-blue ever be established?

tokens.grounds: negated quality; sandhi elision marked by apostrophe

mv-k02-v269.label: AgMsv_1.270
cite_parts:
yad uvācotpalagurur yathā sadasatāṃ tathā /
jaḍājaḍānāṃ na svātmaviśeṣa iti niścitam // [AgMsv_1.270]
mv-k02-v269.quick_english: As Utpalaguru said, just as the existent and the nonexistent have no intrinsic difference in their own nature, so too the inert and the non-inert do not; this is firmly established.

tokens.grounds: compound: spoke + Utpalaguru; sandhi fusion in form

mv-k02-v270.label: AgMsv_1.271
cite_parts:
tasmād bodhabharollāsavisṛṣṭasvaparasthitim /
cidanuprāṇanāṃ viṣvag vamann ānandasundarām // [AgMsv_1.271]
mv-k02-v270.quick_english: Therefore, consciousness, in the fullness of its awareness, releases the states of self and other, and everywhere emits an animation of consciousness that is beautiful with bliss.

tokens.grounds: long compound: awareness-fullness + blossoming + emitted + own-other + state

mv-k02-v271.label: AgMsv_1.272
cite_parts:
cidekavapuṣā viśvaṃ svīcikīrṣaṃś cidātmani /
svabodhaśaktivamanāt sa devo vāma ucyate // [AgMsv_1.272]
mv-k02-v271.quick_english: That God, whose one body is consciousness, desiring to make the universe his own within the self of consciousness by emitting his own power of awareness, is called Vāma.

tokens.grounds: compound: consciousness + one + body; instrumental manner
object desired to be made own
compound: consciousness + self; locus of emission
name of the deity in this aspect

mv-k02-v272.label: AgMsv_1.273
cite_parts:
svabodhaśaktyudrekeṇa yady apy eṣa prayacchati /
bhāvānāṃ svavapus tādṛk tathāpi paramārthataḥ // [AgMsv_1.273]
mv-k02-v272.quick_english: Although, by the surge of his own power of awareness, this deity bestows such a form upon beings, nevertheless, in ultimate truth, the matter stands otherwise.

tokens.grounds: compound: own-awareness + power + surge; instrumental cause
first part of concessive; sandhi before apy
second part of concessive with yady
act of granting form to beings

mv-k02-v273.label: AgMsv_1.274
cite_parts:
svīkartum icchan saṃhāram eṣāṃ kalpayate bhidaḥ /
ato bhedavyavasthāyāṃ vāmo 'sau parameśvaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.274]
mv-k02-v273.quick_english: Desiring to take back these beings into himself, he constructs their divisions; therefore, in the arrangement of difference, this supreme lord is called Vāma.

tokens.grounds: refers to the beings or distinctions
compound: difference + arrangement; locus of the name
name of the supreme lord in this function
demonstrative; sandhi elision marked by apostrophe

mv-k02-v274.label: AgMsv_1.275
cite_parts:
atra saubhāgyaniḥṣyandi tādṛg jñānaṃ pratāyate /
saubhāgyaṃ socyate teṣāṃ bhinnānāṃ svīkriyaiva yā // [AgMsv_1.275]
mv-k02-v274.quick_english: Here such knowledge spreads; fortune is called the acceptance of distinct beings.

mv-k02-v275.label: AgMsv_1.276
cite_parts:
bhāvānāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ bhogāṅgānāṃ svaśaktitaḥ /
svakautukakalālokād ucchalanty eva yā citiḥ // [AgMsv_1.276]
mv-k02-v275.quick_english: Consciousness springs up from its own power and playful glimpse among varied beings.

mv-k02-v276.label: AgMsv_1.277
cite_parts:
saiva svabhāvarāgeṇa viśvaṃ rañjayate yataḥ /
vyakto hi rañjayed viśvaṃ vyaktiś cāsya svarūpataḥ // [AgMsv_1.277]
mv-k02-v276.quick_english: That same consciousness colors the universe by nature, since manifestation is its own form.

mv-k02-v277.label: AgMsv_1.278
cite_parts:
yaiva procchalitāvasthā svīkārecchābharodayaḥ /
tadraśmisārasarvasve kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhaty ananyadhīḥ // [AgMsv_1.278]
mv-k02-v277.quick_english: The risen state of acceptance-desire stands for a moment in ray-essence wealth with undivided mind.

mv-k02-v278.label: AgMsv_1.279
cite_parts:
kiṃ nākarṣati kiṃ naiṣa ca bhāvayati yogavit /
tata evocyate śāstre nārakto rañjayed iti // [AgMsv_1.279]
mv-k02-v278.quick_english: What does the yoga-knower not attract or manifest? Scripture says the uncolored does not color.

mv-k02-v279.label: AgMsv_1.280
cite_parts:
kāmasthaṃ kāmamadhyasthaṃ kāmāṅkuśapuṭīkṛtam /
kāmena sādhayet kāmān kāmaṃ kāmeṣu yojayet // [AgMsv_1.280]
mv-k02-v279.quick_english: Desire, placed and goad-enclosed, should accomplish desires and yoke them into desires.

mv-k02-v280.label: AgMsv_1.281
cite_parts:
kāmaḥ svīkartum icchaiva tadācchādanayogataḥ /
viśvaṃ sādhayate kāmī kāmatattvam idaṃ yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.281]
mv-k02-v280.quick_english: Desire is acceptance-desire; by covering union the desirer accomplishes the universe, because this is desire-principle.

mv-k02-v281.label: AgMsv_1.282
cite_parts:
tathā hi parame svātmany adhyāsya sthairyam añjasā /
taducchalitasaṃbodhakalāsaṃchādanakramāt // [AgMsv_1.282]
mv-k02-v281.quick_english: Thus in the supreme self, steadiness is directly superimposed through the covering order of risen awareness.

mv-k02-v282.label: AgMsv_1.283
cite_parts:
viśvaṃ kāmāṅkuśādhīnaṃ kiṃkaratvena bhāsate /
adhyātmasiddhayā yuktyā tv anayaiva nijodaye // [AgMsv_1.283]
mv-k02-v282.quick_english: The universe appears as servant under the desire-goad; by inner accomplishment method, this is understood in its own rise.

mv-k02-v283.label: AgMsv_1.284
cite_parts:
prāṇaḥ puryaṣṭakaṃ dehaṃ vyāpya viśvaṃ prakarṣati /
tattvasya kāmatattvasya prakaṭīkriyayā yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.284]
mv-k02-v283.quick_english: Life-force pervades body and eightfold city, drawing the universe because desire-principle manifests.

mv-k02-v284.label: AgMsv_1.285
cite_parts:
siddhacakreṣv idaṃ gopyaṃ kiṃ vā na prakaṭīkṛtam /
śūnyānandāt prasṛtyaiva devaḥ procchalitātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.285]
mv-k02-v284.quick_english: Whether this secret is manifested in siddha circles, god spreads from void-bliss as risen-natured.

mv-k02-v285.label: AgMsv_1.286
cite_parts:
vartamāno nijāḥ śaktīr vikāsyaiva pravartate /
yatrāsya pravivikṣāsti yataś ca prāvṛtad vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.286]
mv-k02-v285.quick_english: Present, the lord proceeds by unfolding his own powers where he desires to enter, because the lord is covered.

mv-k02-v286.label: AgMsv_1.287
cite_parts:
sarvāḥ śaktīr asau bhāvaḥ svātmany udrecya vartate /
tataś cidātmako devo nyagbhūta iva bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.287]
mv-k02-v286.quick_english: That being remains after raising all powers in itself; then the consciousness-natured god appears as if submerged.

mv-k02-v287.label: AgMsv_1.288
cite_parts:
udbhūtās tu vibhānty etāḥ pronmeṣecchāvidikriyāḥ /
ataś catuṣkayukto 'sau yady api pratibhāsate // [AgMsv_1.288]
mv-k02-v287.quick_english: These arisen powers shine as opening, desire, knowledge, and action; therefore that being appears even though endowed with four.

mv-k02-v288.label: AgMsv_1.289
cite_parts:
tathāpi śaktigaṇanā vastuto 'sya bhavet kutaḥ /
atraiva bhāvabhedāṃśanirmūlanakalā yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.289]
mv-k02-v288.quick_english: Nevertheless, how could power-counting be real for it? Here only the art of uprooting parts of being-difference exists.

mv-k02-v289.label: AgMsv_1.290
cite_parts:
sthitas tataḥ samācāro lokātikrāntagocaraḥ /
anantaśaktivaicitryād atrāpy uccāṭanādayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.290]
mv-k02-v289.quick_english: Then conduct standing beyond world range occurs; from infinite power variety, uprooting and similar acts occur here too.

mv-k02-v290.label: AgMsv_1.291
cite_parts:
saṃhāralīlābhūyiṣṭhā api tās tāḥ kriyāḥ sthitāḥ /
tad itthaṃ jñānaśaktyante bhāvānāṃ vapuṣi sthite // [AgMsv_1.291]
mv-k02-v290.quick_english: Even dissolution-play-predominant actions are established thus at the end of knowledge-power, with beings' body established.

mv-k02-v291.label: AgMsv_1.292
cite_parts:
kriyāśaktir athāntyaiva tān saṃharati sādaram /
yathā sūkṣmatamā śaktir unmeṣākhyā parāvadhau // [AgMsv_1.292]
mv-k02-v291.quick_english: Then final action-power respectfully withdraws them, as the most subtle power called opening at the supreme limit.

mv-k02-v292.label: AgMsv_1.293
cite_parts:
sraṣṭavyabhāvasthaulyena sthūlākāreva bhāsate /
tathaivaiṣā kriyāśaktir yasyāṃ bhāvā nimeṣitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.293]
mv-k02-v292.quick_english: By created being grossness it appears as gross form; thus this action-power is that in which beings are closed.

mv-k02-v293.label: AgMsv_1.294
cite_parts:
svasvarūpasthitā kāpi pūrṇeva pravijṛmbhate /
nanv asty eva kriyā yasyāṃ bhedaḥ pratyavabhāsate // [AgMsv_1.294]
mv-k02-v293.quick_english: Some power established in its own form unfolds as if full; indeed there is action in which difference appears.

mv-k02-v294.label: AgMsv_1.295
cite_parts:
maivaṃ sarvā kriyā bhedaṃ praty uta prāg vyapohati /
tathā hi bhedabhūmau ye kāṣṭhajvalanataṇḍulāḥ // [AgMsv_1.295]
mv-k02-v294.quick_english: Not so: every action does not remove difference beforehand; thus on the ground of difference stand wood, fire, and rice.

mv-k02-v295.label: AgMsv_1.296
cite_parts:
ta eva pākāviṣṭatve bhedaṃ projjhanti sādaram /
yadi bhinnasvarūpās te pākaikyaṃ tat kathaṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.296]
mv-k02-v295.quick_english: Those very things abandon difference in the state of cooking; if their natures were different, how could cooking unity arise?

mv-k02-v296.label: AgMsv_1.297
cite_parts:
bhinnaṃ svarūpam aṅgānāṃ na hi yuktyopapadyate /
nanu pāko na kaś cit sa yat tan nānāsvarūpakam // [AgMsv_1.297]
mv-k02-v296.quick_english: A different own-form of the parts is not reasonable; indeed cooking is not any thing that is many-formed.

mv-k02-v297.label: AgMsv_1.298
cite_parts:
jvalanakledadāhādi tat pāka iti śabdyate /
bhinnā eva kriyāḥ sarvāḥ phalam ekaṃ prati sthitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.298]
mv-k02-v297.quick_english: Burning, moistening, burning and so on is called cooking; all different actions are established toward one fruit.

mv-k02-v298.label: AgMsv_1.299
cite_parts:
pāka ity ucyate nānyā kriyā nāmāsti kācana /
etad eva kathaṃ bahvya ekaṃ phalam abhīpsitam // [AgMsv_1.299]
mv-k02-v298.quick_english: Cooking is said; no other action by name exists. How can many yield one desired fruit?

mv-k02-v299.label: AgMsv_1.300
cite_parts:
kathaṃ saṃpādayeyus tāḥ. pūrvoktād eva hetutaḥ /
nanu locanadīpārthamanaskārair api sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.300]
mv-k02-v299.quick_english: How would those accomplish it from the previously stated cause? Indeed, by eye, lamp, meaning, and mind-efforts, it is clearly so.

mv-k02-v300.label: AgMsv_1.301
cite_parts:
janyate jñānam ekaṃ tat tathaivātra bhaviṣyati /
so 'yaṃ kardamasaṃmardamalinībhūtavigrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.301]
mv-k02-v300.quick_english: One knowledge is born; so here it will be. That is this body become dirty through kneading mud.

mv-k03-v301.label: AgMsv_1.302
cite_parts:
marau marīcikāmbhobhiḥ snānecchur abhidhāvati /
bhinnasvarūpād yady ekam asti vastv iti saṃbhavaḥ // [AgMsv_1.302]
mv-k03-v301.quick_english: A traveler runs toward mirage water in a desert; if one thing exists despite different forms, possibility is questioned.

mv-k03-v302.label: AgMsv_1.303
cite_parts:
tarhi kāraṇabhedena na bhedaḥ pāramārthikaḥ /
atha bhinnasvarūpaṃ tad ekaṃ cety upagamyate // [AgMsv_1.303]
mv-k03-v302.quick_english: Then difference is not ultimate by cause-difference; but if different form is accepted as one, the issue remains.

mv-k03-v303.label: AgMsv_1.304
cite_parts:
svabhāvabhedo bhedāyety etat tyaktaṃ vrataṃ bhavet /
nanv itthaṃ sā kriyā mā bhūd ekā kāṣṭhādi kārakam // [AgMsv_1.304]
mv-k03-v303.quick_english: Nature-difference would lead to difference; if that is abandoned, the vow is broken. Thus action should not be one agent like wood.

mv-k03-v304.label: AgMsv_1.305
cite_parts:
phalaṃ janayatām evam apy astu na hi naḥ kṣatiḥ /
kriyā hi nāma nāsmākam anyā śaktis tv asau yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.305]
mv-k03-v304.quick_english: Let fruit be produced even so; there is no harm to us, because action is not another power.

mv-k03-v305.label: AgMsv_1.306
cite_parts:
śaktiś ca phalabhitkḷptyā bhāvātmaivāvibhedataḥ /
sā ca śaktir vibhor eva sa ca viśvātmavigrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.306]
mv-k03-v305.quick_english: Power arises by fruit-piercing arrangement from non-difference of being and self; that power is the lord's, and he is world-self-form.

mv-k03-v306.label: AgMsv_1.307
cite_parts:
phalakārakabhedena na bhinnā paramārthataḥ /
svātmany abhinne 'pi vibhor evaṃ bhedāvabhāsanāt // [AgMsv_1.307]
mv-k03-v306.quick_english: By fruit and agent difference, power is not ultimately different; even in the lord's undifferentiated self, difference appears.

mv-k03-v307.label: AgMsv_1.308
cite_parts:
kriyāśaktir iti proktā yayā kartā maheśvaraḥ /
nanu yat paśavaḥ kuryuḥ kathaṃ tad upapadyatām // [AgMsv_1.308]
mv-k03-v307.quick_english: Action-power is called that by which the great lord is agent; but how can bound souls act? Let that be explained.

mv-k03-v308.label: AgMsv_1.309
cite_parts:
te hi bhedaikajīvatvāt kuryur bhedavatīṃ kriyām /
alam etena paśavaḥ kathaṃ kuryur iti sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.309]
mv-k03-v308.quick_english: They, from having one life in difference, would perform differentiated action; enough of this, how bound souls act is clear.

mv-k03-v309.label: AgMsv_1.310
cite_parts:
sa eva svavacaśchinno vādo vandhyāsutādivat /
na hi kumbhakṛtaḥ kvāpi kadācit kartṛtā bhavet // [AgMsv_1.310]
mv-k03-v309.quick_english: That self-contradictory statement is like a barren woman's son; agency is never found in a pot-maker.

mv-k03-v310.label: AgMsv_1.311
cite_parts:
yadi nāsau maheśākhyāt kartur avyatirekabhāk /
nanu kiṃ svit kulālena kumbho 'pi kriyate tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.311]
mv-k03-v310.quick_english: If that is not non-different from the agent called great lord, then what is made by the potter? Is the pot made by the potter?

mv-k03-v311.label: AgMsv_1.312
cite_parts:
īśasya viśvakartṛtve kiṃ paṭe 'pi na kartṛtā /
yady evaṃ tat kulālena paṭo 'pi kriyate na kim // [AgMsv_1.312]
mv-k03-v311.quick_english: If the lord has world-agency, is there no agency in cloth? If so, cloth too is not made by the potter.

mv-k03-v312.label: AgMsv_1.313
cite_parts:
nanv evaṃ sati no kartā ko 'py anya iti karmaṇām /
śubhāśubhānāṃ svaphalaṃ kartuṃ kaṃ prati hetutā // [AgMsv_1.313]
mv-k03-v312.quick_english: If so, there is no other agent; for auspicious and inauspicious actions, toward whom is causality for producing their own fruit?

mv-k03-v313.label: AgMsv_1.314
cite_parts:
evam evaitad āyuṣmaṃs tathāhy evaṃ vijānatām /
na kiṃ cana phalaṃ kvāpi śubhāśubhasamudbhavam // [AgMsv_1.314]
mv-k03-v313.quick_english: Thus it is, venerable one; for those who know thus, no fruit arises anywhere, auspicious or inauspicious.

mv-k03-v314.label: AgMsv_1.315
cite_parts:
itthaṃ ye tu na jānanti bhuñjate te 'vipaścitaḥ /
tad eva karmasaṃjñaṃ tu malam ajñānamūlakam // [AgMsv_1.315]
mv-k03-v314.quick_english: Those who do not know thus enjoy; they are unwise. That very thing called action is impurity rooted in ignorance.

mv-k03-v315.label: AgMsv_1.316
cite_parts:
etad evānumanyaiva kecit saṃvittimātrakam /
saṃmanyante hy akartāraṃ kartṛtvānupapattitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.316]
mv-k03-v315.quick_english: Approving this only, some consider consciousness-only, indeed a non-agent, because agency is impossible.

mv-k03-v316.label: AgMsv_1.317
cite_parts:
citsvarūpādhikaṃ hy asya yat tat kartṛtvam ucyate /
taj jāḍyam arpayed asmai cidādhikyaprasaṅgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.317]
mv-k03-v316.quick_english: Consciousness-form is superior; that is called agency. From consciousness-superiority, inertness would be attributed to this.

mv-k03-v317.label: AgMsv_1.318
cite_parts:
prakṛteḥ kartṛtā puṃsi nanu nāmopacaryate /
etan nyāyapathāpetair vṛthā jegīyate gṛhe // [AgMsv_1.318]
mv-k03-v317.quick_english: Nature's agency in a person is indeed metaphorically called; those departed from the path of logic vainly debate this in the house.

mv-k03-v318.label: AgMsv_1.319
cite_parts:
upacāro hi no vastutathātvaṃ pratipadyate /
vyapadeśaḥ paraṃ tādṛg vastuśūnyo 'stu tāvatā // [AgMsv_1.319]
mv-k03-v318.quick_english: Figurative usage does not reach the real nature of a thing; such a designation may be empty of reality, so it cannot establish real agency.

mv-k03-v319.label: AgMsv_1.320
cite_parts:
nopacārikavahnitvavyapadeśe 'pi mānavaḥ /
himānīśīkarāsārivātotthaśiśirāpahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.320]
mv-k03-v319.quick_english: Even if someone were called fire only figuratively, he would not remove the cold caused by snow, hail, showers, and wind.

mv-k03-v320.label: AgMsv_1.321
cite_parts:
draṣṭuḥ puṃsaś ca na draṣṭrī prakṛtiḥ parigīyate /
na cānyo 'sti varāko 'taḥ kartṛbhāvopacārakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.321]
mv-k03-v320.quick_english: Prakṛti is not called the seer of the self, and there is no other candidate left; so there is no one to whom agency could even be figuratively assigned.

tokens.grounds: subject of second clause; sandhi ca+anyaḥ

mv-k03-v321.label: AgMsv_1.322
cite_parts:
kiṃ ca prayojanaṃ tasya kartṛtvavyavahārajam /
vyapadeśas tu nāvastu parivartayituṃ kṣamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.322]
mv-k03-v321.quick_english: What purpose is served by talk of agency if it is only figurative? Such a designation need not be real and can simply be changed.

mv-k03-v322.label: AgMsv_1.323
cite_parts:
ye 'py ātmānaṃ nayavidaḥ kartāraṃ samupāgaman /
te 'pi praśnam imaṃ tāvad asmākaṃ pratibhārpitam // [AgMsv_1.323]
mv-k03-v322.quick_english: Even those who, following their doctrine, accept the self as an agent must first answer this question that we put to them.

mv-k03-v323.label: AgMsv_1.324
cite_parts:
kiṃ yādṛglokasaṃsiddhakartṛtvaṃ karmayogataḥ /
spandātma tad vibhau spandahīne samupapadyate // [AgMsv_1.324]
mv-k03-v323.quick_english: Can the kind of agency known from ordinary action, which involves vibration, really belong to an all-pervading self that has no vibration?

mv-k03-v324.label: AgMsv_1.325
cite_parts:
nanu jñānaṃ cikīrṣā ca yatnaś ceti guṇatrayam /
samavaiti yad atrāsya tat kartṛtvam udāhṛtam // [AgMsv_1.325]
mv-k03-v324.quick_english: The objection is: knowledge, desire to act, and effort form a triad belonging to the self, and that is what is called agency.

tokens.grounds: third member of triad; sandhi yatnaḥ
appositive to the three; compound = guṇa+traya

mv-k03-v325.label: AgMsv_1.326
cite_parts:
itthaṃ bālamatīnāṃ dhīr vipralabhyeta vañcakaiḥ /
dārakā api vā vidyur na saṃvedanavarjitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.326]
mv-k03-v325.quick_english: This kind of reasoning might deceive the childish, but even children are not without awareness.

mv-k03-v326.label: AgMsv_1.327
cite_parts:
tatra jñānaṃ na kartṛtvaṃ sarvatrāsty eva tad yataḥ /
icchāyatnāv api prāyaḥ saṃstaḥ sarvasya sarvataḥ // [AgMsv_1.327]
mv-k03-v326.quick_english: Knowledge is not agency, since it is present everywhere; and desire and effort too are generally found in everyone, so their mere presence does not amount to agency.

mv-k03-v327.label: AgMsv_1.328
cite_parts:
kumbhakāro gṛhābhāvaparitāpitacetanaḥ /
jānann icchan sayatno 'pi kiṃ kuryān nātmano gṛham // [AgMsv_1.328]
mv-k03-v327.quick_english: A potter distressed by not having a house may know, want, and try, yet still be unable to make a house for himself.

mv-k03-v328.label: AgMsv_1.329
cite_parts:
nanu kartuṃ na jānāti tataḥ kartuṃ na cecchati /
tasmāt kartuṃ na yatate tad gṛhaṃ kurutāṃ kathaṃ // [AgMsv_1.329]
mv-k03-v328.quick_english: The objection says: he does not know how to do it, so he does not want to do it and does not try; then how could he make the house?

mv-k03-v329.label: AgMsv_1.330
cite_parts:
kartum ity eva yad rūpaṃ jñānādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam /
karotes tatra ko 'rthaḥ syād yadi saspandatā kila // [AgMsv_1.330]
mv-k03-v329.quick_english: If knowledge, desire, and effort are qualified by 'to do', what does that qualifier mean? Does it mean having vibration?

tokens.grounds: genitive of the verbal root sense; sandhi karoteḥ

mv-k03-v330.label: AgMsv_1.331
cite_parts:
tadāsau spandituṃ vetti prepsatīti bhaved vacaḥ /
tac ca svātmagataṃ nāsya spanditaṃ vaibhavodbhavāt // [AgMsv_1.331]
mv-k03-v330.quick_english: If 'to do' meant vibration, the statement would be that he knows and wants to vibrate; but such vibration cannot belong to an all-pervading self.

mv-k03-v331.label: AgMsv_1.332
cite_parts:
anyad aspanditaṃ jñānaṃ śarvasyāpi na saṃbhavet /
jñānecchāyatnavattvaṃ ca karaṇaṃ tasya bhāṣitam // [AgMsv_1.332]
mv-k03-v331.quick_english: A knowledge without vibration would not be possible even for Śiva, and merely having knowledge, desire, and effort has been described only as an instrument, not as true agency.

tokens.grounds: subject of second clause; compound = jñāna+icchā+yatna+vattva

mv-k03-v332.label: AgMsv_1.333
cite_parts:
ātmanaḥ kartum ity asya tato 'rthapravivecane /
jānātīcchan prayatate jñātuṃ yatitum eṣitum // [AgMsv_1.333]
mv-k03-v332.quick_english: When we analyze the meaning of 'the self is to do', it comes down to knowing, desiring, and striving — even striving to know, to desire, and to strive.

mv-k03-v333.label: AgMsv_1.334
cite_parts:
pratyekam iti yo 'rthaḥ sa kartuṃ vettīti śabditaḥ /
cikīrṣitṛtvaṃ caitat syān na kartṛtvaṃ punar bhavet // [AgMsv_1.334]
mv-k03-v333.quick_english: Taken one by one, this analysis amounts to knowing to do and wanting to do; that makes one a desirer to act, but not truly an agent.

tokens.grounds: subject of result clause; compound = cikīrṣitṛ+tva
verb of result clause; sandhi syāt

mv-k03-v334.label: AgMsv_1.335
cite_parts:
tathātve mānasaiḥ sāmyaṃ bhaved vākkāyakarmaṇām /
vākkāyakarmabhir vāsya kathaṃ kartṛtvam āpatet // [AgMsv_1.335]
mv-k03-v334.quick_english: If that were so, speech and bodily actions would be wrongly equated with mental ones; or else how could agency in speech and body belong to the same agent?

tokens.grounds: instrumental in second question; compound = vāc+kāya+karman

mv-k03-v335.label: AgMsv_1.336
cite_parts:
mānasāny api karmāṇi kathaṃ tasyeti gīyatām /
tadguṇatrayasadbhāve manovākkāyasambhuvām // [AgMsv_1.336]
mv-k03-v335.quick_english: Even if that triad is present, explain how mental actions — and likewise actions arising from mind, speech, and body — can truly belong to him.

mv-k03-v336.label: AgMsv_1.337
cite_parts:
karmaṇāṃ saṃciter eṣa karmabhāgīti cen nanu /
upacāro 'yam evaṃ syāt sa cāvastv iti varṇitam // [AgMsv_1.337]
mv-k03-v336.quick_english: If one says the self is the sharer of accumulated actions, that too would be only figurative usage — and that has already been shown to be inadequate.

tokens.grounds: ablative/genitive sense in compound context; sandhi saṃciteḥ
predicate with quotation; compound = karman+bhāgin + iti

mv-k03-v337.label: AgMsv_1.338
cite_parts:
kiṃ cātmagamahattvādidravyāntaguṇasaṃnidhau /
tāni santīti kiṃ so 'pi kartṛtvāyatano bhavet // [AgMsv_1.338]
mv-k03-v337.quick_english: Just because qualities such as motion, greatness, and others are present in relation to the self, does that make the self a locus of agency?

mv-k03-v338.label: AgMsv_1.339
cite_parts:
na cāstv ity upagantavyaṃ muktāv api hi tad bhavet /
anyātmaguṇasāṃnidhye samaś caiṣa vidhir yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.339]
mv-k03-v338.quick_english: That cannot be accepted, because then agency would arise even in liberation, and the same rule would apply when the qualities of another self are nearby.

mv-k03-v339.label: AgMsv_1.340
cite_parts:
ātmasv ataḥ pravarteran kṛtanāśākṛtāgamāḥ /
kiṃ ceśvareṇa sarvatra buddhimattāvyapekṣiṇi // [AgMsv_1.340]
mv-k03-v339.quick_english: Then, among selves, there would arise the faults of losing what has been done and gaining what has not been done; and what about the Lord's role in effects everywhere that require intelligence?

mv-k03-v340.label: AgMsv_1.341
cite_parts:
saṃniveśādhike kārye nimittatvaṃ kṛtaṃ yadi /
svaiḥ svaiś ca samavāyānyakāraṇāṃśaiḥ prapūrite // [AgMsv_1.341]
mv-k03-v340.quick_english: If efficient causality is assigned to the Lord in a complexly arranged effect, what happens when that effect is already fully supplied by its own inherent and other causal factors?

mv-k03-v341.label: AgMsv_1.342
cite_parts:
kam aṃśaṃ kumbhakārādeḥ prātuṃ bhavatu hetutā /
na hi so 'sty aṃśaleśo 'pi sarvakartari yaṃ prati // [AgMsv_1.342]
mv-k03-v341.quick_english: What partial contribution, like that of a potter, could be assigned as the Lord's causality? In the all-doer there is not even the slightest trace of such a partial role.

mv-k03-v342.label: AgMsv_1.343
cite_parts:
na jñānecchāyatnam asti kartṛtvaṃ nānyad ity api /
tasmān nānyasya kartṛtvaṃ kadācid api saṃbhavet // [AgMsv_1.343]
mv-k03-v342.quick_english: Agency is nothing other than knowledge, will, and effort; therefore no one else can ever possess true agency.

mv-k03-v343.label: AgMsv_1.344
cite_parts:
īśvarād īśvarasyāpi svātantryaṃ kartṛtāṃ viduḥ /
tad itthaṃ parameśānāṃ bhede bhede 'pi vātmanām // [AgMsv_1.344]
mv-k03-v343.quick_english: The wise understand that the Lord's autonomy is agency; thus, even amid the apparent differences of supreme lords or individual selves, agency is that same autonomy.

mv-k03-v344.label: AgMsv_1.345
cite_parts:
prabhavanti na karmāṇi bandhanāya svabhāvataḥ /
tasmād idam amuṣmāt syāt karmaṇo vā śubhāśubham // [AgMsv_1.345]
mv-k03-v344.quick_english: Actions do not bind by their own nature; therefore this good or bad result does not arise merely from that action.

mv-k03-v345.label: AgMsv_1.346
cite_parts:
tad aiśvaryam amuṣyaiva vihitaṃ parameśituḥ /
nirṇītam etad anyatra mayaiva vitataṃ yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.346]
mv-k03-v345.quick_english: That sovereignty belongs to the supreme Lord alone; this has been determined and I have explained it at length elsewhere.

mv-k03-v346.label: AgMsv_1.347
cite_parts:
tad alaṃ prakṛtaṃ brūmaḥ kriyāśaktir iyaṃ parā /
aghoratvena devasya tata eva prakīrtitā // [AgMsv_1.347]
mv-k03-v346.quick_english: Enough of that; returning to the topic, this supreme power of action of the Lord is proclaimed Aghorā because of its non-terrifying nature.

mv-k03-v347.label: AgMsv_1.348
cite_parts:
dākṣiṇyam ata evāsyā bhāvānāṃ śivasaṃśraye /
yato 'ñjasaiva mārgo 'yaṃ yā kriyā ca na sātmikā // [AgMsv_1.348]
mv-k03-v347.quick_english: Therefore this power is benevolent: for beings who take refuge in Śiva it makes the path direct, and its action is not confined to a limited self.

tokens.grounds: not limited to the self alone

mv-k03-v348.label: AgMsv_1.349
cite_parts:
nanu nātra sthitāḥ kecid bhāvā ye śivatāśritāḥ /
kartāraḥ satyam itthaṃ tu bodhyamāno 'vadhārayet // [AgMsv_1.349]
mv-k03-v348.quick_english: One may object that no beings here are established in Śiva-hood as agents; true, but the one being instructed should understand the matter properly.

tokens.grounds: abiding in the state of Śiva

mv-k03-v349.label: AgMsv_1.350
cite_parts:
deśakālakriyākārakalpanāpathavarjitaḥ /
devadevas tathaivāsya śaktiḥ sā viśvarūpiṇī // [AgMsv_1.350]
mv-k03-v349.quick_english: The Lord of gods is free from constructions of place, time, action, and form; likewise his power is of universal form.

mv-k03-v350.label: AgMsv_1.351
cite_parts:
tad viśvam api kālādikalaṅkāṅkakalojjhitam /
\hspace{3cm} bhairavābhedavartinam // [AgMsv_1.351]
mv-k03-v350.quick_english: That universe too is free from the stains of time and the rest, abiding in non-difference from Bhairava.

mv-k03-v351.label: AgMsv_1.352
cite_parts:
tatsvātantryāt svatantraṃ tat svātmani procchalat sthitam /
yato bhāti tato 'py astaśivāveśabahiṣkṛtam // [AgMsv_1.352]
mv-k03-v351.quick_english: By that autonomy it is autonomous, surging forth and abiding within itself; and because it shines, it is never excluded from immersion in Śiva.

mv-k03-v352.label: AgMsv_1.353
cite_parts:
ata eva parā seyaṃ dakṣiṇāghorarūpiṇī /
yad vakṣyate jantucakre śivadhāmaphalapradāḥ // [AgMsv_1.353]
mv-k03-v352.quick_english: Therefore this supreme power has the form of both Dakṣiṇā and Aghorā, since it will be said to grant beings the fruit of Śiva's abode.

mv-k03-v353.label: AgMsv_1.354
cite_parts:
parāḥ prakathitās tajjñair aghorāḥ śivaśaktayaḥ /
anyatrāpi kriyāśaktiḥ śivasya paśuvartinī // [AgMsv_1.354]
mv-k03-v353.quick_english: The knowers declare the supreme powers of Śiva to be Aghorā; and elsewhere Śiva's power of action operates within the bound soul.

tokens.grounds: present at the level of the limited being

mv-k03-v354.label: AgMsv_1.355
cite_parts:
bandhayitrī svamārgasthā jñātā siddhyupapādinī /
akārādihakārāntaḥ prasaro yaḥ pragīyate // [AgMsv_1.355]
mv-k03-v354.quick_english: Abiding in its own path it binds, but when known it brings accomplishment; it is proclaimed as the expansion from A to Ha.

mv-k03-v355.label: AgMsv_1.356
cite_parts:
sa eva bindunilayād asvaratvam upāśritaḥ /
kriyāśaktivijṛmbheyaṃ samastavarṇamālikā // [AgMsv_1.356]
mv-k03-v355.quick_english: That same expansion, proceeding from the abode of bindu and taking on non-vowel manifestation, is this unfolding of the power of action as the entire garland of letters.

mv-k03-v356.label: AgMsv_1.357
cite_parts:
kroḍīkṛtāv aham iti parāmarśasvarūpiṇī /
tiṣṭhaty eva. tataḥ pūrṇaparāhaṃkārasasphuraḥ // [AgMsv_1.357]
mv-k03-v356.quick_english: Embraced in the reflective awareness 'I', it abides there; from that arises the vivid flash of the full, supreme I-consciousness.

mv-k03-v357.label: AgMsv_1.358
cite_parts:
anantādiviriñcāntapaśusaṃghātaghasmaraḥ /
nijodaradarīnītacarācarajagadvrajaḥ // [AgMsv_1.358]
mv-k03-v357.quick_english: It devours the whole mass of bound souls from Ananta to Brahmā and draws the entire moving and unmoving world into the cave of its own belly.

tokens.grounds: consuming the whole range of limited beings

mv-k03-v358.label: AgMsv_1.359
cite_parts:
svacaitanyavimarśāntar grastapudgalasaṃcayaḥ /
yāvad ullasitas, tāvat kriyāśaktisvarūpataḥ // [AgMsv_1.359]
mv-k03-v358.quick_english: Having swallowed the aggregate of individuals within the reflective awareness of its own consciousness, as long as it flashes forth, it does so by the nature of the power of action.

mv-k03-v359.label: AgMsv_1.360
cite_parts:
asaṃvijñānaniḥsaṃkhyavaicitryacarcitasthiteḥ /
anantakāryaśāntyādisaumyaraudrabhidātmanaḥ // [AgMsv_1.360]
mv-k03-v359.quick_english: Its state is pervaded by countless unconscious varieties, and its nature is divided into gentle and fierce forms such as endless activity and peace.

mv-k03-v360.label: AgMsv_1.361
cite_parts:
api svagrāsamāhātmyaprakaṭīkṛtasusthiteḥ /
aucityād vividhākārā api bhairavatejasaḥ // [AgMsv_1.361]
mv-k03-v360.quick_english: Even though its firm state is revealed by the glory of its own reabsorption, the splendor of Bhairava, by appropriateness, takes on various forms.

mv-k03-v361.label: AgMsv_1.362
cite_parts:
riktapūrṇobhayabhavapunarāvṛtticitritāḥ /
śāktasvarūpaviśvākhyasvāṃśagrāsaikalampaṭāḥ // [AgMsv_1.362]
mv-k03-v361.quick_english: They are variegated by the recurrence of empty, full, and mixed states, and are solely intent on reabsorbing their own portion, called the universe, into the nature of Śakti.

mv-k03-v362.label: AgMsv_1.363
cite_parts:
lokakālacirārūḍhabhāvonmūlanabhāvitāḥ /
śaktayo nijavisphārād raśmipuñjaṃ nijaṃ nijaṃ // [AgMsv_1.363]
mv-k03-v362.quick_english: Conditioned to uproot states long rooted in world and time, the powers, from their own expansion, send forth each its own mass of rays.

mv-k03-v363.label: AgMsv_1.364
cite_parts:
prasārayantyaḥ saṃkalpasatyabhāvasamāśrayāt /
svocitāny eva lokotthavāmācārabahiṣkṛteḥ // [AgMsv_1.364]
mv-k03-v363.quick_english: Spreading forth, and relying on the true state of will, they manifest only what is fitting to them, in a way excluded from worldly left-hand practice.

mv-k03-v364.label: AgMsv_1.365
cite_parts:
ghaṭayanty eva śāstrāṇi yātāni paripūrṇatām /
yādṛk prathamasaṃbhūto lokātikrāntigocare // [AgMsv_1.365]
mv-k03-v364.quick_english: They bring about scriptures that attain fullness, just like the first-arisen teaching in the sphere of transcending the world.

mv-k03-v365.label: AgMsv_1.366
cite_parts:
samācāraḥ sa evātra grastabhedadaśo bhavet /
pūrṇeyaṃ parameśasya mahāsṛṣṭir iha sthitā // [AgMsv_1.366]
mv-k03-v365.quick_english: That same practice here would be one in which the state of difference is swallowed; this is the full great creation of the supreme Lord, established here.

mv-k03-v366.label: AgMsv_1.367
cite_parts:
yasyāṃ saṃhārasṛṣṭyaṃśā viśve te madhyavartinaḥ /
sā cādyā sṛṣṭir ity eva naiva vaktuṃ bhavet kṣamam // [AgMsv_1.367]
mv-k03-v366.quick_english: In that creation, all the aspects of dissolution and creation exist in the middle; therefore it would not be fitting to call it the very first creation.

mv-k03-v367.label: AgMsv_1.368
cite_parts:
adeśakāle tattve hi katham ādyādisaṃbhavaḥ /
jāgraddaśeyaṃ sā mukhyā pronmeṣapadabhāginī // [AgMsv_1.368]
mv-k03-v367.quick_english: For in a principle beyond place and time, how could there be a first arising and so on? This waking state is the primary one, partaking of the state of unfolding.

mv-k03-v368.label: AgMsv_1.369
cite_parts:
brahmaiṣa nijaśaktyaṃśasaṃbodhakamalāsanaḥ /
tā etāḥ sauśivād rūpāt prabhṛti brāhmam antataḥ // [AgMsv_1.369]
mv-k03-v368.quick_english: This Brahma is seated on the lotus of awakening of a portion of his own power; these powers unfold beginning from the auspicious Śiva form and extending finally to the form of Brahma.

mv-k03-v369.label: AgMsv_1.370
cite_parts:
rūpaṃ kṛtvā vijṛmbhante saṃvinnāthasya śaktayaḥ /
etāvān eva devo 'yam iti yady api śakyate // [AgMsv_1.370]
mv-k03-v369.quick_english: The powers of the Lord of consciousness unfold by taking form. Even if one might try to say, 'This god is only so much,' such a claim is considered possible.

mv-k03-v370.label: AgMsv_1.371
cite_parts:
na vaktum aprameyatvāc cidrūpasya maheśituḥ /
prabodhapañcadaśikāmadhye tādṛṅ mayā sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.371]
mv-k03-v370.quick_english: It cannot truly be said, because the great Lord, whose nature is consciousness, is immeasurable. I have stated this clearly in the Prabodhapañcadaśikā.

mv-k03-v371.label: AgMsv_1.372
cite_parts:
uktaṃ mitaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam /
jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate // [AgMsv_1.372]
mv-k03-v371.quick_english: It has been said that limited manifestation is indeed the characteristic of the inert; awareness is distinct from the inert because it is not measured.

mv-k03-v372.label: AgMsv_1.373
cite_parts:
tathāpi svayam etādṛg devo mānavivarjitaḥ /
nijasvātantryayogena kṛtvātmānaṃ carācaram // [AgMsv_1.373]
mv-k03-v372.quick_english: Even so, the god, who is himself beyond measure, by the exercise of his own freedom makes himself into the moving and unmoving universe.

mv-k03-v373.label: AgMsv_1.374
cite_parts:
īśatatpuruṣājātair udbhūtair udbubhūṣubhiḥ /
ekakaiḥ ṣaḍbhir, ekena trikeṇa, dvyātmakais tribhiḥ // [AgMsv_1.374]
mv-k03-v373.quick_english: Through Īśa, Tatpuruṣa, and Aja, in their arisen and about-to-arise forms, combining as single ones, as six, as one, as a triad, and as three dyads,

mv-k03-v374.label: AgMsv_1.375
cite_parts:
jāyate śivabhedānāṃ daśānāṃ vividhā sthitiḥ /
ata eva vicitrābhyaḥ saṃvidbhyo miśratāvaśāt // [AgMsv_1.375]
mv-k03-v374.quick_english: There arises a manifold state of the ten divisions of Śiva; indeed, this is due to the mixture of varied consciousnesses.

mv-k03-v375.label: AgMsv_1.376
cite_parts:
citrāṇy atra śivākhye 'pi bhedajñānāni tenire /
yadā trayāṇāṃ vaktrāṇāṃ vāmadakṣiṇasaṃgatiḥ // [AgMsv_1.376]
mv-k03-v375.quick_english: Even in what is called Śiva, varied knowledges of difference were unfolded when the left and right aspects of the three faces came together.

mv-k03-v376.label: AgMsv_1.377
cite_parts:
tadā pratyekaśaktitvaṃ bhaviṣyadbhavadudbhavaiḥ /
ṣaṇṇāṃ tritve rudrabhedas tenāṣṭādaśadhā sthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.377]
mv-k03-v376.quick_english: Then, as each becomes a distinct power through the future, present, and arisen modes, the six in a triad make the Rudra division established in eighteen forms.

mv-k03-v377.label: AgMsv_1.378
cite_parts:
ekaikaṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca vaktraṃ yasmāt pragīyate /
daśāṣṭādaśabhinnasya tato bhedair asaṃkhyatā // [AgMsv_1.378]
mv-k03-v377.quick_english: Since each is declared to be five-faced, what is divided into ten and eighteen becomes innumerable through further divisions.

mv-k03-v378.label: AgMsv_1.379
cite_parts:
pūrvoditayathāsvasvajñānakarmavicitritāḥ /
nirṇīyante yatas teṣu tena no punaruktatā // [AgMsv_1.379]
mv-k03-v378.quick_english: Because in them the distinctions are determined by each one's own knowledge and action as stated before, there is no mere repetition.

mv-k03-v379.label: AgMsv_1.380
cite_parts:
anyānya eva bodho hi samācāraḥ kriyākramaḥ /
tatra tatra tathā proktaḥ sarvas tu śivadhāmagaḥ // [AgMsv_1.380]
mv-k03-v379.quick_english: For awareness, practice, and the sequence of action are indeed different in each case, as declared there; yet all of them lead to the abode of Śiva.

mv-k03-v380.label: AgMsv_1.381
cite_parts:
yathā jalakaṇāh sarve viśrāmyanti mahāmbudhau /
tathā jñānakriyāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvitsindhau maheśvare // [AgMsv_1.381]
mv-k03-v380.quick_english: Just as all drops of water come to rest in the great ocean, so all knowledges and actions come to rest in the great Lord, the ocean of consciousness.

mv-k03-v381.label: AgMsv_1.382
cite_parts:
mitam api jalaṃ bhūmau sūryāṃśubhiḥ kila pīyate / tad api ca punar vṛṣṭidvāraiḥ prayāti mahārṇavam /
jagati nikhilaṃ jñānaṃ karma sphuṭaṃ kim api svayaṃ / kim api ca paraiḥ pāramparyāc chivārṇasi majjati // [AgMsv_1.382]
mv-k03-v381.quick_english: Even limited water on earth is drawn up by the sun's rays and returns again to the great ocean through rain; so too, all knowledge and action in the world, some arising by themselves and some through others in succession, sink into the ocean of Śiva.

mv-k03-v382.label: AgMsv_1.383
cite_parts:
yac cānte dakṣiṇe hārdaṃ liṅgaṃ hṛt paramaṃ matam /
tad apy antaḥkṛtāśeṣasṛṣṭabhāvasunirbharam // [AgMsv_1.383]
mv-k03-v382.quick_english: And that heart-mark at the right end, regarded as the supreme heart, is also fully filled with all created beings taken within it.

mv-k03-v383.label: AgMsv_1.384
cite_parts:
bhedabhāvakamāyīyatejoṃśagrasanāc ca tat /
sarvasaṃhārakatvena kṛṣṇaṃ timirarūpadhṛt // [AgMsv_1.384]
mv-k03-v383.quick_english: And because it devours the rays of māyā that produce difference, that, as the dissolver of all, is dark and bears the form of darkness.

mv-k03-v384.label: AgMsv_1.385
cite_parts:
vijñānaśāstre kathitam ata eva maheśinā /
līnaṃ mūrdhni viyat sarvam ityādi timiraṃ vibhoḥ // [AgMsv_1.385]
mv-k03-v384.quick_english: Therefore it is stated in the Vijñānaśāstra by the great Lord: 'All space is dissolved in the head,' and so forth, referring to the darkness of the Lord.

mv-k03-v385.label: AgMsv_1.386
cite_parts:
evam eva durniśāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāgame ciram /
bhāvayed bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ bhāvayadbhir durābhidam // [AgMsv_1.386]
mv-k03-v385.quick_english: Thus, on a dark night at the arrival of the dark fortnight, one should contemplate for a long time the Bhairava form, which is hard to name, by those who practice contemplation.

mv-k03-v386.label: AgMsv_1.387
cite_parts:
uktaṃ ca yatra svar duḥkhaṃ tamo vādvayasaṃvṛte /
nāvidyākarmasaṃbandhaḥ pāratantryādidarśanāt // [AgMsv_1.387]
mv-k03-v386.quick_english: And it is said: where light, suffering, and darkness are covered by nonduality, there is no connection with ignorance and karma, because dependence and the like are not seen.

mv-k03-v387.label: AgMsv_1.388
cite_parts:
tad atra timirākāre bhairavīye vapuṣy alam /
antarlīnatayā bhāti yāvad vaktracatuṣṭayam // [AgMsv_1.388]
mv-k03-v387.quick_english: Therefore, in this Bhairava body of the form of darkness, the group of four faces shines fully by being inwardly dissolved.

mv-k03-v388.label: AgMsv_1.389
cite_parts:
udbubhūṣu tathodbhūtaṃ tirodhitsu tirohitam /
tato yugapad evaitadbhidā ṣoḍaśakātmakam // [AgMsv_1.389]
mv-k03-v388.quick_english: As about to emerge, emerged, about to withdraw, and withdrawn, this division therefore becomes simultaneously sixteenfold.

mv-k03-v389.label: AgMsv_1.390
cite_parts:
dakṣe vaisargike hārde svatantre ca śive viśat /
aṣṭāṣṭakātmakaṃ śāstraṃ yugapad bhairavābhidham // [AgMsv_1.390]
mv-k03-v389.quick_english: Entering the right, emissive, heart, and autonomous aspects in Śiva, the scripture named Bhairava becomes simultaneously an eight-times-eight system.

mv-k03-v390.label: AgMsv_1.391
cite_parts:
itthaṃ tantraṃ rudraśivabhairavākhyaṃ sthitaṃ tridhā /
vastuto hi tridhaiveyaṃ jñānasattā vijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.391]
mv-k03-v390.quick_english: Thus the scripture, named Rudra, Shiva, and Bhairava, is established as threefold in reality; for indeed this being of knowledge unfolds in a threefold way.

mv-k03-v391.label: AgMsv_1.392
cite_parts:
bhedena bhedābhedena pūrṇenābhedasandhinā /
tathā ca mukhyāḥ śāmbhavyas tisra icchādiśaktayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.392]
mv-k03-v391.quick_english: It unfolds by difference, by difference-and-nondifference, and by the full junction of nondifference; and likewise there are three principal powers of Shambhu, beginning with will.

tokens.grounds: fused form: pūrṇena + abheda-sandhinā; third mode

mv-k03-v392.label: AgMsv_1.393
cite_parts:
tatraiva tu prapañcena pañcaśaktyādiyojanam /
itthaṃ madhye vibhinnaṃ tat trikam eva paraṃ tathā // [AgMsv_1.393]
mv-k03-v392.quick_english: There indeed, by elaboration, there is the application of the five powers and so on; thus, though divided in the middle, that triad is indeed supreme.

tokens.grounds: fused form: tatra + eva; locative emphasis

mv-k03-v393.label: AgMsv_1.394
cite_parts:
śāstram asmadgurugṛhe saṃpradāyakramāt sthitam /
ata eva hi naikaṭyād vāmadakṣiṇaśāstrayoḥ // [AgMsv_1.394]
mv-k03-v393.quick_english: The scripture is established in our teacher's house through the lineage sequence; therefore, indeed, because of its nearness to the left and right scriptures.

tokens.grounds: genitive dual of the two streams

mv-k03-v394.label: AgMsv_1.395
cite_parts:
dhārā prāntadharāprānte kaulikī pravijṛmbhate /
tato 'pi saṃhṛtāśeṣabhāvopādhisunirbharaḥ // [AgMsv_1.395]
mv-k03-v394.quick_english: The Kaula stream fully unfolds at the edge of the edge-stream; and from that, full with all the limiting conditions of beings withdrawn.

mv-k03-v395.label: AgMsv_1.396
cite_parts:
bhairavaḥ paramārthodyadravabṛmhitavṛttikaḥ /
īśānavāmadakṣāsu tāsu śaktitrayaṃ kramāt /
aparādiparāprāntaṃ kroḍīkṛtyāvatiṣṭhate // [AgMsv_1.396]
mv-k03-v395.quick_english: Bhairava, whose activity is expanded by the rising fluid of supreme reality, embraces the triad of powers in sequence in those Ishana, left, and right channels, from Apara up to Para, and abides.

tokens.grounds: describes the range of the triad
fused form: kroḍīkṛtya + avatiṣṭhate; main action

mv-k03-v396.label: AgMsv_1.397
cite_parts:
tad vibhāvayati bhedavibhāgaṃ tatsphuṭatvakṛd atho tam anantam /
saṃgrasiṣṇu parameśvararūpaṃ vastutas triśira eva nirāhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.397]
mv-k03-v396.quick_english: It manifests that division of difference and makes it clear; and then they declare that infinite, reabsorbing form of the supreme lord to be, in reality, truly three-headed.

mv-k03-v397.label: AgMsv_1.398
cite_parts:
ūrdhvavāmatadanyāni tantrāṇi ca kulāni ca /
rūḍhāny amuṣyāṃ dhārāyāṃ bhedasaṃkocahānaye // [AgMsv_1.398]
mv-k03-v397.quick_english: The upper, left, and other tantras and kulas are established in that stream for the removal of the contraction of difference.

mv-k03-v398.label: AgMsv_1.399
cite_parts:
paraprakāśaviṣayas trikārthas traidham āsthitaḥ /
sa eṣa parameśena jñānacandrākhyayoditaḥ // [AgMsv_1.399]
mv-k03-v398.quick_english: The triad-meaning, established threefold in supreme light, is uttered by the supreme lord as the knowledge-moon.

mv-k03-v399.label: AgMsv_1.400
cite_parts:
sa eva sarvaḥ śāstrārthaḥ paravāgvṛttisaṃśritaḥ /
anullasitatadvācyavācakādivibhaktikaḥ // [AgMsv_1.400]
mv-k03-v399.quick_english: All scripture-meaning rests in the course of supreme speech, without unfolded distinctions of meaning and word.

mv-k03-v400.label: AgMsv_1.401
cite_parts:
paścāt tu jñānaśaktyaṃśaprādhānyasphuritātmani /
kriyāśaktau susūkṣmāyāṃ sādākhyaiśvaryasaṃpadi // [AgMsv_1.401]
mv-k03-v400.quick_english: Afterward, in the self where knowledge-power dominates, action-power remains very subtle within sadākhya lordship.

tokens.grounds: compound: jñānaśakti + aṃśa + prādhānya + sphurita + ātman

mv-k03-v401.label: AgMsv_1.402
cite_parts:
paśyantīmadhyamādhāmni sañjalpollekhayogataḥ /
padavākyasvarūpeṇa vartate varṇarūpiṇā // [AgMsv_1.402]
mv-k03-v401.quick_english: In the paśyantī and madhyamā abodes, through the mention of stirring, it exists as word and sentence in letter form.

mv-k03-v402.label: AgMsv_1.403
cite_parts:
svacchandaśāstre tenoktaṃ svayaṃ devaḥ sadāśivaḥ /
pūrvottarapadair vākyais tantraṃ yojitavān iti // [AgMsv_1.403]
mv-k03-v402.quick_english: In the Svacchanda scripture it is said that Sadāśiva himself joined the tantra with prior and later words and sentences.

mv-k03-v403.label: AgMsv_1.404
cite_parts:
tathā ca tatraivoktaṃ tatsuśivāvaraṇe 'dhvani /
suśivāvaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ tatra jñeyaḥ sadāśivaḥ // [AgMsv_1.404]
mv-k03-v403.quick_english: Thus it is also said there: in that sushiva covering on the path, Sadāśiva is first to be known.

mv-k03-v404.label: AgMsv_1.405
cite_parts:
śivadaśakasaṃyukto rudrāṣṭādaśakānvitaḥ /
adhikāro hīśatattve tajjighṛkṣā tu sauśive // [AgMsv_1.405]
mv-k03-v404.quick_english: Joined with ten Śiva and endowed with eighteen Rudra, authority is in the Īśa principle, but the desire to grasp that is in Sauśiva.

mv-k03-v405.label: AgMsv_1.406
cite_parts:
varaṇe binduto bhogadhāmni vibhavato vibhoḥ /
bhairavākhyasya bodhasya śaktitattve paraṃ trayam // [AgMsv_1.406]
mv-k03-v405.quick_english: In the covering, from bindu in the enjoyment-abode, from the lord's abundance, there is a supreme triad of Bhairava knowledge in the power principle.

mv-k03-v406.label: AgMsv_1.407
cite_parts:
sthitis tasmād īśvarordhve sadāśivapadād adhaḥ /
suśivāvaraṇenoktā śrīmatsvacchandaśāsane // [AgMsv_1.407]
mv-k03-v406.quick_english: Therefore the position is above Īśvara and below the Sadāśiva station, as said by the sushiva covering in the glorious Svacchanda scripture.

mv-k03-v407.label: AgMsv_1.408
cite_parts:
tadanantaram etāsu śivarudrabhidāsv alam /
māyīyādhvani kḷptāsu śivair uktaḥ śivābhidhaḥ // [AgMsv_1.408]
mv-k03-v407.quick_english: After that, in these Śiva-Rudra distinctions, enough; on the māyīya path, established by the Śivas, the one named Śiva is said.

mv-k03-v408.label: AgMsv_1.409
cite_parts:
bhedo rudraiś ca rudrākhya iti prāpto vicitratām /
tataḥ prodyatkriyāsāraprollāsāt kramaśaḥ sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.409]
mv-k03-v408.quick_english: The difference, by Rudras and called Rudra, thus reaches variety; then, from the flourishing essence of rising action, it becomes gradually clear.

mv-k03-v409.label: AgMsv_1.410
cite_parts:
sarvagocaramāyīyaśrutavaikharyupāśritāḥ /
varṇavākyapadātmānaḥ śāstrārthā lokagocarāḥ // [AgMsv_1.410]
mv-k03-v409.quick_english: The scriptural meanings that rest on Maya-born Vaikhari speech heard by all, and whose nature is letters, sentences, and words, are within the range of the world.

mv-k03-v410.label: AgMsv_1.411
cite_parts:
samāśritya pravartante tāṃs tāṃs tantrāvatārakān /
tena prathamato yāvan māyīyāṃ vaikharīṃ darīm // [AgMsv_1.411]
mv-k03-v410.quick_english: Having resorted to those various transmitters of the tantras, they proceed; therefore, at first, as long as they come through the Maya-born cavity of Vaikhari.

tokens.grounds: metaphor for the level of Vaikhari

mv-k03-v411.label: AgMsv_1.412
cite_parts:
māyīyavarṇasaṃdṛbdhaḥ śāstrārtho nāyam āgataḥ /
antaḥ sāravibodhaikaparavāṅmayavarṇakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.412]
mv-k03-v411.quick_english: This scriptural meaning, bound by Maya-born letters, has not arrived within as that which consists of the supreme speech-letters of essential awakening.

tokens.grounds: fused form: na + ayam; negated subject

mv-k03-v412.label: AgMsv_1.413
cite_parts:
akṛtrimaparāveśamūlasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaḥ /
śāstrārtho laukikānto 'sti saptatriṃśe pare vibhau // [AgMsv_1.413]
mv-k03-v412.quick_english: The scriptural meaning, refined by the root impression of uncontrived supreme immersion, extends to the worldly level, yet it is in the supreme thirty-seventh lord.

tokens.grounds: fused form: laukika + antaḥ; describes scope

mv-k03-v413.label: AgMsv_1.414
cite_parts:
tatrāsatāṃ hi bhāvānāṃ kvāpi nāsty eva satyatā /
svāminy avinayākrāntaprakṛtau vinayaḥ kutaḥ // [AgMsv_1.414]
mv-k03-v413.quick_english: For there, unreal beings have no reality anywhere at all; how could respect arise in a lordly nature overcome by disrespect?

tokens.grounds: fused form: tatra + asatām; genitive plural
fused form: kva + api; indefinite locative
fused form: na + asti; negated existence

mv-k03-v414.label: AgMsv_1.415
cite_parts:
tasmāt samastaśāstrārthaḥ paratattvātmanā sthitaḥ /
ato vedādayo 'py ete māyīyāḥ śāsanāṃśavaḥ // [AgMsv_1.415]
mv-k03-v414.quick_english: Therefore the entire meaning of scripture is established as the nature of the supreme principle; hence even these Vedas and others are Maya-born portions of teaching.

mv-k03-v415.label: AgMsv_1.416
cite_parts:
sphuranti bhairavādityaprabhāvād eva nānyataḥ /
na hi saṃvidvimarśāt syād anyat kvāpy eva kāraṇam // [AgMsv_1.416]
mv-k03-v415.quick_english: They shine forth from the power of the Bhairava-sun alone, not from elsewhere; for apart from the reflective awareness of consciousness there could be no other cause anywhere at all.

tokens.grounds: fused form: na + anyataḥ; negated alternative source

mv-k03-v416.label: AgMsv_1.417
cite_parts:
saṃvinnāthasya saṃvit syāt saṃvid eva tathā yataḥ /
kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ ceti tathātva upacāryate // [AgMsv_1.417]
mv-k03-v416.quick_english: The consciousness of the lord of consciousness would be consciousness alone; therefore, since it is spoken of as both effect and cause, that status is applied only figuratively.

tokens.grounds: fused form: ca + iti; quotation marker

mv-k03-v417.label: AgMsv_1.418
cite_parts:
pariṇāme hi bhāvasya kramād vitatadharmaṇaḥ /
ādyantayoḥ saṃvid eva rūpatvenāvabhāsate // [AgMsv_1.418]
mv-k03-v417.quick_english: For in the sequential transformation of a being with extended properties, at the beginning and at the end, consciousness alone appears as its very form.

tokens.grounds: fused form: rūpatvena + avabhāsate; main verb

mv-k03-v418.label: AgMsv_1.419
cite_parts:
saṃvic ca kālakalanāṃ saheta yadi tat sphuṭam /
bhuñjīmahi niśātāsicchinnā vyomāṃśaśarkarāḥ // [AgMsv_1.419]
mv-k03-v418.quick_english: And if consciousness could endure division by time, then we would clearly be enjoying gravel bits of sky cut by a sharpened sword.

mv-k03-v419.label: AgMsv_1.420
cite_parts:
ataḥ samagraśāstrāṇi saṃvidrūpāparicyuteḥ /
saṃvidaḥ svaprakāśatvāt svaprakāśāni vastutaḥ // [AgMsv_1.420]
mv-k03-v419.quick_english: Therefore all the scriptures, because they do not fall away from the form of consciousness and because consciousness is self-luminous, are in reality self-luminous.

mv-k03-v420.label: AgMsv_1.421
cite_parts:
na ca vācyaṃ pṛthag jātu vācakād vyavatiṣṭhate /
svātantryād abhidhātaiva bhāvivācyatayā yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.421]
mv-k03-v420.quick_english: And it should not be said that the expressed ever stands apart from the expresser; for by autonomy the expresser alone appears as what will be expressed.

mv-k03-v421.label: AgMsv_1.422
cite_parts:
kadācid vācakāṃśas tu svarūpagrastavācyakaḥ /
nirbhāsate kadācit tu sāmānyollāsavācakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.422]
mv-k03-v421.quick_english: Sometimes the expressing aspect appears with the expressed absorbed into its own nature; sometimes, instead, it appears as expressing a general flash.

mv-k03-v422.label: AgMsv_1.423
cite_parts:
jātucin nikaṭānantaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣitaḥ /
sphuṭasvarūpavācyāṃśasamudrekeṇa bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.423]
mv-k03-v422.quick_english: Sometimes it shines, qualified by near and countless qualifiers, with a surge of the clear expressed aspect of its own form.

mv-k03-v423.label: AgMsv_1.424
cite_parts:
tenārthaparatā jātu svarūpaparatā tathā /
bubhūtsitārthā kvāpi kvacid rasamayī daśā // [AgMsv_1.424]
mv-k03-v423.quick_english: Therefore sometimes there is orientation toward meaning, and likewise sometimes orientation toward the word's own form; sometimes a state in which the meaning is desired to be known, and sometimes a state consisting of rasa.

tokens.grounds: fused form: kva + api; indefinite locative

mv-k03-v424.label: AgMsv_1.425
cite_parts:
śabdānāṃ lakṣyate citrā saṃvidrūpānapāyataḥ /
saṃvidvicitrakacanaiḥ kacatīti kim adbhutam // [AgMsv_1.425]
mv-k03-v424.quick_english: A variegated state of words is observed, because they do not depart from the form of consciousness; since it flashes through the varied flashings of consciousness, what is wonderful about that?

tokens.grounds: fused form: kacati + iti; explanatory clause

mv-k03-v425.label: AgMsv_1.426
cite_parts:
itthaṃ śivātmakavimarśapadād abhinnaḥ śabdaḥ sphuṭatvata iha svaparaprakāśaḥ /
mānaṃ tad eva citisāravimarśamātram anyat punas tadupacāravaśāt tathā hi // [AgMsv_1.426]
mv-k03-v425.quick_english: Thus word, non-different from the Śiva-natured level of reflective awareness, becomes clear here and illuminates both itself and other. Valid cognition is nothing but reflective awareness whose essence is consciousness; anything else is called cognition only by figurative extension from that.

mv-k03-v426.label: AgMsv_1.427
cite_parts:
svaprakāśātmikā yeyaṃ saṃvittiḥ pāramārthikī /
tat svasaṃvedanaṃ proktaṃ yato viśvavyavasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.427]
mv-k03-v426.quick_english: That ultimate consciousness, whose nature is self-luminous, is called self-awareness, because the ordering of the entire universe rests on it.

mv-k03-v427.label: AgMsv_1.428
cite_parts:
sā caiṣā na vimarśātmasvarūpam ativartate /
vimarśo 'syāḥ paro bhogaḥ pūrṇaḥ paśyanty udāhṛtā // [AgMsv_1.428]
mv-k03-v427.quick_english: This consciousness never goes beyond a nature whose very self is reflective awareness. Its reflective awareness is its supreme, full enjoyment, and that state is called paśyantī.

mv-k03-v428.label: AgMsv_1.429
cite_parts:
parāparā saiva devī mānam ity avadhāryatām /
yatrāparāṃśagaṃ meyaṃ tādātmyād vyavatiṣṭhate // [AgMsv_1.429]
mv-k03-v428.quick_english: Understand that same goddess as parāparā, which is valid cognition. In that state the knowable object appears on the lower side and stands forth through identity with that cognition.

tokens.grounds: identifies with previous subject; sandhi sā + eva
describes the object; sandhi yatra + aparāṃśa-gam

mv-k03-v429.label: AgMsv_1.430
cite_parts:
na hi bhinnena mānena meyasya syād vyavastitiḥ /
na hi haṃsasya śuklatve kākaḥ śvetatvam arhati // [AgMsv_1.430]
mv-k03-v429.quick_english: For an object cannot be determined by a cognition that is entirely different from it; just as a crow cannot claim the whiteness that belongs to a swan.

mv-k03-v430.label: AgMsv_1.431
cite_parts:
etad eva tathā cāha guruḥ śaṅkaranandanaḥ /
na mānatvāt tato 'nyatvān na bādhād asthiteḥ sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.431]
mv-k03-v430.quick_english: The teacher Śaṅkaranandana says the same thing: establishment does not arise merely because something is cognition, nor because it is other than cognition, nor because of sublation, nor because of non-establishment.

mv-k03-v431.label: AgMsv_1.432
cite_parts:
prakāśenāvinābhūtaiḥ sattāyāṃ niyatātmabhiḥ /
dharmair bhāvo bahirbhāvān na bhāvaḥ siddhim ṛcchati // [AgMsv_1.432]
mv-k03-v431.quick_english: A thing is established through properties that are inseparable from luminosity and fixed in existence; if it stood outside that, it could not attain establishment at all.

mv-k03-v432.label: AgMsv_1.433
cite_parts:
tena saṃvittikātmaiva mātṛmānaprameyatā /
gṛhṇatī svaprakāśatvaṃ svabhāvād eva bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.433]
mv-k03-v432.quick_english: Therefore the triad of knower, cognition, and known, though appearing in those roles, is in essence nothing but consciousness and shines by its own nature as self-luminous.

tokens.grounds: predicate of the triad; sandhi saṃvitti-ātmā + eva

mv-k03-v433.label: AgMsv_1.434
cite_parts:
sā cāntaḥsthitamantrātmaśabdanāmarśasundarā /
anapekṣānyavirahāt pramāṇaṃ svata eva hi // [AgMsv_1.434]
mv-k03-v433.quick_english: That consciousness, inwardly beautiful with mantra-natured verbal reflective awareness, is valid by itself, because it does not depend on anything else.

mv-k03-v434.label: AgMsv_1.435
cite_parts:
tasyā eva vicitrāṇi nāmāni bahubhaṅgibhiḥ /
tatprasādotthitāny eva vādinaḥ paryacīkḷpan // [AgMsv_1.435]
mv-k03-v434.quick_english: The various names of that same consciousness, arising in many modes from its own grace, were fashioned by different theorists.

mv-k03-v435.label: AgMsv_1.436
cite_parts:
tathā ca cakṣurādyakṣamaṇḍalīṭaṅkaniṣṭhitam /
pratyakṣam iti yad gītaṃ tat tāvat pravivicyate // [AgMsv_1.436]
mv-k03-v435.quick_english: And so the teaching that perception rests on the sphere of the eye and other senses is now examined.

mv-k03-v436.label: AgMsv_1.437
cite_parts:
saṃvittivyatirekeṇa yady akṣāṇāṃ vyavasthitiḥ /
na syād arthapramāṇaikyaṃ tarhi bāhyaghaṭādivat // [AgMsv_1.437]
mv-k03-v436.quick_english: If the senses cannot be established apart from consciousness, then the supposed identity of object and cognition would have to be treated like that of an external pot and so on.

mv-k03-v437.label: AgMsv_1.438
cite_parts:
nanv ātmanaś cakṣurādi karaṇaṃ na ghaṭādikam /
tasmāt tenaiva bhāvānāṃ mānaṃ na tu ghaṭādibhiḥ // [AgMsv_1.438]
mv-k03-v437.quick_english: An objection says: the eye and other senses are instruments of the self, unlike a pot and so on; therefore things are cognized by those senses, not by pots and the like.

tokens.grounds: instrument of cognition; sandhi tena + eva

mv-k03-v438.label: AgMsv_1.439
cite_parts:
vyāpakābhimatasyāsya saṃyoge cāviśeṣiṇaḥ /
bhautikatvāviśeṣeṇa ghaṭādyaiś cakṣurādinā // [AgMsv_1.439]
mv-k03-v438.quick_english: If the self is taken as all-pervading, its contact is undifferentiated; and since the eye and other senses are not relevantly different in materiality from pots and the like, mere contact cannot explain their special role.

tokens.grounds: describes the self; sandhi vyāpaka-abhimatasya + asya

mv-k03-v439.label: AgMsv_1.440
cite_parts:
ātmanaḥ karaṇākāṅkṣāpūraṇaṃ niyataṃ kutaḥ /
viśiṣṭa eva saṃyogaḥ karaṇatve nibandhanam // [AgMsv_1.440]
mv-k03-v439.quick_english: How could the self's need for an instrument be fulfilled in a determinate way? Only a specific contact, not a generic one, could be the basis for something becoming an instrument.

mv-k03-v440.label: AgMsv_1.441
cite_parts:
viśeṣaḥ karmabhis tais tair dharmādharmagiroditaiḥ /
tad etad yuktisadbhāvapratibhāvikalātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.441]
mv-k03-v440.quick_english: If one says the specific difference comes from various actions called merit and demerit, that explanation is devoid of the appearance of genuine reasoning.

mv-k03-v441.label: AgMsv_1.442
cite_parts:
bruvan vañcayate mugdhān palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ /
yac cāśeṣākṣasaṃyogivyāpakātmavaśotthitām // [AgMsv_1.442]
mv-k03-v441.quick_english: One who, intent on evasion, speaks of cognition as arising from an all-pervading self in contact with all the senses deceives the deluded.

tokens.grounds: relative object introducing next point; sandhi yat
describes the view to be examined; sandhi ca + aśeṣa...

mv-k03-v442.label: AgMsv_1.443
cite_parts:
yugapaj jñaptim ācchettuṃ mano nāma nigadyate /
tatrāpi brumahe pūrvaṃ manasātmaiva yujyate // [AgMsv_1.443]
mv-k03-v442.quick_english: Mind is said to cut cognition at once; even there, mind-self alone is first fitted.

mv-k03-v443.label: AgMsv_1.444
cite_parts:
tatrāpy ātmamanoyogaṃ kaḥ kuryād iti carcyatām /
vyāpakatvād asau syāc cet sarvair eva mano vrajet // [AgMsv_1.444]
mv-k03-v443.quick_english: Who would make self-mind union? If it is pervasive, all minds would go.

mv-k03-v444.label: AgMsv_1.445
cite_parts:
ekasya jāte saṃyoge sarvaḥ sarvajñatām iyāt /
yadi svāntam adhiṣṭhātṛ cakṣurādyam apekṣate // [AgMsv_1.445]
mv-k03-v444.quick_english: If one union arises, all would become omniscient, if own mind depends on presiding senses.

mv-k03-v445.label: AgMsv_1.446
cite_parts:
tenādhiṣṭhānam arthānāṃ tāvato 'kṣāṃśavartmanaḥ /
akṣādhiṣṭhitasūkṣmāṃśabhāgasaṃparkabhāsitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.446]
mv-k03-v445.quick_english: Therefore presiding over objects is so many along the sense-particle path, illuminated by contact with fine sense particles.

mv-k03-v446.label: AgMsv_1.447
cite_parts:
bāhyasyārthasya kuṇḍāder aṇur eko 'vabhāsatām /
athāpi mānasādhiṣṭhā jātā ced akṣagocare // [AgMsv_1.447]
mv-k03-v446.quick_english: Let one atom of an external object like a pot appear; but if mind-presiding arises in sense-range.

mv-k03-v447.label: AgMsv_1.448
cite_parts:
tad etasya svaviṣaye śaktataivopajāyate /
tarhi sūkṣmatamacchidranissṛtā netraraśmayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.448]
mv-k03-v447.quick_english: Power arises in its own domain; then eye-rays are emitted from the tiniest hole.

mv-k03-v448.label: AgMsv_1.449
cite_parts:
viśvavartini bhāvaughe na pramāṃ kurvate kutaḥ /
yogyadeśasthitān bhāvān gṛhṇate 'kṣāṇi nanv alam // [AgMsv_1.449]
mv-k03-v448.quick_english: In the world-abiding flood they do not make valid cognition; senses grasp beings situated in a suitable place.

mv-k03-v449.label: AgMsv_1.450
cite_parts:
yogyataiva hi deśasya kīdṛśīti vicāryatām /
yatrasthasya bhaved vittiḥ sa deśo yogya ucyate // [AgMsv_1.450]
mv-k03-v449.quick_english: Suitability of place is to be examined; the place where cognition occurs is called suitable.

mv-k03-v450.label: AgMsv_1.451
cite_parts:
kutrasthasya bhaved vittir iti kiṃ vā na darśyate /
tad amī tārkikammanyā yuktyupanyāsavarjitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.451]
mv-k03-v450.quick_english: Where would cognition occur? It is not shown; these logician-pretenders lack reasoned presentation.

mv-k04-v451.label: AgMsv_1.452
cite_parts:
pūrvam eva kathaṃ tūṣṇīṃ nātiṣṭhan kiṃ vikatthanaiḥ /
ātmanaś cābhisaṃdhānavandhyasyaiva balādayam // [AgMsv_1.452]
mv-k04-v451.quick_english: Why did it not stay silent before, and what do boasts avail for one barren of resolve?

mv-k04-v452.label: AgMsv_1.453
cite_parts:
manokṣajālasaṃyogo bhavet kiṃ nāsamañjasaḥ /
abhisandhir athaitasya viṣayaṃ prati jāyate // [AgMsv_1.453]
mv-k04-v452.quick_english: Would the union of mind and sense-net be inconsistent, and does resolve arise toward its object?

mv-k04-v453.label: AgMsv_1.454
cite_parts:
ajñāte ko 'bhisandhiḥ syāj jñāte ko 'rtho 'kṣasaṃyujā /
prajñāte smaryamāṇe ced abhisandhātṛbhāvitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.454]
mv-k04-v453.quick_english: If unknown, what resolve; if known, what purpose in sense-union; if remembered, it is shaped by the resolver.

mv-k04-v454.label: AgMsv_1.455
cite_parts:
anyad evābhisandhātuḥ prayatno 'nyatra jāyate /
mmanoyuktātmasaṃbaddhacakṣurādyakṣasaṃśritāḥ // [AgMsv_1.455]
mv-k04-v454.quick_english: The resolver's effort arises elsewhere, while senses rest on the mind-united self.

mv-k04-v455.label: AgMsv_1.456
cite_parts:
viṣayāḥ savidhībhūtanetrādyullaṅghanakramāt /
ātmany eva kathaṃkāraṃ pramātṛtvaṃ pratanvatām // [AgMsv_1.456]
mv-k04-v455.quick_english: How do objects, by overtaking the eye sequence, extend knowerhood in the self?

mv-k04-v456.label: AgMsv_1.457
cite_parts:
nanu jñānakṛto mātṛbhāvo vijñānam ātmani /
samavaiti tato 'nyasya kathaṃ mātṛtvaśaṅkanam // [AgMsv_1.457]
mv-k04-v456.quick_english: If knowledge-made motherhood occurs in the self, how can motherhood be doubted for another?

mv-k04-v457.label: AgMsv_1.458
cite_parts:
etad eva vayaṃ brūmo jñānaṃ tatraiva vai kutaḥ /
bhayāt svapakṣapātāndhas tad evottaram abhyadhāt // [AgMsv_1.458]
mv-k04-v457.quick_english: We say knowledge is there; why fear, O party-blind one, that reply was stated?

mv-k04-v458.label: AgMsv_1.459
cite_parts:
yathendriyātmasaṃyoge manaḥ kāraṇam ucyate /
tathaivātmamanoyoge kāraṇāntaram ucyatām // [AgMsv_1.459]
mv-k04-v458.quick_english: As mind is cause in sense-self union, so let another cause be said in self-mind union.

mv-k04-v459.label: AgMsv_1.460
cite_parts:
tathātve cānavasthaiva mūlakṣatikarī ca sā /
atha svāntātmasaṃyogo dhruva evābhyupeyate // [AgMsv_1.460]
mv-k04-v459.quick_english: In such case there is regress damaging the root; otherwise mind-self union is assumed fixed.

mv-k04-v460.label: AgMsv_1.461
cite_parts:
jñātāraḥ syuḥ sadā suptamattamūrchitadurbhagāḥ /
na caitad bhavatāṃ jñānam abhīṣṭaṃ śākyaśiṣyavat // [AgMsv_1.461]
mv-k04-v460.quick_english: Knowers would always be sleeping, drunk, fainted, unfortunate; this is not your desired knowledge, like a Buddhist disciple.

mv-k04-v461.label: AgMsv_1.462
cite_parts:
tasmāt pratyakṣatā nāma katham indriyagocarāt /
atha pratyekam eteṣāṃ parīkṣeyaṃ pratanyate // [AgMsv_1.462]
mv-k04-v461.quick_english: Therefore how is perceptibility from sense-range; then examination of these is extended.

mv-k04-v462.label: AgMsv_1.463
cite_parts:
tatrāṇu nityaṃ sarvārthaṃ vegavallaghv abhautikam /
manas tac cāpi naiveha yuktisiddhatvam aśnute // [AgMsv_1.463]
mv-k04-v462.quick_english: There an atomic eternal all-object swift light non-material mind is proposed, but it does not attain reason-establishedness here.

mv-k04-v463.label: AgMsv_1.464
cite_parts:
aṇu cec chīgrasaṃcāri mano yad viṣayān muhuḥ /
spṛśet tadaiva dehasya bhavec chavaśarīratā // [AgMsv_1.464]
mv-k04-v463.quick_english: If an atomic swift-moving mind repeatedly touched objects, the body would become a corpse.

mv-k04-v464.label: AgMsv_1.465
cite_parts:
dehasthe 'pi manoyoge tatraiva jñānayogataḥ /
ekāṇumātraṃ jīvaḥ syāc chiṣṭaṃ syād ghaṭakuḍyavat // [AgMsv_1.465]
mv-k04-v464.quick_english: Even in body-seated mind union, from knowledge union the soul would be only one atom, the rest like pot and wall.

mv-k04-v465.label: AgMsv_1.466
cite_parts:
atha svāntena yogaś cej jātaḥ kvāpy ātmagocare /
tad vibhor ātmano jñānaṃ samavāyīti mātṛtā // [AgMsv_1.466]
mv-k04-v465.quick_english: If union by mind is born somewhere in self-range, knowledge of the all-pervading self is inherent, hence motherhood.

mv-k04-v466.label: AgMsv_1.467
cite_parts:
jāteti sarvadehasthaṃ jīvanaṃ kiṃ na siddhyati /
enayaiva na kiṃ yuktyā ghaṭāder jīvanaṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.467]
mv-k04-v466.quick_english: Thus life in all bodies is not established; by this very reason, would pot and the like have life?

mv-k04-v467.label: AgMsv_1.468
cite_parts:
vibhāv ātmani jātaṃ hi jñānaṃ tatraikadeśataḥ /
dehamātre punaḥ svānte bhavet sāvayavā sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.468]
mv-k04-v467.quick_english: Knowledge born in the all-pervading self; from one part in body only, again in mind there would be a state with parts.

mv-k04-v468.label: AgMsv_1.469
cite_parts:
vibhutve mānasasya syād yugapat sarvavedanam /
nitye ca manasi jñānaṃ sarvadaiva bhavet tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.469]
mv-k04-v468.quick_english: If mind were all-pervasive, all perception would occur simultaneously; if mind were eternal, knowledge would always occur.

mv-k04-v469.label: AgMsv_1.470
cite_parts:
mokṣāvasthāpi vijñānayoginy evopajāyate /
muktau cātmamanoyogo nāstīty etan mahādbhutam // [AgMsv_1.470]
mv-k04-v469.quick_english: Even liberation state arises possessing awareness union; yet self-mind union is denied in liberation—this is a great wonder.

mv-k04-v470.label: AgMsv_1.471
cite_parts:
kiṃ hi vyāpakatā mokṣe svātmano vinirudhyate /
abhautikaṃ cet sarvārthaṃ kathaṃkāraṃ mano bhavet // [AgMsv_1.471]
mv-k04-v470.quick_english: Why is the pervasiveness of one's own self restricted in liberation; if mind is non-material, how can it be all-object?

mv-k04-v471.label: AgMsv_1.472
cite_parts:
viśiṣṭaviṣayavyaktikauśalād eva cakṣuṣaḥ /
taijasatvam abhīṣṭaṃ hi tan mano bhautikaṃ na kim // [AgMsv_1.472]
mv-k04-v471.quick_english: It asks whether mind is material, since its luminous nature is desired from skill in manifesting distinct objects.

mv-k04-v472.label: AgMsv_1.473
cite_parts:
sarvarthatve ca manasaḥ kim anyair akṣaḍambaraiḥ /
nanu bāhye 'sya viṣaye prāg asty akṣopayogitā // [AgMsv_1.473]
mv-k04-v472.quick_english: If mind grasps all objects, why are other sense-organs needed, since external objects already have sense-usefulness?

mv-k04-v473.label: AgMsv_1.474
cite_parts:
tathā hīndriyasaṃdṛṣṭe pāścātyā manasaḥ sthitiḥ /
atrocyate yathaiva prāg indriyeṇa na gṛhyate // [AgMsv_1.474]
mv-k04-v473.quick_english: Thus mind's later state is in what sense perceives; it is said that, just as earlier, it is not grasped by sense.

mv-k04-v474.label: AgMsv_1.475
cite_parts:
tac cet svalakṣaṇaṃ paścād anuyantr iti kā kathā /
atha sāmānyamātraṃ tad gṛhītaṃ prāk tadindriyaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.475]
mv-k04-v474.quick_english: If the particular is only inferred later, what is there to say; if only a universal was grasped earlier by those senses.

mv-k04-v475.label: AgMsv_1.476
cite_parts:
vyaktiniṣṭhaṃ tadānīṃ ca manasā vyaktiniścayaḥ /
nāstīti manasā kasmāt sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.476]
mv-k04-v475.quick_english: Then particular is fixed and mind determines particular; if not, why would mind grasp a universal?

mv-k04-v476.label: AgMsv_1.477
cite_parts:
vinā vyaktigraheṇaiva sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ ya[ku]taḥ /
sāmānyagrahaṇe cāsya sarvārthatvaṃ nirudhyate // [AgMsv_1.477]
mv-k04-v476.quick_english: Without particular grasp, from where universal grasp? And if universal grasp occurs, mind's all-objectness is destroyed.

mv-k04-v477.label: AgMsv_1.478
cite_parts:
viśeṣagrahavandhyasya sarvaśabdavilopataḥ /
āśugāmitvam etasya yac coktaṃ tatra vastuni // [AgMsv_1.478]
mv-k04-v477.quick_english: Deprived of particular grasp, all words vanish; the speed attributed to it in that object is thereby challenged.

mv-k04-v478.label: AgMsv_1.479
cite_parts:
puraḥsthite svahastādau kiṃcid dūragate ghaṭe /
atidūre ca mervādau kathaṃ tulyaiva gantṛtā // [AgMsv_1.479]
mv-k04-v478.quick_english: For an object before the hand, a somewhat distant pot, and very distant Meru, how can going-agency be equal?

mv-k04-v479.label: AgMsv_1.480
cite_parts:
āśusaṃcāriṇāṃ yasmāt kvāpi pūrvakatejasām (?) /
savidhāsavidhatvena viśeṣaḥ pravibhāvyate // [AgMsv_1.480]
mv-k04-v479.quick_english: Because of prior light of swift-moving things, difference by near and far is manifested.

mv-k04-v480.label: AgMsv_1.481
cite_parts:
kathaṃ cābhautikaṃ sūkṣmaṃ gṛhṇīyāt parvatādikam /
abhivyaktiḥ samānasya samānena vidhīyate // [AgMsv_1.481]
mv-k04-v480.quick_english: How could a non-elemental subtle thing grasp mountains and the like? Manifestation is established by the same through the same.

mv-k04-v481.label: AgMsv_1.482
cite_parts:
nanv astu prākṛtī buddhis tato 'haṃkṛt tato manaḥ /
ittham apy aṇutā naiva manasaḥ saṃprasiddhyati // [AgMsv_1.482]
mv-k04-v481.quick_english: Let there be material intellect, then ego, then mind; even so, mind's atomicity is not established.

mv-k04-v482.label: AgMsv_1.483
cite_parts:
vyāpakatvena pūrvoktadūṣaṇāni sthitāny alam /
itthaṃ mano na yuktyaṃśair mānasāvarjanāya naḥ // [AgMsv_1.483]
mv-k04-v482.quick_english: By pervasiveness the previous refutations remain; thus mind is not accepted by reason-parts for us.

mv-k04-v483.label: AgMsv_1.484
cite_parts:
yādṛg vādyantarair iṣṭaṃ dvaitavyāmūḍhadṛṣṭibhiḥ /
cidātmanaḥ prakāśasya tathābhāsanabhāginī // [AgMsv_1.484]
mv-k04-v483.quick_english: Such as is desired by other instruments for dualist-deluded views, so participates in the manifestation of consciousness-self.

mv-k04-v484.label: AgMsv_1.485
cite_parts:
yā śaktis tan manas tv astu svasvātantryopakalpitam /
yatra śrotraṃ nabhas tatra sarvaśabdaśrutir bhavet // [AgMsv_1.485]
mv-k04-v484.quick_english: Let that mind be a power imagined by self-autonomy; where ear and space are, there all sound hearing would be.

mv-k04-v485.label: AgMsv_1.486
cite_parts:
cakṣurādyaiś ca sarvatra nirvibandhaṃ yato nabhaḥ /
dharmādharmair vibandhaś ca yuktyupanyāsavaikalī // [AgMsv_1.486]
mv-k04-v485.quick_english: By eye and the rest perception is everywhere unobstructed because of space; obstruction by merit and demerit shows the opponent's reasoning is weak.

mv-k04-v486.label: AgMsv_1.487
cite_parts:
bādhiryādi kathaṃ ca syāt kathaṃ vā taccikitsanam /
bandhāśrayavighātena tadanugrahas tathā // [AgMsv_1.487]
mv-k04-v486.quick_english: How could deafness and the like arise, or how could they be treated? Thus grace comes by destroying the support of bondage.

mv-k04-v487.label: AgMsv_1.488
cite_parts:
akṣaṃ svāvayaveṣv eva x x x samavāyinaḥ /
viśeṣeṇa nabho naiva kvāpy āśritam iti sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.488]
mv-k04-v487.quick_english: A sense organ is inherent in its own parts; space is not dependent anywhere: this is the position.

mv-k04-v488.label: AgMsv_1.489
cite_parts:
saṃyogitā tu \ldots sākaṃ bhāvena vartate /
tadanugrahaghātābhyām api vikriyatāṃ tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.489]
mv-k04-v488.quick_english: Conjunction occurs together with being; by grace and destruction let it be modified then.

mv-k04-v489.label: AgMsv_1.490
cite_parts:
yad anugrahas tad anugrahaḥ sa tadāśrayaḥ /
itīyaṃ svavacaḥkḷptir niḥsāraiva vibhāti naḥ // [AgMsv_1.490]
mv-k04-v489.quick_english: Grace is grace and that is its support; thus this self-speech construction appears empty to us.

mv-k04-v490.label: AgMsv_1.491
cite_parts:
āśrayadvārako 'kṣāṇām anugraha iti sphuṭam /
abhidhatsva ka eteṣām āśrayo 'stv iti codite // [AgMsv_1.491]
mv-k04-v490.quick_english: When asked what support these senses have, favor is named as support.

mv-k04-v491.label: AgMsv_1.492
cite_parts:
yad anugrahayogo 'sya sa evāśraya ity ayam /
