nyāyo 'nyonyasamālambī cakrakaṃ nātivartate // [AgMsv_1.492]
mv-k04-v491.quick_english: This reasoning that favor-union is support does not escape mutual dependence.

mv-k04-v492.label: AgMsv_1.493
cite_parts:
vāyuprakṛti yac coktaṃ sparśanaṃ tad vivicyate /
vāyor vegavatī tāvad aniruddhā sthitiḥ sthitā // [AgMsv_1.493]
mv-k04-v492.quick_english: The touch said to be air-nature is distinguished while air's swift unobstructed state remains established.

mv-k04-v493.label: AgMsv_1.494
cite_parts:
dehadeśe tataḥ sparśaḥ na kuḍya iti kaḥ kramaḥ /
cakṣuś ca taijasaṃ tejaḥ prasṛtaṃ bāhyagocare // [AgMsv_1.494]
mv-k04-v493.quick_english: If touch is not wall in the body-place, what order follows, while the eye is fiery light extended into external range?

mv-k04-v494.label: AgMsv_1.495
cite_parts:
arthān rūpapradhānāṃś ca vettīty etan nirūpyate /
adṛśyaṃ yadi tat tejaḥ preryate manasā katham // [AgMsv_1.495]
mv-k04-v494.quick_english: This examines how objects, predominantly form, are known, and how invisible light could be driven by mind.

tokens.grounds: verb third singular present active plus indeclinable

mv-k04-v495.label: AgMsv_1.496
cite_parts:
preraṇaṃ na hy avijñānaṃ kadācid upapadyate /
indriyeṇa na ca jñātaṃ kadācic cākṣuṣaṃ mahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.496]
mv-k04-v495.quick_english: Driving never occurs without knowledge, and visual greatness is never known merely by sense.

mv-k04-v496.label: AgMsv_1.497
cite_parts:
na cāpīndriyavijñāte svatantraṃ bhavatāṃ manaḥ /
apreritaṃ ca tat paśyet sarvataḥ sarvathā sadā // [AgMsv_1.497]
mv-k04-v496.quick_english: Mind is not independent in what is sense-known, and undriven mind would see everywhere in every way always.

mv-k04-v497.label: AgMsv_1.498
cite_parts:
āsamañjasyam eva syāt pravṛttau vā nivartane /
kiṃ ca golakasaṃsthānaṃ tāvac ca yadi tan mahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.498]
mv-k04-v497.quick_english: Inconsistency would arise in activity or cessation, and the orb-arrangement is questioned if that greatness holds.

mv-k04-v498.label: AgMsv_1.499
cite_parts:
tāvatas tadgatasyaiva grahaḥ syān nānyataḥ kvacit /
tathaitad viparītaṃ tu golake 'pi nimīlite // [AgMsv_1.499]
mv-k04-v498.quick_english: Grasping would be only of that gone-indeed, not from elsewhere anywhere; yet the opposite holds even in a closed orb.

mv-k04-v499.label: AgMsv_1.500
cite_parts:
unmīlite vā sarvatra vastuni grahaṇaṃ bhavet /
unmīlite cakṣuṣi ca prasṛte raśmimaṇḍale // [AgMsv_1.500]
mv-k04-v499.quick_english: When opened, grasping would occur everywhere in the object, and when the eye is opened with ray-circle extended.

mv-k04-v500.label: AgMsv_1.501
cite_parts:
tasyāsti na paṭasyeva saṃvṛtir netramīlane /
tato nimīlitākṣasya vastudṛṣṭir na kiṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.501]
mv-k04-v500.quick_english: There is no cloth-like covering in eye-closing, so closed-eyed object-sight would not occur.

mv-k04-v501.label: AgMsv_1.502
cite_parts:
ghane cātapamadhye 'sti vinimīlitacakṣuṣaḥ /
citratejovabhānaṃ tatpīḍitākṣayugasya ca // [AgMsv_1.502]
mv-k04-v501.quick_english: In dense sunlight there is bright light appearance for one with closed eyes and pressed eye-pair.

mv-k04-v502.label: AgMsv_1.503
cite_parts:
yogināṃ bindudṛg dhvānte kathaṃ tad vā bhaviṣyati /
bhaved unmīlite 'py akṣṇi na vastugrahaṇaṃ kvacit // [AgMsv_1.503]
mv-k04-v502.quick_english: How would yogins' point-sight in darkness be, when even with opened eye there is no object-grasping anywhere?

mv-k04-v503.label: AgMsv_1.504
cite_parts:
manodhiṣṭhānayogena paramāṇvadhikaprathā /
dīpāpekṣā ca yāmuṣya sāpi kiṃ na vibādhyate // [AgMsv_1.504]
mv-k04-v503.quick_english: By mind-seat union, atom-exceeding appearance and lamp-dependence of that too may be refuted.

mv-k04-v504.label: AgMsv_1.505
cite_parts:
dīpaprakāśaḥ svāntātmanetrārtheṣūpakārakaḥ /
na pratyekaṃ manovṛtteḥ saṃskāras tena ced bhavet // [AgMsv_1.505]
mv-k04-v504.quick_english: Lamp-light helps mind, self, eye, and objects, but not individually; mind-fluctuation impression would be by that if.

mv-k04-v505.label: AgMsv_1.506
cite_parts:
dīpe saṃkalpyamane syād rātrau rūpaparigrahaḥ /
ātmanaḥ saṃskriyā cet syāt tasya sarvagatatvataḥ // [AgMsv_1.506]
mv-k04-v505.quick_english: When a lamp is imagined at night, form-grasping would occur; self-impression would be due to its all-pervadingness.

mv-k04-v506.label: AgMsv_1.507
cite_parts:
sarvadā rūpasaṃvit syāt saṃyogaḥ saṃskriyā yataḥ /
amūrtasypi nityasya ko 'nyaḥ saṃskāra ucyate // [AgMsv_1.507]
mv-k04-v506.quick_english: Form-awareness would always be; conjunction is impression, so for the formless eternal what other impression is called?

mv-k04-v507.label: AgMsv_1.508
cite_parts:
netropakāraś cet tarhi netradeśasthite 'rciṣi /
tejomadhyagataṃ rūpaṃ na bhāseta kadācana // [AgMsv_1.508]
mv-k04-v507.quick_english: If eye-help, then form in light-middle would never shine in a flame situated in the eye-place.

mv-k04-v508.label: AgMsv_1.509
cite_parts:
nanu tad vedyadeśe 'sau nāyanaḥ kiraṇavrajaḥ /
hanta tatraiva vijñānam ātmadeśe na kiṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.509]
mv-k04-v508.quick_english: If the eye's rays reach the object, why should knowledge not arise in the self's own place?

mv-k04-v509.label: AgMsv_1.510
cite_parts:
tatraivātmā vibhutvena tatraiva karaṇaṃ yataḥ /
tasmād bhogāśrayo deho jīvann iti vṛthoktayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.510]
mv-k04-v509.quick_english: Since the self is omnipresent and the instrument is there itself, talk of the body as support of enjoyment is vain.

mv-k04-v510.label: AgMsv_1.511
cite_parts:
nāyanānāṃ mayūkhānāṃ gantṛtve 'vasite sati /
anāvṛte 'raṇyamārge svahastāt prabhṛti sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.511]
mv-k04-v510.quick_english: Once the going of eye-rays is settled, clear perception begins from one's own hand along an uncovered forest path.

mv-k04-v511.label: AgMsv_1.512
cite_parts:
arkacandrādisaṃdṛṣṭiḥ kathaṃ nāmopajāyatām /
śīghratve 'pi yataḥ proktabhedo dūrāvidūragaḥ // [AgMsv_1.512]
mv-k04-v511.quick_english: How can perception of sun and moon arise, even if swift, when the stated difference concerns going far and near?

mv-k04-v512.label: AgMsv_1.513
cite_parts:
dīpanetrāvabhāsābhyāṃ channe tasmin kathaṃ matiḥ /
śuddha eva bhaved bhāve tābhyāṃ vyāmalatājuṣi // [AgMsv_1.513]
mv-k04-v512.quick_english: How can mind arise when lamp and eye illumination cover it; pure being would remain in that state.

mv-k04-v513.label: AgMsv_1.514
cite_parts:
andhatvaṃ tac cikitsā ca na yuktāśrayadūṣaṇā /
rasanā ca jalātmā cet taj jalaṃ srutimadyataḥ // [AgMsv_1.514]
mv-k04-v513.quick_english: Blindness and its treatment are not a fault of fit support; if tongue is water-self, that water flows from the middle.

mv-k04-v514.label: AgMsv_1.515
cite_parts:
tataḥ sthairyaṃ kathaṃ tasya kā ca nānārasaprathā /
tasyaikarasatāyoge tasyā naikarasasthiteḥ // [AgMsv_1.515]
mv-k04-v514.quick_english: Then how is its stability possible, and what various taste manifestation occurs, if one-taste union conflicts with not-one-taste station?

mv-k04-v515.label: AgMsv_1.516
cite_parts:
na syād ekarasajñaptir yathā pittabhare sati /
tiktā rasanavṛttir no mādhuryaṃ viditaṃ kṣamā // [AgMsv_1.516]
mv-k04-v515.quick_english: One-taste cognition would not arise; when bile abounds, tongue function is bitter, and sweetness is not known as possible.

mv-k04-v516.label: AgMsv_1.517
cite_parts:
nanu pittagataṃ taiktyaṃ na tv evaṃ rasanāgatam /
tarhi pittagūḍau tulyaṃ rasanāpathagāminau // [AgMsv_1.517]
mv-k04-v516.quick_english: Bitterness is bile-gone, not tongue-gone; then bile-hidden and tongue-path-goers are equal.

mv-k04-v517.label: AgMsv_1.518
cite_parts:
iti syād yugapaj jñaptis tiktamādhuryagocarā /
nīrasā rasanā cet sā rasābhivyañjikā kutaḥ // [AgMsv_1.518]
mv-k04-v517.quick_english: Thus cognition would be simultaneous toward bitter and sweet; if tongue is tasteless, whence does it manifest taste?

mv-k04-v518.label: AgMsv_1.519
cite_parts:
svabhāvād iti ced asyāḥ ko 'yam āmbhasatāgrahaḥ /
ghrāṇaṃ ca pārthivaṃ tasya kāṭhinyaṃ kiṃ na dṛśyate // [AgMsv_1.519]
mv-k04-v518.quick_english: If from nature, what is this water-ness grasp? Nose is earthly, so why is its hardness not seen?

mv-k04-v519.label: AgMsv_1.520
cite_parts:
nanu gandhaguṇodreki kiṃ sa gandho na bhāsate /
nāsti tatrendriyavyaktagandhavattve tathā pramā // [AgMsv_1.520]
mv-k04-v519.quick_english: If smell is quality-excessive, why does smell not shine? There is no valid cognition there in that way.

mv-k04-v520.label: AgMsv_1.521
cite_parts:
nirgandham apṛthivyātmā mano gandhagrahakṣamam /
asty eva bhavatāṃ tena nānumā tādṛśā kṣamā // [AgMsv_1.521]
mv-k04-v520.quick_english: Mind is smell-less and non-earth-self, yet smell-grasping-capable; such inference is not possible for you.

mv-k04-v521.label: AgMsv_1.522
cite_parts:
tasmād indriyasaṃghāto bhautiko nopapadyate /
āhaṃkārikatāyāṃ tu vyāptṛtvam avibhinnatā // [AgMsv_1.522]
mv-k04-v521.quick_english: Therefore an elemental sense-aggregate does not fit; but in egoity there is pervasion and non-distinctness.

mv-k04-v522.label: AgMsv_1.523
cite_parts:
dehāśrayavirodhaś ca karaṇatvena cāsthitiḥ /
vāgādi yac ca karmākṣapañcakaṃ tad vivicyatām // [AgMsv_1.523]
mv-k04-v522.quick_english: Body-support contradicts instrumentality and non-stability; speech and the five action-senses should be distinguished.

mv-k04-v523.label: AgMsv_1.524
cite_parts:
ānābher mūrdhaparyantaṃ yaḥ samīrābhighātajaḥ /
viśeṣaḥ ko 'pi vāgātmā sa tādṛg iha kathyate // [AgMsv_1.524]
mv-k04-v523.quick_english: From navel to head, wind-strike-born; what distinction is speech-self? Such is said here.

mv-k04-v524.label: AgMsv_1.525
cite_parts:
tasya kāryaṃ bhavec chabdaḥ kartā ko 'tra vicāryatām /
ātmano naiva kartṛtvaṃ tathātve 'pi vibhutvataḥ // [AgMsv_1.525]
mv-k04-v524.quick_english: Its work would be sound; who is the doer here, let be examined. The self has no doership, even in that state, due to omnipresence.

mv-k04-v525.label: AgMsv_1.526
cite_parts:
mayā proccārite śabde tvaṃ vaktā kiṃ na jāyase /
prakṛtāv api doṣo 'yaṃ kartryāṃ kartṛtvavarjitā // [AgMsv_1.526]
mv-k04-v525.quick_english: When I utter sound, why are you not speaker? Even in prakṛti this fault remains: doership is devoid of doership.

mv-k04-v526.label: AgMsv_1.527
cite_parts:
karaṇasya sthitir nāsti tulye vāgindriye sati /
kathaṃ cāsphuṭasuspaṣṭabhāvaḥ śabdeṣu jāyate // [AgMsv_1.527]
mv-k04-v526.quick_english: There is no fixed state of the instrument when the vocal organ is the same — so how does the indistinct-and-distinct state arise in sounds?

tokens.grounds: bhāva with the dvandva visarga to ḥ

mv-k04-v527.label: AgMsv_1.528
cite_parts:
kathaṃ copāṃśusaṃjalpasmṛtyādau śabdagā bhidā /
prayatnāc cet prayatno 'pi yady utpattis tataḥ katham // [AgMsv_1.528]
mv-k04-v527.quick_english: And how, in whispering, muttering, recollection and the like, is there sound-bound difference? If from effort — yet if effort too is an origination, whence then?

mv-k04-v528.label: AgMsv_1.529
cite_parts:
viśeṣo jāyate hy anyo na hy anyaguṇasaṃbhavaḥ /
prayatnamāndyāmāndyābhyāṃ yena pratividhīyate // [AgMsv_1.529]
mv-k04-v528.quick_english: For a further distinction arises, not born of another quality, by which — through slack and intense effort — it is met.

mv-k04-v529.label: AgMsv_1.530
cite_parts:
pāṇīndriyaṃ cādadānaṃ mukhādyair grahaṇaṃ kutaḥ /
grahaṇaṃ ca kim ucyeta svīkāro yadi saṃmataḥ // [AgMsv_1.530]
mv-k04-v529.quick_english: And the hand-organ gives nothing — whence then grasping by mouth and the rest? And what would be called grasping, if acceptance is what is meant?

mv-k04-v530.label: AgMsv_1.531
cite_parts:
asvasya svasya karaṇaṃ svīkāra iti bhaṇyate /
svaśabdaś cātmavācī cet tatrātmā prakṛtir yadi // [AgMsv_1.531]
mv-k04-v530.quick_english: Acceptance, it is said, is the making-ones-own of what is not ones own; and if the word 'own' expresses the self — with the self as the root...

mv-k04-v531.label: AgMsv_1.532
cite_parts:
tan nāsty aprākṛtaṃ kiṃcid ity asvatatvaṃ kathaṃ kila /
ahaṅkāro 'py athātmā syān nāhaṃkārī kṛtir ghaṭe // [AgMsv_1.532]
mv-k04-v531.quick_english: Therefore nothing is non-radical, they say — so how indeed is there non-ownness? Then ego too would be the self — yet pot-making is not egoic.

mv-k04-v532.label: AgMsv_1.533
cite_parts:
ātmīyo 'yam anenaitad dūṣaṇenaiva dūṣitam /
ahaṃkārasya saṃbandhi sarvam eva hi tat svakam // [AgMsv_1.533]
mv-k04-v532.quick_english: Mine — this is faulted by that very fault; for all that is related to ego is indeed its own.

mv-k04-v533.label: AgMsv_1.534
cite_parts:
ātmano vyāpakasyāsti na svaṃ nāsvaṃ ca kiṃcana /
evaṃ pādendriyasyāpi samo 'yaṃ yuktivikramaḥ // [AgMsv_1.534]
mv-k04-v533.quick_english: For the pervading self there is nothing own or not-own; and likewise for the foot-organ too this same stride of argument holds.

mv-k04-v534.label: AgMsv_1.535
cite_parts:
deśād deśāntaraprāptyā gamanaṃ ca yad ucyate /
tattyāgarūpaṃ svīkārābhāvenaiva prasiddhyati // [AgMsv_1.535]
mv-k04-v534.quick_english: And what is called going, by reaching from place to place — that is of abandoning-nature, established precisely by the absence of acceptance.

tokens.grounds: abhāva with svīkāra and eva instrumental

mv-k04-v535.label: AgMsv_1.536
cite_parts:
svīkāro dūṣitaś caiṣa svīkārāṃśo 'pi yo gatau /
tasya pāṇīndriyaṃ yuktaṃ karaṇaṃ nāṅghrināmakam // [AgMsv_1.536]
mv-k04-v535.quick_english: And this acceptance stands refuted — yet whatever share of acceptance there is in going, for that the hand-organ is the fit instrument, not the foot-named.

tokens.grounds: aṃśa with svīkāra visarga to o

mv-k04-v536.label: AgMsv_1.537
cite_parts:
indriyāṇāṃ hi sāṃkāryam evaṃ kāryeṣu jāyate /
ata eva mahānyāyavedibhiś carame naye // [AgMsv_1.537]
mv-k04-v536.quick_english: For the common task of the senses thus arises in their tasks; therefore indeed, by the knowers of the great Nyaya, in the final view.

mv-k04-v537.label: AgMsv_1.538
cite_parts:
prokto gatiniṣedhāya bhūyān sadvākyaḍambaraḥ /
gataṃ na gamyate tāvad agataṃ naiva gamyate // [AgMsv_1.538]
mv-k04-v537.quick_english: Proclaimed for the denial of going is the great pomp of true statements: the gone is not gone-to for now, the not-gone indeed is not gone-to.

mv-k04-v538.label: AgMsv_1.539
cite_parts:
gatāgatavinirmuktaṃ nāstītyādi svake naye /
pāyvindriyaṃ ca na cchidramātraṃ koṣṭhyamarutkramāt // [AgMsv_1.539]
mv-k04-v538.quick_english: Nothing free from gone-and-not-gone exists and the like, in one own view; and the anus-organ is not a mere hole — from the course of the belly-wind.

mv-k04-v539.label: AgMsv_1.540
cite_parts:
utsargaḥ kila sāṃkāryaṃ tena syād iyatī sthitiḥ /
upastham indriyaṃ yac ca tasya kāryaṃ nigadyate // [AgMsv_1.540]
mv-k04-v539.quick_english: Excretion, they say, is the common task — thereby stands just this position; and the sex-organ, whose task is declared...

mv-k04-v540.label: AgMsv_1.604
cite_parts:
............................. /

śāmyatīti na yuktettham anumānapramāṇatā /
tadbhedavādināṃ tāvad dve māne naiva saṃgate // [AgMsv_1.604]
mv-k04-v540.quick_english: It ceases is thus improper — inferential authoritativeness; for the difference-theorists, however, the two measures are simply incompatible.

mv-k04-v541.label: AgMsv_1.605
cite_parts:
śabdādes tv anumānena sudhībhiḥ pariniścitam /
tasmāt svasaṃvid evaiṣā svaprakāśatayā sthitā // [AgMsv_1.605]
mv-k04-v541.quick_english: But this, from sound, is ascertained by the wise through inference; therefore this self-consciousness abides in self-luminosity.

mv-k04-v542.label: AgMsv_1.606
cite_parts:
mātṛmānaprameyādiprapañcaiḥ sāvabhāsate /

samullāsaḥ sindhor bahalalaharīvibhramamayaḥ prakāśaḥ śāśāṅkaḥ kumudadalanirbhedasacivaḥ /
parasyāḥ saṃvitter mitiviṣayamātṛvyatikarair vikāso yaḥ seyaṃ jagati vividhā kalpanakalā // [AgMsv_1.606]
mv-k04-v542.quick_english: She shines forth with the expanses beginning with knower, measure, and object — the oceans upsurge of dense-wave play is moonlight, soft on unpierced lily-petals; the opening of supreme consciousness through the mixture of measure, object, and knower — that is, in the world, the manifold art of imagining.

tokens.grounds: prapañca with the triple compound instrumental plural
vyatikara with the triple instrumental plural

mv-k04-v543.label: AgMsv_1.607
cite_parts:
tasmāt prakāśa evāyaṃ citraśaktisunirbharaḥ /
svayaṃ vicitrarūpeṇa bhāti viśvatra viśvataḥ // [AgMsv_1.607]
mv-k04-v543.quick_english: Therefore this very light, full of manifold power, itself shines in manifold form — everywhere, from every side.

mv-k04-v544.label: AgMsv_1.608
cite_parts:
tad ayaṃ prasphuṭābhāso lokarūpādivartmanā /
svaśaktyaṃśād vikalpākhyāt pratyakṣavyapadeśabhāk // [AgMsv_1.608]
mv-k04-v544.quick_english: Then this clear shining, by way of world-form and the like, from own-power portion called imagining, shares the title perception.

mv-k04-v545.label: AgMsv_1.609
cite_parts:
tathā hi devadevāṃśas tat samunmīlanaṃ dṛśaḥ /
prāṇaspandas tadaikāgryaṃ bhāvas taddharmasaṃcayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.609]
mv-k04-v545.quick_english: For thus: the god-of-gods portion is the opening of vision; breath throb is one-pointedness on that; being is the collection of its properties.

tokens.grounds: aṃśa with devadeva visarga to s
spanda with prāṇa visarga to s

mv-k04-v546.label: AgMsv_1.610
cite_parts:
ityādi sarvaṃ yad bhāti tat pratyakṣam iti sphuṭam /
na tv atra kartṛkarmāṃśakaraṇatvādinā gatiḥ // [AgMsv_1.610]
mv-k04-v546.quick_english: All that shines, beginning with thus — that is clearly perception; but here there is no recourse through agent-act-part-instrumentality and the like.

tokens.grounds: tvādi with the long compound instrumental

mv-k04-v547.label: AgMsv_1.611
cite_parts:
nanv asāv asti pāścātye vaikalpikapathe tataḥ /
yato dehaghaṭābhāso sphuṭaḥ paścāt tu so 'sphuṭaḥ // [AgMsv_1.611]
mv-k04-v547.quick_english: But surely it exists in the later conceptual path — since the body-pot shining is clear, but afterwards it is unclear.

mv-k04-v548.label: AgMsv_1.612
cite_parts:
sa eva cchannarūpas tu śuddhāṃśasvātmasaṃvidam /
tato dehaghaṭābhāsas tatrāpy eṣaiva vartanī // [AgMsv_1.612]
mv-k04-v548.quick_english: But that very one of hidden form — toward pure-part self-consciousness; thence the body-pot shining; therein too this very procedure.

mv-k04-v549.label: AgMsv_1.613
cite_parts:
yāvatsahasradehaughabhāvakoṭyavabhāsanam /
tatrāpi ca purā paścān na tu tādṛkprathā yadi // [AgMsv_1.613]
mv-k04-v549.quick_english: Even the shining of crores of beings in thousand-fold floods of bodies — yet therein too, before and after, if there is no such-like forth-arising...

mv-k04-v550.label: AgMsv_1.614
cite_parts:
āmarśapadavīṃ yāti tat spuṭāsphuṭacitritaḥ /
tāvān asāv eka eva svarūpaprasphuṭātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.614]
mv-k04-v550.quick_english: It reaches the path of relishing — variegated clear-and-unclear; so much is this one alone, of manifest own-nature.

tokens.grounds: spuṭa for sphuṭa with dvandva adjective

mv-k04-v551.label: AgMsv_1.615
cite_parts:
śivaprakāśa āyāti. /

\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ vicitro 'yaṃ na vastutaḥ /
tatrātadrūpasaṃveśād vaicityraṃ paricarcyate // [AgMsv_1.615]
mv-k04-v551.quick_english: Śivas light comes. Variegated is this, not in reality — therein, from entry into the not-that-form, variety is considered.

mv-k04-v552.label: AgMsv_1.616
cite_parts:
śivaprakāśe 'tadrūpapraveśas tu na saṃgataḥ /
yadi vā kathitanyāyabalāt kvāpi na citratā // [AgMsv_1.616]
mv-k04-v552.quick_english: But entry into the not-that-form in Śivas light is incoherent — or else, by force of the stated reasoning, nowhere is there variety.

tokens.grounds: praveśa with atadrūpa visarga to s

mv-k04-v553.label: AgMsv_1.617
cite_parts:
kiṃtu citratayābhāsaś citrabhāvaṃ prasūyate /
evaṃ caitro 'yam asmākaṃ citravadbhavann īdṛśaḥ // [AgMsv_1.617]
mv-k04-v553.quick_english: But shining-as-variety gives birth to the variegated state; thus this Caitra of ours, being as it were variegated, is such.

tokens.grounds: ābhāsa with citratā visarga to ś

mv-k04-v554.label: AgMsv_1.618
cite_parts:
maitreṇa tanmatenālaṃ dṛṣṭo māṃ bhāvadarśinam /
paśyan paśyati yaḥ so 'yaṃ samādhau pariniṣṭhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.618]
mv-k04-v554.quick_english: Enough of Mitra view of that! Seen — me, the seer of beings — seeing, he sees; who, this very one, is established in samadhi.

mv-k04-v555.label: AgMsv_1.619
cite_parts:
prāk tv eṣa janmakoṭīṣu tattattāpādy abhuṅkta vai /
mokṣyate dhyānacaryādyair yo 'py etena pathāgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.619]
mv-k04-v555.quick_english: But formerly this one enjoyed, bringing about this and that, through crores of births indeed; he will be freed by meditation-practice and the like — whoever has come by this path.

mv-k04-v556.label: AgMsv_1.620
cite_parts:
so 'py anyo mokṣabhāg īttham aparyavasitodayaḥ /
prakāśa eka evāyaṃ yaś cirān na vibhidyate // [AgMsv_1.620]
mv-k04-v556.quick_english: This one too — another — is a freedom-sharer, thus of unended rise: the light, one alone, which has long been undivided.

mv-k04-v557.label: AgMsv_1.621
cite_parts:
ata eva hi bhedo 'sti na kaścid yo maheśvaram /
advayaṃ saṃprabindhīta prakāśānandasundaram // [AgMsv_1.621]
mv-k04-v557.quick_english: Therefore indeed there is no difference which could split the nondual Great Lord, beautiful with the bliss of light.

mv-k04-v558.label: AgMsv_1.622
cite_parts:
deśakālākṛtijñānadharmopādhyantarādayaḥ /
saṃmatā bhedakatvena bhānti cet sā vibhā tathā // [AgMsv_1.622]
mv-k04-v558.quick_english: Beginning with place, time, form, knowledge, property, and other adjuncts — agreed; if they shine as difference-makers, that shining is just so.

mv-k04-v559.label: AgMsv_1.623
cite_parts:
na ced vibhaiva sā tādṛk tad advaitam idaṃ sphuṭam /
bheda ity eṣa śabdas tu kevalaṃ pratibhojjhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.623]
mv-k04-v559.quick_english: But if that shining is just such, then this nondualism is clear — while the mere word difference is devoid of shine.

mv-k04-v560.label: AgMsv_1.624
cite_parts:
astu vā bhedakalanā pratibhāsaṃprarohiṇī /
uktanītyā tu tatraiva sapratiṣṭhā bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_1.624]
mv-k04-v560.quick_english: Let there be difference-reckoning growing in shining — but by the stated reasoning it will be well-established right there.

mv-k04-v561.label: AgMsv_1.625
cite_parts:
ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ paṭaś cāyaṃ tāv anyonyavibhedinau /
pramātrantarabhinnau ca tau matto 'pi vibhedinau // [AgMsv_1.625]
mv-k04-v561.quick_english: This pot and this cloth — the two differ mutually, differ from another knower too, and those two differ even from me.

mv-k04-v562.label: AgMsv_1.626
cite_parts:
iti prakāśa eko 'yaṃ tathāmarśasvarūpakaḥ /
nanv evaṃ pakṣapāto 'yam advaitaṃ bhavatāṃ katham // [AgMsv_1.626]
mv-k04-v562.quick_english: Thus this one light, of the nature of such relishing — but surely on this view this is partiality: how is nondualism yours?

mv-k04-v563.label: AgMsv_1.627
cite_parts:
bhedo 'py astu sa āhatya kiṃ nāma na viṣahyate /
seyaṃ badhiragoṣṭhīṣu gītavādyaprarocanā // [AgMsv_1.627]
mv-k04-v563.quick_english: Let difference be — having struck, what indeed is not endured? This is delighting deaf assemblies with song and music.

mv-k04-v564.label: AgMsv_1.628
cite_parts:
na hy advayaṃ dvayāveśabādhenāsmābhir ucyate /
tvatpakṣopagamo hy eṣa syād dvayaṃ taddhi susphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.628]
mv-k04-v564.quick_english: For nondualism is not stated by us through exclusion of dualism entry — that would be reaching your side, for that dualism is blatant.

tokens.grounds: bādha with the long compound instrumental

mv-k04-v565.label: AgMsv_1.629
cite_parts:
idaṃ dvaitam idaṃ neti tad idaṃ ca dvayādvayam /
iti yatra samaṃ bhāti tad advayam udāhṛtam // [AgMsv_1.629]
mv-k04-v565.quick_english: This is dual, this is not, and this is dual-and-nondual — where all shines the same, that is called nondual.

mv-k04-v566.label: AgMsv_1.630
cite_parts:
nanv ittham astu bhedo 'pi na vayaṃ śabdakāmukāḥ /
astv asau na hi no heyam ādeyaṃ vā yathātra vaḥ // [AgMsv_1.630]
mv-k04-v566.quick_english: Well then, so be it — even difference; we are no lovers of mere words. Let it be — for us there is nothing to reject or accept, as with you here.

mv-k04-v567.label: AgMsv_1.631
cite_parts:
sarvānugrāhakaṃ pakṣam ālilambiṣase yadi /
paramādvayadṛṣṭiṃ tat saṃśrayeḥ śaraṇaṃ mahat // [AgMsv_1.631]
mv-k04-v567.quick_english: If you would cling to the all-favoring position, then resort to the supreme-nondual view — the great refuge.

mv-k04-v568.label: AgMsv_1.632
cite_parts:
etad aṣṭādaśe tattvam adhikāre bhaviṣyati /
yat tad ante paraprāpyaṃ tad astu paramārthataḥ // [AgMsv_1.632]
mv-k04-v568.quick_english: This principle will be in the eighteenth chapter — which is finally to be reached as supreme; let that ultimately be.

mv-k04-v569.label: AgMsv_1.633
cite_parts:
atra ye na hi viśrāntās te mitāṃ saṃvidaṃ śritāḥ /
sarvathaivāpabādhyante janmamṛtyūtthavibhramaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.633]
mv-k04-v569.quick_english: But those who here have not come to rest resort to measured consciousness; they are in every way refuted by birth-death-born delusions.

tokens.grounds: vibhrama with the compound instrumental plural

mv-k04-v570.label: AgMsv_1.634
cite_parts:
tasmāt sa eka evāsau prakāśaḥ parameśvaraḥ /
pratyakṣam iti tenaiva prakāśenaiva bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.634]
mv-k04-v570.quick_english: Therefore this one light alone is the Lord; directly — thus by that very light it shines.

mv-k04-v571.label: AgMsv_1.635
cite_parts:
tatra tā dṛṣṭayaḥ sarvā mahānadya ivārṇave /
viśanty avaśyaṃ nāviṣṭāḥ prayānti kṛtakṛtyatām // [AgMsv_1.635]
mv-k04-v571.quick_english: Therein all those views, like great rivers in the ocean, necessarily enter; unentered, they do not reach fulfillment.

mv-k04-v572.label: AgMsv_1.636
cite_parts:
tathā hi mānasāmagrī rūpālokamanokṣajā /
sākaṃ mātṛprameyābhyāṃ tadvarjaṃ vāpy anekaśaḥ // [AgMsv_1.636]
mv-k04-v572.quick_english: For thus the mental apparatus, born of form, light, mind, and eye — together with knower and object, or excluding that, manifoldly.

tokens.grounds: jā born with the quadruple adjective

mv-k04-v573.label: AgMsv_1.637
cite_parts:
jñātaṃ ca gamayen mānaṃ na cāpi ujjhati mānatām /
pratyakṣapādotprekṣeyam idānīm upapadyate // [AgMsv_1.637]
mv-k04-v573.quick_english: And let it make the measure known — nor does it abandon measureness; this perception-grounded supposition holds good now.

mv-k04-v574.label: AgMsv_1.638
cite_parts:
kiṃ cānadhigatagrāhi mānaṃ navanavaṃ yataḥ /
bhairavecchāvaśād etad viśvaṃ bhāti tathā tathā // [AgMsv_1.638]
mv-k04-v574.quick_english: And since the measure grasping the ungrasped is ever fresh — by Bhairavas will this universe shines just so.

mv-k04-v575.label: AgMsv_1.639
cite_parts:
vastu pradarśayan mānaṃ pravṛttiṃ vidadhat sphuṭam /
prāpayaty eva tad vastu tathābhāsanayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.639]
mv-k04-v575.quick_english: Displaying the thing, the measure clearly effects activity; it brings about just that thing through fitness for such shining.

mv-k04-v576.label: AgMsv_1.640
cite_parts:
sad apy ekāntato nedaṃ nāsac cetyādisaṃvidaḥ /
bhānty eva paramārthena tad anekāntadṛk sphuṭā // [AgMsv_1.640]
mv-k04-v576.quick_english: Even the true absolute is not simply this or nonexistence; consciousness shines ultimately through a clear non-one-sided view.

mv-k04-v577.label: AgMsv_1.641
cite_parts:
eko bhāvaḥ sarvabhāvasvabhāvaḥ sarve bhāvā ekabhāvasvabhāvāḥ /
arhadvādaḥ so 'yam asmadsudṛṣṭau yuktaś ca śrīsāraśāstre 'pi coktaḥ // [AgMsv_1.641]
mv-k04-v577.quick_english: One being is the nature of all beings and all beings are the nature of one; this jain doctrine is fitting in our good view and is also stated in the Sri Sara scripture.

mv-k04-v578.label: AgMsv_1.642
cite_parts:
idaṃ mānaṃ meyaṃ tad idam iti saṃkhyāṃ kalayituṃ svarūpaṃ vā śaktaḥ ka iva jagatīty etad api sat /
mataṃ vācāṃ patyur bhagavati cidānandasubhage yatas tūṣṇīṃbhāvād apara iha kaḥ kiṃ prakurutām // [AgMsv_1.642]
mv-k04-v578.quick_english: Who is able to count measure and measured, this and that, in the world? This true opinion belongs to the blessed lord of speech, blissful consciousness; since he is silent, what else can anyone do here?

mv-k04-v579.label: AgMsv_1.643
cite_parts:
ahetor bhāne syād yadi na tanudikkālaniyamas tato hetor īdṛṅ niyama iti kasyaiṣa mahimā /
svabhāvo 'yaṃ hetor atha vivṛtakaṇṭhaṃ katham asau na bhāvasyaivokto yamayati pare kena hi paraḥ // [AgMsv_1.643]
mv-k04-v579.quick_english: If appearance were without cause, there would be no space-time restriction; then whose greatness is such restriction of cause? This own nature of cause, how does it not restrain being itself in the supreme, by whom indeed is the supreme?

mv-k04-v580.label: AgMsv_1.644
cite_parts:
svabhāvāc cātmāsau paramaśiva ity āgamakathā nirukto viśvātmā jagati nikhile jṛmbhata iti /
dharādeś cānanyo bhavatu tad iyaṃ bhūtacititā sa vandhyo dikkālair jananamaraṇāpāyarahitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.644]
mv-k04-v580.quick_english: From own nature the self is supreme Shiva, as scripture says; the world-self expands in the entire world. Let it be not other than earth and so on; this element-consciousness is barren, free from space-time, birth, death, and loss.

mv-k04-v581.label: AgMsv_1.645
cite_parts:
tad asyāyaṃ lokas tadanu paraloko 'py ayam it grahaḥ kasmād dhetoḥ spṛśati na hi taṃ kālakalanā /
tataḥ svātantryodyatsukharasaparānandamahimābhavadbhasmībhūtākhilakaluṣapāśaughasubhagaḥ // [AgMsv_1.645]
mv-k04-v581.quick_english: That is this world, then the other world also is this; why, because of cause, does time-measure not touch him? Therefore autonomy, rising bliss, supreme joy, glory, becoming ash, all impurity and bond-masses, is auspicious.

mv-k04-v582.label: AgMsv_1.646
cite_parts:
sāṃkhyadṛk punar ihaiva bhūyasā carcyate nikhilatattvagocarā /
dṛśyate dharaṇīprabhṛty alaṃ tac ca sūkṣmatamakāraṇotthitam // [AgMsv_1.646]
mv-k04-v582.quick_english: The sankhya view is again discussed here greatly, covering all principles; it is seen from earth upward, enough, and that arises from the subtlest cause.

mv-k04-v583.label: AgMsv_1.647
cite_parts:
tadgṛhītikaraṇodyataṃ punar bāhyataḥ karaṇakaṃ daśātmakam /
āntaraṃ trividham asya kāraṇaṃ saukhyaduḥkhaparimohadarpaṇaḥ // [AgMsv_1.647]
mv-k04-v583.quick_english: The instrument for grasping that is again external tenfold and internal threefold; the cause of this is a mirror of pleasure, pain, and delusion.

mv-k04-v584.label: AgMsv_1.648
cite_parts:
tādṛśaṃ triguṇam eva yad bhavet tat punar jaḍatayātha bhedataḥ / mūlakāraṇam apekṣate paraṃ sā niśeyam iha bhogyam ucyate /
tac ca bhoktṛ paratantratāmayam no parasparam upaiti bhoktṛtām // [AgMsv_1.648]
mv-k04-v584.quick_english: Such a three-guna thing, by inertness and difference, requires a supreme root cause; that is called enjoyable here, and dependence-nature does not mutually approach enjoyership.

mv-k04-v585.label: AgMsv_1.649
cite_parts:
bhogyabhoktṛvapur ekam eva no jāghaṭīti hi viruddhadharmataḥ /
tena bhoktṛ citiśaktimātrakam tac cidātmamayatāvaśān manaḥ // [AgMsv_1.649]
mv-k04-v585.quick_english: The body of enjoyable and enjoyer is not one, because of opposite qualities; therefore the enjoyer is only consciousness power, and mind is by consciousness nature.

mv-k04-v586.label: AgMsv_1.650
cite_parts:
vyāptṛ sarvagatam īśvaraṃ kathaṃ bhoktṛtāṃ vrajatu bhedasaṃgatām /
tena tannijavaśitvanirmitāṃ saṃkucatsthitijuṣaṃ daśāṃ śrayet // [AgMsv_1.650]
mv-k04-v586.quick_english: How can the all-pervading pervader, the lord, go to enjoyership joined with difference? Therefore he may resort to a contracted condition made by his own mastery.

mv-k04-v587.label: AgMsv_1.651
cite_parts:
anyakāraṇakalādyabhāvataḥ so 'yam asya sahajo malaḥ smṛtaḥ /
sa tridhā samavabhāti tadvaśād eṣa eva sa pumān udāhṛtaḥ // [AgMsv_1.651]
mv-k04-v587.quick_english: From absence of other cause and arts, this innate impurity of this is remembered; it appears threefold, and by its power this person is indeed called.

mv-k04-v588.label: AgMsv_1.652
cite_parts:
bhoktṛbhāvaparatantratāvaśā nāntarīyakatayāsya kañcukam /
bhāti naivam iti kālavitkalārāgasanniyatināmadheyakam // [AgMsv_1.652]
mv-k04-v588.quick_english: By dependence of enjoyership and by non-essentiality of this, the covering shines; not thus, it is named time, knowledge, arts, attachment, restriction.

mv-k04-v589.label: AgMsv_1.653
cite_parts:
yady ātmaiṣa punar nirargalanijasvātantryasaṃchāditaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ vivṛṇoty alaṃ nijabalāt tacchuddhavitsaṃbhavaḥ /
kartṛtvaṃ kila kāryavargam akhilaṃ bodhe nidhāya svake paśyann īśvaratāṃ vrajed aham idaṃ sarvaṃ sadety uddhuraḥ // [AgMsv_1.653]
mv-k04-v589.quick_english: If this self again reveals its own form covered by own autonomy, by own strength, pure consciousness birth; agency indeed places all class of actions in own knowledge, seeing, may go to lordship: I, this all, true, exalted.

mv-k04-v590.label: AgMsv_1.654
cite_parts:
jñātṛtvaṃ hṛdayāntarasphuritadṛg dṛṣṭvā sphuṭābhāsini jñeye bhedatirodhitāṃ nijacitau yasmāt sa saṃpaśyati /
tenāsyedam ahaṃvidoḥ sarabhasaṃ bhedaikyam ājagmuṣī sāmānādhikaraṇyadhīḥ prakaṭayet sādāśivīṃ saṃsthitim // [AgMsv_1.654]
mv-k04-v590.quick_english: Having seen knower-ness with the eye throbbing in the hearts interior — in the clearly shining object the concealment of difference in own consciousness — since he fully sees, thereby may the thought of common-substratum-ness, swiftly attaining the unity-and-difference of I and knower, reveal the Sadāśiva-state.

tokens.grounds: dṛś with the long compound instrumental

mv-k04-v591.label: AgMsv_1.655
cite_parts:
jñeyaṃ kāryaṃ sarvam antar vibodhe yāval līnaṃ tāvad udriktavṛtteḥ /
bodhajvālāsaṃcayasyāntarāle tatprastyānaṃ svaṃ vapuḥ projjhatīva // [AgMsv_1.655]
mv-k04-v591.quick_english: The whole object-effect merged within awakening — insofar as merged, from exuberant activity — in the interval of the flame-mass of awakening, that setting-forth as it were abandons its own form.

mv-k04-v592.label: AgMsv_1.656
cite_parts:
idaṃbhāvaḥ so 'yaṃ vigalitumanā no vigalito bhavet prākkakṣyāyām api sa samakāntis tad adhunā /
ahaṃbhāgodreke vidhir anavadhir bhāvavisare tad eṣā śāktī bhūriṣir iti svasiddhātmani parā // [AgMsv_1.656]
mv-k04-v592.quick_english: This this-ness of melted mind — may it not melt away for us even in the prior stage; it is of equal lustre. That now: in the excess of the I-share the rule is boundless; in the spread of beings, this śakti — supreme in the self-proved self.

mv-k04-v593.label: AgMsv_1.657
cite_parts:
īhate galitumanvato galet tatra pūrvapararūpasaṃgateḥ /
śāktabhūmir akhileyam ucyate citracinnicayacarcitā satī // [AgMsv_1.657]
mv-k04-v593.quick_english: It strives — may it melt from melted thought — from the conjunction of prior-and-later form; all this is called the śākta stage, being anointed with manifold consciousness-heaps.

tokens.grounds: carcitā with the long compound feminine

mv-k04-v594.label: AgMsv_1.658
cite_parts:
tattve tattve svecchayā devadevaḥ sarvāṃ sarvāṃ bhūmim ālambamānaḥ /
pūrṇaikātmā pūrṇasaṃvitsvarūpaḥ śrīmāñ śāstre bhairavo niruktaḥ // [AgMsv_1.658]
mv-k04-v594.quick_english: In principle after principle, by own will, the god of gods rests upon every stage — of full one-self, of full-consciousness-nature, glorious; in scripture declared Bhairava.

mv-k04-v595.label: AgMsv_1.659
cite_parts:
śaktipātadṛg iyaṃ nirucyate mandamadhyaparatīvrabhedataḥ /
tatparasparabhidābhir apy alaṃ yā svarūpaparidṛṣṭir ātmanaḥ // [AgMsv_1.659]
mv-k04-v595.quick_english: This descent-of-power view is declared according to faint, middling, supreme, and intense distinction — but enough of those mutual divisions, which is the all-round vision of the self nature.

mv-k04-v596.label: AgMsv_1.660
cite_parts:
nanu kiṃ kadācid ayam īśvaro nijarūpaṃ prakāśayati pūrṇacitiḥ /
kiṃ vā kadācid atha saṃvṛṇute nirhetuko hi niyamaḥ kila kaḥ // [AgMsv_1.660]
mv-k04-v596.quick_english: But surely — does this Lord, full consciousness, ever reveal his own form? Or does he ever conceal it? For what indeed would be a causeless rule?

mv-k04-v597.label: AgMsv_1.661
cite_parts:
uktam atra kila pūrvam anantaṃ nānyad asti niyameṣu nimittam /
laukikeṣv api sa eva maheśaś citracitraparibhāsanaśīlaḥ // [AgMsv_1.661]
mv-k04-v597.quick_english: Endlessly declared before, they say: there is no other cause in regularities, even worldly ones — that very Great Lord, whose habit is ever-variegated shining-forth.

tokens.grounds: śīla with the long compound nominative

mv-k04-v598.label: AgMsv_1.662
cite_parts:
tatsvātantryād adhikam adhunā nottaraṃ bambhaṇīmaḥ saṃvitsindhoḥ prathitalaharīharmyadhārādhirūḍhiḥ /
śāntis tasyās tadanu tad ayaṃ bandhanāmnāpadiṣṭas tenaivetthaṃ parigataraso mokṣa ity uktarūpaḥ // [AgMsv_1.662]
mv-k04-v598.quick_english: From his autonomy — more now, no reply — we babble, mounted on the palace-course of the famed waves of the consciousness-ocean. Peace thereof; thereupon that — this one designated by the name bondage — thereby thus of fully-drunk relish: freedom, of the stated form.

tokens.grounds: adhirūḍhi with the long compound nominative
apadiṣṭa with bandhanāman visarga to s

mv-k04-v599.label: AgMsv_1.663
cite_parts:
sadā kadācid adhunā tadetyādi ca saṃvidaḥ /
tatsvātantryāvabhāsīyakālakelivikalpanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.663]
mv-k04-v599.quick_english: Always, sometimes, now, beginning with that — of consciousness: the time-sport imaginings shining with his autonomy.

tokens.grounds: vikalpanā with the long compound nominative plural

mv-k04-v600.label: AgMsv_1.664
cite_parts:
na ca kālakalābhiḥ sa spṛśyate parameśvaraḥ /
na hi tāsāṃ svatantrāsti sthitis tatkalpanāṃ vinā // [AgMsv_1.664]
mv-k04-v600.quick_english: And the Lord is not touched by time-divisions — for they have no independent standing without the imagining of that.

tokens.grounds: visarga to s before t nominative
visarga to s before t nominative

mv-k05-v601.label: AgMsv_1.665
cite_parts:
tena svasṛṣṭe bhāvāṃśe svarūpātmany api sphuṭam /
pāratantryāvabhāso 'yaṃ devenaivāvabhāsyate // [AgMsv_1.665]
mv-k05-v601.quick_english: Therefore, even in the self-created portion of being, which is essentially one's own nature, this clear appearance of dependence is manifested by the Lord alone.

tokens.grounds: part or aspect of existence; bhāva-aṃśa
whose essence is one's own nature; svarūpa-ātman

mv-k05-v602.label: AgMsv_1.666
cite_parts:
pāratantryaṃ kalayati svatantraḥ parameśvaraḥ /
svātantrye pāratantrye ca nānyal lakṣaṇam ucyate // [AgMsv_1.666]
mv-k05-v602.quick_english: The self-dependent supreme Lord fashions dependence; no other defining mark is stated for autonomy and dependence than this.

mv-k05-v603.label: AgMsv_1.667
cite_parts:
paricchinnaprakāśo hi jaḍas tenātra yaḥ sthitaḥ /
paricchedaka eṣo 'pi paricchedyo yadi sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.667]
mv-k05-v603.quick_english: For what has limited light is inert; therefore, if the limiter posited here is itself clearly something to be limited, a problem arises.

tokens.grounds: one whose light is circumscribed; paricchinna-prakāśa

mv-k05-v604.label: AgMsv_1.668
cite_parts:
tad asya rūpagrahaṇe na prakāśaḥ prakāśate /
tathā hi bāhyo bhāvāṃśaḥ svayaṃ naiṣa prakāśate // [AgMsv_1.668]
mv-k05-v604.quick_english: Then, in grasping its form, light does not shine; for an external portion of being does not shine by itself.

mv-k05-v605.label: AgMsv_1.669
cite_parts:
jñānam arthaprakāśātma tac cānābhātam eva hi /
tasyāpi samavāyy ātmā naiva bhāti svarūpataḥ // [AgMsv_1.669]
mv-k05-v605.quick_english: Knowledge is of the nature of illuminating objects, yet if it is unmanifest, even its inherent self does not shine by its own nature.

tokens.grounds: having the illumination of objects as its essence; artha-prakāśa-ātman
ca-anābhāta; not appearing; sandhi within token

mv-k05-v606.label: AgMsv_1.670
cite_parts:
tadīyakaraṇaṃ netraprabhṛty api na bhāsate /
ālokādeś ca vijñānād ṛte naivāvābhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.670]
mv-k05-v606.quick_english: Its instrument, such as the eye, does not shine by itself; and without consciousness there is no manifestation at all, even with light and other aids.

tokens.grounds: the instrument belonging to that; tadīya-karaṇa

mv-k05-v607.label: AgMsv_1.671
cite_parts:
nanu jātaṃ yadi jñānam arthasyāsau prakāśatā /
śaktir dharmo yadi prāptaṃ sārvajñyaṃ viśvamaṇḍale // [AgMsv_1.671]
mv-k05-v607.quick_english: But if, when knowledge arises, that luminosity of the object is its own power or property, then omniscience would follow throughout the whole universe.

mv-k05-v608.label: AgMsv_1.672
cite_parts:
anyad evātha tat kiṃcit prakāśatvābhiśabditam /
tan meyamātṛmāneṣu naiva kutrāpi saṃgatam // [AgMsv_1.672]
mv-k05-v608.quick_english: Or if that so-called luminosity is taken as something else, it does not fit coherently anywhere among the known, the knower, and the means of knowing.

tokens.grounds: designated by the term luminosity; prakāśatva-abhiśabdita
among known, knower, and knowing; meya-mātṛ-māna

mv-k05-v609.label: AgMsv_1.673
cite_parts:
tataś cāprakaṭaṃ viśvaṃ sarvadaiva bhaved idam /
aprakāśasya bhāvasya yadi ca syād prakāśanam // [AgMsv_1.673]
mv-k05-v609.quick_english: Therefore this whole universe would always remain unmanifest; and if an unmanifest being were to become illuminated, another difficulty follows.

mv-k05-v610.label: AgMsv_1.674
cite_parts:
tāvataivāsya hīyeta svarūpaṃ parihānitaḥ /
jñānotpattiś ca bhāvasya svarūpasthasya cet prathā // [AgMsv_1.674]
mv-k05-v610.quick_english: By that much its own nature would be lost; and if the arising of knowledge is the manifestation of a being while it remains in its own nature, that must be explained.

tokens.grounds: remaining in its essential form; svarūpa-stha

mv-k05-v611.label: AgMsv_1.675
cite_parts:
aviśiṣṭe svarūpasthabhāve viśvasya sā na kim /
tasmāt prakāśo viśvasya paricchedakaniṣṭhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.675]
mv-k05-v611.quick_english: If a being remains undifferentiated in its own nature, why would that manifestation not belong to the whole universe? Therefore the light of the universe rests in the limiter.

tokens.grounds: in an entity remaining in its essence; svarūpa-stha-bhāva
grounded in the delimiting principle; paricchedaka-niṣṭhita

mv-k05-v612.label: AgMsv_1.676
cite_parts:
tatsvātantryāvabhāsotthacitrākāravibheditaḥ /
paricchedaka itthaṃ cet paricchedyo bhavet tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.676]
mv-k05-v612.quick_english: If the limiter, differentiated by varied forms arising from the manifestation of its own freedom, were itself something to be limited, then a consequence follows.

mv-k05-v613.label: AgMsv_1.677
cite_parts:
mūlakṣatikarī seyam anavasthā patiṣyati /
ataś ca so 'paricchinnaḥ paricchedaka ucyate // [AgMsv_1.677]
mv-k05-v613.quick_english: Then this root-destroying infinite regress would occur; therefore that limiter is said to be unlimited.

mv-k05-v614.label: AgMsv_1.678
cite_parts:
akālpyas tena śāstreṣu tan na kālasya gocaraḥ /
tenāsya vedyadharmatvaṃ kālasya paribhāṣitam // [AgMsv_1.678]
mv-k05-v614.quick_english: Therefore it is not constructible and, as the scriptures say, not within the domain of time; for that reason the condition of being a knowable object is explained as belonging to time.

tokens.grounds: not to be conceptually fabricated; a-kalpya
the condition of having knowable properties; vedya-dharma-tva

mv-k05-v615.label: AgMsv_1.679
cite_parts:
yadi kālaś ca mātāraṃ paricchindyāt tato dhruvam /
mātṛlagnaiva kālasya sthitir nirvāham icchati // [AgMsv_1.679]
mv-k05-v615.quick_english: If time were to delimit the subject, then the stability of time would certainly depend on the subject and would require the subject's functioning.

mv-k05-v616.label: AgMsv_1.680
cite_parts:
na ca mātrantaraṃ kiṃcit saṃbhaved anavasthiteḥ /
tāṃ hantuṃ vopagamyo 'sau mātā kālakalojjhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.680]
mv-k05-v616.quick_english: And no other subject could be posited, because of infinite regress; to remove that regress, this subject must be accepted as free from the divisions of time.

mv-k05-v617.label: AgMsv_1.681
cite_parts:
ya eva tu paricchedyo mātā tallagna eva cet /
sa kālo mātṛmeyatve tarhy ekasya kathaṃ tava // [AgMsv_1.681]
mv-k05-v617.quick_english: But if the limited subject is indeed dependent on that time, then how, in your view, can one and the same entity be both subject and object?

tokens.grounds: in being both knower and known; mātṛ-meya-tva

mv-k05-v618.label: AgMsv_1.682
cite_parts:
bhedavāde hi bhavatāṃ niṣṭhitā matir īdṛśī /
abhedavādināṃ nas tu naiva kāpy astu khaṇḍanā // [AgMsv_1.682]
mv-k05-v618.quick_english: For in the doctrine of difference your view is fixed in that way; but for us, who uphold non-difference, let there be no such refutation at all.

tokens.grounds: in the view based on difference; bheda-vāda
of those who hold non-difference; abheda-vādin

mv-k05-v619.label: AgMsv_1.683
cite_parts:
viśvaṃ mātṛmayaṃ yeṣāṃ mātā viśvamayas tathā /
tan na kālakalājālajambālaiḥ parameśvaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.683]
mv-k05-v619.quick_english: For those for whom the universe consists of the subject and the subject likewise consists of the universe, the supreme Lord is not entangled in the mire of the nets of time and limiting factors.

tokens.grounds: by entangling nets of time and limiting factors; kāla-kalā-jāla-jambāla

mv-k05-v620.label: AgMsv_1.684
cite_parts:
citiśaktiprakāśo hi mālinyam avalambate /
atas tadā saṃvṛto 'sau paścāt prakaṭarūpakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.684]
mv-k05-v620.quick_english: For the light of the power of consciousness takes on a kind of tarnish; therefore it appears concealed at that time and later appears in manifest form.

tokens.grounds: the luminosity of the power of consciousness; citi-śakti-prakāśa

mv-k05-v621.label: AgMsv_1.685
cite_parts:
iti tasyaiva jṛmbheyaṃ tathātvavyapadeśinī /
kalanaivāsya sā kācit svarūpāmarśanātmikā // [AgMsv_1.685]
mv-k05-v621.quick_english: Thus this unfolding, which designates that condition, belongs to that same reality alone; it is a certain creative construal of its own, whose nature is reflective awareness of its own form.

tokens.grounds: consisting in reflective awareness of one's own nature; svarūpa-āmarśana-ātmikā

mv-k05-v622.label: AgMsv_1.686
cite_parts:
śivayogārham ātmānaṃ yasyām ātmābhimanyate /
yato vaicitryayogena tathātmānaṃ sa manyate // [AgMsv_1.686]
mv-k05-v622.quick_english: In that construal the self regards itself as fit for union with Śiva; for through connection with variety it comes to regard itself in that way.

tokens.grounds: the self takes itself to be; ātmā-abhimanyate

mv-k05-v623.label: AgMsv_1.687
cite_parts:
śaktipātasya tenoktā navadhātra vyavasthitiḥ /
anyathā neśvarasyāsti rāgo dveṣo 'tha vā kvacit // [AgMsv_1.687]
mv-k05-v623.quick_english: Therefore the descent of power is taught here as ninefold; otherwise the Lord would have attachment or aversion somewhere, which he does not.

tokens.grounds: of the fall/descent of grace-power; śakti-pāta

mv-k05-v624.label: AgMsv_1.688
cite_parts:
yena kvāpy eṣa niyatāṃ svāṃ śaktiṃ pātayed vibhuḥ /
animittas tathā cāyaṃ śaktipāto maheśituḥ // [AgMsv_1.688]
mv-k05-v624.quick_english: For if this all-pervading Lord were to send down his own power in a fixed way anywhere, that would imply a motive; thus this descent of power of the great Lord is without external cause.

mv-k05-v625.label: AgMsv_1.689
cite_parts:
tena rāgakṣayāt karmasāmyāt sukṛtagauravāt /
malapākāt suhṛdyogād bhakter bhāvāc ca sevanāt // [AgMsv_1.689]
mv-k05-v625.quick_english: By decay of attachment, equality of karma, weight of good deeds, ripening of impurity, union with a friend, devotion, feeling, and practice.

mv-k05-v626.label: AgMsv_1.690
cite_parts:
abhyāsād vāsanodbhedāt saṃskāraparipākataḥ /
mithyajñānakṣayāt karmasaṃnyāsāt kāmyavicyuteḥ // [AgMsv_1.690]
mv-k05-v626.quick_english: From practice, breaking of latencies, ripening of impressions, decay of false knowledge, renunciation of karma, and falling away of desire.

mv-k05-v627.label: AgMsv_1.691
cite_parts:
sāmyāc cittasya sā śaktiḥ patatīti yad ucyate /
tad asan /
nanu tatrāpi nimittāntaramārgaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.691]
mv-k05-v627.quick_english: That power descends from equality of mind is said, but that is unreal; even there another cause must be sought.

mv-k05-v628.label: AgMsv_1.692
cite_parts:
anavasthātiprasaṅgasaṃbhavābhāvayogataḥ /
anyonyāśrayaniḥśreṇicakrakādyupapātataḥ // [AgMsv_1.692]
mv-k05-v628.quick_english: From the absence of infinite regress and from avoiding mutual dependence, circularity, and similar faults.

mv-k05-v629.label: AgMsv_1.693
cite_parts:
asmiṃs tu pakṣe sarveṣāṃ pravādānām api sthitiḥ /
yuktā sarvaṃsahe pakṣe na kiṃcit kila duṣyati // [AgMsv_1.693]
mv-k05-v629.quick_english: In this view, even all doctrines have a fitting standing; in the all-enduring view, nothing is indeed faulted.

mv-k05-v630.label: AgMsv_1.694
cite_parts:
yuktiḥ sudhībhiḥ svayam eva tatra śakyeta saṃyojayitum tato na /
pṛthaktayā yojanam uktam atra yad granthato vistara eṣa mithyā // [AgMsv_1.694]
mv-k05-v630.quick_english: Wise ones can join it themselves there; therefore separate joining is not said here, and this textual expansion is false.

mv-k05-v631.label: AgMsv_1.695
cite_parts:
upajagmur ato 'napekṣiṇīṃ śivaśaktiṃ na ca tāṃ vinā bhavet /
apavargapadaṃ yato mudhā paraśāstreṣu vimokṣasaṃkathāḥ // [AgMsv_1.695]
mv-k05-v631.quick_english: Therefore they approached independent Shiva-power; without her there is no liberation-state, so liberation-talks in other scriptures are in vain.

mv-k05-v632.label: AgMsv_1.696
cite_parts:
śaktipātasamaye vicāraṇaṃ prāptam īśa na karoṣi karhicit /
śrīmadutpalagurur nyarūpayat tatra tatra nijaśāstra īdṛśam // [AgMsv_1.696]
mv-k05-v632.quick_english: At the time of power-descent inquiry is proper, Lord, yet you never do it; the venerable Utpala teacher showed such inquiry there in his own scripture.

mv-k05-v633.label: AgMsv_1.697
cite_parts:
tasyaiva hi prasādena bhaktir utpādyate nṛṇām /
yayā yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ tadbhāvagatamānasaḥ // [AgMsv_1.697]
mv-k05-v633.quick_english: By his grace alone devotion is produced in men, by which they go to supreme perfection with mind gone to his state.

mv-k05-v634.label: AgMsv_1.698
cite_parts:
itthaṃ purāṇaśāstrādau śaktiḥ sā pārameśvarī /
nirapekṣaiva kathitā sāpekṣatve hy anīśatā // [AgMsv_1.698]
mv-k05-v634.quick_english: Thus in the puranas and scriptures first, that supreme power is declared independent, for in dependence there is lack of lordship.

mv-k05-v635.label: AgMsv_1.699
cite_parts:
kevalaṃ bhedavādāndhyasthagitālasadṛṣṭibhiḥ /
duḥsamarthatvam etasyā niyamena kvacitsthiteḥ // [AgMsv_1.699]
mv-k05-v635.quick_english: Only by blind views hidden by dualism does difficulty of capacity of this power arise, by rule of its sometimes standing.

mv-k05-v636.label: AgMsv_1.700
cite_parts:
paryālocyāniśaṃ karmamalasāmyaprapākataḥ /
ityādihetujāleṣu vṛthātmā parikhedyate // [AgMsv_1.700]
mv-k05-v636.quick_english: Constantly considering karma, impurity, equality, and ripening in nets of such causes, the vain self is exhausted.

mv-k05-v637.label: AgMsv_1.701
cite_parts:
tat teṣāṃ nopakārāya kuśakāśāvalambanam /
tasmāt sa eva tādṛkṣasvasvātantryopabṛṃhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.701]
mv-k05-v637.quick_english: That is not for their benefit, like clinging to grass; therefore he indeed is endowed with such own autonomy.

mv-k05-v638.label: AgMsv_1.702
cite_parts:
tadā tathā tathetyādivaicitryeṇāvabhāsate /
tad itthaṃ sarvadṛṣṭīṇām atraiva parameśvare // [AgMsv_1.702]
mv-k05-v638.quick_english: Then so it appears with such variety; thus all views are right here in the supreme Lord.

mv-k05-v639.label: AgMsv_1.703
cite_parts:
anupraveśa ity anyair alaṃ vā yuktiḍambaraiḥ /
tad itthaṃ devadevena svasvarūpam ihoditam // [AgMsv_1.703]
mv-k05-v639.quick_english: Entry thus by others, enough, or with reasoning pomp; that own nature is here declared by the god of gods.

mv-k05-v640.label: AgMsv_1.704
cite_parts:
pratyakṣaṃ tatra tanmānaṃ sarvamānadhuroddhuram /
ekam evedṛśaṃ mānam iti kecit prapedire // [AgMsv_1.704]
mv-k05-v640.quick_english: Direct perception there is its measure, supreme among all measures; some held one such measure thus.

mv-k05-v641.label: AgMsv_1.705
cite_parts:
dhūmād agnir iti prāyas tasyaivaitad vijṛṃbhitam /
yathā ghaṭasya pūrvāṃśadṛṣṭaikapariniṣṭhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.705]
mv-k05-v641.quick_english: From smoke fire, thus mostly; this is his manifestation, as of a pot fixed by seeing its first part.

mv-k05-v642.label: AgMsv_1.706
cite_parts:
mātā sphuṭāsphuṭākāratāvadarthāvalehinīm /
sphuṭām eva matiṃ matvā pratyakṣatvaṃ prapadyate // [AgMsv_1.706]
mv-k05-v642.quick_english: Mother, grasping such form, having considered clear mind indeed, direct perception attains.

mv-k05-v643.label: AgMsv_1.707
cite_parts:
na cānumānam antyāṃśe saṃvid ekaiva sā yataḥ /
dhūmādhyakṣapratītyantarniviṣṭāgniprathā tathā // [AgMsv_1.707]
mv-k05-v643.quick_english: Not and inference in the final part; awareness is one indeed, because fire is known within smoke perception, so.

mv-k05-v644.label: AgMsv_1.708
cite_parts:
ekaiva tāvad arthāṃśalehinī jāyate matiḥ /
tāvaty āṃśe sphuṭākārā pratyakṣam iti bhāṣyatām // [AgMsv_1.708]
mv-k05-v644.quick_english: One indeed, so far grasping an object part, mind arises; to that extent in part clear form is direct perception, thus let it be said.

mv-k05-v645.label: AgMsv_1.709
cite_parts:
yathā ratnādivaicityraṃ tathā saṃskārasaṃsthiteḥ /
netrātmamānasālokaviṣayādiṣu saṃvidi // [AgMsv_1.709]
mv-k05-v645.quick_english: As variety of gems, so from establishment of impressions in eye, mind, light, object, etc., in awareness.

mv-k05-v646.label: AgMsv_1.710
cite_parts:
pratyakṣam eva saṃvittau sphuṭatvenāvabhāsate /
tathā tathāvidhavyāptidhāmasaṃkārasaṃsthiteḥ // [AgMsv_1.710]
mv-k05-v646.quick_english: Direct perception indeed in awareness appears as clear, so from establishment of such pervasion, light, and impression.

mv-k05-v647.label: AgMsv_1.711
cite_parts:
ante tathaiva sā vittir dhūmāgnyākārarūpiṇī /
yathā ca dṛḍhasaṃskārāḥ sollekhāḥ sapadi svayam // [AgMsv_1.711]
mv-k05-v647.quick_english: At the end, so indeed that awareness having smoke-fire form, as firm impressions with clear marks immediately oneself.

mv-k05-v648.label: AgMsv_1.712
cite_parts:
ratnāditattvaṃ paśyanti vighnāntaratirodhitaḥ /
tathā bubhukṣitātmānaḥ śīghram evātiniścitam // [AgMsv_1.712]
mv-k05-v648.quick_english: Gem etc. reality they see, obstructed by inner obstacle; so hungry selves quickly, very certain indeed.

mv-k05-v649.label: AgMsv_1.713
cite_parts:
annādi gṛhṇate bhoktuṃ vyāptyādyavyavadhānataḥ /
tena pratyuktam eva syād yad āhuḥ parikalpanam // [AgMsv_1.713]
mv-k05-v649.quick_english: People take food to eat without any intervening inference of pervasion or the like; therefore what the opponents call mere conceptual construction is already answered and refuted.

mv-k05-v650.label: AgMsv_1.714
cite_parts:
abhyasteṣv avinābhāvasvabhāvavyāptisaṃvidaḥ /
kiṃ hi tatkalpanāvyāptivitter iti na manmahe // [AgMsv_1.714]
mv-k05-v650.quick_english: In matters that have become well practiced, where awareness of invariable pervasion is already present, what use is there for a cognition pervaded by conceptual construction? We do not accept that.

mv-k05-v651.label: AgMsv_1.715
cite_parts:
āśūtpattivaśād asyā na khalv asty upalakṣaṇam /
anumīyata evaṃ sā tad eva parikalpanam // [AgMsv_1.715]
mv-k05-v651.quick_english: Because this cognition arises very quickly, it is not clearly noticed; so the opponent infers that it must be conceptual construction. That is the move being stated here.

tokens.grounds: what is absent due to speed

mv-k05-v652.label: AgMsv_1.716
cite_parts:
aho svapakṣapātāndhāḥ svam apy upagataṃ muhuḥ /
amī vismartum ārabdhās tārkikammanyabuddhayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.716]
mv-k05-v652.quick_english: Alas, these people who fancy themselves logicians, blinded by loyalty to their own side, have begun again and again to forget even what they themselves have accepted.

mv-k05-v653.label: AgMsv_1.717
cite_parts:
kṣaṇāpavargiṇī buddhiḥ sarvaiva hi bhavanmatā /
utpattimātrayogena viṣayasyāvabhāsikā // [AgMsv_1.717]
mv-k05-v653.quick_english: For in your own view, every cognition lasts only a moment and manifests its object simply by arising.

tokens.grounds: nature of cognition in opponent's view

mv-k05-v654.label: AgMsv_1.718
cite_parts:
na kṣaṇāc cāparaṃ kiṃcid āśubhāvitvam ucyate /
tat sarvam āśubhāvy eva vijñānam iti tattvataḥ // [AgMsv_1.718]
mv-k05-v654.quick_english: If swift manifestation means nothing more than what happens in a moment, then in truth every cognition would be swiftly manifesting.

mv-k05-v655.label: AgMsv_1.719
cite_parts:
sarvatra bhāvajāteṣu bhaved anupalakṣaṇam /
athāvicchinnadṛṣṭīnāṃ drāghīyaḥkālagocaram // [AgMsv_1.719]
mv-k05-v655.quick_english: Then non-noticing would occur everywhere among all things; or else, in the case of unbroken seeing, what is known would have to range over a longer time.

mv-k05-v656.label: AgMsv_1.720
cite_parts:
jñātaṃ tenāpi tarhy artho janmamātreṇa bhāsyate /
yac cotpattivaśād eva viṣayasphuṭatātmakam // [AgMsv_1.720]
mv-k05-v656.quick_english: Then even on that view the object is manifested by mere arising; and if clarity of the object is also due simply to arising, that same fact must explain everything.

mv-k05-v657.label: AgMsv_1.721
cite_parts:
tasya śīghratarasthāsnubhāvo bhedāvahaḥ katham /
yat tat kila grahāpekṣaṃ svaprakāśam athāpi sat // [AgMsv_1.721]
mv-k05-v657.quick_english: How can the fact that the experience is quicker make a difference, if that cognition is said to be self-luminous, even while being related to grasping?

tokens.grounds: refers to the cognition or clarity

mv-k05-v658.label: AgMsv_1.722
cite_parts:
anyatropāyatāṃ yāti vidyuddīpādivat tathā /
tatraiva ciraśīghrasthabhāvo bhedāya bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.722]
mv-k05-v658.quick_english: If it becomes a means elsewhere, like lightning or a lamp, then the difference between lasting long or briefly may appear right there as a basis for difference.

mv-k05-v659.label: AgMsv_1.723
cite_parts:
na ca kvāpy anumāneṣu vyāptyāder grahaṇaṃ bhavet /
punaḥ punaḥ sphuṭībhāvaṃ yāti yenopalakṣyate // [AgMsv_1.723]
mv-k05-v659.quick_english: And in inferences the grasping of pervasion and so on does not become clear again and again in such a way that it would be separately noticed.

mv-k05-v660.label: AgMsv_1.724
cite_parts:
kiṃ ca kramikadhūmādijñānamālātmani sphuṭam /
uditāpi kathaṃ kuryād ekabhāvāvabhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.724]
mv-k05-v660.quick_english: Moreover, even if a clear series of successive cognitions of smoke and so on arises, how could that produce the manifestation of a single thing?

mv-k05-v661.label: AgMsv_1.725
cite_parts:
athāntyam anusandhānajñānam evaṃ kariṣyati /
tad api prāksthasaṃvittisamaṃ bhinnaṃ kathaṃ tathā // [AgMsv_1.725]
mv-k05-v661.quick_english: If one says the final connecting cognition will do this, that too is distinct and just like the earlier cognitions—so how could it unify them in that way?

mv-k05-v662.label: AgMsv_1.726
cite_parts:
tena prāktanavijñānamālāmanvasyate yadi /
tad asan na hi saṃdhānaṃ naṣṭāyām upapadyate // [AgMsv_1.726]
mv-k05-v662.quick_english: If that final cognition is supposed to connect the earlier series of cognitions, but those earlier cognitions no longer exist, then no connection is possible once they have perished.

mv-k05-v663.label: AgMsv_1.727
cite_parts:
atha smaraṇam eveha saṃdhānaṃ saṃvidāṃ bhavet /
tad apy anubhavābhāve kathaṃ nāma bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_1.727]
mv-k05-v663.quick_english: If one says that memory itself is the connection between cognitions, how could that memory arise at all in the absence of experience?

mv-k05-v664.label: AgMsv_1.728
cite_parts:
na ca jñāneṣv anubhavo yujyate saṃvidaḥ kvacit /
yugapaj jñānayugalaṃ nāstīti hi bhavanmatam // [AgMsv_1.728]
mv-k05-v664.quick_english: And in your view there is no pair of cognitions existing simultaneously; so an experience of cognitions by awareness does not fit anywhere in that system.

mv-k05-v665.label: AgMsv_1.729
cite_parts:
jñānajñeyātmatā dṛṣṭā yugapatsthitatājuṣoḥ /
na tu pūrvāparākārasamutpannavirodhinoḥ // [AgMsv_1.729]
mv-k05-v665.quick_english: The relation of cognition and its object is observed only where two factors stand together at the same time, not where they arise successively as earlier and later and are therefore opposed.

mv-k05-v666.label: AgMsv_1.730
cite_parts:
tasmād vyāptyanusārāvabhāsapūrvāpi yā matiḥ /
tatrāpy akramam evedaṃ pratyakṣamānavedanam // [AgMsv_1.730]
mv-k05-v666.quick_english: Therefore, even the cognition that seems to be preceded by a manifestation following pervasion is, in that very case, a non-sequential knowing of a directly perceptual kind.

mv-k05-v667.label: AgMsv_1.731
cite_parts:
yathā jhaṭiti sauṣuptaprabuddhaḥ pronmiṣaddṛṣiḥ /
pratyakṣam iti bhāvāṃśadhyāmalatvanivṛtaye // [AgMsv_1.731]
mv-k05-v667.quick_english: Just as someone suddenly awakened from deep sleep, with eyes just opening, acts to remove the dimness in the appearance of things, taking them directly...

mv-k05-v668.label: AgMsv_1.732
cite_parts:
netrasaṃmārjanādīni vidadhannābhimanyate /
bhāvān anuminomīti tathaivātrāpi buddhyatām // [AgMsv_1.732]
mv-k05-v668.quick_english: While rubbing the eyes and so on, that person does not think, 'I am inferring these things.' Let the same be understood in this case as well.

mv-k05-v669.label: AgMsv_1.733
cite_parts:
yathā ca ghanasauṣuptamohāvyutthitadarśanaḥ /
svātmānam atha tatsthānaṃ vismaraty eva tat kṣaṇaṃ // [AgMsv_1.733]
mv-k05-v669.quick_english: And just as someone whose vision has just emerged from the delusion of deep sleep may, for that moment, forget himself and the place he is in...

mv-k05-v670.label: AgMsv_1.734
cite_parts:
atha prayatnasaṃbhāraprabuddhavimalasvadṛk /
so 'ham asmīti manvānaḥ saṃvitteḥ paramārthataḥ // [AgMsv_1.734]
mv-k05-v670.quick_english: Then, when his own clear seeing is awakened through gathered effort, he recognizes, 'I am that one,' and in the ultimate sense this comes from awareness itself.

mv-k05-v671.label: AgMsv_1.735
cite_parts:
tatra sarvatra nātho 'yaṃ bhairavaś citsvarūpakaḥ /
svātantryāt svaṃ vapur yāvad gūhate vivṛṇoti ca // [AgMsv_1.735]
mv-k05-v671.quick_english: In all of this, the Lord Bhairava, whose very nature is consciousness, freely conceals and reveals his own form.

mv-k05-v672.label: AgMsv_1.736
cite_parts:
tāvad ajñānam etasya vijñānaṃ copajāyate /
tac ca sphuṭatayā sarvapratyakṣam iti manyatām // [AgMsv_1.736]
mv-k05-v672.quick_english: To that extent ignorance arises, and knowledge arises; and that knowledge, by its clarity, should be understood as directly evident to all.

tokens.grounds: of the subject or Lord's manifestation

mv-k05-v673.label: AgMsv_1.737
cite_parts:
ghaṭaśabde śrute yā ca pṛthubudhnodarādidhīḥ /
tatrāpi khalu samketasmaraṇādi tathāvidham // [AgMsv_1.737]
mv-k05-v673.quick_english: When the word 'pot' is heard, a cognition arises of its broad base, belly, and other features; in that cognition, convention, memory, and similar factors are present in the same way.

mv-k05-v674.label: AgMsv_1.738
cite_parts:
yathā ratnaparīkṣāyāṃ svāṃ saṃvittiṃ sphuṭātmikām /
samvidantarasaṃghātais tiṣṭhati pratibodhayan // [AgMsv_1.738]
mv-k05-v674.quick_english: Just as in examining a gem one awakens one's own clear awareness through assemblages of other cognitions, so that awareness stands forth distinctly.

mv-k05-v675.label: AgMsv_1.739
cite_parts:
tataḥ prabuddhacaramasphuṭasaṃvittiyogataḥ /
ratnatattvaṃ vibhāty atra nopayoge 'nyasaṃvidām // [AgMsv_1.739]
mv-k05-v675.quick_english: Then, through the connection with the final awakened clear awareness, the reality of the gem shines forth; at that point the other cognitions have no further use.

mv-k05-v676.label: AgMsv_1.740
cite_parts:
tāḥ paraṃ tatprabodhāya kāraṇatvaṃ vitenire /
tasyaivāvabhāsayoge hi na tāsām upayogitā // [AgMsv_1.740]
mv-k05-v676.quick_english: Those other cognitions exercised causality only for awakening that awareness; for in the very connection of its manifestation, they have no usefulness.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to other cognitions
tasya + eva + avabhāsa + yoge, locative compound

mv-k05-v677.label: AgMsv_1.741
cite_parts:
bālavaikaṭikajñānadṛṣṭāntād īdṛśāt svayam /
śābde 'pi khalu vijñāne sphuṭaivaikā prakāśadhīḥ // [AgMsv_1.741]
mv-k05-v677.quick_english: From such an example as the knowledge of a child and a gem-cutter, in verbal cognition too there is indeed by itself one clear cognition of illumination.

mv-k05-v678.label: AgMsv_1.742
cite_parts:
atas tathāvidhe śabde śrute yat samanantaram /
arthāvabhāsane seyam iyatī matir īdṛśī // [AgMsv_1.742]
mv-k05-v678.quick_english: Therefore, when such a word is heard, whatever cognition arises immediately after in the manifestation of meaning, that cognition is of this extent and of such a character.

mv-k05-v679.label: AgMsv_1.743
cite_parts:
arthaḥ sa tāvāṃs tatrāste ghaṭapūrvāparāṃśavat /
nanv asau ghaṭa ekaḥ syād avayavyātmakas tathā // [AgMsv_1.743]
mv-k05-v679.quick_english: That meaning, of that extent, stands there like the prior and posterior parts of a pot. But surely that pot may be one whole composed of parts?

tokens.grounds: objection particle, sandhi form of nanu

mv-k05-v680.label: AgMsv_1.744
cite_parts:
na tu śabdārthayor aikyaṃ tat kathaṃ sāmyam īdṛśam /
aho bhedagrahābhyāsatimirāvilalocanaḥ // [AgMsv_1.744]
mv-k05-v680.quick_english: But there is no unity of word and meaning, so how could there be such sameness? Alas, one whose eyes are clouded by the darkness of habitual grasping of difference!

mv-k05-v681.label: AgMsv_1.745
cite_parts:
sadyuktyañjanayoge 'pi na dṛṣṭiṃ vimalāṃ gataḥ /
abhinno bhagavān eṣa bhairavo bhogyabhoktṛtām // [AgMsv_1.745]
mv-k05-v681.quick_english: Even with the application of the collyrium of true reasoning, he has not attained clear vision. This undivided Lord Bhairava assumes within himself the state of both the enjoyed and the enjoyer.

mv-k05-v682.label: AgMsv_1.746
cite_parts:
ātmany evānusandhāya sarvadā pūrṇavigrahaḥ /
iti prasādhite pūrvaṃ kaḥ praśnasyāsya saṃbhavaḥ // [AgMsv_1.746]
mv-k05-v682.quick_english: Having unified everything within himself, always full-bodied — when this has been established previously, what possibility remains for this question?

mv-k05-v683.label: AgMsv_1.747
cite_parts:
tad evam upamānādāv api mānāntare sphuṭam /
saṃvitpratyakṣarūpaiva sarvatra pratibhāsate // [AgMsv_1.747]
mv-k05-v683.quick_english: Therefore, thus, in comparison and in other means of knowing as well, it is clearly the form of awareness-perception alone that appears everywhere.

mv-k05-v684.label: AgMsv_1.748
cite_parts:
andho 'pi sparśaśabdādyais tattadrūpaṃ vilokayan /
sphuṭatām eva tāṃ tāvat saṃvetti sa tathāvidhām // [AgMsv_1.748]
mv-k05-v684.quick_english: Even a blind person, perceiving each respective form through touch, sound, and so on, cognizes that clarity of just such a kind.

mv-k05-v685.label: AgMsv_1.749
cite_parts:
evaṃ jātijaḍā rūpasparśādyair abhimanvate /
sphuṭam eva hi bhāvāṃśaṃ teṣāṃ nājñātadhīḥ kvacit // [AgMsv_1.749]
mv-k05-v685.quick_english: Thus those congenitally deaf apprehend an aspect of things clearly through form, touch, and so on; for them cognition is never unknown anywhere.

mv-k05-v686.label: AgMsv_1.750
cite_parts:
iyaṃ lāvaṇyasarasī tāruṇyodyānakaṇḍalī /
iti tuṣyati jātyandhas tadaṅgaparimarśanāt // [AgMsv_1.750]
mv-k05-v686.quick_english: Saying 'this is a lake of beauty, a shoot in the garden of youth,' a congenitally blind person is pleased from touching her limbs.

mv-k05-v687.label: AgMsv_1.751
cite_parts:
aho nu sadalaṃkāraṃ gāyatīti jaḍo janaḥ /
gātur mukhaṃ vilokyaiva tāvatā parituṣyati // [AgMsv_1.751]
mv-k05-v687.quick_english: Saying 'ah, he sings with ornament,' a deaf person, merely by seeing the singer's face, is satisfied by that alone.

mv-k05-v688.label: AgMsv_1.752
cite_parts:
iti pratyakṣam evaikaṃ niḥsapatnaṃ vijṛmbhate /
tad asya phalacintādi kartuṃ prastūyate manāk // [AgMsv_1.752]
mv-k05-v688.quick_english: Thus perception alone expands without rival; therefore a brief consideration of its fruit and so on is now begun.

mv-k05-v689.label: AgMsv_1.753
cite_parts:
tad eva khalu vijñānaṃ parimarśarasātmakam /
tasmād bhedakathā naiva phalaṃ prati susaṃgatā // [AgMsv_1.753]
mv-k05-v689.quick_english: That very cognition is surely of the nature of the essence of reflective awareness; therefore talk of difference is not at all well suited with regard to its fruit.

mv-k05-v690.label: AgMsv_1.754
cite_parts:
hānādidhīḥ phalaṃ vāstu tasyā apy atha bhāsanāt /
yadi vā svaprakāśaiva saṃvittiḥ pāramārthikī // [AgMsv_1.754]
mv-k05-v690.quick_english: Let avoidance and similar cognitions be the fruit; yet even that comes from manifestation. Or else, awareness is self-luminous and ultimate.

mv-k05-v691.label: AgMsv_1.755
cite_parts:
tad eva paryanthaphalaṃ sarvatraiva suniścitam /
hlādādikaṃ phalaṃ mukhyaṃ yat sarvatreha gīyate // [AgMsv_1.755]
mv-k05-v691.quick_english: That indeed is the final fruit, well determined everywhere; joy and so on, which is spoken of everywhere here as the primary fruit, is included in it.

mv-k05-v692.label: AgMsv_1.756
cite_parts:
tatsvasaṃvidi viśrāntim abhyeti bharitātmani /
tad evam idam adhyakṣaṃ sarvataḥ pravijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.756]
mv-k05-v692.quick_english: It comes to rest in that own awareness, in the full self. Therefore, thus, this perception fully expands on all sides.

mv-k05-v693.label: AgMsv_1.757
cite_parts:
etadabhyāsaniṣṭḥasya keva siddhir na jāyate /
brahmādibhāṣitaśrautapraunmukhyena kalādikāt // [AgMsv_1.757]
mv-k05-v693.quick_english: For one devoted to the practice of this, what accomplishment does not arise? Beginning from kala and so on, through an inclination toward hearing what is spoken by Brahma and others...

mv-k05-v694.label: AgMsv_1.758
cite_parts:
dūrāc chravaṇavijñānam acirāt saṃpravartate /
manodṛṣṭe 'pi bhāvāṃśe sphuṭavṛttyudayo hy alam // [AgMsv_1.758]
mv-k05-v694.quick_english: Hearing-cognition from afar quickly arises; even in an aspect of a thing seen by the mind, the arising of clear cognition indeed occurs abundantly.

tokens.grounds: ablative adverb, sandhi form of dūrāt

mv-k05-v695.label: AgMsv_1.759
cite_parts:
svavimarśabalākrānte kiṃ citraṃ yadi jāyate /
spandaśāstre tathā coktaṃ sāvadhāne 'pi cetasi // [AgMsv_1.759]
mv-k05-v695.quick_english: What wonder is it if this arises when overcome by the power of one's own reflective awareness? So it is said in the Spanda scripture, even in an attentive mind.

mv-k05-v696.label: AgMsv_1.760
cite_parts:
bhūyaḥ sphuṭataro bhātīty alaṃ bahulavistaraiḥ /
itthaṃ pratyakṣam evedaṃ viśvaṃ yat parameśituḥ // [AgMsv_1.760]
mv-k05-v696.quick_english: It shines forth ever more clearly — enough of much elaboration. In this way, this entire universe is indeed the perception of the supreme lord.

mv-k05-v697.label: AgMsv_1.761
cite_parts:
tat tato 'py avibhinnasya mātṛvargasya tat tathā /
na ca pratītisāṃkāryaṃ tathā bhāsanayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.761]
mv-k05-v697.quick_english: Even though the group of knowing subjects is undivided, there is no confusion of cognitions, because each cognition arises through its own distinct mode of manifestation.

mv-k05-v698.label: AgMsv_1.762
cite_parts:
pratyakṣe 'pi same sāmyaṃ no ghaṭāghaṭasamvidoḥ /
itthaṃ pratyakṣam evedaṃ niḥsapatnaṃ vijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.762]
mv-k05-v698.quick_english: Even when perception operates in the same field, the cognition of a pot and of a non-pot are not identical; thus perception itself shines forth unrivaled.

mv-k05-v699.label: AgMsv_1.763
cite_parts:
tato na bhidyate cārthaḥ pratyakṣādvaitam īdṛśam /
idaṃ sandhānakalikāpariniṣṭhitabuddhinā // [AgMsv_1.763]
mv-k05-v699.quick_english: For that reason the object is not divided, and such nonduality of perception is recognized by one whose understanding is firmly established in the unifying insight.

mv-k05-v700.label: AgMsv_1.764
cite_parts:
ācāryanarasiṃhena pratyakṣādvaitam ucyate /
anumānapramāṇatvaṃ viśvasmin kaiś cid ucyate // [AgMsv_1.764]
mv-k05-v700.quick_english: Teacher Narasiṃha teaches the nonduality of perception, while some others claim that inference is the valid means of knowing for the entire universe.

mv-k05-v701.label: AgMsv_1.765
cite_parts:
tathā hi devaḥ sarvajño nirvikalpasvabhāvakaḥ /
sa cādhyakṣasvabhāvo 'pi nāyāti vyavahāryatām // [AgMsv_1.765]
mv-k05-v701.quick_english: The all-knowing Lord, whose nature is nonconceptual and even perceptual, does not enter into ordinary practical usage.

mv-k05-v702.label: AgMsv_1.766
cite_parts:
avikalpe vikalpātmā vyavahāraḥ kathaṃ kila /
vikalpena ca sarvo 'yaṃ vyavahāro 'vatanyate // [AgMsv_1.766]
mv-k05-v702.quick_english: How could practical activity, which is conceptual by nature, arise in the nonconceptual? In fact, all ordinary practical activity is carried on through conceptualization.

mv-k05-v703.label: AgMsv_1.767
cite_parts:
sa eva cānumānaṃ syāt tasyaitāḥ parikalpanāḥ /
pakṣataddharmatadvyāptitatpratītyādayo 'khilāḥ // [AgMsv_1.767]
mv-k05-v703.quick_english: That very process would be inference, consisting of conceptual constructions such as the subject, its property, pervasion, and the apprehension of these, and so on.

mv-k05-v704.label: AgMsv_1.768
cite_parts:
vastutas tv eka evāsau pratyayaḥ pāramārthikaḥ /
nanv adhyakṣaviyoge syād anumānaṃ kathaṃ yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.768]
mv-k05-v704.quick_english: But in reality there is only one ultimate cognition. Yet one may object: how could inference exist in the absence of perception, since it depends on it?

mv-k05-v705.label: AgMsv_1.769
cite_parts:
tatpratyakṣaparicchinnapratibandhanibandhanam /
satyaṃ kiṃtu ya eko 'sau devaḥ sarvajñatāspadam // [AgMsv_1.769]
mv-k05-v705.quick_english: It is true that inference depends on a connection determined by perception; but ultimately that rests on the one Lord who is the abode of omniscience.

mv-k05-v706.label: AgMsv_1.770
cite_parts:
tadāveśavaśād eṣā vyāptir bodhe 'vakalpate /
anyathā vahnidhūmādi tadabhāvādivedanam // [AgMsv_1.770]
mv-k05-v706.quick_english: Through immersion in that Lord, pervasion becomes possible in awareness; otherwise, even relations like fire and smoke, or knowledge of their absence, could not be established.

mv-k05-v707.label: AgMsv_1.771
cite_parts:
anvayavyatirekātmā na syād yugaśatair api /
ata eva hi mukhyasya mānasya sadṛśatvataḥ // [AgMsv_1.771]
mv-k05-v707.quick_english: The pattern of agreement and difference would not arise even over hundreds of ages; it arises because of similarity recognized by a primary cognition.

mv-k05-v708.label: AgMsv_1.772
cite_parts:
anumānam iti proktaṃ vyavahārapravartanam /
tad evam ete mātāraḥ sarvatreśvarasaṃvidam // [AgMsv_1.772]
mv-k05-v708.quick_english: Inference is said to set practical activity in motion; thus all knowing subjects everywhere depend on the awareness of the Lord.

mv-k05-v709.label: AgMsv_1.773
cite_parts:
upajīvitum āyānti mātṛbhāvaṃ na cānyathā /
ajño hi jantuvargo 'yaṃ kathaṃ tadaniveśataḥ // [AgMsv_1.773]
mv-k05-v709.quick_english: They come to be knowers by depending on that awareness, and not otherwise; for how could this ignorant class of beings become knowers without entering into it?

mv-k05-v710.label: AgMsv_1.774
cite_parts:
jñasvarūpatvam āpnoti tad vinā mātṛtā kutaḥ /
tasmād saṃvidi yogo 'sya sa ca nānena durlabhaḥ // [AgMsv_1.774]
mv-k05-v710.quick_english: One attains the nature of a knower through that awareness; without it, how could knowerhood arise? Therefore this being's connection with awareness is not hard to obtain.

mv-k05-v711.label: AgMsv_1.775
cite_parts:
vastuto hi na kaś cit sa savinnātho hy asau tathā /
tad evaṃ pakṣam īśānapratyakṣākṣiptavṛttikam // [AgMsv_1.775]
mv-k05-v711.quick_english: In reality there is no one apart from awareness, for each knower has awareness as its lord; thus any position operates only as drawn from the Lord's perception.

mv-k05-v712.label: AgMsv_1.776
cite_parts:
sāpekṣaṃ paratantre ca pāśavaṃ mānam ucyate /
ajño jantur anīśo 'yam ātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ // [AgMsv_1.776]
mv-k05-v712.quick_english: The bound means of knowing is said to be dependent on another; for this ignorant, non-sovereign being does not control its own pleasure and pain.

mv-k05-v713.label: AgMsv_1.777
cite_parts:
īśvaraprerito yātīty ata eva munir jagau /
evam īśvarasāpekṣānumānaikapramāṇatā // [AgMsv_1.777]
mv-k05-v713.quick_english: The sage declared that the being moves only as impelled by the Lord; thus, for such a being, inference dependent on the Lord is the sole means of valid knowledge.

mv-k05-v714.label: AgMsv_1.778
cite_parts:
nirṇītā lolaṭākhyena guruṇā lokasaṃmatā /
anyas tadgṛhya evāha satyaṃ vādhyakṣasaṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_1.778]
mv-k05-v714.quick_english: This position was determined by the teacher named Lolaṭa and accepted by many; another thinker took it up and said, 'True, perceptual awareness also has validity.'

mv-k05-v715.label: AgMsv_1.779
cite_parts:
vyavahāre 'sti mānatvam anumā tu kathaṃ pramā /
sulabhavyabhicārāyām anumāyāṃ viniścitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.779]
mv-k05-v715.quick_english: In practical life, perception has validity; but how can inference be certain knowledge when error is so easily possible in it?

mv-k05-v716.label: AgMsv_1.780
cite_parts:
viśaṃśramītu ko nāma parīkṣakatayā sthitaḥ /
anvayo vyatirekaś ca yaḥ sapakṣetarasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.780]
mv-k05-v716.quick_english: Who, standing as a careful examiner, could rest confidently on agreement and difference, which depend on presence in similar and dissimilar cases?

mv-k05-v717.label: AgMsv_1.781
cite_parts:
ādidṛṣṭas tadātve no viniścayavidhāyinau /
yais tu tasmād apāsyeta pakṣadharmādidūṣaṇāt [ṇam] // [AgMsv_1.781]
mv-k05-v717.quick_english: What is seen at first does not produce certainty at that moment; therefore it should be rejected because of faults such as defects in the subject and its property.

tokens.grounds: fragmentary token as transmitted; likely part of dūṣaṇam

mv-k05-v718.label: AgMsv_1.782
cite_parts:
varcaskakūṭe śuddhiṃ te kuryuḥ pāṃsukaṇoccayaiḥ /
tasmāt saṃśaya evāyaṃ pravṛttyaṅgatayā sthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.782]
mv-k05-v718.quick_english: They would be trying to purify a heap of filth with piles of dust; therefore inference remains as doubt, serving only as an aid to action.

mv-k05-v719.label: AgMsv_1.783
cite_parts:
sa eva bhedābhāsitvān māyeti paribhāṣyate /
māyeva ca paśūnāṃ syān mānaṃ māyācidātakam // [AgMsv_1.783]
mv-k05-v719.quick_english: Because it manifests difference, that same doubtful cognition is called māyā; and for bound beings, the means of knowing is māyā itself, arising from māyā and consciousness.

mv-k05-v720.label: AgMsv_1.784
cite_parts:
tarko vāpy ekapakṣāṃśasthitisaṃbhāvanātmakaḥ /
arthānarthabalīyastvāt pravṛttau [ttyai] vā nivṛttaye // [AgMsv_1.784]
mv-k05-v720.quick_english: Reasoning, which considers the possibility that one side may hold, serves to guide engagement or withdrawal in action by weighing the greater force of benefit or harm.

tokens.grounds: fragmentary token as transmitted; likely part of pravṛttyai

mv-k05-v721.label: AgMsv_1.785
cite_parts:
prabhaviṣṇuḥ sa eveti kim anyair mānaḍambaraiḥ /
pramātā śiva evaiko yasyedaṃ svāṅgam īdrśam // [AgMsv_1.785]
mv-k05-v721.quick_english: He alone is all-powerful; what need is there of other displays of means of knowledge? Śiva alone is the one knower, whose own limb this world appears as such.

mv-k05-v722.label: AgMsv_1.786
cite_parts:
meyatvena samābhāti sarvato niścayātmakam /
anyaḥ punaḥ paśuḥ sarvaḥ saṃśayadhvāntamadhyagaḥ // [AgMsv_1.786]
mv-k05-v722.quick_english: As an object, it appears on all sides as having the nature of certainty; but every other being, the bound soul, dwells in the midst of the darkness of doubt.

tokens.grounds: in the form of the knowable
abiding in the midst of the darkness of doubt

mv-k05-v723.label: AgMsv_1.787
cite_parts:
saudāmanīdyutiprāyasaṃvitsamanurañjitaḥ /
pakṣadvitayasatyānyabhāvānyatamaniścayam // [AgMsv_1.787]
