mv-k07-v921.quick_english: For the wise know that very nature as Śiva consisting of supreme śakti; the second seven therein consists of the parāpara plane.

mv-k07-v922.label: AgMsv_1.986
cite_parts:
vikalpa iti saṃgītam iti bhedo 'vabhāsyate /
tad asyāṃ sūkṣmasaṃvittau kalanāya samudyatāḥ // [AgMsv_1.986]
mv-k07-v922.quick_english: Sung as vikalpa — thus difference is made to appear; for that, in this subtle consciousness, they are intent on impelling.

tokens.grounds: visarga to o before voiced consonant

mv-k07-v923.label: AgMsv_1.987
cite_parts:
saṃvedayante yadrūpaṃ tatra kiṃ vā vikatthanaiḥ /
kramāt tu bhedanyūnatve tuṭīnām api yo mataḥ // [AgMsv_1.987]
mv-k07-v923.quick_english: Whatever form they experience — what is there in boastings about it? But what is held: even the tuṭis, in the lessening of difference that comes from sequence.

tokens.grounds: causative of vid to make known 3pl middle

mv-k07-v924.label: AgMsv_1.988
cite_parts:
vikalpasya ca nirhrāso nirvikalpopalakṣaṇam /
yathā hi ciraduḥkhārtaḥ paścād āttasukhasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.988]
mv-k07-v924.quick_english: The diminution of conceptualization is characterized by the absence of conceptualization, just as one afflicted by long suffering later attains a state of happiness.

mv-k07-v925.label: AgMsv_1.989
cite_parts:
vismaraty eva tadduḥkhaṃ sukhaviśrāntivartmanā /
tathā gatavikalpe 'pi rūḍhāḥ saṃvedane janāḥ // [AgMsv_1.989]
mv-k07-v925.quick_english: Just as someone who has found happiness forgets earlier suffering by resting in that happiness, so people who are firmly established in awareness, even when conceptual thought has gone, no longer cling to it.

tokens.grounds: instrumental of the way of repose in pleasure
state where conceptual thought has departed

mv-k07-v926.label: AgMsv_1.990
cite_parts:
vikalpaviśrāntibalāt tāṃ vṛttiṃ nābhimanvate /

vikalpanirhrāsavaśena yāti vikalpavandhyā paramārthasatyā /
saṃvitsvarūpaprakaṭatvam itthaṃ tatrāvadhāne yatatāṃ subuddhiḥ // [AgMsv_1.990]
mv-k07-v926.quick_english: People who rely on conceptual thinking do not lay claim to that deeper state; but when conceptualization dissolves, awareness becomes free of thought and ultimately true, and its own nature shines forth. In this way, clear understanding arises for those who attend to it with effort.

tokens.grounds: power arising from reliance on thought
refers to the non-conceptual state or awareness
do not appropriate or identify with
through the fading away of thought
the becoming manifest of awareness's own nature
in focused attention on that state

mv-k07-v927.label: AgMsv_1.991
cite_parts:
grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittau saṃbandhe sāvadhānatā /
iyaṃ sā bhaṇyate tatra yatheṣṭaphalayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.991]
mv-k07-v927.quick_english: This attentiveness is said to occur in the relation between the grasped, the grasper, and their awareness, because in that context it is connected with the attainment of the desired result.

tokens.grounds: in the cognition involving object and subject
because it yields the intended result

mv-k07-v928.label: AgMsv_1.992
cite_parts:
ata eva hi tadbhedabāhulyād bhuvanāny api /
vicitratvaṃ prayāntīti na cātikrama iṣyate // [AgMsv_1.992]
mv-k07-v928.quick_english: For this very reason, because of the abundance of its divisions, the worlds too become variegated; and no transgression of this explanation is accepted.

tokens.grounds: because of the multiplicity of distinctions within it
and no violation of this principle

mv-k07-v929.label: AgMsv_1.993
cite_parts:
sakramākramam evedaṃ kālasya prākpradūsaṇāt /
diśaś ca paramārthatvaṃ naiva yuktyopapadyate // [AgMsv_1.993]
mv-k07-v929.quick_english: This reality appears both with sequence and without sequence; but since time has already been refuted, and since the ultimate reality of space cannot be established by reasoning, neither can be taken as ultimately real.

tokens.grounds: because time has already been criticized

mv-k07-v930.label: AgMsv_1.994
cite_parts:
pūrvāparapratītiṃ hi naikā sā kurute tathā /
upādhibhedo no vastu tat kathaṃ sā prakalpyatām // [AgMsv_1.994]
mv-k07-v930.quick_english: For no single thing produces the cognition of before and after, and difference based on limiting conditions is not itself a real entity; so how could that cognition be postulated as ultimately grounded?

mv-k07-v931.label: AgMsv_1.995
cite_parts:
yo hi yasmādguṇotkṛṣṭa ity ataḥ parameśvaraḥ /
abhāṣata nijānandakḷptadikkālamaṇḍalaḥ // [AgMsv_1.995]
mv-k07-v931.quick_english: The supreme Lord, who fashions the sphere of space and time out of his own bliss, declared the basis on which one thing is said to be superior to another by its qualities.

tokens.grounds: whose domain of space and time is created by his own bliss

mv-k07-v932.label: AgMsv_1.996
cite_parts:
tad evaṃ tattvarūpe 'smin vicitre pravivikṣatām /
upāyabhedāt traividhyaṃ samāveśeṣu varṇitam // [AgMsv_1.996]
mv-k07-v932.quick_english: Thus, for those who wish to enter into this variegated nature of reality, a threefold division of absorptions has been described, because the means differ.

tokens.grounds: in the true nature of reality
for those desiring to enter deeply

mv-k07-v933.label: AgMsv_1.997
cite_parts:
anupāyaḥ śāṃbhavo 'sau cidupāyas tataḥ param /
jaḍopāyas tv āṇavaḥ syāt sa cāpi bahudhā mataḥ // [AgMsv_1.997]
mv-k07-v933.quick_english: The Śāmbhava means is without method; next comes the means based on consciousness; and the Āṇava means, based on the inert, is also regarded as taking many forms.

tokens.grounds: the means based on the inert

mv-k07-v934.label: AgMsv_1.998
cite_parts:
ajaḍe 'pi jaḍābhāsaḥ pārameśvaryayogataḥ /
nāḍīkaraṇabāhyādes tena saṃvidupāyatā // [AgMsv_1.998]
mv-k07-v934.quick_english: Even within what is non-inert, an appearance of inertness arises through the power of the supreme Lord, as in the channels, senses, and external supports; therefore these can still function as a means grounded in consciousness.

tokens.grounds: in what is conscious or non-material
through the power of the supreme Lord
from nāḍīs, organs, and external supports
its functioning as a means through consciousness

mv-k07-v935.label: AgMsv_1.999
cite_parts:
tatrākṣavṛttim āśritya bāhyākāragraho hi yaḥ /
tajjāgratsphuṭam āsīnam anubandhi punaḥ punaḥ // [AgMsv_1.999]
mv-k07-v935.quick_english: When experience rests on the functioning of the senses and there is a grasping of external forms, that clear and repeatedly continuous condition is the waking state.

tokens.grounds: the operation of the sense faculties
that is the clear waking state

mv-k07-v936.label: AgMsv_1.1000
cite_parts:
ātmasaṃkalpanirmāṇaṃ svapno jāgradviparyayaḥ /
layākalasya yo bhogaḥ layakarmavaśān na tu // [AgMsv_1.1000]
mv-k07-v936.quick_english: Dream is a construction made by one's own imagination and is the reverse of waking; and the experience belonging to the layākala arises under the force of karma tending toward dissolution, but not in a stable way.

tokens.grounds: fabrication produced by one's own mental projection
of the limited subject in dissolution
under the power of karma tending toward dissolution

mv-k07-v937.label: AgMsv_1.1001
cite_parts:
sthiro bhaven niśābhāvāt suptaṃ saukhyādyavedane /
jñānākalasya malataḥ kevalād bhogamātrataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1001]
mv-k07-v937.quick_english: That experience would not be stable, because there is no night-like obscuration; deep sleep is the non-awareness of pleasure and so on. For the jñānākala, due to mere impurity, there is only bare experience.

tokens.grounds: because there is no night-like obscuration
in the absence of awareness of pleasure etc.
of the limited subject with knowledge obscured

mv-k07-v938.label: AgMsv_1.1002
cite_parts:
bhedavantaḥ svato bhinnāś cikīrṣyante jaḍājaḍāḥ /
turye tatra sthitā mantratannāthādhīśvarās trayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1002]
mv-k07-v938.quick_english: Inert and non-inert things appear as inherently distinct and differentiated; yet in the fourth state there abide the three groups: the mantra beings, their lords, and the overlords.

tokens.grounds: the mantra beings, their lords, and the overlords

mv-k07-v939.label: AgMsv_1.1003
cite_parts:
yāvad bhairavabodhāṃśapraveśanasahiṣṇavaḥ /
bhāvā vigaladātmīyasārāḥ svayam abhedinaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1003]
mv-k07-v939.quick_english: To the extent that entities become capable of receiving a share of Bhairava-awareness, their own separate essence melts away and they become non-different by themselves.

tokens.grounds: able to admit entry into a portion of Bhairava-consciousness

mv-k07-v940.label: AgMsv_1.1004
cite_parts:
turyātītapade saṃsyur iti pañcadaśātmake /
yasya yad yad sphuṭaṃ rūpaṃ taj jāgrad iti manyatām // [AgMsv_1.1004]
mv-k07-v940.quick_english: They would abide in the state beyond the fourth. In this fifteenfold scheme, whatever form appears clear and distinct should be regarded as the waking state.

mv-k07-v941.label: AgMsv_1.1005
cite_parts:
tad evāsthiram ābhāti svarūpaṃ svapna īdṛśaḥ /
asphuṭaṃ tu yad ābhāti suptaṃ tat tat puro 'pi yat // [AgMsv_1.1005]
mv-k07-v941.quick_english: That same form, when it appears unstable, is dream of that kind; but when it appears unclear, that is deep sleep, including what appears before it.

mv-k07-v942.label: AgMsv_1.1006
cite_parts:
tritayasyānusaṃdhis tu yadvaśād upajāyate /
sraksūtratulyaṃ tatturyaṃ sarvabhedeṣu gṛhyatām // [AgMsv_1.1006]
mv-k07-v942.quick_english: The continuity by which the three states arise and are held together, like the thread in a garland, should be understood as the fourth state present through all differences.

tokens.grounds: the continuity linking the three states
like the string running through a garland

mv-k07-v943.label: AgMsv_1.1007
cite_parts:
yat tv advaitabharollāsi drāvitāśeṣabhedakam /
turyātītaṃ tu tat prāhur itthaṃ sarvatra yojayet // [AgMsv_1.1007]
mv-k07-v943.quick_english: But that which shines with the fullness of nonduality and melts away all distinctions is declared to be the state beyond the fourth; one should apply this understanding everywhere.

tokens.grounds: radiant with the plenitude of nonduality

mv-k07-v944.label: AgMsv_1.1008
cite_parts:
layākale hi svaṃ rūpaṃ jāgrattatpūrvavṛtti tu /
svapnādīti kramaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatrānusared budhaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1008]
mv-k07-v944.quick_english: For the layākala, its own form is waking, and the prior states are counted as dream and so on; the wise person should trace this whole sequence in every case.

tokens.grounds: in the case of the layākala subject
waking together with the preceding states
counted as dream and so on
one should follow in all cases

mv-k07-v945.label: AgMsv_1.1009
cite_parts:
ekatrāpi prabhau pūrṇe citturyātītam ucyate /
ānandas turyam icchaiva bījabhūmiḥ suṣuptatā // [AgMsv_1.1009]
mv-k07-v945.quick_english: Even within the one full Lord, consciousness is said to be the state beyond the fourth, bliss is the fourth, and will itself is the seed-ground corresponding to deep sleep.

tokens.grounds: consciousness as the state beyond the fourth

mv-k07-v946.label: AgMsv_1.1010
cite_parts:
jñānaṃ tu svapnavṛttitvaṃ kriyā jāgrad iti smṛtā /
atraiva yogabhūmyutthāḥ saṃjñāḥ piṇḍasthatādayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1010]
mv-k07-v946.quick_english: Knowledge corresponds to the dream state, and action is remembered as the waking state; in this same context arise the yogic designations beginning with piṇḍastha.

mv-k07-v947.label: AgMsv_1.1011
cite_parts:
sarvatobhadratādyās tu prasaṃkhyājñāninirmitāḥ /
ekaikatra catūrūpasadbhāvād vitate tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1011]
mv-k07-v947.quick_english: Classifications such as sarvatobhadra are constructed by those who rely on discriminative analysis; because the fourfold structure is present in each case, further elaborations arise in the expanded scheme.

tokens.grounds: formed by those who rely on reflective enumeration
because the fourfold structure is present

mv-k07-v948.label: AgMsv_1.1012
cite_parts:
catūrūpatvam ekatra tritvaṃ paścād athaikatā /
ekas tu bhairavo nāthaḥ prollasadviśvarūpakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1012]
mv-k07-v948.quick_english: In one place there is fourfoldness, then threefoldness, then oneness; yet the one Lord Bhairava remains, with all universal forms flashing forth within him.

tokens.grounds: whose universal forms are vividly manifest

mv-k07-v949.label: AgMsv_1.1013
cite_parts:
ekaḥ śivādisakalaparyantasthitisaṃgataḥ /
so 'yaṃ samasta evādhvā bhairavābhedavṛttimān // [AgMsv_1.1013]
mv-k07-v949.quick_english: The one reality, present in every state from Śiva to the limited individual, is this entire path itself, abiding in non-difference from Bhairava.

tokens.grounds: compound spanning the whole range of existence
possessing the state of identity with Bhairava

mv-k07-v950.label: AgMsv_1.1014
cite_parts:
tatsvātantryāt svatantratvam aśnuvāno 'vabhāsate /
so 'yaṃ mātṛsvarūpastho mantrādhveti vibhāvyate // [AgMsv_1.1014]
mv-k07-v950.quick_english: By its own freedom, that same reality shines forth as autonomous; when it abides in the form of the knowing subject, it is recognized as the path of mantras.

tokens.grounds: situated in the subject's own form
identified as the mantra path; iti fused

mv-k07-v951.label: AgMsv_1.1015
cite_parts:
pramārūpatayā so 'yaṃ varṇādhveti nirucyate /
pramāṇarūpatām etya prayāty eṣa padādhvatām // [AgMsv_1.1015]
mv-k07-v951.quick_english: In the form of valid cognition, this reality is called the path of phonemes; when it takes the form of the means of knowledge, it becomes the path of words.

tokens.grounds: in the mode of knowledge itself
identified as the phoneme path; iti fused
the form of the instrument of cognition
the condition of being the word path

mv-k07-v952.label: AgMsv_1.1016
cite_parts:
pramāṇarūpatāveśam aparityajya meyatām /
gacchan saṃkalpanayogāt kalādhvā mātṛsaṃgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1016]
mv-k07-v952.quick_english: Without abandoning its role as the means of knowledge, it moves toward objecthood through conceptualization; joined with the knower, it becomes the path of limited powers.

tokens.grounds: the absorbed state of being the cognitive instrument

mv-k07-v953.label: AgMsv_1.1017
cite_parts:
śuddhe prameyatāyoge sa tattvādhveti gṛhyatām /
tatsthaulyādhāratāyogād bhuvanādhveti varṇitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1017]
mv-k07-v953.quick_english: When it is purely connected with objecthood, it should be understood as the path of principles; when it serves as the support of that grossness, it is described as the path of worlds.

tokens.grounds: in the pure or unmixed state
when joined with being a knowable object
identified as the tattva path; iti fused
should be grasped or taken as
by association with serving as the basis of that coarseness
identified as the bhuvana path; iti fused

mv-k07-v954.label: AgMsv_1.1018
cite_parts:
tathā hi cidvimarśena grastā vācyadaśā yadā /
śivajñānakriyāyattamananatrāṇatatparā // [AgMsv_1.1018]
mv-k07-v954.quick_english: For when the state of what can be expressed is swallowed by the reflective awareness of consciousness, it becomes intent on cognition and protection grounded in Śiva's knowledge and action.

tokens.grounds: the condition of what can be spoken
devoted to knowing and saving grounded in Śiva's powers of knowledge and action

mv-k07-v955.label: AgMsv_1.1019
cite_parts:
aśeṣaśaktipaṭalīlīlālāmpaṭyapāṭavāt /
mantrādhvā rabhasena drāk prāg udbhūtaḥ śivātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1019]
mv-k07-v955.quick_english: From its skill in the eager play of all its powers, the mantra path, whose nature is Śiva, first arises swiftly and with force.

tokens.grounds: because of adeptness in the playful activity of all powers

mv-k07-v956.label: AgMsv_1.1020
cite_parts:
ucchalatsaṃvidāmātraviśrāntyāsvādayoginaḥ /
sarvābhidhānasāmarthyād aniyantritaśaktayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1020]
mv-k07-v956.quick_english: For the one who relishes repose in surging consciousness alone, the powers are unrestricted because of the capacity to name everything.

tokens.grounds: possessing the enjoyment of repose in pure, rising awareness
because of the power to express everything

mv-k07-v957.label: AgMsv_1.1021
cite_parts:
sṛṣṭāḥ svātmasahotthārthadharāparyantavṛttayaḥ /
svātmīye cidvilasite tāvato 'rthān nijātmani // [AgMsv_1.1021]
mv-k07-v957.quick_english: The powers are emanated with operations ranging from meanings that arise with the self down to the earth, encompassing all those objects within the play of consciousness in their own self.

tokens.grounds: functioning from self-coemergent meanings down to the level of earth
the shining or unfolding of awareness
meanings or things; elided initial vowel

mv-k07-v958.label: AgMsv_1.1022
cite_parts:
āmṛśantaḥ pramārūpāṃ satyāṃ bibhrati saṃvidam /
bālās tiryakpramātāro ye 'py asaṃketabhāginaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1022]
mv-k07-v958.quick_english: Infants and even animal knowers, who have no share in linguistic convention, still apprehend things and bear a real consciousness in the form of valid cognition.

mv-k07-v959.label: AgMsv_1.1023
cite_parts:
te 'py akṛtrimasaṃskārasārām enāṃ svasaṃvidam /
bhinnabhinnām upāśritya yānti citrāṃ pramātṛtām // [AgMsv_1.1023]
mv-k07-v959.quick_english: Even they, relying on this own consciousness of theirs—whose essence is an uncontrived impression and which is both differentiated and undifferentiated—attain a varied state of being knowers.

tokens.grounds: having an innate, non-artificial formative core

mv-k07-v960.label: AgMsv_1.1024
cite_parts:
asyām akṛtrimānantavarṇasaṃvidi rūḍhatām /
saṃketā yānti cet te 'pi yānty asaṃketavṛttitām // [AgMsv_1.1024]
mv-k07-v960.quick_english: If linguistic conventions become firmly established in this uncontrived consciousness of infinite phonemes, then even they come to operate in a non-conventional way.

tokens.grounds: in the innate awareness consisting of limitless phonemes
the state of being rooted or established
reach, come to; sandhi before vowel

mv-k07-v961.label: AgMsv_1.1025
cite_parts:
anayā tu vinā sarve saṃketā bahuśaḥ kṛtāḥ /
naiva cetasi viśrāntiṃ saṃketāntarayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1025]
mv-k07-v961.quick_english: But without this innate consciousness, all the many conventions that are made could never find rest in the mind, because they would depend on yet other conventions.

tokens.grounds: due to dependence on further conventions

mv-k07-v962.label: AgMsv_1.1026
cite_parts:
vrajeyur anavasthānān mūlakṣatikaratvataḥ /
tatrāpi khalu saṃkete bālo vyutpādyatāṃ kutaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1026]
mv-k07-v962.quick_english: They would never find rest, because of infinite regress and because that would destroy the very root; so how, indeed, could a child even be instructed in a convention?

tokens.grounds: due to infinite regress or lack of stable ground
since it would undermine the foundation
with regard to a linguistic convention
from what basis, by what means

mv-k07-v963.label: AgMsv_1.1027
cite_parts:
tenānantas tv amāyīyo yo varṇagrāma īdṛśaḥ /
sa cidvimarśasacivaḥ sadaiva pravijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.1027]
mv-k07-v963.quick_english: Therefore, this infinite, non-māyic collection of phonemes, accompanied by the reflective awareness of consciousness, is always unfolding.

tokens.grounds: for that reason limitless; sandhi with following particle
attended by the self-reflection of consciousness

mv-k07-v964.label: AgMsv_1.1028
cite_parts:
tata eva ca māyīyā varṇāḥ sūtiṃ vitenire /
teṣāṃ te khalv amāyīyā vīryam ity avadhāryate // [AgMsv_1.1028]
mv-k07-v964.quick_english: And from that very source the māyic phonemes came into being; it is understood that those non-māyic phonemes are indeed their power.

tokens.grounds: they brought forth, extended into being

mv-k07-v965.label: AgMsv_1.1029
cite_parts:
tathā hi paravākyeṣu śruteṣv āvṛṇute nijā /
pramā yasya jaḍo nāsau tatrārthe yāti mātṛtām // [AgMsv_1.1029]
mv-k07-v965.quick_english: For when others' utterances are heard, if one's own cognition remains veiled, that dull person does not become a knowing subject with respect to that meaning.

tokens.grounds: having been heard; sandhi before vowel
that person does not; sandhi fusion
with respect to that object or meaning

mv-k07-v966.label: AgMsv_1.1030
cite_parts:
yasya tu svapramā bodhe praviśed bhedagarbhagā /
māyīyavarṇapuñje sve sa pramātṛtvam ṛcchati // [AgMsv_1.1030]
mv-k07-v966.quick_english: But if one's own cognition, bearing differentiation within it, enters into awareness within one's own mass of māyic phonemes, that person attains the state of being a knower.

tokens.grounds: into the aggregate of māyic sounds

mv-k07-v967.label: AgMsv_1.1031
cite_parts:
yathā yathā cākṛtakaṃ tadrūpam atiricyate /
tathā tathā camatkāratāratamyaṃ prakalpyate // [AgMsv_1.1031]
mv-k07-v967.quick_english: To the extent that the uncreated, innate form predominates, to that same extent a gradation of aesthetic wonder is produced.

mv-k07-v968.label: AgMsv_1.1032
cite_parts:
tadudrekamahattve tu pratibhātmani niṣṭhitāḥ /
dhruvaṃ kavitvavaktṛtvaśālitāṃ yānti sarvataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1032]
mv-k07-v968.quick_english: But when that surge becomes great, those established in the nature of intuitive insight certainly attain, in every way, excellence in poetry and eloquence.

tokens.grounds: in the state of creative intuition
the brilliance of being a poet and speaker

mv-k07-v969.label: AgMsv_1.1033
cite_parts:
ata eva hi vāksiddhau varṇānāṃ samupāsyatā /
teṣām eva tatas tena guptā guptena bhāṣitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1033]
mv-k07-v969.quick_english: Therefore, in the perfection of speech, the phonemes are contemplated; for that very reason they are kept secret and spoken only by one who maintains secrecy.

tokens.grounds: for that reason, by that means

mv-k07-v970.label: AgMsv_1.1034
cite_parts:
tato yāvadvibhoḥ śaśvadviśrāntir yugapadbahūn /
varṇān udṛṅkya bhogāṃśaparipūraṇasusthitān // [AgMsv_1.1034]
mv-k07-v970.quick_english: Then, insofar as there is the Lord's constant repose, it projects many phonemes at once, well established in fulfilling the portions of experience.

tokens.grounds: to the extent that the all-pervading Lord's; compound
firmly set in completing shares of enjoyment

mv-k07-v971.label: AgMsv_1.1035
cite_parts:
tāvad eva padādhvāsau meyabhūmim upāśritaḥ /
saṃsāramṛtasaṃketasaṃghāte prathamāṅkuraḥ // [AgMsv_1.1035]
mv-k07-v971.quick_english: To that extent, this path of words, resting on the level of the object, becomes the first sprout within the mass of conventions bound up with worldly existence.

tokens.grounds: the domain of what is known
in the aggregate of worldly, inert conventions

mv-k07-v972.label: AgMsv_1.1036
cite_parts:
evaṃ prameyatā mātṛbhāvo mānatvam apy atha /
ṣaṭtriṃśadātmanas tattvakalāpasyeti niścitam // [AgMsv_1.1036]
mv-k07-v972.quick_english: Thus it is ascertained that objecthood, the state of being the knower, and the state of being the means of knowledge all belong to the thirty-sixfold collection of principles.

tokens.grounds: the condition of being the means of knowledge
of the group of tattvas; iti fused

mv-k07-v973.label: AgMsv_1.1037
cite_parts:
tatra sarvaṃ vibhāty etat parameśitari dhruve /
pratibimbasvarūpeṇa na tu bāhyatayā yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1037]
mv-k07-v973.quick_english: There, all this shines forth in the unchanging supreme Lord in the form of a reflection, and not as something external.

tokens.grounds: points to the supreme Lord as locus
in the manner of a reflection

mv-k07-v974.label: AgMsv_1.1038
cite_parts:
cidvyomny eva śive tattaddehādimatir īdṛśī /
bhinnā saṃsāriṇāṃ bhāti rajjau sarpādikā yathā // [AgMsv_1.1038]
mv-k07-v974.quick_english: In the sky of consciousness, in Śiva alone, such divided cognitions of various bodies appear to worldly beings, just as a snake and the like appear in a rope.

tokens.grounds: in the space of pure awareness; sandhi before eva
cognitions of various bodies and so on
appearance of a snake and the like

mv-k07-v975.label: AgMsv_1.1039
cite_parts:
yataḥ prāgdehamaraṇasiddhāntaḥ svapnagocaraḥ /
dehāntarādir maraṇāt kīdṛg vā dehasaṃbhavaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1039]
mv-k07-v975.quick_english: Because the settled view before the body's death belongs to the realm of dream, what kind of other body or bodily arising after death could there really be?

tokens.grounds: the settled view prior to the death of the body
belongs to the domain of dream
after the death of the body
questions the nature of post-death embodiment

mv-k07-v976.label: AgMsv_1.1040
cite_parts:
svapne tu pratibhāmātrasāmānyaprathanād balāt /
viśeṣāḥ pratibhāsante na bhāvyante 'pi te tathā // [AgMsv_1.1040]
mv-k07-v976.quick_english: In a dream, particular details appear by the force of the unfolding of mere appearance, but they are not produced as independent realities in that way.

tokens.grounds: from the unfolding of mere appearance in general
by the power of that unfolding
are brought into being as separate realities

mv-k07-v977.label: AgMsv_1.1041
cite_parts:
sāligrāmopalāḥ kecic citrākṛtihṛdo yathā /
tathā māyādibhūmyantalekhāś citrahṛdayaś citaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1041]
mv-k07-v977.quick_english: Just as some śālagrāma stones contain varied forms within them, so the inner delineations of the levels from māyā downward belong to the variegated heart of consciousness.

tokens.grounds: stones naturally marked with varied forms
containing diverse shapes within; sandhi before yathā
the inner delineations of the levels from māyā downward; sandhi before citaḥ
having a multiform core; sandhi before citaḥ

mv-k07-v978.label: AgMsv_1.1042
cite_parts:
nagarārṇavaśailādyās tadicchānuvidhāyinaḥ /
na svayaṃ sadasadrūpakāraṇākaraṇātmakāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1042]
mv-k07-v978.quick_english: Cities, oceans, mountains, and the like follow that will; they are not by themselves entities that independently function as existent or nonexistent causes and effects.

tokens.grounds: worldly forms such as cities, oceans, and mountains; sandhi before tadicchā
conforming to the will of consciousness
having the nature of existent or nonexistent causes and effects

mv-k07-v979.label: AgMsv_1.1043
cite_parts:
ciraprarūḍhe niyame samucchedāt pravartanāt /
arūḍhe 'pi svatantro 'yaṃ sthitaś cidvyomabhairavaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1043]
mv-k07-v979.quick_english: Whether by cutting off or setting in motion a long-established rule, or even where no rule has yet taken root, this Bhairava of the sky of consciousness remains independent.

tokens.grounds: when a rule has long taken root
in a fixed order or regulation
when no rule has yet taken root
this Lord; sandhi form of ayam
Bhairava as the space of consciousness

mv-k07-v980.label: AgMsv_1.1044
cite_parts:
ekacinmātrasaṃpūrṇabhairavābhedabhāgini /
evam asmīty anāmarśo bhedako bhāvamaṇḍale // [AgMsv_1.1044]
mv-k07-v980.quick_english: In that state which shares nondifference with Bhairava, full of one consciousness alone, the absence of the recognition 'I am thus' is what differentiates the realm of beings.

tokens.grounds: in the state sharing nondifference with Bhairava, full of only one consciousness
the reflective sense 'I am'; sandhi before anāmarśo
lack of reflective awareness; sandhi before bhedako
that which produces division; sandhi before bhāva
within the sphere of manifested entities

mv-k07-v981.label: AgMsv_1.1045
cite_parts:
sarvapramāṇair no siddhaṃ svapne kartrantaraṃ yathā /
svasaṃvidaḥ svatantrāyās tathā sargo 'pi budhyatām // [AgMsv_1.1045]
mv-k07-v981.quick_english: Just as no other agent is established in a dream by any means of knowledge, so too the creation should be understood as belonging to one's own independent awareness.

tokens.grounds: by every valid means of knowing; sandhi before no
negates establishment; sandhi form before siddhaṃ
the emanation or projection of the world; sandhi before 'pi

mv-k07-v982.label: AgMsv_1.1046
cite_parts:
cittacitrapurodyāne krīḍann evaṃ hi vetti yaḥ /
aham eva sthito bhāvair bhūtaiś cinmātrakair iti // [AgMsv_1.1046]
mv-k07-v982.quick_english: One who plays in the mind's variegated city and garden knows: 'I alone abide as all these beings that have come to be, and they are nothing but consciousness.'

tokens.grounds: in the mind's multiform city and garden
sporting or freely acting; sandhi before evaṃ
in the form of manifested entities; sandhi before bhūtaiś
as those that have come to be; sandhi before cinmātrakair
consisting of consciousness alone; sandhi before iti

mv-k07-v983.label: AgMsv_1.1047
cite_parts:
evaṃ jāto mṛto 'smīti janmamṛtyuvicitratāḥ /
ajanmany amṛtau bhānti cittabhittau svakalpināḥ // [AgMsv_1.1047]
mv-k07-v983.quick_english: The varied experiences of 'I am born' and 'I am dead' appear in the unborn and deathless, on the wall of the mind, as projections of one's own imagination.

tokens.grounds: having come into being; sandhi before mṛto
the reflective sense 'I am'; sandhi form of asmi+iti
the diverse experiences of birth and death
in that which has no birth
in that which does not die
on the screen or surface of the mind

mv-k07-v984.label: AgMsv_1.1048
cite_parts:
parehasaṃvidāmātraṃ paralokehalokatā /

mv-k07-v985.label: AgMsv_1.1049

mv-k07-v986.label: AgMsv_1.1050

mv-k07-v986.quick_english: When one examines the elements, subtle elements, and the rest in terms of support and what is supported, in the end it is the consciousness-power, identical with Śiva's own nature, that upholds them.

identical with Śiva's own nature; sandhi of śivarūpā+eva

atra svātmani te tena śaktiḥ sādhārasaṃjñitā // [AgMsv_1.1051]
mv-k07-v987.quick_english: Therefore cognition itself is the agent; that manifestation is Śiva in his own self. For that reason, this power is called the common ground.

tokens.grounds: emphasizes this very mode; sandhi of eva+ittham

mv-k07-v988.label: AgMsv_1.1052
cite_parts:

due to repose; sandhi before viśvam

mv-k07-v989.label: AgMsv_1.1053

mv-k07-v989.quick_english: From the fixation of the dense 'I' and so on arises the state beginning with earth, until at last the recognition 'I am consciousness' is fulfilled as the identity of Bhairava.

from the fixation expressed as 'I' and so on; sandhi before eva
the condition of earth and the lower levels
the recognition 'I am consciousness'; sandhi of cit+asmi+iti

mv-k07-v990.label: AgMsv_1.1054

tokens.grounds: in this world; sandhi form of atra

tokens.grounds: any definite thing; sandhi before api

mv-k07-v994.label: AgMsv_1.1058

tokens.grounds: by a narrow channel, metaphor for constricted view
those who depend on a doctrine of emptiness

mv-k07-v995.label: AgMsv_1.1059

mv-k07-v998.label: AgMsv_1.1062
cite_parts:
nanv itthaṃ janmamaraṇe karmaṇaḥ phalayogitā /
kathaṃ syāt kin nu pūrvoktaṃ citsvātantryaṃ suvisṛmtam // [AgMsv_1.1062]
mv-k07-v998.quick_english: But if things are so, how can karma be connected with its fruit in birth and death? Has the previously stated freedom of consciousness been completely forgotten?

tokens.grounds: dvandva compound; dual locative sense in context

mv-k07-v999.label: AgMsv_1.1063
cite_parts:
tathā hi citsvatantreyaṃ yathā bhāsayate tathā /
satyaṃ bhāty akhilākāragarbhā sā ceti niścitam // [AgMsv_1.1063]
mv-k07-v999.quick_english: For this free consciousness makes things shine forth just as it wills, and so they truly appear; it contains all forms within itself, and this is firmly established.

tokens.grounds: cit + svatantrā + iyam; sandhi fusion in form
present of bhā; sandhi before vowel

mv-k07-v1000.label: AgMsv_1.1064
cite_parts:
ikṣau pratyaṇu mādhuryaṃ yathā sarvātmanā tathā /
pratyekaparamāṇau hi sarvasṛṣṭimayī sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.1064]
mv-k07-v1000.quick_english: Just as sweetness is present in every atom of sugarcane in every way, so in each ultimate atom there abides a state consisting of the whole creation.

mv-k07-v1001.label: AgMsv_1.1065
cite_parts:
ajñātatattvamūlās tu vivadante 'tra ye budhāḥ /
nūnaṃ nijamanorājyarakṣāyai te samudyatāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1065]
mv-k07-v1001.quick_english: But those learned people who do not know the root principle and dispute this are surely engaged only in protecting their own fantasy-kingdom.

tokens.grounds: a + jñāta + tattva + mūla; compound with plural ending
nija + manorājya + rakṣā; dative of purpose

mv-k07-v1002.label: AgMsv_1.1066
cite_parts:
prāṇe khe citi bāhye vā kutrāpīdam iti bhramaḥ /
ajñatvāt tanniyatyutthasvātantryābhāvajṛmbhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1066]
mv-k07-v1002.quick_english: The idea that this is located in breath, in space, in consciousness, in the external world, or anywhere at all is a delusion, arising from ignorance and swollen by the seeming absence of freedom produced by restriction.

tokens.grounds: ether or void as possible locus
kutra + api + idam; sandhi fusion in form
a + jña + tva; ablative of cause
tat + niyati + uttha + svātantrya + abhāva + jṛmbhita; long compound

mv-k07-v1003.label: AgMsv_1.1067
cite_parts:

mv-k07-v1003.quick_english: Therefore, the awareness of one's own consciousness appears here as birth; but beforehand consciousness does not appear in a form suited to its freedom.

tokens.grounds: janma + tva + iha; sandhi fusion in form

mv-k07-v1004.label: AgMsv_1.1068
cite_parts:
prāktanī saṃvid eveha pūrvakarmeti bhāṣyate /

mv-k07-v1004.quick_english: Here the former consciousness is called previous karma; therefore, a consciousness that obstructs that former consciousness brings about the destruction of karma.

tokens.grounds: pūrva + karma + iti; sandhi fusion in form

mv-k07-v1005.label: AgMsv_1.1069
cite_parts:
akṛtaṃ ca yathā svapne mayā kṛtam iti sphuret /

mv-k07-v1005.quick_english: Just as in a dream something not actually done can flash forth as 'done by me' and be seen to give fruit, the same is true of karma in the waking state.

mv-k07-v1006.label: AgMsv_1.1070
cite_parts:
tathā ca prācyakarmaughaphalasaṃploṣaṇātmikā /
yasyaikāpy uttarodeti saṃvit sa phalabhāṅ na hi // [AgMsv_1.1070]
mv-k07-v1006.quick_english: And so, if even a single higher consciousness arises in someone, consisting in the burning up of the fruit of the mass of past karma, that person does not undergo that fruit.

tokens.grounds: prācya + karma + ogha + phala + saṃploṣaṇa + ātmikā; long compound
yasya + ekā + api; sandhi fusion in form
uttarā + udeti; sandhi fusion in form

mv-k07-v1007.label: AgMsv_1.1071
cite_parts:
kiṃ cānyadbahusaṃvitsusphurattvādayaśo yaśaḥ /

mv-k07-v1007.quick_english: Moreover, through the clear flashing forth of many consciousnesses, even disrepute can become repute, bearing abundant fruit like a seed watered by the waters of a river in the sky.

tokens.grounds: ca + anyat + bahu + saṃvit + su-sphurattva + ādi + ayaśas; long compound as transmitted

mv-k07-v1008.label: AgMsv_1.1072
cite_parts:

mv-k07-v1008.quick_english: Thus karma that flashes forth in slight awareness yields little fruit, while what does not flash forth is indeed fruitless; this is the principle with regard to one's own consciousness.

mv-k07-v1009.label: AgMsv_1.1073
cite_parts:

mv-k07-v1009.quick_english: Even there, the smallness or greatness conceived among consciousnesses belongs to the doer of karma and takes that form according to how firmly it is established in consciousness.

tokens.grounds: saṃvit + ti-rūḍhi; instrumental of means as transmitted

mv-k07-v1010.label: AgMsv_1.1074
cite_parts:

nāpy anyaphalanirgrāhimātṛsaṃgatitas tathā // [AgMsv_1.1074]
mv-k07-v1010.quick_english: And if a consciousness does not arise by itself as pregnant with such a fruit, nor does so through association with a subject grasping another fruit, then that fruit does not arise in that way.

tokens.grounds: anya + phala + nirgrāhi + mātṛ + saṃgati + tas; long compound

mv-k07-v1011.label: AgMsv_1.1075
cite_parts:

anyapramātṛsaṃkalpād yāvadante sa ko 'py alam // [AgMsv_1.1075]
mv-k07-v1011.quick_english: Even in the consciousness of another subject who knows the fruit, who could, to the very end, be capable of determining it through the intention of a different subject?

tokens.grounds: yāvat + anta; locative compound as transmitted

mv-k07-v1012.label: AgMsv_1.1076
cite_parts:

vidāḥ sma saṃkocayati phalālambanakalpanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1076]

mv-k07-v1017.label: AgMsv_1.1081

mv-k07-v1017.quick_english: Therefore, in determining what is eatable or uneatable in cases like swans and other birds, a difference of understanding is fitting; otherwise, it would not be so at all.

mv-k07-v1018.label: AgMsv_1.1082
cite_parts:
evaṃ dṛṣṭe 'py adṛṣṭe 'tha kalpitāṃśāṃśikākramāt /
phalayogaḥ sa evādya rūḍhaḥ saṃvidbhuvi sthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1082]
mv-k07-v1018.quick_english: Thus, in both the seen and the unseen, the connection with fruit, arranged through conceived divisions and sequences, is now firmly established on the ground of consciousness.

mv-k07-v1019.label: AgMsv_1.1083
cite_parts:
dehaḥ piṇḍāt pare loke nānyatheti sthitiḥ kṛtā /

mv-k07-v1019.quick_english: Is the settled view that a body in the other world comes from the rice-ball offering and not otherwise, implying that embodied beings have no mutual connection apart from that?

tokens.grounds: na + anyathā + iti; sandhi fusion in form

mv-k07-v1020.label: AgMsv_1.1084
cite_parts:

ajñacittadharārūḍhaḥ phalaparyantatāṃ gataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1084]
mv-k07-v1020.quick_english: And by all those masses of scriptures, stakes of doubt were planted; rooted in the ground of ignorant minds, they grew into fixed conclusions about karmic fruit.

tokens.grounds: tat + sarva + śāstra + pūga; instrumental plural compound
past passive participle of pra-ruh causative sense in context
phala + paryanta + tā; accusative abstract noun

mv-k07-v1021.label: AgMsv_1.1085
cite_parts:
asti me piṇḍado 'dyāhaṃ piṇḍadānakkramāt tathā /
prapnobh/m(?)yavayavābhogaṃ pūrṇadeho 'smi susthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1085]
mv-k07-v1021.quick_english: One thinks, 'Today I have someone to offer me rice-balls; through that offering I enjoy my limbs again, and I am whole and well-established.'

mv-k07-v1022.label: AgMsv_1.1086
cite_parts:
adṛṣṭakriyayā putraśiṣyasvātmādikḷptayā /
svargabhāgahamatyantamāttasaṃbhogasusthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1086]
mv-k07-v1022.quick_english: Through unseen rites arranged by a son, disciple, oneself, or others, one imagines having a share in heaven, fully enjoying it and firmly settled there.

mv-k07-v1023.label: AgMsv_1.1087
cite_parts:
nāsti me piṇḍadaḥ kaś cit svayaṃ cāsmy atiduṣkṛtī /
na me trātāsti kutrāpi patāmi narakārṇave // [AgMsv_1.1087]
mv-k07-v1023.quick_english: One thinks, 'I have no one to offer me rice-balls, I myself have done great wrong, there is no savior for me anywhere, and I am falling into the ocean of hell.'

mv-k07-v1024.label: AgMsv_1.1088
cite_parts:
bhaviṣyati mama trātā kvāpi kāle kathaṃ cana /
ityādiḥ saṃvidāṃ sphāras tathaiva phalati svayam // [AgMsv_1.1088]
mv-k07-v1024.quick_english: Thoughts like 'Somehow, sometime, I will have a savior' are expansions of awareness, and they bear fruit in just that form by themselves.

mv-k07-v1025.label: AgMsv_1.1089
cite_parts:
tasyās tu piṇḍakartrādir mābhūd atha yathā sphuret /
sa tāvat tatphalaṃ bhuṅkte svasaṃkalpena kalpitam // [AgMsv_1.1089]
mv-k07-v1025.quick_english: Even if there is no actual person performing the rice-ball rites, one experiences the result exactly as it appears in awareness, fashioned by one's own resolve.

mv-k07-v1026.label: AgMsv_1.1090
cite_parts:
śaṅkāvajrapralepāntardṛḍhabaddhāṃ tv imāṃ matim /
bhairavānala evaikaḥ samūlaṃ pluṣyati kṣaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.1090]
mv-k07-v1026.quick_english: This belief, tightly sealed within by the diamond-hard plaster of doubt, is burned away root and all in an instant by the fire of Bhairava alone.

mv-k07-v1027.label: AgMsv_1.1091
cite_parts:
aśeṣacitracidgarbhasaṃsārasvapnasadmanaḥ /
ploṣakaḥ śiva evāham ityullāsī hutāśanaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1091]
mv-k07-v1027.quick_english: The fire that burns up the whole dream-house of the world, contained in all varied consciousness, is the flashing realization, 'I alone am Śiva.'

mv-k07-v1028.label: AgMsv_1.1092
cite_parts:
tanmūḍhaḥ karmasaṃvitticitrībhūtacitis tathā /
saṃkalpam eva saṃsāraṃ vicitram abhimanyate // [AgMsv_1.1092]
mv-k07-v1028.quick_english: Deluded by that, with consciousness variegated by karmic cognitions, one takes what is really a construction of resolve to be the varied world of transmigration.

mv-k07-v1029.label: AgMsv_1.1093
cite_parts:
ata eva mṛto bālo vāsanāntaravarjitaḥ /
śiśur eva bhavet suptadṛḍhasaṃsāravāsanaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1093]
mv-k07-v1029.quick_english: For that reason, a child who dies without other impressions, but with firm worldly tendencies lying dormant, would be born again as an infant.

mv-k07-v1030.label: AgMsv_1.1094
cite_parts:
tānyau tathā (?) /
yāvadyauvanam abhyeti punas tadvāsanakramāt // [AgMsv_1.1094]
mv-k07-v1030.quick_english: In that way, by the sequence of those impressions, one reaches youth again and continues according to those same latent tendencies.

mv-k07-v1031.label: AgMsv_1.1095
cite_parts:
saṃskārasaṃvidā tās tāḥ saṃsṛtīr abhimanyate /
kaścij jaḍatvasaṃskārāj jaḍībhūto 'pi khānilaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.1095]
mv-k07-v1031.quick_english: Through cognition shaped by impressions, one takes various transmigrations to be real; and someone, through the impression of inertness, may even become inert while still associated with space and wind.

mv-k07-v1032.label: AgMsv_1.1096
cite_parts:
saha bhūjalayogena yāti puṣpaphalātmatām /
bhakṣito vīryarūpeṇa punar āyāti garbhatām // [AgMsv_1.1096]
mv-k07-v1032.quick_english: Joined with earth and water, one may become flower and fruit; eaten and transformed into seed, one may come again into the state of a womb.

mv-k07-v1033.label: AgMsv_1.1097
cite_parts:
yāvad punaḥ punaś citrān saṃsārān abhimanyate /
ekatraiva svasaṃskāravāsanāvāsitaḥ śivaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1097]
mv-k07-v1033.quick_english: Again and again, Śiva, dwelling in his own impressions and tendencies, takes varied worlds of transmigration to be real, all in one and the same place.

mv-k07-v1034.label: AgMsv_1.1098
cite_parts:
bhuṅkte svarnarakādyāṃs tu bhogān svātantryakalpitān /
kvacid bhūmimayī kvāpi jalātmā kvāpi miśritā // [AgMsv_1.1098]
mv-k07-v1034.quick_english: It experiences heavens, hells, and other enjoyments fashioned by its own freedom, appearing sometimes as earthy, sometimes as watery, and sometimes as mixed.

mv-k07-v1035.label: AgMsv_1.1099
cite_parts:
evaṃ bhuvanamayy eṣā saṃvid bhāti svarūpataḥ /
dhriyate yatra tatraiva svasaṃskārāt sukhādikam // [AgMsv_1.1099]
mv-k07-v1035.quick_english: Thus awareness shines by its own nature as made of worlds; wherever it is held, there, from its own impressions, it experiences pleasure and the like.

mv-k07-v1036.label: AgMsv_1.1100
cite_parts:
vetty anyena na dṛśyas tu sa tv anyān veda cānyathā /
na deśaḥ paramārthena na ca kālo 'sti kaś cana // [AgMsv_1.1100]
mv-k07-v1036.quick_english: One knows, but is not seen by another in that same way; one knows others differently. In ultimate truth, there is no place and no time at all.

mv-k07-v1037.label: AgMsv_1.1101
cite_parts:
bhedavāde hi gaganadeśāt sarvaikadeśatā /
upādher eva deśād bhiddeśasyāpy upādher bhidā // [AgMsv_1.1101]
mv-k07-v1037.quick_english: In the doctrine of difference, if space is the common place, everything would be in one place; but if difference comes from limiting conditions, even those differently placed conditions depend on further difference.

mv-k07-v1038.label: AgMsv_1.1102
cite_parts:
ity anyonyasamāśrityā deśabhedo na kaś cana /
svarūpabheda evāto bhedakatve susaṃgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1102]
mv-k07-v1038.quick_english: Thus, because of mutual dependence, there is no real difference of place; only a difference of intrinsic nature would fit as a true differentiator.

mv-k07-v1039.label: AgMsv_1.1103
cite_parts:
sa ca nāsti prakāśaikasvarūpeṣv iti sādhitam /
enayaiva parāmarśadṛśā ye parivarjitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1103]
mv-k07-v1039.quick_english: But that intrinsic difference does not exist in things whose nature is one light; this has already been established. Those who lack this reflective insight miss it.

mv-k07-v1040.label: AgMsv_1.1104
cite_parts:
te śaṅkākāriśāstraughaśaṅkitās tanmayīkṛtāḥ /
svasvapnanirmitānantajaḍajantuvikalpitaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.1104]
mv-k07-v1040.quick_english: Those deprived of that insight are made doubtful by floods of doubt-producing scriptures and become absorbed in them, taking as real the endless inert beings imagined in their own dreams.

mv-k07-v1041.label: AgMsv_1.1105
cite_parts:
śāstrābhāsair vṛthā śaṅkāṃ grāhyante bodhavarjitāḥ /
yathā prabuddhyante saṃvin nibhṛtāpi ciraṃ sthitā // [AgMsv_1.1105]
mv-k07-v1041.quick_english: Those without awakening are vainly made to cling to doubt by mere semblances of scripture; yet awareness, though hidden for long, can still awaken.

mv-k07-v1042.label: AgMsv_1.1106
cite_parts:
tathāpi phalatīty evaṃ prāyaś cittādikalpitaiḥ /
evam ābhāsanānātvasvātantryaiśvaryaśālinā // [AgMsv_1.1106]
mv-k07-v1042.quick_english: Even so, such things mostly bear fruit through constructions of the mind and the like, because of the sovereign freedom that manifests multiplicity.

mv-k07-v1043.label: AgMsv_1.1107
cite_parts:
kḷptaṃ yad eva tat tasya yāti tanvādirūpatām /
viparyayābhāsayoge śītādyābhāsadūṣite // [AgMsv_1.1107]
mv-k07-v1043.quick_english: Whatever is fashioned becomes for that person a body and the like; when joined with reversed appearances and tainted by sensations such as cold, it takes that disturbed form.

mv-k07-v1044.label: AgMsv_1.1108
cite_parts:
nāḍyādāv atha saṃkocasphoṭaghātādipīḍite /
dehabhastrāmahāyantravātacakre 'nyathāgate // [AgMsv_1.1108]
mv-k07-v1044.quick_english: Then, when the channels and so forth are afflicted by contraction, bursting, blows, and the like, the body—like a great bellows-machine with its wheel of winds—goes out of order.

mv-k07-v1045.label: AgMsv_1.1109
cite_parts:
prāṇo vighaṭate tena jaḍābhāsaṃ kalevaram /
yasmin yāty adhikāre vā jāte prāg vāsanākramāt // [AgMsv_1.1109]
mv-k07-v1045.quick_english: When the vital breath breaks apart, the body appears inert, and one passes into another sphere of experience that arises according to the sequence of earlier latent impressions.

tokens.grounds: passes into; sandhi form of yāti before adhikāre
into a new sphere of experience or jurisdiction
when it has come into being
according to the order of past impressions

mv-k07-v1046.label: AgMsv_1.1110
cite_parts:
tatraiva kalpayed bhogaṃ paralokābhidhānakam /
pāṣāṇatāṃ vā vetty eṣa punar vā pratibudhyate // [AgMsv_1.1110]
mv-k07-v1046.quick_english: In that very state one may fashion an experience called the other world, or one may feel like stone, or else one may wake up again.

tokens.grounds: in that very state or domain
the condition of being like stone
experiences or cognizes; sandhi form of vetti

mv-k07-v1047.label: AgMsv_1.1111
cite_parts:
paro 'yaṃ loka iti ca rūḍhyāsya paralokitā /
svargamokṣādi yasyeha yathārūḍhaṃ ca cetasi // [AgMsv_1.1111]
mv-k07-v1047.quick_english: It is called another world because of one's firm conviction, and whatever heaven, liberation, or the like has become settled in the mind for someone here takes shape accordingly.

tokens.grounds: this; elided form of ayam after paro
through this one's settled conviction; sandhi of rūḍhyā + asya
the state of being an other world
for whomever in this life; sandhi of yasya + iha
in whatever way it has become settled

mv-k07-v1048.label: AgMsv_1.1112
cite_parts:
tathaivāsya bahir bhāti tatas tatrāpi citratā /
bandho mokṣaḥ sukhaṃ svargo duḥkhaṃ jaḍamayī sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.1112]
mv-k07-v1048.quick_english: In just that way it shines outwardly for that person, and so even there there is variety: bondage and liberation, happiness and heaven, suffering and an inert state.

tokens.grounds: in that very way for this subject; sandhi of tathā + eva + asya
even in that domain; sandhi of tatra + api

mv-k07-v1049.label: AgMsv_1.1113
cite_parts:
saṃvid eva svatantretthaṃ śivarūpatā virājate /
bhūyo 'vayavayuktasya yathā tāvaty ahaṃsthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.1113]
mv-k07-v1049.quick_english: Consciousness alone, in its own freedom, shines forth in this way as Śiva-nature; and just as a being made of parts has an 'I'-sense only to a limited extent,

tokens.grounds: by its own freedom in this way; sandhi of svatantrā + ittham
the state of being of Śiva's nature
of a being composed of parts; elided form of avayavayuktasya
limited to that measure; sandhi form of tāvatī
the standing of the sense of 'I'

mv-k07-v1050.label: AgMsv_1.1114
cite_parts:
tathā viśvātmake rūpe bhairavasyāpy ahaṃsthitiḥ /
śiśuḥ śūnye 'pi vetālaṃ vetti satyārthakāriṇam // [AgMsv_1.1114]
mv-k07-v1050.quick_english: so too Bhairava's 'I'-sense abides in a form that is the whole universe; just as a child, even in an empty place, perceives a goblin as something that produces real effects.

tokens.grounds: whose nature is the whole universe
even of Bhairava; sandhi of bhairavasya + api
the standing of the sense of 'I'
in an empty place or void
even, also; elided form of api
a vetāla, a spirit or demon
acting as if objectively real and effective

mv-k08-v1051.label: AgMsv_1.1115
cite_parts:
dhyeyapūjyādivaicitryam ittham arthakriyākaram /
mūrto bhinnaḥ samāhūto hitvā bhogān nijān kṣaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.1115]
mv-k08-v1051.quick_english: Thus the variety of meditation, worship, and the like becomes effective in action: an embodied, divided deity, when invoked, can abandon its own enjoyments and act in an instant.

tokens.grounds: compound denoting diverse forms of meditation, worship, etc.
compound describing something that accomplishes practical ends

mv-k08-v1052.label: AgMsv_1.1116
cite_parts:
deva etīti vārtaiṣā vacaneṣv eva śobhate /
amūrtādisvarūpatvaṃ sarvam etat tu yujyate // [AgMsv_1.1116]
mv-k08-v1052.quick_english: Saying 'O god, he comes' is fitting only within scriptural statements; but all this is truly fitting only as the nature of the formless and so forth.

tokens.grounds: verb with quotative particle fused in the token
fused form referring to such a report or claim
locative plural with sandhi before eva
abstract state of being formless and so on
demonstrative referring to the preceding account

mv-k08-v1053.label: AgMsv_1.1117
cite_parts:
ātmaiva hi tathābhūtas tathā bhāty eva bhedataḥ /
evaṃ svabhāva evaiṣa saṃvido yaḥ sa eva tu // [AgMsv_1.1117]
mv-k08-v1053.quick_english: Indeed the self alone, being of that nature, appears just so through division; for this is the very nature of consciousness, and that alone is what appears.

mv-k08-v1054.label: AgMsv_1.1118
cite_parts:
bhedagrastatayā kārmo malaḥ śāstre nirūpyate /
dīkṣādikarmayoge tu na malatvaṃ pratāyate // [AgMsv_1.1118]
mv-k08-v1054.quick_english: In scripture the karmic impurity is defined as being seized by division; but in the practice of initiation and related rites, it is not regarded as an impurity.

tokens.grounds: instrumental abstract expressing domination by difference
related to action and its traces
compound locative referring to initiatory and ritual practice
the condition of being an impurity
is recognized or extended as such

mv-k08-v1055.label: AgMsv_1.1119
cite_parts:
sa hi bhedamayāśeṣasaṃsāradahanavrataḥ /
dīkṣā ca vastutas tādṛksatyasaṃvitsvarūpiṇī // [AgMsv_1.1119]
mv-k08-v1055.quick_english: For initiation is vowed to burning away the entire world of transmigration made of division; and in reality it is of the nature of that true consciousness.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative referring to the karmic factor or rite context
compound describing a vow to consume the whole world of division
from the standpoint of true nature
compound describing initiation as true awareness itself

mv-k08-v1056.label: AgMsv_1.1120
cite_parts:
evaṃ yo veda tattvenety uktaṃ cānuttare naye /
evaṃ vijñānayoge hi śamite bhedagocare // [AgMsv_1.1120]
mv-k08-v1056.quick_english: Thus it is said in the supreme doctrine: one who knows in this way knows in truth; for in the yoga of realization, when the sphere of division is quieted, this is understood.

tokens.grounds: fused connective and locative referring to the highest teaching
in the discipline of direct knowledge

mv-k08-v1057.label: AgMsv_1.1121
cite_parts:
ātmaiva śiva evaikaḥ ko bandhaḥ kā ca muktatā /
etaddīkṣāmahāsaṃvidpraveśāya tu bhaṇyate // [AgMsv_1.1121]
mv-k08-v1057.quick_english: The self alone is Śiva, the one reality—so what bondage is there, and what liberation? Yet this is taught for the sake of entry into the great consciousness of initiation.

mv-k08-v1058.label: AgMsv_1.1122
cite_parts:
kriyāsvabhāvadīkṣāsau karmādimalahānaye /
svabhāvakḷptaniyatibalākṣipteṣu karmasu // [AgMsv_1.1122]
mv-k08-v1058.quick_english: This initiation, whose nature is action, is for the removal of karmic and other impurities, operating within actions that are driven by the fixed force fashioned by nature.

tokens.grounds: fused compound referring to initiation characterized by ritual action
compound locative plural describing karmic actions governed by inherent necessity

mv-k08-v1059.label: AgMsv_1.1123
cite_parts:
bhogo 'sya yugapadyasmāt kriyate mantraśaktitaḥ /
tathā hi prāṇagā deśakalākālādhvaniścayāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1123]
mv-k08-v1059.quick_english: Because his experience is brought about simultaneously through the power of mantra, the determinations belonging to breath, space, limited agency, and time are likewise brought into play.

tokens.grounds: compound naming limiting determinations along the paths of space, limited agency, and time

mv-k08-v1060.label: AgMsv_1.1124
cite_parts:
jātayo 'sya pratāyante dharaṇyādiśivāntataḥ /
tatraiva janmasaṃbhogādhikāralayabhājanam // [AgMsv_1.1124]
mv-k08-v1060.quick_english: His births are unfolded from earth all the way up to Śiva, and right there he becomes subject to birth, experience, authority, and dissolution.

tokens.grounds: compound indicating the full range of levels
compound describing undergoing birth, enjoyment, office, and dissolution

mv-k08-v1061.label: AgMsv_1.1125
cite_parts:
vidhāyotkṛṣyate tasmād anyatra ca vidhīyate /

itthaṃ guror niścitasaṃvidātmarūḍheś ca śiṣyasya paraspareṇa /
niṣkarmacetor acitaiva dīkṣā prākkarmaśaktīr akhilā ruṇaddhi // [AgMsv_1.1125]
mv-k08-v1061.quick_english: Thus, having been arranged and elevated from one level and placed in another, initiation—through the mutual, non-conceptual meeting of a guru established in settled consciousness and a disciple of actionless mind—blocks all the powers of prior karma.

tokens.grounds: absolutive plus passive verb indicating elevation after arrangement
compound describing a guru or lord grounded in settled consciousness
compound with truncated genitive form indicating minds free of karmic action
fused instrumental-like form emphasizing non-conceptual means

mv-k08-v1062.label: AgMsv_1.1126
cite_parts:
tatrāpi taṇḍulatilājyacaruprabandha ityādi śaivaniyatipratibhārakḷptam /
tāvaty api sphuṭapade na niśāprapañco nirmūlatām upagato 'pi vibhedavṛtteḥ // [AgMsv_1.1126]
mv-k08-v1062.quick_english: Even there, the series of rice, sesame, ghee, oblations, and so forth—fashioned according to Śaiva necessity—does not, even at a clear stage, make the expanse of obscurity rootless, because division still continues to operate.

tokens.grounds: compound listing ritual substances and procedures
compound describing ritual forms shaped by Śaiva rule
in an explicit or manifest level
compound metaphorically suggesting obscurity or darkness
ablative/genitive sense indicating the persistence of differentiation

mv-k08-v1063.label: AgMsv_1.1127
cite_parts:
bhede 'pi kiṃtv eṣa punar bhaviṣyasaṃsārakārisukṛtādivighātahetuḥ /
śuddhas tatas tad ata eva hi tattvajālaṃ śuddhetarasthititayā nikhilaṃ dvidhaiva // [AgMsv_1.1127]
mv-k08-v1063.quick_english: Even within difference, this pure element destroys the merit that would cause future transmigration. For that reason, the entire network of principles is only twofold, divided into pure and other.

tokens.grounds: indeclinable, sandhi form of kiṃ tu
compound describing the cause of obstructing merit that produces future transmigration
instrumental expressing the mode of division

mv-k08-v1064.label: AgMsv_1.1128
cite_parts:
śuddhaṃ triśaktikhacitaṃ nanu yāmalaṃ ca bhāty eva tena bahudhaiṣa kṛtaḥ kriyāyāḥ /
vyāpārakalpanāvaśān niyatiprapañcaḥ svalpetaratvakṛtatādṛśabhogayogaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1128]
mv-k08-v1064.quick_english: The pure reality shines as filled with the three powers and as paired. From this, ritual action is conceived in many ways, and so an expanse of restriction arises that brings about limited forms of enjoyment.

tokens.grounds: compound describing the pure as pervaded by three powers
indeclinable particle introducing an objection or emphasis
adjective referring to the Yāmala character
sandhi fusion of bahudhā and eṣaḥ
compound describing the regulated expanse as linked to limited enjoyment

mv-k08-v1065.label: AgMsv_1.1129
cite_parts:
mudrāmaṇḍalasaṃghātaḥ samantratantracarcitaḥ /
yatra yogādikaṃ sarvaṃ phaladānāya kalpate // [AgMsv_1.1129]
mv-k08-v1065.quick_english: Where the assemblage of seals and mandalas is practiced together with mantras and tantras, all practices such as yoga become capable of yielding their fruits.

mv-k08-v1066.label: AgMsv_1.1130
cite_parts:
nirvṛtiphalasaṃprāptikāṅkṣāsaṃkocasusthitāḥ /
anavacchinnatām eva phalatvenātra manvate // [AgMsv_1.1130]
mv-k08-v1066.quick_english: Those who are fixed in the narrowed desire to attain liberation regard unlimitedness itself as the fruit to be obtained here.

tokens.grounds: compound describing practitioners whose aspiration is narrowed to liberation as a result
sandhi fusion of phalatvena and atra

mv-k08-v1067.label: AgMsv_1.1132
cite_parts:
na hy anantānav/yacchede kāpi yāgādikalpanā anavacchinnavāñchā // 1.1131 //

tatsarvottīrṇadṛṣṭayaḥ /
tathāpi vidite hy arthe paramādvayasundare // [AgMsv_1.1132]
mv-k08-v1067.quick_english: In what is unlimited and unbroken, there is no room for conceiving sacrifice and similar rites; such is the view of those who have transcended all that. Still, even when the supremely nondual reality is known, some desire for a fruit can remain.

tokens.grounds: locative compound; slash in source marks an editorial reading boundary
sandhi fusion of kā and api
editorial reference marker in the text

mv-k08-v1068.label: AgMsv_1.1133
cite_parts:
saṃvitsvabhāvasvātantryāt keṣāṃcit phalakāmatā /
tāny evoddiśya tat sarvaṃ pūraṇāya dharāditaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1133]
mv-k08-v1068.quick_english: Because consciousness is free by its very nature, some people still desire fruits. For their sake, the entire teaching is set forth, from earth up to Śiva, so that their aims may be fulfilled.

tokens.grounds: accusative plural demonstrative, sandhi form of tāni
gerund with sandhi fusion of eva and uddiśya
ablative compound indicating the starting point of the hierarchy

mv-k08-v1069.label: AgMsv_1.1134
cite_parts:
śivāntaṃ bahudhā bhedair dhāraṇāgrantha ucyate

iha hi nānyanayeṣv iva kiñcana sphuritam asti na yat kila satyataḥ /
tad iha satyapade sthitibhāgināṃ kim iva heyapade nipatiṣyati // [AgMsv_1.1134]
mv-k08-v1069.quick_english: The teaching on concentrations sets out the whole range up to Śiva in many divisions. Here, unlike in other systems, nothing that appears is unreal; so for those who abide in truth, what could possibly fall into the category of what must be rejected?

tokens.grounds: compound subject, sandhi form of dhāraṇāgranthaḥ
sandhi fusion of na, anya, nayeṣu
relative pronoun, sandhi form of yad

mv-k08-v1070.label: AgMsv_1.1135
cite_parts:
itthaṃ saptadaśādhikāracaramaṃ tattvaṃ yad ābhāsate tan nirṇītam anuttaraṃ śivapadaṃ saṃprāptikāmān prati /
etat sarvam ihoditaṃ ca jagadānande vipakṣātmakaṃ bhedaprāṇatayā yato 'tra nikhilo 'py eṣa prapañcaḥ sthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1135]
mv-k08-v1070.quick_english: Thus the principle that appears as the culmination of the seventeen sections is determined to be the unsurpassed state of Śiva for those who desire attainment. Everything taught here appears in an opposing form, because this entire expanse stands animated by difference.

tokens.grounds: relative pronoun, sandhi form of yad
demonstrative pronoun, sandhi form of tat
demonstrative pronoun, sandhi form of etad
sandhi fusion of iha and uditam
locative compound referring to the text or state

mv-k08-v1071.label: AgMsv_2.1
cite_parts:
dvitīyaḥ kāṇḍaḥ

evaṃ maheśvaro devo viśvātmatvena saṃsthitaḥ /
kramikajñānayogābhyāṃ dhāraṇābhir upāsyate // [AgMsv_2.1]
mv-k08-v1071.quick_english: Thus, in the second section, the great Lord is established as the self of all and is worshiped through gradual knowledge and yoga, and through concentrations.

mv-k08-v1072.label: AgMsv_2.2
cite_parts:
tattvakramaṃ gatadvaitamalamāyādijālakam /
aṣṭādaśe tat paṭale tattvaṃ samyag vibhāvyate // [AgMsv_2.2]
mv-k08-v1072.quick_english: In the eighteenth chapter, the sequence of principles is fully expounded as freed from the net of duality, impurity, māyā, and the like.

tokens.grounds: indeclinable adverb, sandhi form of samyak

mv-k08-v1073.label: AgMsv_2.3
cite_parts:
prāṇāyāmādikaṃ yatra heyam ity eva varṇyate /
na hi tasya parāṃ vittiṃ prati kācid upāyatā // [AgMsv_2.3]
mv-k08-v1073.quick_english: Here, practices such as breath control are described as to be abandoned, because they are not a means to supreme knowledge.

tokens.grounds: indefinite pronoun, sandhi form of kācit

mv-k08-v1074.label: AgMsv_2.4
cite_parts:
antaḥ saṃvidi yan nirūḍham abhitas tat prāṇadhīvigrahe saṃcāryeta kathaṃ tatheti ghaṭatām abhyāsayogakramaḥ /
ye tv abhyāsapathena saṃvidam imāṃ saṃskartum abhyudyatās te kiṃ kutra kutaḥ kathaṃ vidadhatām ity atra saṃdihmahe // [AgMsv_2.4]
mv-k08-v1074.quick_english: What is firmly established within consciousness cannot be moved into the apparatus of breath and mind; so how could a method of practice make that happen? If some still strive to refine consciousness through practice, we doubt what they could accomplish, where, from what basis, and how.

tokens.grounds: relative pronoun, sandhi form of yad
sandhi fusion of tathā and iti
nominative plural participle, sandhi form of abhyudyatāḥ

mv-k08-v1075.label: AgMsv_2.5
cite_parts:
abhyāso hi punaḥ punar arthaḥ so 'pi ca dikkālapratibhedāt /
ābhāsetarayogasamuttho dehamanaḥprāṇākṣapathe syāt // [AgMsv_2.5]
mv-k08-v1075.quick_english: Practice means doing something over and over again, and even that arises from differences of space and time and from involvement with appearance and otherness; so it takes place on the path of body, mind, breath, and senses.

tokens.grounds: adverb of repetition, sandhi before arthaḥ
predicate noun in compound sense with repetition

mv-k08-v1076.label: AgMsv_2.6
cite_parts:
prakāśaikaghane rūpe bhairavīye vivikṣavaḥ /
sakṛdvibhātavijñānaviśrāntyaiva susaṃsthitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.6]
mv-k08-v1076.quick_english: Those who wish to enter the Bhairava form, which is dense with pure light alone, become firmly established simply by resting in knowledge that shines forth once.

tokens.grounds: predicate describing those who wish to enter

mv-k08-v1077.label: AgMsv_2.7
cite_parts:
atraivātaḥ paraṃ proktam aṅgaṃ sarvopakāri yat /
dhāraṇā api taddvāraniścitāḥ syus tathātmikāḥ // [AgMsv_2.7]
mv-k08-v1077.quick_english: For that reason, concentration is declared here to be the supreme and universally helpful limb, and concentrations determined through that same door may become of that very nature.

tokens.grounds: atra + eva + ataḥ fused in sandhi

mv-k08-v1078.label: AgMsv_2.8
cite_parts:
nanv apratiṣṭhe kas tarke samāśvāsaḥ prakalpyatām /
kiṃ vā na bhavatāṃ tādṛg apratiṣṭhāhataṃ vacaḥ // [AgMsv_2.8]
mv-k08-v1078.quick_english: But surely, what confidence can be placed in reasoning that has no firm ground? Or else, why would your own statement not be struck down by the same lack of ground?

mv-k08-v1079.label: AgMsv_2.9
cite_parts:
tathā hy āgama evaikaṃ pramāṇam iti niścitaiḥ /
tadviruddhāgamavrāte sati niścīyatāṃ katham // [AgMsv_2.9]
mv-k08-v1079.quick_english: Likewise, if some insist that scripture alone is the valid means of knowledge, how is certainty to be reached when there is a whole host of scriptures that contradict it?

tokens.grounds: explanatory particle, sandhi form of hi

mv-k08-v1080.label: AgMsv_2.10
cite_parts:
mahājanaprasiddhis tu tatra prāmāṇyakāraṇam /
apratiṣṭhā tadviruddhamahājanasusaṃbhavāt // [AgMsv_2.10]
mv-k08-v1080.quick_english: But if acceptance by the great multitude is taken as the reason for validity, that too is ungrounded, because a great multitude opposed to it can just as well exist.

mv-k08-v1081.label: AgMsv_2.11
cite_parts:
pratyakṣam api rucyādau dṛṣṭabādhakasaṃvidam /
uttarottaravijñānānavasthābhājanaṃ nanu // [AgMsv_2.11]
mv-k08-v1081.quick_english: Even perception, in matters like taste and so on, is seen to be overruled, and it becomes subject to an endless regress of later cognitions, does it not?

mv-k08-v1082.label: AgMsv_2.12
cite_parts:
svasaṃvid api tatraiva bādhiteti kathaṃ kila /
vyavahāram ayaṃ kuryād bhedasaṃdhānapaṇḍitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.12]
mv-k08-v1082.quick_english: If even self-awareness were overruled in that way, how could this person, skilled in joining differences together, carry on any practical dealings at all?

tokens.grounds: subject, the expert in joining differences

mv-k08-v1083.label: AgMsv_2.13
cite_parts:
asmākaṃ tv apratiṣṭhānaṃ na kadācit kvacid bhavet /
yeṣāṃ sarvatra saṃpūrṇaḥ paro bhairavasāgaraḥ // [AgMsv_2.13]
mv-k08-v1083.quick_english: But for us there can never be groundlessness at any time or place, because for us the supreme, all-full ocean of Bhairava is present everywhere.

tokens.grounds: possessive reference to the Trika position
contrastive particle, sandhi form of tu
ultimate ground of certainty; compound: bhairava-sāgara

mv-k08-v1084.label: AgMsv_2.14
cite_parts:
viśeṣatas tu tarkasya tān praty evāpratiṣṭhatā /
ye tarkārṇavatārāttaparamāmṛtasaṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_2.14]
mv-k08-v1084.quick_english: Especially for those whose awareness has received the supreme nectar by crossing the ocean of reasoning, reasoning itself is not ungrounded.

tokens.grounds: relative pronoun introducing the qualified group

mv-k08-v1085.label: AgMsv_2.15
cite_parts:
tathā hi sarve tarkāṃśā anāmṛṣṭasvasaṃvidaḥ /
sarvatra paryantaphalaṃ na śivaṃ pratipedire // [AgMsv_2.15]
mv-k08-v1085.quick_english: For all the parts of reasoning that do not touch self-awareness never, anywhere, attain Śiva as their final fruit.

mv-k08-v1086.label: AgMsv_2.16
cite_parts:
abhedasāraḥ sarvo hi śāstrārthas tatprapattaye /
yas tatrodbhāvito bhedas tatra mūḍhadhiyo ratāḥ // [AgMsv_2.16]
mv-k08-v1086.quick_english: The meaning of all scripture is essentially non-difference; any difference brought forth there is for attaining that non-difference, yet those of deluded intellect take delight in the difference itself.

tokens.grounds: describes bheda; tatra + udbhāvitaḥ in sandhi
subject who delight in difference; compound: mūḍha-dhī

mv-k08-v1087.label: AgMsv_2.17
cite_parts:
tarkaś ca bhedavādāṃśayukticchedaikapaṇḍitaḥ /
nanv abhede 'pi tarkasya kā cid asty upayogitā // [AgMsv_2.17]
mv-k08-v1087.quick_english: Reasoning is skilled only in cutting down the arguments of views based on difference; but surely, does reasoning have any usefulness even in the realm of non-difference?

mv-k08-v1088.label: AgMsv_2.18
cite_parts:
paramādvayadṛṣṭau ca so 'pi naiva na saṃgataḥ /
ata eva parādvaitaṃ yad viśvānugrahātmakam /
tasyopāyaṃ paraṃ brūte hṛdayaṃ spandanātmakam // [AgMsv_2.18]
mv-k08-v1088.quick_english: In the vision of supreme nonduality, even reasoning is not truly fitting; therefore, for that supreme nonduality whose nature is grace to the universe, the text declares the Heart, whose nature is vibration, to be the supreme means.

tokens.grounds: object characterized by the relative clause

mv-k08-v1089.label: AgMsv_2.19
cite_parts:
hṛdaye bodhamaye yaḥ svavimarśaḥ pūrṇaciccamatkāraḥ /
yugapad drāgiti haṭhato līnīkṛtaviśvataḥsphuraṇaḥ // [AgMsv_2.19]
mv-k08-v1089.quick_english: In the Heart, which is made of awareness, there is a self-reflective awareness, the wonder of full consciousness, which all at once, suddenly and forcibly, dissolves the outward flashing of the universe.

mv-k08-v1090.label: AgMsv_2.20
cite_parts:
bhāvagrahādyacaramadaśāyor ullāsinirvṛtisupūrṇaḥ /
jagadānandamayo 'sau sāmānyaspanda ity uktaḥ // [AgMsv_2.20]
mv-k08-v1090.quick_english: In the first and last moments of grasping things, that state which is fully filled with surging bliss and made of the bliss of the whole world is called the universal vibration.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative subject, sandhi form of asau

mv-k08-v1091.label: AgMsv_2.21
cite_parts:
sphuraṇaṃ hṛdayasya yat kila prakaṭam idaṃ visargadhāmnaḥ /
sad iti pratibhāti yāvatā trikaśaktau viśatīha tāvatā // [AgMsv_2.21]
mv-k08-v1091.quick_english: The manifest flashing of the Heart, which shines forth as pure being from the abode of emission, leads one into the triad of powers to the very extent that it is recognized.

mv-k08-v1092.label: AgMsv_2.22
cite_parts:
tad idaṃ hṛdayaṃ nirucyate paramaṃ bhairavasaṃvidāmṛtam /
iṣidṛkkṛtiśaktiśūlagaṃ parame dhāmni visṛjyate tataḥ // [AgMsv_2.22]
mv-k08-v1092.quick_english: This Heart is defined as the supreme nectar of Bhairava awareness, situated on the trident of the powers of will, knowledge, and action; from the supreme abode it is emitted.

mv-k08-v1093.label: AgMsv_2.23
cite_parts:
parame bhagavatparātmani sphuritaṃ viśvam idaṃ cidātmakam /
śaktitrayaśūlagaṃ tataḥ śāmbhavabhūmivisargavartmanā // [AgMsv_2.23]
mv-k08-v1093.quick_english: In the supreme, lordly Self this universe flashes forth as consciousness, situated on the trident of the three powers, and then proceeds by the path of emission on the Śāmbhava level.

mv-k08-v1094.label: AgMsv_2.24
cite_parts:
tad atho sad iti pragīyate tad idaṃ pūrṇam ihāhamātmakaṃ /
hṛdayaṃ śivaśaktisaṃgamasphuraṇātmaiva sadāvabhāsate // [AgMsv_2.24]
mv-k08-v1094.quick_english: That is then proclaimed as pure being; this full Heart, of the nature of 'I', always shines forth as the very flashing of the union of Śiva and Śakti.

tokens.grounds: iha + aham-ātmakaṃ in sandhi; compound: aham-ātmaka

mv-k08-v1095.label: AgMsv_2.25
cite_parts:
iha sṛṣṭilayasthitikramāḥ śataśo vāpi sahasrakoṭiśaḥ /
pravibhānti sadātanātmanā haraviṣṇvambujahetusaṃcitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.25]
mv-k08-v1095.quick_english: Here, in the Heart, sequences of creation, dissolution, and maintenance shine forth by the hundreds or even by thousands of millions, eternally, gathered through the agencies of Hara, Viṣṇu, and the lotus-born.

tokens.grounds: locative adverb referring to the Heart
adverb of vast multiplicity; compound: sahasra-koṭi-śas

mv-k08-v1096.label: AgMsv_2.26
cite_parts:
iha tu puroktād yuktikalāpād yaḥ praviśet sadyo nāśaktaḥ /
taṃ prati śāktopāyapathena prakaṭīkriyate hṛdayaspandaḥ // [AgMsv_2.26]
mv-k08-v1096.quick_english: But for one who is not able to enter immediately through the collection of reasonings stated before, the vibration of the Heart is made manifest by the path of the śākta means.

mv-k08-v1097.label: AgMsv_2.27
cite_parts:
triśūlaprāntagaprāṇapreraṇāvāptahṛtpathaḥ /
tadantarvarticiccandrakalāviśrāntitatparaḥ // [AgMsv_2.27]
mv-k08-v1097.quick_english: One reaches the path of the Heart by impelling the breath at the tip of the trident, and becomes intent on resting in the moon-digit of consciousness within that.

mv-k08-v1098.label: AgMsv_2.28
cite_parts:
jhaṭity evātha tadbhūmityāgena projjhya tā daśāḥ /
nirānandādikāḥ pañcabhūtamadhyavyavasthitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.28]
mv-k08-v1098.quick_english: Then, suddenly, by abandoning that level and casting off those states beginning with absence of bliss, which are situated amid the five elements, one moves beyond them.

mv-k08-v1099.label: AgMsv_2.29
cite_parts:
tyajet pūrvāṃ parāṃ krāmet samyagviśrāntitatparaḥ /
yato nijānandamayī bhūmiḥ śāntapadānugā // [AgMsv_2.29]
mv-k08-v1099.quick_english: Intent on complete rest, one should abandon the former stage and move to the higher one, because the ground of innate bliss follows upon the peaceful state.

mv-k08-v1100.label: AgMsv_2.30
cite_parts:
nirānandaparānandau puruṣājātasaṃgatau /
abhedabhinnabhogyaughajanitānandajṛmbhaṇāt // [AgMsv_2.30]
mv-k08-v1100.quick_english: Nirānanda and parānanda, connected with puruṣa and the unborn, arise from the expansion of bliss produced by masses of undivided and divided objects of experience.

mv-k08-v1101.label: AgMsv_2.31
cite_parts:
mahānandasthitiḥ kāpi vāmācārā samullaset /
bhairavīyamahādhāmni svīkṛtāśeṣasaṃvidi // [AgMsv_2.31]
mv-k08-v1101.quick_english: A wondrous state of great bliss, of leftward course, shines forth in the great abode of Bhairava, in consciousness that has taken all within itself.

tokens.grounds: describes the mode of the state

mv-k08-v1102.label: AgMsv_2.32
cite_parts:
mahānandaś cidānandībhūya bhūyaḥ pravartate /
asmiṃs tu svīkṛtāśeṣadakṣavāmordhvagatrike // [AgMsv_2.32]
mv-k08-v1102.quick_english: Great bliss, having become the bliss of consciousness, proceeds again in this triad that has taken in all the right, left, and upper aspects.

mv-k08-v1103.label: AgMsv_2.33
cite_parts:
trike sarvātmanā dvaitādvaitasaṃgrahaṇātmani /
abhinnā vātha bhinnā vā bhinnābhinnā athāpi vā // [AgMsv_2.33]
mv-k08-v1103.quick_english: In the triad whose nature is to grasp both duality and nonduality in every way, things may appear as undivided, or divided, or both divided and undivided.

mv-k08-v1104.label: AgMsv_2.34
cite_parts:
bhāvā nijādikānandadaśāpañcakayojitāḥ /
jāyante jagadānandasamuddāmadaśājuṣaḥ // [AgMsv_2.34]
mv-k08-v1104.quick_english: Beings, joined with the five states of bliss beginning with innate bliss, arise from the state of intense, overflowing universal bliss.

mv-k08-v1105.label: AgMsv_2.35
cite_parts:
nijānandaḥ pramātraṃśamātraniṣṭhanibandhanaḥ /
śūnyatāmātraviśrānter nirānandātmikā sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.35]
mv-k08-v1105.quick_english: Innate bliss is founded only on resting in the aspect of the subject, while the state of nirānanda arises from resting only in emptiness.

mv-k08-v1106.label: AgMsv_2.36
cite_parts:
prameyapadaviśrānteḥ parānando 'py udety alam /
anantameyasaṃghaṭṭapūrṇe meye tu sarvataḥ // [AgMsv_2.36]
mv-k08-v1106.quick_english: Supreme bliss also fully arises from resting in the domain of the object, when the object is filled on all sides with the collision of infinite knowables.

mv-k08-v1107.label: AgMsv_2.37
cite_parts:
pramāṇāc carvaṇāyogān mahānanda iti sthitiḥ /
samastamānameyaughakalanāgrāsakovidaḥ // [AgMsv_2.37]
mv-k08-v1107.quick_english: The state called great bliss arises from the means of knowing through the yoking of savoring; it is skilled in devouring the apprehension of all masses of knowers and knowns.

tokens.grounds: compound describing the state or experiencer

mv-k08-v1108.label: AgMsv_2.38
cite_parts:
yadā viśrāntim abhyeti nirupādhisunirbharām /
tadā khalu cidānando yo jaḍānupabṛṃhitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.38]
mv-k08-v1108.quick_english: When one attains a rest that is unconditioned and utterly full, then indeed there is consciousness-bliss, which is not nourished by anything inert.

mv-k08-v1109.label: AgMsv_2.39
cite_parts:
na ca yatra sthitiḥ kāpi vibhaktā jaḍarūpiṇī /
yatra ko 'pi vyavacchedo nāsti yad viśvataḥ sphurat // [AgMsv_2.39]
mv-k08-v1109.quick_english: Where there is no divided state of inert form, where there is no division at all, and which shines forth on every side.

mv-k08-v1110.label: AgMsv_2.40
cite_parts:
yad anāhṛtasaṃvitti paramāmṛtabṛṃhitam /
tad eva jagadānandadhāmāsmākaṃ gurur jagau // [AgMsv_2.40]
mv-k08-v1110.quick_english: Our teacher declared that very reality—unstruck awareness nourished by supreme nectar—to be the abode of universal bliss.

tokens.grounds: compound with possessive sense; sandhi dhāma+asmākam

mv-k08-v1111.label: AgMsv_2.41
cite_parts:
yatrāsti bhāvanādīnāṃ na mukhyā kāpi saṃgatiḥ /
tatra viśrāntir ādheyā hṛdayoccārayogataḥ // [AgMsv_2.41]
mv-k08-v1111.quick_english: Where contemplation and other practices have no primary applicability, rest should be established there through the yoga of utterance in the heart.

tokens.grounds: relative clause with existential; sandhi yatra+asti
object to be established; sandhi for viśrāntiḥ

mv-k08-v1112.label: AgMsv_2.42
cite_parts:
yā tatra samyag viśrāntis tat parādvaitam ucyate /
prāṇadaṇḍaprayogena pūrvāparasamīkṛteḥ // [AgMsv_2.42]
mv-k08-v1112.quick_english: The complete rest attained there is called supreme nonduality; it comes about through the application of the breath-staff and the equalizing of before and after.

tokens.grounds: adverb qualifying rest; sandhi for samyak

mv-k08-v1113.label: AgMsv_2.43
cite_parts:
catuṣkikāmbujālambilambikāsaudhasiktabhūḥ /
bandhamokṣavibhāgena narād anyatra yoginā // [AgMsv_2.43]
mv-k08-v1113.quick_english: By the yogin, elsewhere than in the ordinary person’s division of bondage and liberation, the ground is sprinkled by the mansion of the pendant lotus tetrad.

tokens.grounds: long compound describing the yogic ground
ablative of comparison; sandhi for narāt

mv-k08-v1114.label: AgMsv_2.44
cite_parts:
anuttarasvabhāvena vāgvyāpārābhivartinā /
cidvimarśaparāhaṃkṛtpralayollāsayoginā // [AgMsv_2.44]
mv-k08-v1114.quick_english: By the unsurpassed nature that operates through the activity of speech, united with the dissolution and flourishing of the supreme I in the reflective awareness of consciousness.

mv-k08-v1115.label: AgMsv_2.45
cite_parts:
udyogavaśariktena saddvādaśakalātmanā /
sūryeṇābhāsite bhāve pūrite paricarcite // [AgMsv_2.45]
mv-k08-v1115.quick_english: When the entity is illuminated by the sun—emptied of effort and whose nature is the true twelve phases—it is filled and fully pervaded.

mv-k08-v1116.label: AgMsv_2.46
cite_parts:
tadgrāsamantharavaśāḥ ṣoḍaśākhyakalājuṣā /
praviṣṭeṇa vibodhāgnau samyag visṛjatā kalāḥ // [AgMsv_2.46]
mv-k08-v1116.quick_english: Having entered the fire of awakening, the one possessing the sixteen named phases completely releases the phases, which are slowed by the power of devouring that.

mv-k08-v1117.label: AgMsv_2.47
cite_parts:
catasro jīvanīḥ prāptavisargāvikṛtasthiteḥ /
antaḥkṛtānantatattvakādikṣāntena sarvataḥ // [AgMsv_2.47]
mv-k08-v1117.quick_english: By the one who has internalized the infinite principles from ka to kṣa on all sides, whose state remains unchanged after attaining emission, the four life-giving powers are attained.

mv-k08-v1118.label: AgMsv_2.48
cite_parts:
bhāvānāṃ bhāvatāsāravimarśābhāvahṛdyujā /
bahiḥprasavasadyogikulanetryadhiśāyinā // [AgMsv_2.48]
mv-k08-v1118.quick_english: Joined to the heart where there is no reflection on the essence of the beingness of things, resting upon the eye of the yogin lineage fit for outward emission.

mv-k08-v1119.label: AgMsv_2.49
cite_parts:
rudrayāmalabhāvena nityaṃ yā niṣṭhitaiva tām /
citprāṇaguṇadehāntaśaktisopānamālikām // [AgMsv_2.49]
mv-k08-v1119.quick_english: By the state of Rudra-union, that stairway-garland of powers—ending in consciousness, breath, quality, and body—is always indeed established.

mv-k08-v1120.label: AgMsv_2.50
cite_parts:
visargena visṛjyātha spandanodaravartinā /
visargabhūmim āśliṣya matsyodaradaśājuṣam // [AgMsv_2.50]
mv-k08-v1120.quick_english: Then, having released through emission moving within the womb of vibration, one embraces the ground of emission, which enjoys the state of the fish-womb.

mv-k08-v1121.label: AgMsv_2.51
cite_parts:
sarvasarvagatāṃ sarvajīvanīṃ paramāṃ kalām /
triśūlabhuvam ākramya nāḍītritayasaṃgatām // [AgMsv_2.51]
mv-k08-v1121.quick_english: Having ascended the ground of the trident, connected with the three channels, one reaches the supreme phase that is present in all, pervading all, and life-giving to all.

mv-k08-v1122.label: AgMsv_2.52
cite_parts:
vikasvarāṃ saṃkucitāṃ krameṇaikātmyam āśritām /
bhrūkuṭībindunādāntaśaktisopānamālikām // [AgMsv_2.52]
mv-k08-v1122.quick_english: One reaches the stairway-garland of powers ending in the brow-center, bindu, and nāda—expanding and contracting, and resorting in sequence to unity.

tokens.grounds: object of resorting to; sandhi krameṇa+ekātmyam

mv-k08-v1123.label: AgMsv_2.53
cite_parts:
rāsabhīvaḍavāsrāvasasaṃkocavikāsikām /
