muhur muhur līyamānasṛṣṭabhāvaughanirbharām // [AgMsv_2.53]
mv-k08-v1123.quick_english: She contracts and expands like the alternating flow of a she-donkey and a mare, again and again full of streams of beings that dissolve and are created.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound describing the goddess; rāsabhī = she-donkey, vaḍavā = mare, āsrāva = flow, saṃkoca-vikāsikā = contracting and expanding
indeclinable adverb of repetition, paired with previous
indeclinable adverb of repetition, paired with previous
bahuvrīhi; līyamāna = dissolving, sṛṣṭa = created, bhāva-ogha = stream of beings, nirbharā = full of

mv-k08-v1124.label: AgMsv_2.54
cite_parts:
ekīkṛtamahāmūlaśūlavaisargikāspadām /
samagrabhāvabharaṇabhairavīyahṛdāśritām // [AgMsv_2.54]
mv-k08-v1124.quick_english: She makes the great root spike into one emissive abode and rests in the heart of Bhairavī, who nourishes all beings.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; ekīkṛta = unified, mahā-mūla-śūla = great root spike, vaisargika = emissive, āspadā = abode
bahuvrīhi; samagra-bhāva-bharaṇa = nourishing all beings, bhairavīya-hṛd = heart of Bhairavī, āśritā = resting in

mv-k08-v1125.label: AgMsv_2.55
cite_parts:
sarvāpūraṇahevākasamarjitaparābhidhām /
ādyantarahitām enāṃ viśvapravaṇaśālinīm // [AgMsv_2.55]
mv-k08-v1125.quick_english: This goddess, who has won the supreme name by boldly filling all, is without beginning or end and is inclined toward the whole universe.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; sarva-āpūraṇa = filling all, hevāka = bold gesture/call, samarjita = acquired, parā-abhidhā = supreme name
bahuvrīhi; ādi-anta-rahitā = without beginning and end
demonstrative pronoun referring to the goddess
bahuvrīhi; viśva-pravaṇa = inclined toward the universe, śālinī = possessing

mv-k08-v1126.label: AgMsv_2.56
cite_parts:
hṛdbodhākāśaciccandracandrikāṃ tritayeśikām /
devīṃ prāpya na kiṃ nāma labhate lambhyaty api // [AgMsv_2.56]
mv-k08-v1126.quick_english: Having attained the goddess, the moonlight of the consciousness-moon in the space of heart-awareness and ruler of the triad, what indeed does one not obtain, and even cause others to obtain?

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; hṛd-bodha-ākāśa = space of heart-awareness, cit-candra = moon of consciousness, candrikā = moonlight
bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa sense; tritaya = triad, īśikā = ruler
present active causative of labh; sandhi form as given

mv-k08-v1127.label: AgMsv_2.57
cite_parts:
tad atra bhāvanādehagatopāyaiḥ pare sati /
yadaiṣa pravivikṣuḥ syād yogī tāvad prakampate // [AgMsv_2.57]
mv-k08-v1127.quick_english: Therefore, when the yogi, using means grounded in the contemplative body, wishes to enter the supreme, he first trembles.

tokens.grounds: instrumental plural; bhāvanā-deha-gata = situated in the contemplative body, upāyaiḥ = by means
locative of para, referring to the supreme reality
sandhi fusion marked by editor as a single token; yadā + eṣa

mv-k08-v1128.label: AgMsv_2.58
cite_parts:
pūrvajanmaśatābhyastadehatādātmyaniścayaḥ /
jalapāṃsuvad ekatvaṃ manvānaś ciccharīrayoḥ // [AgMsv_2.58]
mv-k08-v1128.quick_english: He trembles because, for hundreds of past births, he has been certain of identity with the body and has imagined consciousness and body to be one, like water mixed with dust.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; pūrva-janma-śata-abhyasta = practiced for hundreds of past births, deha-tādātmya-niścayaḥ = certainty of identity with the body
comparative compound; jala-pāṃsu-vat = like water and dust
present middle participle of man; sandhi form as given
dual genitive; cit-śarīrayoḥ = of consciousness and body

mv-k08-v1129.label: AgMsv_2.59
cite_parts:
bhedākhyamāyārahite paripūrṇacidātmani /
praviśet prathamaṃ yāvat svabalākramaṇakramāt // [AgMsv_2.59]
mv-k08-v1129.quick_english: He may first enter the perfectly full conscious self, free from the māyā called difference, through the process of pressing forward by his own power.

tokens.grounds: locative; bheda-ākhya-māyā-rahite = devoid of māyā called difference
locative; paripūrṇa-cit-ātmani = in the fully complete conscious self
ablative; sva-bala-ākramaṇa-kramāt = by the sequence of overpowering with one's own strength

mv-k08-v1130.label: AgMsv_2.60
cite_parts:
bhaven nidrāsya sā dehāveśaśaithilyadāyinī /
kamprarūpaiva yāvan no rūḍhir jātā parātmani // [AgMsv_2.60]
mv-k08-v1130.quick_english: For him there may arise a kind of sleep that loosens his immersion in the body, appearing just as trembling, so long as firm establishment in the supreme self has not yet arisen.

tokens.grounds: optative of bhū; sandhi form as given
demonstrative pronoun referring to the state
bahuvrīhi; deha-āveśa-śaithilya-dāyinī = giving slackening of immersion in the body
kampra-rūpā + eva; in the very form of trembling
temporal particle; sandhi form as given

mv-k08-v1131.label: AgMsv_2.61
cite_parts:
etad avyaktaliṅgaṃ tannaraśaktiśivātmakam /
yatra viśvam idaṃ līnaṃ yad antaḥsthaṃ ca gamyate // [AgMsv_2.61]
mv-k08-v1131.quick_english: This is the unmanifest sign, whose nature is man, power, and Śiva, in which this whole universe is dissolved and which is understood as present within.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; tat-nara-śakti-śiva-ātmakam = whose nature is man, power, and Śiva

mv-k08-v1132.label: AgMsv_2.62
cite_parts:
kiṃ cādhvajātam etad dehasthatayaiva pūrvanirṇītam /
tasyonmeṣavaśena sphuṭatāṃ yāyāt samāveśaḥ // [AgMsv_2.62]
mv-k08-v1132.quick_english: Moreover, this whole aggregate of paths has already been determined as present in the body; by the force of its unfolding, absorption may become clear.

tokens.grounds: ca + adhva-jātam; the entire collection of paths
deha-stha-tayā + eva; by being located in the body
past passive participle; pūrva-nirṇītam = determined earlier
tasya + unmeṣa-vaśena; by the power of its opening

mv-k08-v1133.label: AgMsv_2.63
cite_parts:
cittattvasya viśeṣaspandadaśāśālinaś cidānandaḥ /
śāktasamullāsabharād antaḥkṛtamantravīryaparasāraḥ // [AgMsv_2.63]
mv-k08-v1133.quick_english: When the mind-principle abides in a state of special vibration, consciousness-bliss arises from the fullness of Śakti's radiance, bearing within it the supreme essence of mantra-power.

tokens.grounds: genitive; cit-tattvasya = of the principle of mind/consciousness
genitive; viśeṣa-spanda-daśā-śālinaḥ = possessing the state of special vibration
ablative; śākta-samullāsa-bharāt = from the abundance of Śakti's radiance
bahuvrīhi; antaḥkṛta-mantra-vīrya-para-sāraḥ = having the supreme essence of mantra-power internalized

mv-k08-v1134.label: AgMsv_2.64
cite_parts:
naraśaktimayam idaṃ tadvyaktāvyaktaṃ bhavel liṅgaṃ /
siddhiphalaprasavarasaprasūnam iti kathyate śāstre // [AgMsv_2.64]
mv-k08-v1134.quick_english: This sign, consisting of man and power and being both manifest and unmanifest, is said in scripture to blossom with the sap of the fruit of accomplishment.

tokens.grounds: compound adjective; nara-śakti-mayam = made of man and power
compound; tat-vyakta-avyaktam = that which is manifest and unmanifest
optative of bhū; sandhi form as given
bahuvrīhi; siddhi-phala-prasava-rasa-prasūnam = blossoming with the sap of the fruit of accomplishment

mv-k08-v1135.label: AgMsv_2.65
cite_parts:
vyaktaliṅgaṃ tad uktaṃ tu yat kevalanarātmakam /
ekasya spandanasyeyaṃ tridhā bhedavyavasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.65]
mv-k08-v1135.quick_english: But the manifest sign is said to be that which consists only of man; this threefold division is an arrangement of one single vibration.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; kevala-nara-ātmakam = whose nature is only man
spandanasya + iyam; this of a single vibration

mv-k08-v1136.label: AgMsv_2.66
cite_parts:
etalliṅgajñānapraviyuktahṛdā vṛthaiva hi bhajante /
bāhyasthaliṅgapūjāṃ prayāsamātraṃ phalāya na hi tat syāt // [AgMsv_2.66]
mv-k08-v1136.quick_english: Those whose hearts lack knowledge of this sign worship an external liṅga in vain; that is mere effort and cannot bring the true fruit.

tokens.grounds: instrumental; etat-liṅga-jñāna-praviyukta-hṛdā = by a heart deprived of knowledge of this sign
accusative; bāhya-stha-liṅga-pūjām = worship of an external standing liṅga

mv-k08-v1137.label: AgMsv_2.67
cite_parts:
yad vyaktam ātmaliṅgākhyaṃ nararūpasamāśrayi /
dehābhedamaye bāhye viśvasmin bharite sati // [AgMsv_2.67]
mv-k08-v1137.quick_english: The manifest sign called the self-sign, resting on the human form, arises when the whole external universe is filled with non-difference from the body.

tokens.grounds: compound; ātma-liṅga-ākhyam = named the sign of the self
compound adjective; nara-rūpa-samāśrayi = taking support in the human form
locative; deha-abheda-maye = made of non-difference from the body

mv-k08-v1138.label: AgMsv_2.68
cite_parts:
samudeti mahānandabhūmau līnasya yoginaḥ /
tenādyaṃ liṅgam abhyeti saṃmukhīnatvam añjasā // [AgMsv_2.68]
mv-k08-v1138.quick_english: For the yogi absorbed on the level of great bliss, the primal sign therefore comes directly face-to-face.

tokens.grounds: locative; mahā-ānanda-bhūmau = on the level of great bliss
tena + ādyam; by that, the first
accusative abstract noun; state of being face-to-face

mv-k08-v1139.label: AgMsv_2.69
cite_parts:
atra liṅge sadā tiṣṭhet pūjāviśrāntitatparaḥ /
yadyoginīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ paramānandamandiram // [AgMsv_2.69]
mv-k08-v1139.quick_english: One should always abide in this sign, intent on resting in worship, for it is the heart of the yoginīs, the temple of supreme bliss.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; pūjā-viśrānti-tatparaḥ = devoted to repose in worship
yat + yoginīnām; which is of the yoginīs
compound; parama-ānanda-mandiram = abode of supreme bliss

mv-k08-v1140.label: AgMsv_2.70
cite_parts:
pūrvoktabījayonyaṃśavisargānandamandirāḥ /
yatra kāmapi tādātmyasampattiṃ cinvate budhāḥ // [AgMsv_2.70]
mv-k08-v1140.quick_english: There, in the abodes of bliss of the previously taught seed, womb, parts, and emission, the wise gather an indescribable attainment of identity.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; pūrva-ukta-bīja-yoni-aṃśa-visarga-ānanda-mandirāḥ = temples of the bliss of emission, parts of the previously taught seed and womb
present middle of ci; they collect/experience

mv-k08-v1141.label: AgMsv_2.71
cite_parts:
yatra prayāsavirahāt sarvo 'sau devatāgaṇaḥ /
ānandapūrṇe dhāmny āste nityoditacidātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_2.71]
mv-k08-v1141.quick_english: There, without effort, the whole host of deities abides in the bliss-filled abode, their nature being eternally arisen consciousness.

tokens.grounds: ablative; prayāsa-virahāt = due to lack of exertion
locative adjective; ānanda-pūrṇe = filled with bliss
locative of dhāman; sandhi form as given
bahuvrīhi; nitya-udita-cit-ātmakaḥ = having the nature of eternally arisen consciousness

mv-k08-v1142.label: AgMsv_2.71
cite_parts:
yattadbhairavanāthasya saṃkocetarabhāsanam /
avidyamānasaṃkocavikāsasyāpi bhāsate // [AgMsv_2.71]
mv-k08-v1142.quick_english: That shining of Lord Bhairava as contraction and expansion appears even though, in truth, contraction and expansion are not present in him.

tokens.grounds: yat-tat + bhairava-nāthasya; of that very Lord Bhairava
compound; saṃkoca-itara-bhāsanam = appearing as contraction and its opposite
avidyamāna-saṃkoca-vikāsasya + api; even though contraction and expansion are not really present

mv-k08-v1143.label: AgMsv_2.72
cite_parts:
yattatsamāptisaṃghaṭṭasamutthānandadhārayā /
avasiktam idaṃ viśvam apojjhati purāṇatām // [AgMsv_2.72]
mv-k08-v1143.quick_english: Sprinkled by that stream of bliss arising from the impact of consummation, this universe casts off its oldness.

tokens.grounds: yat-tat + samāpti-saṃghaṭṭa-samuttha-ānanda-dhārayā; by that flow of bliss arising from the impact of completion
accusative; state of being worn out

mv-k08-v1144.label: AgMsv_2.73
cite_parts:
tatra praveśane yatnaḥ kāryatvena prayāsakṛt /
yataḥ sadodito bhānuḥ kiṃ dīpena vicāryate // [AgMsv_2.73]
mv-k08-v1144.quick_english: There, effortful striving as a task is misplaced, because what is ever risen like the sun does not need to be sought with a lamp.

tokens.grounds: instrumental; in the capacity of a task

mv-k08-v1145.label: AgMsv_2.74
cite_parts:
yadi svātmasthito yogī śivacitspandabhūmigaḥ /
yadi vā bāhyabhāvaughaviśeṣayoginīkulanandanaḥ // [AgMsv_2.74]
mv-k08-v1145.quick_english: Whether the yogi is established in his own self on the level of Śiva's conscious vibration, or delights the circle of yoginīs through special streams of external beings,

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi; sva-ātma-sthitaḥ = abiding in one's own self
compound; śiva-cit-spanda-bhūmi-gaḥ = grounded in the level of Śiva's conscious vibration
bahuvrīhi; bāhya-bhāva-ogha-viśeṣa-yoginī-kula-nandanaḥ = delighting the yoginī circle by special flows of external beings

mv-k08-v1146.label: AgMsv_2.77
cite_parts:
ghaṭābhāve 'pi sāmānyaspandābhāsamayīṃ sthitim /
parabhairavamudrāṃ tām antarlakṣabahirdṛśam // [AgMsv_2.77]
mv-k08-v1146.quick_english: Even in the absence of an object like a pot, that state consisting of the appearance of universal vibration is the supreme Bhairava seal, with inward focus and outward gaze.

tokens.grounds: locative; ghaṭa-abhāve = when a pot is absent
compound adjective; sāmānya-spanda-ābhāsa-mayīm = made of the appearance of universal vibration
appositive compound; para-bhairava-mudrām = the supreme Bhairava seal
bahuvrīhi; antar-lakṣa-bahir-dṛśam = having inward aim and outward vision

mv-k08-v1147.label: AgMsv_2.78
cite_parts:
yad āśrayati śaivī sā parā devī tataḥ punaḥ /
svātantryahelānirmeye tattadarthakriyāmaye // [AgMsv_2.78]
mv-k08-v1147.quick_english: Then that supreme Śaiva goddess resorts again to the stream of phenomena, which is fashioned by the play of her freedom and consists of manifold efficacies.

mv-k08-v1148.label: AgMsv_2.79
cite_parts:
bhāvaughe sotsukaunmukhyavimarśarasayogataḥ /
viśeṣaspandasadbhūmiṃ śaktiṃ saṃspṛśya vartate // [AgMsv_2.79]
mv-k08-v1148.quick_english: In that stream of phenomena, joined to the savor of eager, awakening awareness, she touches Śakti—the true ground of particular vibration—and abides there.

tokens.grounds: locative domain qualified by adjectives from v1147
main verb, subject is the goddess from v1147

mv-k08-v1149.label: AgMsv_2.80
cite_parts:
etenādhiṣṭhitā dhāmnā svamantrāstatprakāśane /
yānti svātantrayogitvaṃ vicitrāsvapi siddhiṣu // [AgMsv_2.80]
mv-k08-v1149.quick_english: Presided over by this power, one's own mantras, in its manifestation, attain autonomy even in the midst of various accomplishments.

tokens.grounds: instrumental, refers to Śakti/power in v1148
sandhi fusion marked by editor: svamantrāḥ + tat-prakāśane; kept as one token
sandhi: vicitrāsu + api; locative plural adjective with particle

mv-k08-v1150.label: AgMsv_2.81
cite_parts:
hānādānatiraskāravṛttau rūḍhim upāgataḥ /
sarvabhāsanayogena bhāsamānaṃ cidātmanā // [AgMsv_2.81]
mv-k08-v1150.quick_english: Having become firmly established in a mode beyond rejection and acceptance, he sees everything shining forth, through its connection with all manifestation, as consciousness itself.

mv-k08-v1151.label: AgMsv_2.82
cite_parts:
abhedavṛttitaḥ paśyan dṛśyaṃ citicamatkṛteḥ /
arthakriyārthitādainyakāritāṃ kātarāṃ sthitm // [AgMsv_2.82]
mv-k08-v1151.quick_english: Seeing the visible from a stance of non-difference, through the wonder of consciousness, he abandons the timid state that comes from the wretched craving for practical results.

tokens.grounds: object of vihāya (v1152); final consonant cluster as given

mv-k08-v1152.label: AgMsv_2.83
cite_parts:
vihāya yāvad āsīta tāvac chāṃbhavabhūmikām /
bhairavīm āviśaty eva parāṃ bhūmim ayatnataḥ // [AgMsv_2.83]
mv-k08-v1152.quick_english: Having abandoned that state, as long as he remains so, he effortlessly enters the Bhairava-like Śāmbhava level, the supreme state.

tokens.grounds: compound object of āviśati: śāmbhava-bhūmikā (initial ch- as given)
present participle/verb form in sandhi context (āviśati)

mv-k08-v1153.label: AgMsv_2.84
cite_parts:
etadāviṣṭasaṃvitti sarvam eva nirīkṣyate /
prakāśarūpatākrāntaṃ caitanyaṃ hi prakāśate // [AgMsv_2.84]
mv-k08-v1153.quick_english: For one whose awareness is entered by this state, everything is seen as pervaded by the nature of light, for it is consciousness that shines.

mv-k08-v1154.label: AgMsv_2.85
cite_parts:
na cāprakāśaṃ prākāśyayogād eti prakāśatām /
iti vistarataḥ pūrvaṃ prakāśitam idaṃ yataḥ // [AgMsv_2.85]
mv-k08-v1154.quick_english: And what is unmanifest does not attain manifestation merely by being connected with something to be manifested; this has already been explained at length.

mv-k08-v1155.label: AgMsv_2.86
cite_parts:
mahāsāhasasaṃyogavilīnākhilavṛttikaḥ /
puñjībhūtasvaraśmyoghanirbharībhūtamānasaḥ // [AgMsv_2.86]
mv-k08-v1155.quick_english: All his activities dissolved through union with great audacity, his mind becomes wholly filled by a concentrated mass of his own rays.

mv-k08-v1156.label: AgMsv_2.87
cite_parts:
akiṃciccintakaḥ spaṣṭadṛṣṭabhedojjhitasthitiḥ /
yāvad āsīta tāvat tu pūrvoktā eva bhūmayaḥ // [AgMsv_2.87]
mv-k08-v1156.quick_english: Thinking of nothing and having abandoned the state of clearly seen difference, as long as he remains so, the previously described levels come forward.

mv-k08-v1157.label: AgMsv_2.88
cite_parts:
sāṃmukhyaṃ yānti saṃsārasadmadāhaikahetavaḥ /
yaś ca divyo 'kṣasaṃghāto bhedarūḍhitirohitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.88]
mv-k08-v1157.quick_english: Those levels come into presence as the sole causes for burning away the intoxication of worldly existence, and so does the divine aggregate of senses that had been overgrown by the firm sense of difference.

tokens.grounds: compound: akṣa-saṃghāta; initial apostrophe marks elision

mv-k08-v1158.label: AgMsv_2.89
cite_parts:
svātantryapoṣakakrīḍāmātropakaraṇātmakaḥ /
yadā nimīlanāvandhyas tiṣṭhaty ekaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tadā // [AgMsv_2.89]
mv-k08-v1158.quick_english: When that aggregate, whose nature is play that nourishes freedom, remains fruitfully turned inward for even a single moment, then—

mv-k08-v1159.label: AgMsv_2.90
cite_parts:
taddvāroditasaṃbodhamahājvālāvilāpitam /
viśvam abhyeti paramānandasāgaraśāyitām // [AgMsv_2.90]
mv-k08-v1159.quick_english: Then the universe, melted by the great flame of awareness that has arisen through that door, attains the state of resting in the ocean of supreme bliss.

mv-k08-v1160.label: AgMsv_2.91
cite_parts:
tadrasāpānaviśrāntaḥ saṃviddevīḥ pratarpayan /
acirād eti maraṇajanmatrāsavihīnatām // [AgMsv_2.91]
mv-k08-v1160.quick_english: Resting in the drinking of that savor and satisfying the goddesses of awareness, he soon attains freedom from the fear of death and birth.

mv-k08-v1161.label: AgMsv_2.92
cite_parts:
āśyānabhāvaṃ hi gatā svasaṃviddehendriyajñeyamayatvam āptā /
yuktyā tu sā prāptavilīnabhāvāt saṃvidghanaṃ svaṃ vapur eva yāti // [AgMsv_2.92]
mv-k08-v1161.quick_english: For awareness, having congealed and taken on the form of its own awareness, body, senses, and objects, returns by the proper method—once that state has dissolved—to its own dense body of consciousness.

mv-k08-v1162.label: AgMsv_2.93
cite_parts:
yuktyā yayaiva bāhyārthavivaśīkṛtacetasām /
vyutthitir jāyate saiva bhairavānandasaṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_2.93]
mv-k08-v1162.quick_english: By the very same method through which those whose minds are overpowered by external objects emerge outward, there arises the awareness of Bhairava's bliss.

mv-k08-v1163.label: AgMsv_2.94
cite_parts:
tayaiva yoginīvaktrasaṃpradāyakramāptayā /
vidhūtakalmaṣāveśā tiṣṭhate cinmayī sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.94]
mv-k08-v1163.quick_english: By that very method, received through the lineage of the yoginī's mouth, the entry of impurity is shaken off and the state made of consciousness stands firm.

mv-k08-v1164.label: AgMsv_2.95
cite_parts:
vaktram īṣad yadā yogī vikāsayati saṃvidaḥ /
sarvā indriyanāḍyantaścakrākramaṇasaṃśrayāḥ // [AgMsv_2.95]
mv-k08-v1164.quick_english: When the yogin slightly opens the mouth of awareness, all the inner circles of the senses and channels, resting on that traversal, are activated.

mv-k08-v1165.label: AgMsv_2.96
cite_parts:
tadā vikāsaṃ grāhyārthabhedābhāvamayaṃ haṭhāt /
prayānti cidunmukhatvāt nīlapītādibhedavān // [AgMsv_2.96]
mv-k08-v1165.quick_english: Then, because of turning toward consciousness, they suddenly move into an expansion consisting in the absence of difference among grasped objects, even though differences like blue and yellow had appeared.

mv-k08-v1166.label: AgMsv_2.97
cite_parts:
grāhyagrāhakasaṃbandhabhedaḥ sapadi bhidyate /
yoginīvaktrasaṃrūḍhasaṃpradāyakramāptayā // [AgMsv_2.97]
mv-k08-v1166.quick_english: The difference in the relation between grasper and grasped is split at once through attainment of the lineage rooted in the yoginī's mouth.

mv-k08-v1167.label: AgMsv_2.98
cite_parts:
sadyo 'nubhavadāyinyā mudrayā mudritākhilaḥ /
sarvādhiṣṭhātṛcidrūpasākṣādbhairavatandritaḥ // [AgMsv_2.98]
mv-k08-v1167.quick_english: Immediately, by the experience-giving seal, he is wholly sealed and absorbed in direct Bhairava, the consciousness-form that presides over all.

mv-k08-v1168.label: AgMsv_2.99
cite_parts:
sa yogī vismayāviṣṭo labhate svātmasaṃvidam /
tattaddṛśyodayāpāyayoge 'py anapayatsthiti // [AgMsv_2.99]
mv-k08-v1168.quick_english: That yogin, filled with wonder, obtains awareness of his own self and remains in a state that does not depart even amid the arising and passing of various objects.

mv-k08-v1169.label: AgMsv_2.100
cite_parts:
taḍāgavartinimnāmbu tannānyatra pravartate /
prayatnenāpi tanmātrapūraṇāya yad akṣamam // [AgMsv_2.100]
mv-k08-v1169.quick_english: Water lying low in a tank does not flow elsewhere, even with effort, because it is incapable of doing more than filling that place alone.

tokens.grounds: adjective explaining why it does not flow elsewhere

mv-k08-v1170.label: AgMsv_2.101
cite_parts:
yadā tvantaḥdvāravāridhārasaṃpūritaṃ rasāt /
bhaved bhaveyustatpūrṇāḥ pravāhāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ // [AgMsv_2.101]
mv-k08-v1170.quick_english: But when it is filled with savor by a stream of water flowing through the inner door, then streams filled by that overflow in all directions.

mv-k08-v1171.label: AgMsv_2.102
cite_parts:
evaṃ svollāsarabhasāc caitanyaṃ pronmiṣatsvayaṃ /
avibhāgena bhāvāṃśān svātmābhedena bhāsayan // [AgMsv_2.102]
mv-k08-v1171.quick_english: Thus, by the force of its own surge, consciousness opens forth by itself and, without division, makes the portions of beings shine as non-different from its own self.

mv-k08-v1172.label: AgMsv_2.103
cite_parts:
mīlanāviṣayībhāvaṃ śrayed yadi muhūrtakaṃ /
māyāvigalanād bhūmir bhairavīyā virājate // [AgMsv_2.103]
mv-k08-v1172.quick_english: If, even for a moment, it does not sink into closure, then through the dissolving of māyā the level of Bhairava shines forth.

mv-k08-v1173.label: AgMsv_2.104
cite_parts:
vaikalpiko 'hyavacchedaḥ paścād yāṃ darśayed bhidām /
saiva māyā svatantrasya bhedadṛṣṭiprakāśinī // [AgMsv_2.104]
mv-k08-v1173.quick_english: For the limitation born of conceptualization may afterward show division; that very division is māyā, the power of the free one that reveals the vision of difference.

tokens.grounds: optative of dṛś in causative sense

mv-k08-v1174.label: AgMsv_2.105
cite_parts:
unmeṣamātrarūḍhasya sā nirmūlā na saṃbhavet /
itthaṃ kiṃ bahunoktena naye 'nuttarātmani // [AgMsv_2.105]
mv-k08-v1174.quick_english: For one who rests only in the opening of consciousness, that māyā is rootless and cannot arise; so what is the use of saying more in this method of the unsurpassed self?

mv-k08-v1175.label: AgMsv_2.106
cite_parts:
vastuto 'sti na kasyāpi yogāṅgasyābhyupāyatā /
svarūpaṃ hyasya nīrūpam avacchedavivarjanāt // [AgMsv_2.106]
mv-k08-v1175.quick_english: In reality, no limb of yoga can serve as a means, for its own nature is formless, being free from all limitation.

tokens.grounds: asti with initial a elided in text

mv-k08-v1176.label: AgMsv_2.107
cite_parts:
upāya 'pyanupāyo 'syāyāgavṛttinirodhataḥ /
recanapūraṇair eṣā rahitā tanuvātanauḥ // [AgMsv_2.107]
mv-k08-v1176.quick_english: Even the means is not a means, because it stops effortful activity; it is free from exhalation and inhalation and from the regulation of body and breath.

tokens.grounds: refers to the state or practice

mv-k08-v1177.label: AgMsv_2.108
cite_parts:
tārayaty evam ātmānaṃ bhedasāgaragocarāt /
nimajjamānam apy etan mano vaiṣayike rase // [AgMsv_2.108]
mv-k08-v1177.quick_english: Thus this mind carries the self across from the ocean of difference, even when it is sinking while still in the taste of objects.

tokens.grounds: present of tṛ in causative sense

mv-k08-v1178.label: AgMsv_2.109
cite_parts:
nāntarārdratvam abhyeti niśchidraṃ tumbakaṃ yathā /
svaṃ panthānaṃ hayasyeva manaso ye nirundhate // [AgMsv_2.109]
mv-k08-v1178.quick_english: A gourd without holes does not become soft inside; likewise, those who forcibly restrain the mind's own path, as if holding back a horse, do not make it inwardly receptive.

mv-k08-v1179.label: AgMsv_2.110
cite_parts:
teṣāṃ tatkhaṇḍanayogād dhavaty unmārgakoṭibhiḥ /
kiṃsvid etad iti prāyo duḥkhe 'py utkaṇṭhate manaḥ // [AgMsv_2.110]
mv-k08-v1179.quick_english: For those who try to break the mind, it runs off along countless wrong paths; wondering, 'What is this?', the mind mostly keeps longing restlessly, even in pain.

mv-k08-v1180.label: AgMsv_2.111
cite_parts:
sukhād api virajyeta jñānād etad idaṃ [tv iti] /
tathāhi gurur ādikṣad bahudhā svakaśāsane // [AgMsv_2.111]
mv-k08-v1180.quick_english: Through knowledge one can become dispassionate even toward pleasure, discerning 'this is this'; for the teacher has taught this in many ways in his own scripture.

mv-k08-v1181.label: AgMsv_2.112
cite_parts:
anādaraviraktyaiva galantīndriyavṛttayaḥ /
yāvat tu viniyamyante tāvat tāvad vikurvate // [AgMsv_2.112]
mv-k08-v1181.quick_english: The activities of the senses fall away through indifference and dispassion alone; but as long as they are forcibly controlled, they keep acting turbulently.

mv-k08-v1182.label: AgMsv_2.113
cite_parts:
pratyāhāro 'pi nāmāyaṃ yo 'kṣajāle pravartyate /
bandhasyārūḍhavṛttes tad vajralepena bandhanam // [AgMsv_2.113]
mv-k08-v1182.quick_english: Even that so-called withdrawal which is applied to the net of the senses becomes, for one whose bondage is already firmly set, a binding as hard as diamond cement.

tokens.grounds: akṣa+jāla compound with initial a elided

mv-k08-v1183.label: AgMsv_2.114
cite_parts:
artheṣu tadbhogavidhau tadutthe \ \ duḥkhe sukhe vā galitābhiśaṅkam /
anāviśanto 'pi nimagnacittā \ \ jānanti vṛttikṣayasaukhyam antaḥ // [AgMsv_2.114]
mv-k08-v1183.quick_english: Amid objects, their enjoyment, and the pleasure or pain that arises from them, those whose fear has dissolved, though their minds are immersed, do not truly enter into them and know within the ease of the quieting of mental activity.

tokens.grounds: present participle of ā+viś with negation

mv-k08-v1184.label: AgMsv_2.115
cite_parts:
saty evātmani citsvabhāvamahasi svānte tathopakriyāṃ tasmai kurvati tatpracāracature saty akṣavarge 'pi ca /
satsv artheṣu rasādiṣu sphuṭataraṃ yad bhedavandhyodayaṃ yogī tiṣṭhati pūrṇaraśmikhacitas tat tattvam ādīyatām // [AgMsv_2.115]
mv-k08-v1184.quick_english: When the self, the great light of consciousness, is present in the heart, and the senses and objects such as taste are also present and active, the yogi abides very clearly in a fullness whose arising is free of difference; let that reality be accepted.

tokens.grounds: locative plural participle form as given

mv-k08-v1185.label: AgMsv_2.116
cite_parts:
aviveka eva param iha saṃsāra iti pravādamātram /
aviveka eva hi paraṃ niḥśreyasalābhasopānam // [AgMsv_2.116]
mv-k08-v1185.quick_english: To say that non-discrimination is supreme bondage is only a common saying; for non-discrimination itself can be the supreme stairway to attaining liberation.

mv-k08-v1186.label: AgMsv_2.117
cite_parts:
tyajāvadhānāni nanu kva nāma dhatse 'vadhānaṃ vicinu svayaṃ tat /
pūrṇe 'vadhānaṃ nahi nāma yuktaṃ nāpūrṇam abhyeti ca satyabhāvam // [AgMsv_2.117]
mv-k08-v1186.quick_english: Abandon deliberate concentrations; where, indeed, would you place concentration? Examine it yourself: in the full it is not fitting, and in the not-full it does not attain true being.

tokens.grounds: tyaja+avadhānāni fused in text, command plus object

mv-k08-v1187.label: AgMsv_2.118
cite_parts:
yatraivānandayogaḥ kvacana nanu bhavet tatra pūrṇaḥ svabhāvaḥ --- --- te veti tatra praśamapadam iyād yady ayaṃ bhedamohaḥ /
tajjñāne jāgradādāv api nikhilapade cinmahācakranātho yogī jāyeta nānāvyavahṛtapathago 'pyullasan mantravīryaḥ // [AgMsv_2.118]
mv-k08-v1187.quick_english: Wherever union with bliss arises, there one's own nature is full; if the delusion of difference is understood, one may reach peace there. Even in waking and in every state, the yogi can become the lord of the great wheel of consciousness, moving through varied activities while shining with mantra power.

tokens.grounds: editorial lacuna marker in token list
editorial lacuna marker in token list

mv-k08-v1188.label: AgMsv_2.119
cite_parts:
yathā hi kūpaṃ pracikīrṣur eva prāpte jale yāti kṛtitvam ekaḥ /
kaścit punar hastagatādi[vāri]mātrād itthaṃ paraprāptividhir vicitraḥ // [AgMsv_2.119]
mv-k08-v1188.quick_english: Just as one who sets out to dig a well feels accomplished only when water is reached, while another is satisfied with water already in hand, so the way of attaining the supreme is varied.

mv-k08-v1189.label: AgMsv_2.120
cite_parts:
anupāyam idaṃ tasmād upāyopeyayogataḥ /
bhedabandhād vimucyeta kathaṃ vetarathā janaḥ // [AgMsv_2.120]
mv-k08-v1189.quick_english: This is without means; so how, by the usual relation of means and goal, or in any other way, could a person be freed from the bondage of difference?

mv-k08-v1190.label: AgMsv_2.121
cite_parts:
anupāye 'pi caitasmin kiṃcit sāṃbandhyavṛttitaḥ /
upāyasyopadeśo 'yaṃ śāstre 'tra bahudhā kṛtaḥ // [AgMsv_2.121]
mv-k08-v1190.quick_english: Even though this reality is without means, this scripture teaches means in many ways, functioning through relational instruction.

mv-k08-v1191.label: AgMsv_2.122
cite_parts:
yathā lipyakṣarair bālāḥ satye varṇātmani sphuṭam /
praveśyante tathā mūḍhais tair aupāyikaiḥ kramāt // [AgMsv_2.122]
mv-k08-v1191.quick_english: Just as children are clearly led into the real nature of sound through written letters, so the deluded are gradually led by those provisional means.

mv-k08-v1192.label: AgMsv_2.123
cite_parts:
tadartham eva cādvaite paratattve 'pi sādaram /
pūjādhyānādi śāstre 'sminn ucitaṃ kiṃcid ucyate // [AgMsv_2.123]
mv-k08-v1192.quick_english: For that very purpose, even in the nondual supreme reality, this scripture respectfully teaches something appropriate, such as worship and meditation.

mv-k08-v1193.label: AgMsv_2.124
cite_parts:
yat kiṃcin manasāhlādi yatra kvāpīndriyasthitau /
yojyate bodhasadbrahmadhāmni brahmabilātmani // [AgMsv_2.124]
mv-k08-v1193.quick_english: Whatever delights the mind, in any state of the senses, can be joined to the abode of true awareness, to the very opening of Brahman.

mv-k08-v1194.label: AgMsv_2.125
cite_parts:
ātmānusārisadbhāvasamāveśadaśāśrayāt

tattatparakuleśānaśakticakrārcanākrame /
prayāty evāprayatnena karaṇatvaṃ svabhāvataḥ // [AgMsv_2.125]
mv-k08-v1194.quick_english: Resting on absorption in true being that follows the self, one naturally and without effort comes to function as an instrument in the worship of the wheel of the supreme Kula lord and his powers.

mv-k08-v1195.label: AgMsv_2.126
cite_parts:
kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitām āttair mānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasaṃdohibhiḥ /
ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye 'harniśam // [AgMsv_2.126]
mv-k08-v1195.quick_english: Having made the support-ground cleansed by a moment of sprinkling with the essence of wonder, I worship you, O God, together with the Goddess day and night in the temple of the body, using flowers of my own nature taken from the mind and filled with their own fragrance, through the method of the priceless offering-vessel of my own heart overflowing with the nectar of bliss.

tokens.grounds: absolutive of kṛ + compound ādhāra-dharā (f.acc.sg); fused sandhi form kept as one token
past participle of ā-dā, qualifying kusumaiḥ
instrumental plural adjective qualifying kusumaiḥ; svāmoda-saṃdohin
ablative singular long compound expressing means/sequence
second person pronoun, object of worship
first person singular present, object tvāṃ
indeclinable adverb; initial avagraha marks elision

mv-k08-v1196.label: AgMsv_2.127
cite_parts:
evaṃ yatra kvacit tiṣṭhet svavimarśasvabhāvataḥ /
tatra śaktitrayāveśas tridhā tāvat prakāśate // [AgMsv_2.127]
mv-k08-v1196.quick_english: Thus, wherever one may stand, by the very nature of one's own reflective awareness, there the entry of the three powers shines forth in a threefold way.

tokens.grounds: indeclinable referring to the preceding manner
third person singular optative of sthā
third person singular present middle of pra-kāś

mv-k08-v1197.label: AgMsv_2.128
cite_parts:
navadhā bhāsamānasya proktadvādaśacakrataḥ /
viśrāntir ekakṣaṇagā sāṣṭottaraśatasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.128]
mv-k08-v1197.quick_english: When that shining appears ninefold, arising from the stated twelve wheels, its repose occurs in a single moment and takes the form of a state numbering one hundred and eight.

tokens.grounds: nominative singular adjective/compound qualifying viśrāntiḥ; eka-kṣaṇa-ga
nominative singular bahuvrīhi describing viśrāntiḥ; sa-aṣṭa-uttara-śata-sthiti

mv-k08-v1198.label: AgMsv_2.129
cite_parts:
ekaiva śatasaṃkhyā ca sā sthitiḥ pravibhāvyate /
itthaṃ yat kiṃcanaitasya vacanaṃ yogino bhavet // [AgMsv_2.129]
mv-k08-v1198.quick_english: That state is clearly discerned as one alone, numbering a hundred; and in this way, whatever speech at all may arise from this yogin belongs to that same state.

tokens.grounds: eka + eva with sandhi; nominative singular feminine
third person singular present passive of pra-vi-bhū/bhāvaya
fused form: kiṃcana + etasya; indefinite + demonstrative genitive
third person singular optative of bhū

mv-k08-v1199.label: AgMsv_2.130
cite_parts:
tad eva japayogāya jāyate 'nuttare pathi /
antarindhanasadbhāvam anapekṣyaiva nityaśaḥ // [AgMsv_2.130]
mv-k08-v1199.quick_english: That very speech becomes mantra practice on the unsurpassed path, constantly and without any need to rely on the presence of inner fuel.

tokens.grounds: third person singular present middle of jan
locative singular; initial avagraha marks elision of a- in anuttara
absolutive of an-apekṣ + eva with sandhi

mv-k08-v1200.label: AgMsv_2.131
cite_parts:
yo jvalaty akhilākṣaughaprasṛtāgraśikhāśataḥ /
tatraiva sarvabhāvānāṃ praveśaś ced vimṛśyate // [AgMsv_2.131]
mv-k08-v1200.quick_english: If one reflectively understands that all beings enter into that which blazes with hundreds of foremost flames spreading forth from all the streams of the senses, then that very place is where their entry occurs.

tokens.grounds: third person singular present active of jval
nominative singular bahuvrīhi-like compound describing the blazing subject; akhila-akṣa-ogha-prasṛta-agra-śikhā-śata
nominative singular; final visarga written as ś before ced in sandhi context
third person singular present passive of vi-mṛś

mv-k09-v1201.label: AgMsv_2.132
cite_parts:
nūnaṃ jhaṭiti saṃpluṣṭasthūlarūpatayā haṭhāt /
yānti bodhamahājvālāprakāśaikyaṃ svarūpataḥ /
sa eṣa paramo homo bhairavīyakrame mataḥ // [AgMsv_2.132]
mv-k09-v1201.quick_english: Surely, when their gross form is suddenly burned away, things forcibly attain unity with the great blazing light of awareness by their very nature; this is regarded as the supreme offering in the Bhairava tradition.

tokens.grounds: instrumental of manner; compound describing dissolution of gross form
accusative goal; compound expressing identity with blazing awareness

mv-k09-v1202.label: AgMsv_2.133
cite_parts:
nijabodhajaṭharahutabhuji bhāvāḥ samyagsamarpitā yuktyā /
jahati bhedavibhāgaṃ nijaśaktyā taṃ samindhate yasmāt // [AgMsv_2.133]
mv-k09-v1202.quick_english: When entities are properly offered by method into the fire within one's own awareness, they abandon the division of difference and, by their own power, kindle that very fire.

tokens.grounds: locative compound; awareness as sacrificial fire
object, refers to the fire of awareness

mv-k09-v1203.label: AgMsv_2.134
cite_parts:
yad eva svecchayā sṛṣṭisvābhāvyavaśataḥ puraḥ /
nirmimīte 'kṣaviṣayaṃ taddhyānāyāvakalpate // [AgMsv_2.134]
mv-k09-v1203.quick_english: Whatever sense-object consciousness creates before itself by its own will and by the force of its creative nature becomes fit for meditation on that very object.

tokens.grounds: object created; elided initial vowel in sandhi
predicate verb; compound with infinitive-like dative sense

mv-k09-v1204.label: AgMsv_2.135
cite_parts:
nirākāre hi ciddhāmni viśvākṛtimaye sati /
phalārthināṃ kācid eva dhyeyatvenākṛtiḥ sthitā // [AgMsv_2.135]
mv-k09-v1204.quick_english: For although the abode of consciousness is formless and yet made of all forms, for those who seek results some particular form is established as the object of meditation.

tokens.grounds: fused compound with instrumental sense of 'as'; subject of clause

mv-k09-v1205.label: AgMsv_2.136
cite_parts:
yathā hy abhedasaṃpūrṇe bhāve 'py udakam āharan /
anyākṛtyapahānena ghaṭam arthayate rasāt // [AgMsv_2.136]
mv-k09-v1205.quick_english: Just as, even within a nondual and full reality, someone fetching water eagerly seeks a pot by setting aside other forms, so too a particular form may be chosen.

tokens.grounds: explanatory particle, sandhi form of hi
concessive particle, sandhi form of api

mv-k09-v1206.label: AgMsv_2.137
cite_parts:
tathaiva parameśānaniyatipravijṛmbhaṇāt /
kācid evākṛtiḥ kāṃcit sūte phalavikalpanam // [AgMsv_2.137]
mv-k09-v1206.quick_english: In the same way, through the unfolding of the supreme Lord's self-restriction, some particular form gives rise to some particular conception of a result.

mv-k09-v1207.label: AgMsv_2.138
cite_parts:
yas tu saṃpūrṇacidvṛttir na phalaṃ nāma vāñchati /
tasya viśvākṛti dhyānaṃ sarvadaiva vijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_2.138]
mv-k09-v1207.quick_english: But for one whose activity is the fullness of consciousness and who desires no result at all, meditation in the form of the whole universe unfolds at all times.

tokens.grounds: relative subject, sandhi form of yaḥ

mv-k09-v1208.label: AgMsv_2.139
cite_parts:
kulayogina udriktabhairavīyarasāsavāt /
ghūrṇamānasya yaḥ kaścit ko 'py udeti yathā tathā // [AgMsv_2.139]
mv-k09-v1208.quick_english: For the Kula yogin reeling from the intoxicant of the surging Bhairava essence, whatever arises, in whatever way it arises, simply arises.

tokens.grounds: genitive of subject, sandhi form of kulayoginaḥ
emphatic particle, sandhi form of api

mv-k09-v1209.label: AgMsv_2.140
cite_parts:
śarīragaḥ samāveśo modanadrāvaṇātmakaḥ /
sā svīkṛtajaganmudrā mudrā nairuttare mate // [AgMsv_2.140]
mv-k09-v1209.quick_english: The bodily absorption whose nature is delight and melting is, in the unsurpassed teaching, the seal that has taken the whole world as its seal.

mv-k09-v1210.label: AgMsv_2.141
cite_parts:
eṣa yogavidhiḥ ko 'pi kasyāpi hṛdi vartate /
yasya prasīdec ciccakraṃ drāg apaścimajanmanaḥ // [AgMsv_2.141]
mv-k09-v1210.quick_english: This rare method of yoga abides in the heart of someone whose wheel of consciousness becomes clear, quickly, as in the case of one who is in his final birth.

tokens.grounds: emphatic particle, sandhi form of api

mv-k09-v1211.label: AgMsv_2.142
cite_parts:
lokenālokyamāno 'pi dehabandhavidhau sthitaḥ /
abhyeti yoge rūḍhe na kṣaṇāt kām api saṃvidam // [AgMsv_2.142]
mv-k09-v1211.quick_english: Even while being seen by people and remaining in the condition of bodily bondage, when yoga has matured he attains in an instant an incomparable awareness.

tokens.grounds: present passive participle with instrumental agent
concessive particle, sandhi form of api

mv-k09-v1212.label: AgMsv_2.143
cite_parts:
atraiva tv asmatpūrvācāryāṇāṃ dhiṣaṇā bhṛśam /
abhyamaṃsta bhavābhogavibhramāṇām asaṃnidhim // [AgMsv_2.143]
mv-k09-v1212.quick_english: But right here, the intellect of our earlier teachers strongly affirmed the non-presence of the delusions of worldly experience.

tokens.grounds: contrastive particle, sandhi form of tu

mv-k09-v1213.label: AgMsv_2.144
cite_parts:
vedasāṃkhyabhavedvādanyāyasaugatalaukikaiḥ /
pañcarātrakriyāśāstrasiddhāntādibhir alam // [AgMsv_2.144]
mv-k09-v1213.quick_english: Enough with the Vedic, Samkhya, dualist, logical, Buddhist, and worldly views, and with Pancaratra, ritual scriptures, Siddhanta, and the rest.

tokens.grounds: instrumental plural compound listing rival systems
instrumental plural compound listing other scriptural systems

mv-k09-v1214.label: AgMsv_2.145
cite_parts:
ucitocitavijñānakriyāṃśaparibhāvakaiḥ /
sarvaiḥ svaprakriyārūḍhais tais tair aucityayogataḥ // [AgMsv_2.145]
mv-k09-v1214.quick_english: All those various practitioners, cultivating the fitting portions of knowledge and action and established in their own procedures, act according to what is appropriate for them.

mv-k09-v1215.label: AgMsv_2.146
cite_parts:
yatra bījasamāvāpakhananādikriyākramaḥ /
akāri śāmbhavānekaśākhābhir yo 'tivistṛtaḥ // [AgMsv_2.146]
mv-k09-v1215.quick_english: Where the very extensive sequence of acts such as sowing, implanting, and digging was carried out by the many branches of the Shambhava teaching.

tokens.grounds: subject; compound describing ritual/agricultural metaphorical sequence
predicate adjective; sandhi form of ativistṛtaḥ

mv-k09-v1216.label: AgMsv_2.147
cite_parts:
tasya cidbhairavataroḥ phalam etad anuttaram /
āśramasthitacaryādyair jaṭājālāñjanāntakaiḥ // [AgMsv_2.147]
mv-k09-v1216.quick_english: The unsurpassed fruit of that tree of consciousness-Bhairava is this, beyond practices such as life-stage observances and even ascetic marks like matted hair and ointments.

tokens.grounds: instrumental plural compound describing ascetic marks

mv-k09-v1217.label: AgMsv_2.148
cite_parts:
kṛtair apy akṛtair vāpi yatra no labhyate bhidā /
tatraiva yoge viśrāntiṃ kurvatāṃ bhavaḍambaraḥ // [AgMsv_2.148]
mv-k09-v1217.quick_english: Where no difference is found between what is done and what is not done, for those who rest in that very yoga the pageantry of worldly existence dissolves.

tokens.grounds: concessive particle, sandhi form of api

mv-k09-v1218.label: AgMsv_2.149
cite_parts:
himānīva mahāgrīṣme svayam eva pralīyate /
alaṃ hi carvyamāṇe 'smin sarase saṃvidāsave // [AgMsv_2.149]
mv-k09-v1218.quick_english: Like a mass of snow in the great summer, it melts away by itself; for when this juicy nectar of awareness is savored, that is enough.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative in locative absolute, sandhi form of asmin

mv-k09-v1219.label: AgMsv_2.150
cite_parts:
nissaranti mahollāsāḥ saṃkhyā yeṣu na vidyate /
teṣāṃ ca prakaṭīkārāḥ kṛtāḥ prāg eva vistarāt /
atrābhinavagupte tu tattve ke 'py eva niścitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.150]
mv-k09-v1219.quick_english: Great raptures flow forth, of which there is no number; their manifestations were already set out at length before, but here in Abhinavagupta's treatment only some are definitively stated.

tokens.grounds: locative compound referring to the author/work context
emphatic particle, sandhi form of api

mv-k09-v1220.label: AgMsv_2.151
cite_parts:
ketakīkusumasaurabhe bhṛśaṃ \ \ bhṛṅga eva rasiko na makṣikā /
bhairavīyaparamādvayārcane \ \ ko 'pi rajyati na bhedamohitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.151]
mv-k09-v1220.quick_english: In the rich fragrance of the ketaki flower, the bee alone is the connoisseur, not the fly; likewise, in the worship of the supreme nondual Bhairava, some rare one delights, not one deluded by duality.

tokens.grounds: emphatic particle, sandhi form of api

mv-k09-v1221.label: AgMsv_2.152
cite_parts:
nātra rūḍhasya kāryā syāc chuddhiḥ kācana kutracit /
aśuddhaṃ hi jagaty eva bhairavātmani kiṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_2.152]
mv-k09-v1221.quick_english: For one established here, no purification of any kind would need to be done anywhere; for what in the world, whose very nature is Bhairava, could be impure?

tokens.grounds: optative of as, sandhi form of syāt

mv-k09-v1222.label: AgMsv_2.153
cite_parts:
aśuddhe 'pi ca bhūtaughe kena śuddhiḥ pratāyatām /
anavasthā bhaved itthaṃ vyarthānyonyāśritis tathā // [AgMsv_2.153]
mv-k09-v1222.quick_english: And even if the mass of beings were impure, by what means could purification be effected? In that way there would be infinite regress and likewise a futile mutual dependence.

tokens.grounds: concessive particle, sandhi form of api

mv-k09-v1223.label: AgMsv_2.154
cite_parts:
aśuddhasya tirodhāne śuddhaṃ nāma pralīyate /
pratiyogikṛtaṃ tad dhi na svabhāvena nīlavat // [AgMsv_2.154]
mv-k09-v1223.quick_english: When the impure is concealed, what is called the pure dissolves as well; for that is constituted by its opposite and is not established by its own nature, like blue.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative subject, sandhi form of tat
explanatory particle, sandhi form of hi

mv-k09-v1224.label: AgMsv_2.155
cite_parts:
ata eva na kaścid āgraho \ \ viṣayāṇāṃ grahaṇe 'py apohane /
parabhairavasaṃvidātmanaḥ \ \ svayam evocchalitā hi bhoktṛtā // [AgMsv_2.155]
mv-k09-v1224.quick_english: Therefore there is no insistence at all on either grasping or rejecting sense objects; for one whose nature is the consciousness of supreme Bhairava, enjoyership surges forth by itself.

tokens.grounds: concessive particle, sandhi form of api
genitive of the realized person; compound
past passive participle; sandhi of eva + ucchalitā

mv-k09-v1225.label: AgMsv_2.156
cite_parts:
sarvam atra vihitaṃ yato 'munā \ \ vartmanā sakalam eva yujyate /
mārgam evam apahastya kiṃcana \ \ kāpi naiva nanu yāti yuktatām // [AgMsv_2.156]
mv-k09-v1225.quick_english: Since everything established here fits together by this path, the whole system is coherent. If one rejects this path, surely no other approach attains any coherence at all.

mv-k09-v1226.label: AgMsv_2.157
cite_parts:
tathāhi dīkṣā nāmeyaṃ yā malānāṃ nikartanī /
sa bhedavādināṃ pakṣe kathaṃ nāmopapadyate // [AgMsv_2.157]
mv-k09-v1226.quick_english: For example, initiation is that which cuts away impurities; but how can this possibly be explained in the view of those who assert difference?

mv-k09-v1227.label: AgMsv_2.158
cite_parts:
tathāhi yo malo nāma sa kathaṃ citsvabhāvakam /
ātmānam āvṛṇīte kva vibhor āvaraṇakriyā // [AgMsv_2.158]
mv-k09-v1227.quick_english: For how can the so-called impurity cover a self whose nature is consciousness? And where is there any act of covering for an all-pervading being?

mv-k09-v1228.label: AgMsv_2.159
cite_parts:
na ca prakāśas tamasā jātu saṃvriyate yataḥ /
prakāśodaya evāyaṃ dhvāntadhvaṃsakriyātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_2.159]
mv-k09-v1228.quick_english: Light is never covered by darkness, because the very arising of light is an act that destroys darkness.

mv-k09-v1229.label: AgMsv_2.160
cite_parts:
kiṃ cāvaraṇam uktaṃ hi raśmyāder gatidharmiṇaḥ /
pratīghātātmakaṃ tat kiṃ vibhor agatidharmiṇaḥ // [AgMsv_2.160]
mv-k09-v1229.quick_english: Moreover, covering is said to be an obstruction of something that moves, like rays; so how could that apply to an all-pervading being that has no motion?

mv-k09-v1230.label: AgMsv_2.161
cite_parts:
api vā jñeyatāmātratirodhānaṃ hi saṃvṛteḥ /
paṭādinā ghaṭādeḥ syān na svarūpānyathāsthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.161]
mv-k09-v1230.quick_english: Or else, covering is merely the concealment of knowability, as when a pot is covered by a cloth; it is not an alteration of its own nature.

mv-k09-v1231.label: AgMsv_2.162
cite_parts:
na cātmānaś cidātmatvāj jñeyatvam adhiśerate /
tadāvaraṇam eṣāṃ tu śabdeṣv api na śobhate // [AgMsv_2.162]
mv-k09-v1231.quick_english: But selves, because they are of the nature of consciousness, do not admit knowability; so to speak of their being covered is not fitting even in words.

mv-k09-v1232.label: AgMsv_2.163
cite_parts:
nanv īśvarasya te jñeyā aṇavaḥ katham īdṛśam /
cidātmakaṃ hi na jñeyaṃ cidātmatvatirohiteḥ // [AgMsv_2.163]
mv-k09-v1232.quick_english: But surely, one objects, those atomic selves are knowable to the Lord. How so? For what is of the nature of consciousness is not knowable, since that would conceal its conscious nature.

mv-k09-v1233.label: AgMsv_2.164
cite_parts:
saṃvij jñeyeti śabdo 'yaṃ vandhyā me jananītyadaḥ /
vākyaṃ smarayatīva svaṃ svātmasabrahmacāri yat // [AgMsv_2.164]
mv-k09-v1233.quick_english: The expression 'awareness is knowable' seems to recall its own fellow, the statement 'my mother is barren,' since both are self-contradictory.

mv-k09-v1234.label: AgMsv_2.165
cite_parts:
kiṃceśvarasya sārvajñyaṃ tāvatā pratihanyate /
āvṛtān vetti nāṇūn yan na tv eṣāṃ kācana kṣatiḥ // [AgMsv_2.165]
mv-k09-v1234.quick_english: Moreover, the Lord's omniscience would be impaired to that extent, because he would not know the covered atomic selves; yet there would be no harm to the selves themselves.

mv-k09-v1235.label: AgMsv_2.166
cite_parts:
nanv anāvaraṇe nīle jñātur āvaraṇe sati /
na darśanaṃ tathā bādhā na sarvajño malāvṛtaḥ // [AgMsv_2.166]
mv-k09-v1235.quick_english: But surely, when a blue object is uncovered the knower sees it, and when it is covered there is no seeing; likewise, one might say, an omniscient being covered by impurity would be obstructed.

mv-k09-v1236.label: AgMsv_2.167
cite_parts:
maivaṃ tatra hi dṛgraśmīn gacchataḥ pratihanti tat /
paṭādi na tu vijñātur asty āvaraṇasaṃbhavaḥ // [AgMsv_2.167]
mv-k09-v1236.quick_english: Not so. In that case, a cloth obstructs the outgoing rays of sight, but there is no possibility of covering the knower himself.

mv-k09-v1237.label: AgMsv_2.168
cite_parts:
malaś cāvyāpako vyāptur āvāraka iti sphuṭam /
ghaṭe 'pi vyomni saṃdadhyād aśūnyatvaṃ svarūpataḥ // [AgMsv_2.168]
mv-k09-v1237.quick_english: It is clear that a non-pervading impurity cannot be the coverer of what is all-pervading; even in a pot, it would by its own nature make space non-empty only in a limited way.

mv-k09-v1238.label: AgMsv_2.169
cite_parts:
ātmanaś cādhikāryatvān malaḥ kiṃcitkaro na cet /
katham āvaraṇāyaiṣa śakto nanu ca bhoḥ kimu // [AgMsv_2.169]
mv-k09-v1238.quick_english: And if impurity produces no effect because the self is not subject to modification, how can it be capable of covering? Surely, sir, what then?

mv-k09-v1239.label: AgMsv_2.170
cite_parts:
malasadbhāvamātraṃ hi tasyāvaraṇam ucyate /
malena sadvitīyo 'ṇur āvṛtaḥ paribhāṣyate // [AgMsv_2.170]
mv-k09-v1239.quick_english: Indeed, its covering is said to be merely the existence of impurity; the atomic self is described as covered simply because it has impurity as a second.

mv-k09-v1240.label: AgMsv_2.171
cite_parts:
hantānena nayenaiṣa śivam uktātmanām api /
sthitam āvaraṇaṃ satyaṃ malasadbhāvamātrataḥ // [AgMsv_2.171]
mv-k09-v1240.quick_english: Alas, by this reasoning, even for those of the stated nature there would truly be a covering of Shiva, merely from the existence of impurity.

mv-k09-v1241.label: AgMsv_2.172
cite_parts:
kiṃcāvṛto malenātmā malam eva na vetti kim /
tadasaṃvedane tasya kiṃ malāntaram ucyate // [AgMsv_2.172]
mv-k09-v1241.quick_english: Moreover, if the self covered by impurity does not even know the impurity, then in that non-awareness of it, is another impurity to be posited?

mv-k09-v1242.label: AgMsv_2.173
cite_parts:
nanv ataḥ kiṃ malaṃ vettu tarhi vidyākale vinā /
sarvajñatvaṃ bhavet tac ca malaṃ viditam eva sat // [AgMsv_2.173]
mv-k09-v1242.quick_english: But what of it? Let it know the impurity. Then, without vidya and kala, there would be omniscience; and if the impurity were known, the self could abandon it by various contrived means.

mv-k09-v1243.label: AgMsv_2.174
cite_parts:
jahātv ātmābhyupāyais tais tair vicitraiḥ prakalpitaiḥ /
kiṃcāvaraṇam etena yasyātmani bhavet tataḥ // [AgMsv_2.174]
mv-k09-v1243.quick_english: Let the self abandon it by those various contrived means; and if so, what covering would that impurity produce in the self?

mv-k09-v1244.label: AgMsv_2.175
cite_parts:
ghaṭādau jñātṛkartṛtve katham asya bhaviṣyataḥ /
nanu vidyākale kiṃcijjñatvakartṛtvapade smṛte // [AgMsv_2.175]
mv-k09-v1244.quick_english: How would this self come to be a knower and doer with respect to pots and such things? Surely, one replies, because vidya and kala are held to be the basis of limited knowing and doing.

mv-k09-v1245.label: AgMsv_2.176
cite_parts:
itthaṃ vimūḍhamatayo vañcyante na tu paṇḍitāḥ /
jaḍasvabhāvā māyaiṣā tatsūtiś ca kalādikaḥ // [AgMsv_2.176]
mv-k09-v1245.quick_english: In this way the deluded are deceived, but not the wise: this maya is inert by nature, and kala and the rest are its offspring.

mv-k09-v1246.label: AgMsv_2.177
cite_parts:
acidātmā kathaṃkāraṃ cidabhivyañjanakṣamaḥ /
abhivyaktā ca cidvibhvī kiṃcittvādiviśeṣaṇaiḥ // [AgMsv_2.177]
mv-k09-v1246.quick_english: How could what is non-conscious be capable of manifesting consciousness? And if all-pervading consciousness were manifested, how could it be qualified by limitedness and such attributes?

mv-k09-v1247.label: AgMsv_2.178
cite_parts:
viśeṣyatāṃ kathaṃ nāma sāṃśavastūcitaṃ hi tat /
nanu devaḥ kalāvidyākaraṇo vyañjayec citam // [AgMsv_2.178]
mv-k09-v1247.quick_english: How could it become qualified? For that is fitting only for things that have parts. But surely, one objects, God, using kala and vidya, could manifest consciousness.

mv-k09-v1248.label: AgMsv_2.179
cite_parts:
vyanaktu sarvato hanta nāsyāśaktir athāgrahaḥ /
male sadātane cāsya kathaṃ muktir bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_2.179]
mv-k09-v1248.quick_english: Let him manifest it in all ways—alas, there is no incapacity in him. But if there is insistence on an eternal impurity, how will liberation ever come about?

mv-k09-v1249.label: AgMsv_2.180
cite_parts:
roddhrī śaktir malasyāsti sā ca kvāpi nivartate /
kvāpi pravartate ceti dhig idaṃ mūḍhabhāṣitam // [AgMsv_2.180]
mv-k09-v1249.quick_english: The claim that impurity has an obstructing power which sometimes stops and sometimes acts is foolish talk.

tokens.grounds: adjective describing the power of mala
sandhi fusion of malasya + asti; mala possesses a power
describes the power stopping in some case
describes the power acting in another case
sandhi fusion of ca + iti marking reported claim

mv-k09-v1250.label: AgMsv_2.181
cite_parts:
jaḍānāṃ ko 'nusandhiḥ syāt taṃ vinaitat kathaṃ bhavet /
atha tatrāpi devasya hetutābhyupagamyate // [AgMsv_2.181]
mv-k09-v1250.quick_english: Insentient things cannot deliberate, so how could that selective operation happen? If so, one must admit that God is the cause even in that case.

tokens.grounds: refers to inert entities like mala or its power
elided initial a; capacity for intentional connection
sandhi fusion of tatra + api; even in that case

mv-k09-v1251.label: AgMsv_2.182
cite_parts:
kiṃ nimittam asau devas tāṃ śaktiṃ saṃpravartayet /
pravartitāṃ vā kiṃ nāma tāṃ nivartayate punaḥ // [AgMsv_2.182]
mv-k09-v1251.quick_english: For what reason would that God set that power in motion, or for what reason would he make it stop again once it has been set in motion?

tokens.grounds: subject who would activate the power
questions God's motive for stopping it

mv-k09-v1252.label: AgMsv_2.183
cite_parts:
svātantryād iti cet pūrṇaṃ tad evāśrīyate na kim /
malasya dhvāntarūpasya na ca pāko 'pi kaścana // [AgMsv_2.183]
mv-k09-v1252.quick_english: If the answer is that God acts from autonomy, then let that plenitude alone be accepted. Why bring in impurity, which is of the nature of darkness, and why suppose any maturation of it at all?

tokens.grounds: sandhi fusion of eva + āśrīyate; accept plenitude directly
rhetorical question challenging need for mala
doctrine of mala ripening is denied

mv-k09-v1253.label: AgMsv_2.184
cite_parts:
sa hy anyatādānayogād dhanty amuṣya dhruvātmatām /
etena malasaṃbandhād īśvarecchāpracoditaḥ // [AgMsv_2.184]
mv-k09-v1253.quick_english: For maturation, by involving a connection with another state, would destroy mala's fixed nature. By this reasoning, the idea that a soul is impelled by God's will because of its connection with impurity is refuted.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of hi; gives reason
maturation would imply acquiring another state
sandhi form before amuṣya; maturation would destroy permanence
permanent essence that would be contradicted
compound describing the soul's supposed motivation

mv-k09-v1254.label: AgMsv_2.185
cite_parts:
bhogalobhakathāviṣṭaḥ paśuḥ sṛṣṭyānugṛhyate /
iti yad bhaṇyate mūlahataṃ taj, janitaṃ tataḥ // [AgMsv_2.185]
mv-k09-v1254.quick_english: The claim that the bound soul, caught up in the desire for enjoyment, is favored by creation is struck at the root; that consequence follows from what has been shown.

tokens.grounds: subject said to be favored by creation
sandhi fusion of sṛṣṭyā + anugṛhyate; opponent's claim
evaluates the doctrine as fundamentally refuted
sandhi form of tat; refers to the doctrine
states the consequence has been generated

mv-k09-v1255.label: AgMsv_2.186
cite_parts:
svātmapracchādanakrīḍāmātram eva malaṃ viduḥ /
svatantro hi vibhuḥ kiṃcit kiṃ na svātmani bhāsayet // [AgMsv_2.186]
mv-k09-v1255.quick_english: They know impurity to be nothing but the mere play of concealing one's own self. For why would the autonomous, all-pervading Lord not manifest anything within himself?

tokens.grounds: compound defining mala in the nondual view
affirms the Lord's freedom to appear as concealment

mv-k09-v1256.label: AgMsv_2.187
cite_parts:
yac ca karmāpi nāmeṣṭaṃ tattāvat pravicāryatām /
tathāhi karmasaṃbandhe sthite 'pi katham īdṛśaḥ // [AgMsv_2.187]
mv-k09-v1256.quick_english: And as for karma, which is also accepted, let that first be examined. For even if the connection with karma remains, how can there be such a state as the great dissolution?

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of yat; introduces next topic
sandhi fusion of karma + api; extends discussion to karma
sandhi fusion of nāma + iṣṭam; opponent accepts karma
sandhi fusion of tat + tāvat; calls for prior examination
refers to the great dissolution described next

mv-k09-v1257.label: AgMsv_2.188
cite_parts:
mahāpralaya ucyate mahāsṛṣṭiś ca vā katham /
nanv īśvarecchayā tatra karmāyāti niruddhatām // [AgMsv_2.188]
mv-k09-v1257.quick_english: How can there be a great dissolution, or a great creation? Surely, one may say, karma becomes restrained there by the will of God.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of mahāsṛṣṭiḥ; parallel case
sandhi form of nanu; introduces opponent's reply
refers to the time of dissolution
sandhi fusion of karma + āyāti; karma enters restraint
state karma is said to reach

mv-k09-v1258.label: AgMsv_2.189
cite_parts:
karmaudāsīnyayogena karmāntaram apekṣatām /
īśvaro 'tha navā pūrvapakṣe saṃbhava eva ca // [AgMsv_2.189]
mv-k09-v1258.quick_english: Does the Lord do this through karma's inactivity, or by depending on another karma, or not? In the first alternative, that very possibility becomes an issue.

tokens.grounds: second option: a further karma intervenes
sandhi form of īśvaraḥ; subject of the options
sandhi fusion of na + vā; presents the negative option
refers to dependence on another karma
sandhi form of saṃbhavaḥ; possibility arises

mv-k09-v1259.label: AgMsv_2.190
cite_parts:
nasaṃbhave sa kutrāṃśe caiśvaryam adhigacchatu /
karmataḥ sarvam evedaṃ syāt sṛṣṭipralayādikam // [AgMsv_2.190]
mv-k09-v1259.quick_english: If that is impossible, in what respect could he possess sovereignty? Then all this—creation, dissolution, and the rest—would come about from karma alone.

tokens.grounds: sandhi fusion of na + saṃbhave; if that option is impossible
sandhi fusion of ca + aiśvaryam; divine lordship
sandhi fusion of eva + idam; emphatic reference to the world process

mv-k09-v1260.label: AgMsv_2.191
cite_parts:
atha karmānapekṣo vā karmaṇāṃ rodhanaṃ tataḥ /
sadā niruddhāny eveśaḥ karmāṇi kurutāṃ vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_2.191]
mv-k09-v1260.quick_english: But if, without depending on karma, he restrains karmas, then let the all-pervading Lord keep them restrained always.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of karmānapekṣaḥ; God acts independently of karma
sandhi form before eveśaḥ; karmas would remain blocked

mv-k09-v1261.label: AgMsv_2.192
cite_parts:
nanu teṣāṃ svabhāvo 'yaṃ yadbhogaprasavātmatā /
kathaṃ svabhāva eṣa syād yaḥ paropādhitāṃ gataḥ // [AgMsv_2.192]
mv-k09-v1261.quick_english: But surely their nature is to produce enjoyment. How could that be an intrinsic nature if it has come to depend on another condition?

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of svabhāvaḥ; proposed intrinsic character
elided initial a; points to the nature described
sandhi form of svabhāvaḥ; questioned status
indicates the nature has become conditioned

mv-k09-v1262.label: AgMsv_2.193
cite_parts:
anapekṣo hi bhāvānāṃ svabhāvaḥ karmaṇāṃ tataḥ /
īśaiṣaṇānapekṣāṇāṃ yadrūpaṃ tatsvakaṃ vapuḥ // [AgMsv_2.193]
mv-k09-v1262.quick_english: For the intrinsic nature of things is independent. Therefore, whatever form karmas have when they do not depend on the Lord's direction—that is their own true nature.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of anapekṣaḥ; defines true intrinsic nature
compound describing karmas apart from divine prompting
sandhi fusion of yat + rūpam; their form without dependence
sandhi fusion of tat + svakam; identifies true own form

mv-k09-v1263.label: AgMsv_2.194
cite_parts:
kiṃ ca pralayalīnāni karmāṇi sthitibhāñjy api /
kiṃ prabodhayate devaḥ kiṃ nu dṛ[sṛ]ṣṭair hi taiḥ kṛtam // [AgMsv_2.194]
mv-k09-v1263.quick_english: And do the karmas dissolved in the great dissolution, or even those that still persist, get awakened by God? What, indeed, is accomplished by those karmas?

tokens.grounds: sandhi form before api; karmas that persist
instrumental; by karmas brought into operation

mv-k09-v1264.label: AgMsv_2.195
cite_parts:
malapākāya cet so 'pi sudūram apasāritaḥ /
kiṃ cātmā vibhur evaiṣa sa kiṃ nāma karoti hi // [AgMsv_2.195]
mv-k09-v1264.quick_english: If it is said to be for the maturation of impurity, that too has been thoroughly dismissed. And this self is all-pervading—what, indeed, can karma do to it?

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of saḥ; refers to maturation doctrine
elided initial a; includes that doctrine
states the maturation doctrine has been rejected
questions what karma can do to it
sandhi fusion of ca + ātmā; shifts to the soul
sandhi fusion of eva + eṣa; emphatic identification
questions what karma can do to it
asks about karma's effect on the self

mv-k09-v1265.label: AgMsv_2.196
cite_parts:
iti pūrvaṃ vicāraś ca vistareṇa prapañcitaḥ /
mṛddaṇḍacakrasūtreṣu dhīmān karteśvaraḥ sthitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.196]
mv-k09-v1265.quick_english: This examination has already been elaborated at length. In the clay, stick, wheel, and threads, it is the intelligent Lord who stands as the true agent.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of vicāraḥ; the prior inquiry
states the issue was fully explained
compound listing potter's instruments as analogy
describes the Lord as wise agent
states where agency is located in the analogy

mv-k09-v1266.label: AgMsv_2.197
cite_parts:
kumbhakārasya kartṛtvaṃ kutrāṃśe nv avatiṣṭhatām /
akṛṣṭapacyabījeṣu prarohaprasavādike // [AgMsv_2.197]
mv-k09-v1266.quick_english: In what respect, indeed, does the potter's agency stand, especially in the sprouting and growth of seeds that have not been ploughed or cultivated?

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of nu; emphatic particle
compound describing seeds not cultivated by human effort

mv-k09-v1267.label: AgMsv_2.198
cite_parts:
pūrvaṃ karotu hetutvaṃ na sasyeṣv iti ko nayaḥ /
idaṃ duṣkṛtam etac ca sukṛtaṃ phalabhedataḥ // [AgMsv_2.198]
mv-k09-v1267.quick_english: Let it be a cause earlier, but not in the crops—what principle is that? This is a bad deed and that a good deed, distinguished by the difference in their fruits.

tokens.grounds: concedes causality at an earlier stage
sandhi form of sasyeṣu; later agricultural results
asks what logical rule supports this
sandhi form of etat; points to a good deed

mv-k09-v1268.label: AgMsv_2.199
cite_parts:
iti yat pravibhaktaṃ kiṃ tatrāsyecchaiva jṛmbhate /
svatantro yady asau kasmāt parapīḍākārīṃ nijām // [AgMsv_2.199]
mv-k09-v1268.quick_english: If that division is made, does only his will unfold there? If he is autonomous, why would he adopt a will of his own that causes harm to others?

tokens.grounds: refers to the classification of deeds
sandhi fusion of tatra + asya + icchā + eva; questions whether God's will alone operates
asks whether divine will manifests there
sandhi form of svatantraḥ; describes God
sandhi form of yadi; introduces condition
describes a will that harms others

mv-k09-v1269.label: AgMsv_2.200
cite_parts:
icchāṃ gṛhṇāti yo nityaṃ karuṇārasanirbharaḥ /
nanu svabhāvāttattādṛk karmātaḥ phaladāyakam // [AgMsv_2.200]
mv-k09-v1269.quick_english: Why would he, who is always filled with compassion, adopt such a will? But surely, one may say, karma is such by its own nature and therefore gives those fruits.

tokens.grounds: questions God's adoption of such a will
sandhi fusion of svabhāvāt + tat + tādṛk; karma is such by nature
sandhi fusion of karma + ataḥ; karma gives fruit by nature

mv-k09-v1270.label: AgMsv_2.201
cite_parts:
prāyaścittādikaraṇāc chāmyec ceti vicārayan /
devas tathaiva tanute śāstraṃ citropadeśakam // [AgMsv_2.201]
mv-k09-v1270.quick_english: Considering that karma might be pacified through expiation and the like, God accordingly promulgates scripture that gives varied instruction.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of prāyaścittādikaraṇāt; ritual remedy for karma
sandhi form of śāmyet; karma's effect could be calmed
sandhi fusion of ca + iti; marks the consideration
sandhi fusion of tathā + eva; accordingly

mv-k09-v1271.label: AgMsv_2.202
cite_parts:
śaivaṃ, svabhāva edādṛk karmaṇām iti ko nayaḥ /
bījam aṅkurasaṃsūtisvabhāvam iti mādṛśaḥ // [AgMsv_2.202]
mv-k09-v1271.quick_english: To say that the Śaiva teaching, or that karmas, are such by their own nature—what principle is that? People like us know that a seed has the nature of producing a sprout.

tokens.grounds: refers to Śaiva scripture or teaching
sandhi form of svabhāvaḥ; invoked as explanation
sandhi fusion of e + tādṛk; describes that nature
compound describing the seed's apparent nature
ordinary knowers who infer from observation

mv-k09-v1272.label: AgMsv_2.203
cite_parts:
pūrvavṛddhavyavahṛter vijñātuṃ prabhaviṣṇavaḥ /
īśvaras tu nijecchayā vinā na hi kadācana // [AgMsv_2.203]
mv-k09-v1272.quick_english: People like us are able to know such things from the established usage of earlier generations. But the Lord, indeed, never acts without his own will.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of īśvaraḥ; contrasted subject

mv-k09-v1273.label: AgMsv_2.204
cite_parts:
avalokitavān karmaphalavaicitryacāturīm /

tasmād devaḥ sarvakartā yadi syāt kartāraḥ syur nātmavargāḥ kathaṃcid /
no kartāras te 'pi cet karmavandhyān uddiśyainān sarvakartā na devaḥ // [AgMsv_2.204]
mv-k09-v1273.quick_english: Having observed the intricate diversity of karmic fruits, if the Lord alone were the doer of everything, the group of individual selves could in no way be doers. But if they too are not doers, then, aiming at these beings barren of action, the Lord would not be the all-doer.

tokens.grounds: ablative demonstrative used as conclusion marker
refers to the group of selves
gerund uddiśya + enam fused by sandhi

mv-k09-v1274.label: AgMsv_2.205
cite_parts:
itthaṃ ca bhedadṛṣṭyedaṃ karma nāma na mu[yu]ktimat /
etāvān atra saṃkṣopo vyāso 'nyatra tu darśitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.205]
mv-k09-v1274.quick_english: Thus, from the standpoint of duality, this so-called karma is not well-reasoned. Here only a brief summary is given, while the fuller elaboration has been shown elsewhere.

tokens.grounds: compound bheda+dṛṣṭi fused with idam by sandhi
locative adverb referring to this context

mv-k09-v1275.label: AgMsv_2.206
cite_parts:
saṃvedanātmako deva ekas tasmāt svataḥ khalu /
sarvakartā sa vaicitryāt karmayogīti bhaṇyate // [AgMsv_2.206]
mv-k09-v1275.quick_english: The Lord is one, whose very nature is consciousness; therefore he is indeed the all-doer by his own nature. Because of diversity, he is spoken of as connected with karma.

tokens.grounds: compound karma+yoga fused with iti by sandhi

mv-k09-v1276.label: AgMsv_2.207
cite_parts:
māyā ca nāma viśvasya yā kāraṇam iti sthitā /
sā dharaṇyantatattvāṃśagarbhā nityā yadi sphuṭam // [AgMsv_2.207]
mv-k09-v1276.quick_english: And that so-called Maya, which is established as the cause of the universe, containing within her womb the elements of the tattvas ending with earth—if she is clearly eternal...

tokens.grounds: that of which Maya is cause

mv-k09-v1277.label: AgMsv_2.208
cite_parts:
pralayo na kadācit syān nanu sa vyaktibhāvataḥ /
vyaktiṃ nāma na jānīmo vijñānaṃ grāhyatā yataḥ // [AgMsv_2.208]
mv-k09-v1277.quick_english: Then dissolution would never occur. But surely it occurs through the state of manifestation? We do not recognize manifestation as such, because cognition consists in being an object of grasping.

mv-k09-v1278.label: AgMsv_2.209
cite_parts:
tadīśvaraparajñānagrāhyatāsti sadātanī /
tasyām avidyamānāyām īśvaraḥ kāraṇaṃ kutaḥ // [AgMsv_2.209]
mv-k09-v1278.quick_english: Its being grasped by the Lord's supreme knowledge is everlasting. If that were absent, how could the Lord be the cause?

tokens.grounds: compound tad+īśvara+para+jñāna+grāhyatā fused with asti by sandhi
present participle of vid with a-

mv-k09-v1279.label: AgMsv_2.210
cite_parts:
sphuṭaṃ prakurute kumbhaṃ tadvad īśe bhaviṣyati /
maivam antarbahīrūpakaraṇapravibhedataḥ // [AgMsv_2.210]
mv-k09-v1279.quick_english: One might think it will be in the Lord as when someone clearly produces a pot. Not so, because of the distinction between inner and outer instruments.

mv-k09-v1280.label: AgMsv_2.211
cite_parts:
sphuṭāsphuṭādivijñānaṃ yuktaṃ kumbhakṛti sphuṭam /
īśvarasya sphuṭodārapūrvavijñānaśālinaḥ // [AgMsv_2.211]
mv-k09-v1280.quick_english: In the making of a pot, cognition that is clear, unclear, and so forth is fitting; but the Lord possesses a clear, noble, prior cognition.

mv-k09-v1281.label: AgMsv_2.212
cite_parts:
ko na jñāto bhaved bhāgo yatrāpi vyaktyapekṣitā /
satkāryavādināṃ deśe kāraṇe 'pi sphuṭaṃ sthitam // [AgMsv_2.212]
mv-k09-v1281.quick_english: What part would not be known, even where dependence on manifestation is assumed? In the view of the satkarya theorists, the universe is clearly established even in the cause.

mv-k09-v1282.label: AgMsv_2.213
cite_parts:
viśvam ityapi māyāyāṃ sphuṭaṃ syād asamañjasam /
vyāpakāś ca śivātmānas tattvaiḥ sākaṃ parasparam // [AgMsv_2.213]
mv-k09-v1282.quick_english: Thus, for the universe to be clearly present in Maya would be incongruous, since Siva and the selves are pervasive, together with the tattvas and mutually so.

mv-k09-v1283.label: AgMsv_2.214
cite_parts:
kathaṃ ca nāma vidyantāṃ vyāpakatvatirohiteḥ /
vikāsaḥ paramo vyāptiḥ saṃvido bheda ucyate // [AgMsv_2.214]
mv-k09-v1283.quick_english: And how indeed could they exist, given the concealment of pervasiveness? The supreme expansion of consciousness is its pervasion, and in division it is spoken of accordingly.

mv-k09-v1284.label: AgMsv_2.215
cite_parts:
māyīyaṃ kañcukavrātaṃ yathā karaṇasaṃcayaḥ /
vicāritaḥ pūrvam eva kāryavargaś ca carcitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.215]
mv-k09-v1284.quick_english: The group of coverings born of Maya, as well as the collection of instruments, has already been examined before, and the group of effects has also been discussed.

tokens.grounds: compound kārya+varga with sandhi for ca

mv-k09-v1285.label: AgMsv_2.216
cite_parts:
yāvac chivapadādhyāsavandhyaṃ viśvaṃ na visphuret /
tatsvātantryakathāmātram etad ity avadhāryatām // [AgMsv_2.216]
mv-k09-v1285.quick_english: As long as the universe, devoid of resting on the state of Siva, does not shine forth, this is merely talk of its autonomy; let that be understood.

mv-k09-v1286.label: AgMsv_2.217
cite_parts:
evaṃ malādyabhāve hi kā dīkṣā ko hi dīkṣakaḥ /
dīkṣāpātraṃ ca ko vā syād iti kiṃcin na yujyate // [AgMsv_2.217]
mv-k09-v1286.quick_english: Thus, in the absence of impurity and the like, what initiation could there be, who would be the initiator, and who the recipient? None of this fits.

mv-k09-v1287.label: AgMsv_2.218
cite_parts:
śiṣye 'dhvany anale kumbhe maṇḍale srukkarādike /
samastādhvakṛto nyāsaḥ kathaṃ vāpy upapadyatām // [AgMsv_2.218]
mv-k09-v1287.quick_english: How could the installation of the entire path in the disciple, the path, the fire, the vessel, the mandala, the ladle, the hand, and so on, be possible?

mv-k09-v1288.label: AgMsv_2.219
cite_parts:
nahi tāvanta eva syur nanu saṃkalpanāvaśāt /
śodhyaśodhakabhāvo 'yaṃ sarva evodito nanu // [AgMsv_2.219]
mv-k09-v1288.quick_english: Surely they would not all be present in that way. But, one may object, by the power of conception this entire relation of purifier and purified has indeed been declared.

tokens.grounds: refers to the full extent of the path
eva fused with uditaḥ by sandhi

mv-k09-v1289.label: AgMsv_2.220
cite_parts:
kalpitaṃ cet phalet satyaṃ manorājyārjitaśriyaḥ /
jayanti nākasāmrājyalābhaviśrāntiyogataḥ // [AgMsv_2.220]
mv-k09-v1289.quick_english: If what is merely imagined could bear fruit, then truly those who have gained riches in the kingdom of fantasy would triumph by attaining the repose of heavenly sovereignty.

mv-k09-v1290.label: AgMsv_2.221
cite_parts:
kiṃ nāma balavadrūpasaṃkalpapathavartinaḥ /
phalanti na tathā bhāvā dhyānādiviṣanāśavat // [AgMsv_2.221]
mv-k09-v1290.quick_english: Do states that follow the path of strong, vivid conception not bear fruit in that way, like the destruction of poison through meditation and the like?

mv-k09-v1291.label: AgMsv_2.222
cite_parts:
saṃkalpadārḍhyam ity eva dhyānaṃ saṃśayarūṣitam /
dhyānaṃ ca na phaled eva svayaṃ pakṣadvayāgrahāt // [AgMsv_2.222]
mv-k09-v1291.quick_english: Meditation is precisely firmness of conception; but meditation tainted by doubt does not bear fruit at all, because it grasps two alternatives.

mv-k09-v1292.label: AgMsv_2.223
cite_parts:
hanta saṃkalpanāyogād yadi jāyeta tatphalam /
kim asaṃvinmayān bhāvān bāhyān kāṃścit abhīpsasi // [AgMsv_2.223]
mv-k09-v1292.quick_english: Look—if its fruit were to arise from the application of conception, why would you desire some external entities that are not made of consciousness?

tokens.grounds: exclamatory particle introducing a sharp point

mv-k09-v1293.label: AgMsv_2.224
cite_parts:
saṃkalpenaiva saṃskāraḥ kuṇḍāgniguruśiṣyagaḥ /
sa eva ca phalābhāsī tatsaṃvid avaśiṣyate // [AgMsv_2.224]
mv-k09-v1293.quick_english: By conception alone there is consecration pertaining to the pit, fire, guru, and disciple; and that same thing, appearing as the fruit, remains as that consciousness.

tokens.grounds: instrumental of saṃkalpa fused with eva

mv-k09-v1294.label: AgMsv_2.225
cite_parts:
saṃvidaś ca svatantrāyās tathārūpāvabhāsanam /
dīkṣeti kila mantavyaṃ muñcyante jantavo yayā // [AgMsv_2.225]
mv-k09-v1294.quick_english: And the manifestation in such a form of autonomous consciousness should indeed be understood as initiation, by which beings are liberated.

tokens.grounds: dīkṣā fused with iti by sandhi

mv-k09-v1295.label: AgMsv_2.226
cite_parts:
ata eva tilājyādeḥ svarūpe grahaṇe mitau /
kramo vā niyamo neha kaścic chāstre nirūpitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.226]
mv-k09-v1295.quick_english: For that very reason, no sequence or fixed rule has been determined here in the scripture regarding the essential nature, taking, or measure of sesame, ghee, and the like.

mv-k09-v1296.label: AgMsv_2.227
cite_parts:
nanu mantreṣu kiṃ nāma niyamaḥ sarvavarṇabhāk /
rūpaṃ paraṃ hi kathitaṃ dīkṣāpi na tathā katham // [AgMsv_2.227]
mv-k09-v1296.quick_english: But surely, what fixed rule is there in mantras? For the supreme form is declared to partake of all letters; so how could initiation not be the same way?

mv-k09-v1297.label: AgMsv_2.228
cite_parts:
evam evārṇadāhasya yadbhavatsaṃmataṃ hitam /
kiṃ tu tāvati ye rūḍhiṃ na prāptās tān prati dhruvam // [AgMsv_2.228]
mv-k09-v1297.quick_english: Thus, the burning of letters as you approve it is indeed beneficial; but for those who have not yet attained firm establishment, a definite rule certainly applies to them.

tokens.grounds: emphatic particle fused with genitive compound
relative pronoun fused with honorific and past participle
relative pronoun, subject of subordinate clause

mv-k09-v1298.label: AgMsv_2.229
cite_parts:
māntro 'yaṃ niyamaḥ prokta upayogaṃ ca gacchati /
pratibuddhā hi te mantrā vimarśapathavartinaḥ // [AgMsv_2.229]
mv-k09-v1298.quick_english: This mantric rule has been declared and it serves a real purpose, for those mantras are awakened and move along the path of reflective awareness.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative pronoun with elided initial vowel

mv-k09-v1299.label: AgMsv_2.230
cite_parts:
svatantrasyaiva ciddhāmna svātantryāt kartṛtāmayāḥ /
mantrā viśanty evācāryaṃ taṃ tādātmyaniyogataḥ // [AgMsv_2.230]
mv-k09-v1299.quick_english: Because the light of consciousness is autonomous, the mantras, made of agency, enter that very teacher through the application of identity with it.

mv-k09-v1300.label: AgMsv_2.231
cite_parts:
svatantrīkurvate yānti karaṇāny api kartṛtām /
itthaṃ dīkṣādividhaye ye 'py anye vidhayo matāḥ // [AgMsv_2.231]
mv-k09-v1300.quick_english: They make him autonomous, and even instruments attain agency; thus, initiation and whatever other rites are accepted become possible.

mv-k09-v1301.label: AgMsv_2.232
cite_parts:
kiṃ nāma kurvatāṃ kṛtyaṃ niṣedhaṃ tv api vā katham /
te 'py atraivopapadyante tat sarvaṃ vihitaṃ tv iha // [AgMsv_2.232]
mv-k09-v1301.quick_english: What, indeed, is to be done by those who act, and how could there even be prohibition? Both are established right here, for all of that is enjoined here.

mv-k09-v1302.label: AgMsv_2.233
cite_parts:
sarvaṃ caitad amutraiva pratiṣiddhaṃ yataḥ sphuṭam /
pratiṣedhe darśite 'sya kiṃ cādvaitapathāśritaḥ // [AgMsv_2.233]
mv-k09-v1302.quick_english: And all this is prohibited only from that other standpoint; for when its prohibition is clearly shown, what force does it have for one who rests on the nondual path?

mv-k09-v1303.label: AgMsv_2.234
cite_parts:
pratiṣedho 'pi vihitaḥ so 'pi ca pratiṣidhyate /
itthaṃ svasaṃvidambhodhiḥ svātmani procchalaty alam // [AgMsv_2.234]
mv-k09-v1303.quick_english: Even prohibition is enjoined, and that too is prohibited; thus the ocean of one's own awareness surges abundantly within itself.

mv-k09-v1304.label: AgMsv_2.235
cite_parts:
itthaṃ ca viśvam evedaṃ jagadānandasundaram /
tadvipakṣaṃ ca bhedāṃśam itthaṃ kṣapayatetarām // [AgMsv_2.235]
mv-k09-v1304.quick_english: Thus this entire universe is beautiful with the bliss of the world, and in this way it utterly dissolves the opposing element of difference.

mv-k09-v1305.label: AgMsv_2.236
cite_parts:
parameśamukhodbhūtajñānacandrasya sarvataḥ /
tāvatā svaprabhābhārabhāsvarāḥ sumarīcayaḥ // [AgMsv_2.236]
mv-k09-v1305.quick_english: From the moon of knowledge risen from the mouth of the Supreme Lord, beautiful rays radiant with the fullness of their own light spread in all directions.

mv-k09-v1306.label: AgMsv_2.237
cite_parts:
śivacandrāṃśusaṃghātapātamātravilāpitaḥ /
samastabhāvaśītāṃśukālakūṭo rasāyate // [AgMsv_2.237]
mv-k09-v1306.quick_english: The deadly poison that darkens the moon of all beings, melted by the mere touch of the mass of rays from Shiva's moon, turns into an elixir.

mv-k09-v1307.label: AgMsv_2.238
cite_parts:
tatrāniśaṃ nimajjantas tadrasāpānaghūrṇitāḥ /
tadrasībhūya tiṣṭhāmaḥ śuddhās tāpatrayojjhitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.238]
mv-k09-v1307.quick_english: Plunging there unceasingly and reeling from drinking that essence, we become that essence itself and abide pure, freed from the three kinds of suffering.

tokens.grounds: locative adverb fused with time adverb

mv-k09-v1308.label: AgMsv_2.239
