cite_parts:
parameśamukhaṃ tu śaktir uktā bhavatīcchā nanu sodbhavaṃ gatā /
pratipadyata īśvarādibhinnasthitivijñānaśaśāṅkaśaktivṛttam // [AgMsv_2.239]
mv-k09-v1308.quick_english: The mouth of the Supreme Lord is said to be his power, namely will; having arisen, that will takes on the functioning of the moon of knowledge in the distinct states beginning with Īśvara.

mv-k09-v1309.label: AgMsv_2.240
cite_parts:
śaśinaḥ kila tasya sarvato yaḥ paripūrṇaḥ prasṛto marīcipuñjaḥ /
iyam eva hi sā kriyātmikoktā parameśasya jaganmayī svaśaktiḥ // [AgMsv_2.240]
mv-k09-v1309.quick_english: The fully spread mass of rays streaming forth on all sides from that moon is indeed the Supreme Lord's own power, declared to consist of action and to be made of the world.

mv-k09-v1310.label: AgMsv_2.241
cite_parts:
tad idaṃ trikaśaktinirbharaṃ paramaṃ bhairavam eva jṛmbhate /
na tu tadvyatireki saṃbhavet svavijṛmbhā vijayo 'sya kīrtitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.241]
mv-k09-v1310.quick_english: Thus this, full of the three powers, expands as the supreme Bhairava alone; nothing different from it could exist, and its own expansion is proclaimed as its victory.

mv-k09-v1311.label: AgMsv_2.242
cite_parts:
tata eva jagaj jayanty amī sphuṭam arthaḥ prakaṭo 'pi yujyate naḥ /
bahuvācakayoga īdṛśaṃ tat paripūrṇatvam amuṣya vākyabhedam // [AgMsv_2.242]
mv-k09-v1311.quick_english: From that very reality these powers clearly conquer the world; the meaning becomes manifest and fits for us, since such a connection with many expressions belongs to that fullness and accommodates the division of statements.

mv-k09-v1312.label: AgMsv_2.243
cite_parts:
ity eka eva śloko 'yaṃ cidātmā bhairavaḥ svayam /
samastabhāvasaṃdarbhanirbharo vyākṛtaḥ sphuṭam // [AgMsv_2.243]
mv-k09-v1312.quick_english: Thus this single verse clearly explains Bhairava himself, whose nature is consciousness, full of the entire sequence of all beings.

mv-k09-v1313.label: AgMsv_2.244
cite_parts:
saṃsāragaranāśāya tārkṣyādhiṣṭhitadṛṣṭayaḥ /
viṣam evopayuñjānāḥ prāpnuvanty amṛtīṃ sthitim // [AgMsv_2.244]
mv-k09-v1313.quick_english: For the destruction of the poison of worldly existence, those whose vision is empowered by Garuda employ poison itself and attain an immortal state.

tokens.grounds: emphatic particle fused with present participle

mv-k09-v1314.label: AgMsv_2.245
cite_parts:
iti darśitam etāvat svaprakāśasvasaṃvidā /
siddhaṃ tadvyatirekeṇa na kiṃcid eva kalpate // [AgMsv_2.245]
mv-k09-v1314.quick_english: Thus it has been shown to this extent: by self-luminous own-awareness everything is established, and apart from that nothing at all is possible.

mv-k09-v1315.label: AgMsv_2.246
cite_parts:
yāvatsvasaṃvidviśrāntaṃ yat tāvat tat sad eva hi /
kālāntaravyapekṣe hi satyatvaṃ syān na kutracit // [AgMsv_2.246]
mv-k09-v1315.quick_english: Whatever rests in own-awareness is real to that very extent; for if reality depended on another time, it could not be real anywhere.

mv-k09-v1316.label: AgMsv_2.247
cite_parts:
saṃvidaḥ kālayogaś ca vistareṇa nivāritaḥ /
tat svasaṃvid yathā deśaṃ vitared vartate tathā // [AgMsv_2.247]
mv-k09-v1316.quick_english: The connection of awareness with time has been refuted at length; therefore own-awareness functions just as it spreads out space.

mv-k09-v1317.label: AgMsv_2.248
cite_parts:
tathā saṃvidy akṣamayyāṃ nikaṣāśmani ropitam /
na yat tat saṃśayāyaiva śāstre 'py uktam avastu tat // [AgMsv_2.248]
mv-k09-v1317.quick_english: Likewise, whatever cannot be placed on the touchstone of awareness is fit only for doubt; even in scripture that is called unreal.

mv-k09-v1318.label: AgMsv_2.249
cite_parts:
svasaṃvid anupārohi pralāpān na viśiṣyate /
tac cchāstraṃ prakriyā sā ca yat saṃvidi vivartate // [AgMsv_2.249]
mv-k09-v1318.quick_english: What does not rise to own-awareness is no different from idle talk; that alone is scripture and that alone is method which unfolds within awareness.

mv-k09-v1319.label: AgMsv_2.250
cite_parts:
hṛdayāj jagato jātāḥ sarvasyaite kṣayodayāḥ /
svapnasyeva suṣuptākhyāt svasaṃvicchāstracarcitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.250]
mv-k09-v1319.quick_english: All these risings and settings of the whole world arise from the heart, like a dream from deep sleep, and are examined by the scripture of own-awareness.

mv-k09-v1320.label: AgMsv_2.251
cite_parts:
rūpālokamanaskārasāmagrī saṃhṛtiḥ sthitiḥ /
sṛṣṭir nimeṣonmeṣau ca satāṃ saṃkocakalpanam // [AgMsv_2.251]
mv-k09-v1320.quick_english: The totality of form, light, and attention; withdrawal, maintenance, and creation; closing and opening; and the construction of contraction in beings — all these are its operations.

mv-k09-v1321.label: AgMsv_2.252
cite_parts:
ityādikā mātṛmeyamānarūpā sthitiḥ sadā /
svasaṃvidaḥ supūrṇāyāḥ prapañcaracanā svayam // [AgMsv_2.252]
mv-k09-v1321.quick_english: Such an abiding state, having the form of knower, known, and knowing, is always the spontaneous fashioning of the manifold world by perfectly full own-consciousness.

tokens.grounds: points to the preceding description of manifestation
compound describing the triadic structure of manifestation
refers to self-awareness as the source

mv-k09-v1322.label: AgMsv_2.253
cite_parts:
sarvasarvātmadigdeśakālākārā svayaṃ hi sā /
satyamithyātvanirṇītis tata eva hi jāyate // [AgMsv_2.253]
mv-k09-v1322.quick_english: She indeed is by herself the form of all, of all selves, directions, places, and times; and from her alone arises the determination of what is true and what is false.

tokens.grounds: compound expressing total pervasion of consciousness
the capacity to discern reality and unreality
points to consciousness as the source

mv-k09-v1323.label: AgMsv_2.254
cite_parts:
ācāryotpaladevo 'pi tadetadupadiṣṭavān /
bahiḥ sadasadātmāpi svasaṃvidi madīyadṛk // [AgMsv_2.254]
mv-k09-v1323.quick_english: Teacher Utpaladeva also taught this very thing: even what appears outside as being or nonbeing is, in own-consciousness, my seeing.

tokens.grounds: adds this authority to the argument
describes the ambiguous status of external objects
locates the true ground of appearance
identifies perception as rooted in self-awareness

mv-k09-v1324.label: AgMsv_2.255
cite_parts:
paśyatv iti svatantrasya niyatiḥ sendriyābhidhā /
saiva rūdhā śivād ā ca krimeḥ svāṃ saṃvidaṃ śritā // [AgMsv_2.255]
mv-k09-v1324.quick_english: The regulation of the autonomous, expressed as 'let it see' and called together with the senses, is that very consciousness which, ascending from Shiva down to the worm, rests upon its own awareness.

tokens.grounds: imperative expressing the freedom of consciousness
the self-imposed order of the free
names this regulation as inclusive of the senses
the self-awareness that is rested upon

mv-k09-v1325.label: AgMsv_2.256
cite_parts:
tad eva deve saṃsāraḥ sa śivaḥ parameīŭvaraḥ /
tatra viśrāntim āpanno mukta ity abhidhīyate // [AgMsv_2.256]
mv-k09-v1325.quick_english: That very same reality is worldly bondage, and it is Shiva, the supreme lord; one who has attained rest in it is called liberated.

tokens.grounds: locates the state in the divine
one who has reached that rest

mv-k09-v1326.label: AgMsv_2.257
cite_parts:
etatprasādāj jīvanti brahmādyāḥ sthāvarāntakāḥ /
aviluptā sadā seyaṃ saṃvittir iti gṛhyatām // [AgMsv_2.257]
mv-k09-v1326.quick_english: By the grace of this, all beings from Brahma down to the immobile live; let this consciousness be understood as always unobscured.

tokens.grounds: states the dependence of all beings
includes the lowest forms of existence
points to the consciousness under discussion

mv-k09-v1327.label: AgMsv_2.258
cite_parts:
vibhānty api hi sā devī na tayā rahitaṃ kvacit /
ātmānaṃ sādhayet kvāpi kvāpi dūṣayate kvacit // [AgMsv_2.258]
mv-k09-v1327.quick_english: Even while shining forth, that goddess never establishes a self anywhere as devoid of her; in one place she may establish it, in another fault it, in another do otherwise.

tokens.grounds: names consciousness in its divine aspect
the self that is established or altered

mv-k09-v1328.label: AgMsv_2.259
cite_parts:
anyathaiva sthāpayate na ca yāti vikāritām /
sādhandūṣaṇānyatvavandhyāpi parameśvarī // [AgMsv_2.259]
mv-k09-v1328.quick_english: She places things otherwise, yet she does not undergo change; even while barren of establishing, faulting, and otherness, she remains the supreme goddess.

tokens.grounds: compound stating she is untouched by her own operations
names consciousness in its sovereign aspect

mv-k09-v1329.label: AgMsv_2.260
cite_parts:
bhāsate ca tathātvena tat svatantrā sphuṭā hi sā /
śrīmān maheśvaro devaḥ pūrveṣām api yo guruḥ // [AgMsv_2.260]
mv-k09-v1329.quick_english: And she shines clearly in that very way, autonomous indeed; she is the glorious great lord, the god who is the teacher even of those who came before.

tokens.grounds: refers to prior teachers or beings

mv-k09-v1330.label: AgMsv_2.261
cite_parts:
sa etad eva provāca lokānugrahahetutaḥ /

mūḍhāḥ kiṃ niḥsāre vāyasaviraṭitakalpe tiṣṭatha vacasi vṛthaivaṃ svāṃ saṃvidam āvarjya /
saṃviddevatayaiva yad ādiṣṭaṃ nikaṭe 'py atha sarva ādriyamāṇās tattaddeśe jīvanmuktā bhavanti // [AgMsv_2.261]
mv-k09-v1330.quick_english: He proclaimed this for the grace of the world: 'Deluded ones, why do you abide in vain in essenceless speech like the cawing of crows? Honoring your own consciousness, all who respect what is instructed even nearby by the goddess-consciousness become liberated while living, in whatever place they are.'

tokens.grounds: the true ground to be honored

mv-k09-v1331.label: AgMsv_2.262
cite_parts:
tad atra nītau saṃvittir evāsau gurur ucyate /
giraty eva yato viśvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtiyogataḥ // [AgMsv_2.262]
mv-k09-v1331.quick_english: Therefore, in this guiding principle, consciousness alone is called the teacher, because it indeed swallows the universe through creation and dissolution.

tokens.grounds: the modes by which it swallows the universe

mv-k09-v1332.label: AgMsv_2.263
cite_parts:
tad atra mukhyā yā rūḍhiḥ saṃbandhaḥ para ucyate /
enayā yad yad ādiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ sāṃsiddhikaṃ tu tat // [AgMsv_2.263]
mv-k09-v1332.quick_english: Therefore, here the primary firm relation is called the supreme one; whatever knowledge is instructed through it is indeed innately accomplished.

mv-k09-v1333.label: AgMsv_2.264
cite_parts:
yatrāsmadguruvargasya sthitā nityāvasthitiḥ /
traiyambakādisaṃtānabhedo yasmāt pravartate // [AgMsv_2.264]
mv-k09-v1333.quick_english: Where the eternal abiding of our lineage of teachers is established, from there proceeds the division of the transmission beginning with Tryambaka.

tokens.grounds: the unchanging condition of the lineage
indicates the source of the lineage
describes the unfolding of the tradition

mv-k09-v1334.label: AgMsv_2.265
cite_parts:
yatroktaṃ pūrvam ajñānatādātmyaṃ naśyatītyapi /
svasaṃvidas tu vaicitryaṃ gṛhṇatyā bhāty ayaṃ tataḥ // [AgMsv_2.265]
mv-k09-v1334.quick_english: Where it was previously said that identity with ignorance perishes, this world shines forth from the variety grasped by own-consciousness.

tokens.grounds: the mistaken identification to be removed

mv-k09-v1335.label: AgMsv_2.266
cite_parts:
antarālamahaddivyādivyādi śāstrasaṃgamaḥ /
tattvavannijavāgaṃśūn guror ātmavinirmitān // [AgMsv_2.266]
mv-k09-v1335.quick_english: The confluence of scriptures—intermediate, great-divine, divine, and so forth—consists of the rays of the teacher's own true speech, fashioned by his own self.

tokens.grounds: classifies levels of scriptures or beings
describes teachings as rays of true speech
created by the teacher's own being

mv-k09-v1336.label: AgMsv_2.267
cite_parts:
prādhānyaṃ prakaṭaṃ svasaṃvidaḥ /
gurutaḥ kila śāstrataḥ svataḥ /
tad ayaṃ mukhyatayā kṛtaḥ śramaḥ // [AgMsv_2.267]
mv-k09-v1336.quick_english: The primacy of own-consciousness is manifest—whether from the teacher, from scripture, or from oneself; therefore this effort has been made with that as primary.

mv-k09-v1337.label: AgMsv_2.268
cite_parts:
śāstravṛttiparatantrito guruḥ svātmasaṃvidi ca tatpratiṣṭhitam /
tena sarvam idam ātmasaṃvidā siddhim eti nahi jātv asahyatām // [AgMsv_2.268]
mv-k09-v1337.quick_english: The teacher depends on the operation of scripture, and that is established in one's own self-consciousness; therefore all this attains accomplishment through self-consciousness and is never obstructed.

tokens.grounds: describes the teacher's reliance on scripture

mv-k09-v1338.label: AgMsv_2.269
cite_parts:
etac chāstraṃ prayatnena carcyatāṃ he mumukṣavaḥ /
mā vṛthaivāyur āyastam anyaśāstreṣu nīyatām // [AgMsv_2.269]
mv-k09-v1338.quick_english: O seekers of liberation, let this scripture be practiced with effort; do not let life be spent in vain, strained over other scriptures.

mv-k09-v1339.label: AgMsv_2.270
cite_parts:
abhedadṛṣṭir yā kācid bhedadṛṣṭir athāpi vā /
sātraivāyāti nirvāhaṃ tenaitat pravicāryatām // [AgMsv_2.270]
mv-k09-v1339.quick_english: Whatever view of non-difference or view of difference there may be, it comes to fulfillment here alone; therefore let this be carefully examined.

tokens.grounds: states where both views are resolved

mv-k09-v1340.label: AgMsv_2.271
cite_parts:
svapnakālaparijñānavī[tanidro] yathā tathā /
etacchāstrasamabhyāsaprabuddhahṛdayaḥ sadā // [AgMsv_2.271]
mv-k09-v1340.quick_english: Just as one is freed from sleep by recognizing the dream state, so one whose heart is awakened by sustained practice of this scripture remains always awake.

mv-k09-v1341.label: AgMsv_2.272
cite_parts:
svasaṃvid eva tac chāstraṃ sā cāpekṣāvivarjitā /
tathā yady abhidhīyeta svataḥ prāmāṇyam ucyatām // [AgMsv_2.272]
mv-k09-v1341.quick_english: Own-consciousness indeed is that scripture, and she is free from dependence; if it is to be stated thus, let its authoritativeness be said to be from itself.

tokens.grounds: the teaching in its deepest sense

mv-k09-v1342.label: AgMsv_2.273
cite_parts:
śāsanaṃ śāsitavyaṃ ca śāsakaṃ ceti yat kila /
tattatrākālakalitaṃ svātantryādvaitasundaram // [AgMsv_2.273]
mv-k09-v1342.quick_english: Teaching, what is to be taught, and the teacher—this triad, in that state, is not measured by time and is beautiful with freedom and nonduality.

tokens.grounds: the act or content of instruction

mv-k09-v1343.label: AgMsv_2.274
cite_parts:
tām avasthitim ātmīyāṃ garbhīkṛtyānapāyinīm /
śrīkaṇṭhanāthaḥ provāca śrīmatkiraṇaśāsane // [AgMsv_2.274]
mv-k09-v1343.quick_english: Having internalized that intrinsic, never-departing state, lord Shrikantha proclaimed it in the glorious Kirana scripture.

mv-k09-v1344.label: AgMsv_2.275
cite_parts:
sarvam etat pravṛttyarthaṃ śrot\rr ṇāṃ tu vibhedataḥ /
arthabhedāt tu bhedo 'yam upacārāt prakalpate // [AgMsv_2.275]
mv-k09-v1344.quick_english: All this is for the sake of engaging hearers through differentiation; but this difference, arising from difference of meaning, is constructed only by metaphorical usage.

tokens.grounds: continuation of the genitive plural ending
refers to the division in teaching
explains the status of the division
states that the division is provisional

mv-k09-v1345.label: AgMsv_2.276
cite_parts:
phalabhedo na kalpyo 'tra kalpyaś ced ayathātatham /
daśakāṣṭādaśāṣṭāṣṭabhedabhinnam idaṃ vibhoḥ // [AgMsv_2.276]
mv-k09-v1345.quick_english: No difference of fruit should be assumed here in the Lord's teaching; if one were assumed, it would be a false assumption, making this teaching of the Lord appear divided by distinctions of ten, eighteen, eight, and eight.

tokens.grounds: gerundive from kḷp; nominative singular with sandhi

mv-k09-v1346.label: AgMsv_2.277
cite_parts:
śivasadbhāvalābhaikaphalaṃ tallābhaprotsuke /
adhikāriṇy aṇau jātikulavarṇādyanādarāt // [AgMsv_2.277]
mv-k09-v1346.quick_english: This teaching has the single fruit of attaining the state of being Śiva, and it applies to the qualified individual soul who is eager for that attainment, without regard for birth, family, caste, and the like.

mv-k09-v1347.label: AgMsv_2.278
cite_parts:
pravṛttam ekavākyatvaṃ yāvad āsādya vartate /
aṅgāṅgivṛttavaicitryāt tāvad ekam idaṃ viduḥ // [AgMsv_2.278]
mv-k09-v1347.quick_english: As long as this teaching, once set forth, maintains its unity of discourse, the wise know it as one, even though there is variety in the functions of its subsidiary and principal parts.

mv-k09-v1348.label: AgMsv_2.279
cite_parts:
trikaśāstraṃ tathābhūto gurur atrādvayātmakaḥ /
tadanantaravākyāṃśapuñjaḥ prakaraṇāni ca // [AgMsv_2.279]
mv-k09-v1348.quick_english: The Trika scripture, the teacher who is of that nature and nondual here, and the collection of its subsequent textual portions and sections all belong to the same unified framework.

mv-k09-v1349.label: AgMsv_2.280
cite_parts:
māyīyabhedavṛttāntasphuṭabhāve bhavanti ca /
tathāpi śivasaṃprāptir mukhyam ante phalaṃ sthitam // [AgMsv_2.280]
mv-k09-v1349.quick_english: Even when the accounts of differences produced by māyā become clear, the attainment of Śiva remains established as the primary and final fruit.

tokens.grounds: compound: śiva-saṃprāptiḥ; nominative singular with sandhi

mv-k09-v1350.label: AgMsv_2.281
cite_parts:
adhikārī caika eva śivatāvāptibhājanam /
tathāpi tāvanmātre ca jāte prakaraṇātmani // [AgMsv_2.281]
mv-k09-v1350.quick_english: The qualified person is truly one, the recipient of attaining Śiva-hood; even when the teaching appears only in limited sectional form, that single qualification and attainment remain.

tokens.grounds: past participle from jan; locative singular

mv-k10-v1351.label: AgMsv_2.282
cite_parts:
yādṛk phalaṃ sphutaṃ mukhyaṃ paryantaphalam aṅgi vā /
tadaṅgaṃ vā tadvipakṣe parapakṣe paraṃ ca vā // [AgMsv_2.282]
mv-k10-v1351.quick_english: The fruit may be clear and primary, or it may be the final result; it may belong to the main element or to an auxiliary; and it may appear in its opposite, in another side, or in some other opposing condition.

mv-k10-v1352.label: AgMsv_2.283
cite_parts:
api tattadvipakṣāṃśasamudbhāvanabhājanam /
tathocitaśarīrādes tathā saṃskārabhāginaḥ // [AgMsv_2.283]
mv-k10-v1352.quick_english: Even one who becomes a vessel for manifesting aspects of various opposites is affected by having a suitable body and by sharing in the proper preparatory conditioning.

mv-k10-v1353.label: AgMsv_2.284
cite_parts:
guroḥ śiṣyasya cāpy uktas tādṛśo 'dhikriyākramaḥ /
tathā ca mṛtyuvidhvaṃsirasāyanavidhiṃ śritaḥ // [AgMsv_2.284]
mv-k10-v1353.quick_english: Such a sequence of qualification is declared for both teacher and student, just as in the case of someone who undertakes the procedure of the death-destroying elixir.

tokens.grounds: compound: adhikriyā+kramaḥ; initial a elided after sandhi

mv-k10-v1354.label: AgMsv_2.285
cite_parts:
pūrvaṃ saṃskāralābhāya kvāthavāntivirecanaiḥ /
dīkṣayā yā ca vikṛtiḥ nottaratra kriyāvidhau // [AgMsv_2.285]
mv-k10-v1354.quick_english: First, for the sake of gaining the proper preparation, one uses decoction, emesis, and purgation; and the alteration brought about by initiation should not occur later during the ritual procedure.

mv-k10-v1355.label: AgMsv_2.286
cite_parts:
tenādhikāriniyamas taddehavidaśādijaḥ /
tenocyate vaiṣṇavādyāḥ paśuśāsanasaṃśritāḥ // [AgMsv_2.286]
mv-k10-v1355.quick_english: Therefore the restriction of qualification arises from factors such as one's body and knowledge; for this reason Vaishnavas and others, who depend on the discipline of bound souls, are spoken of as limited in that way.

mv-k10-v1356.label: AgMsv_2.287
cite_parts:
na śaive 'dhikṛtās tantre na śaivā vāmagocare /
te 'pi no dakṣiṇe te 'pi na syuḥ kulamate trike // [AgMsv_2.287]
mv-k10-v1356.quick_english: They are not qualified in the Shaiva scripture; Shaivas are not qualified in the left sphere; those are not qualified in the right; and those are not qualified in the Kula doctrine or in the Trika.

tokens.grounds: authorized; initial a elided after sandhi
inclusive particle; initial a elided after sandhi
inclusive particle; initial a elided after sandhi

mv-k10-v1357.label: AgMsv_2.288
cite_parts:
uktaṃ śrībhairavakule pañcadīkṣākriyocitaḥ /
gurur ullaṅghitādhastyasrotā vā trikaśāstragaḥ // [AgMsv_2.288]
mv-k10-v1357.quick_english: It is said in the revered Bhairava Kula that the teacher fit for the rite of the five initiations is one who has transcended the lower streams or who is grounded in the Trika scripture.

mv-k10-v1358.label: AgMsv_2.289
cite_parts:
ittham ekādhikāritvam ātmatattvasamāśrayāt /
saṃskārāśraya .... bhedād bhinnādhikāritā // [AgMsv_2.289]
mv-k10-v1358.quick_english: Thus there is a single qualification insofar as all rely on the self-principle, yet qualification becomes differentiated because of differences in preparation.

mv-k10-v1359.label: AgMsv_2.290
cite_parts:
svacchandatantre tenoktaṃ sarvaśāstre śivaḥ phalam /
yataḥ śivodbhavāḥ sarve śivadhāmaphalā iti // [AgMsv_2.290]
mv-k10-v1359.quick_english: Therefore it is said in the Svacchanda Tantra that in every scripture Shiva is the fruit, because all arise from Shiva and all have Shiva's abode as their fruit.

mv-k10-v1360.label: AgMsv_2.291
cite_parts:
tatraiva ca punaḥ proktam ūrdhvatattvavivecane /
yan na sāṃkhyair na yogīndrair na priye pāñcarātrikaiḥ // [AgMsv_2.291]
mv-k10-v1360.quick_english: And there again it is declared, in the discussion of the higher principles: what is not known by the Samkhyas, not by the great yogins, and not, O beloved, by the Pancharatrikas.

mv-k10-v1361.label: AgMsv_2.292
cite_parts:
iyādi yāvad ākṣiptaṃ vādināṃ tu śatatrayam /
triṣaṣṭyā cādhikaṃ te hi tāvanmātravivecakāḥ // [AgMsv_2.292]
mv-k10-v1361.quick_english: Thus, as many as three hundred and sixty-three disputants are challenged, for they discriminate only within that limited measure.

mv-k10-v1362.label: AgMsv_2.293
cite_parts:
kathaṃ syur aparicchinnaśivatattvavidātmakāḥ /
atha tatrāṃśamātre 'pi śivasadbhāvam eva te // [AgMsv_2.293]
mv-k10-v1362.quick_english: How could they be knowers whose very nature is knowledge of the unlimited Shiva principle? Now suppose they posit the presence of Shiva even in that mere partial portion.

tokens.grounds: inclusive particle; initial a elided after sandhi

mv-k10-v1363.label: AgMsv_2.294
cite_parts:
āropayeyus tat tāvan naiva suspaṣṭasaṃgati /
devadattādivākye hi sarvataḥ pūrṇavigrahe // [AgMsv_2.294]
mv-k10-v1363.quick_english: If they were to superimpose that, it would not be clearly coherent; for in a sentence like 'Devadatta,' the reference is to a complete form in every respect.

mv-k10-v1364.label: AgMsv_2.295
cite_parts:
devadattapadaśrotā tāvanmātrapade katham /
samagrapūrvavākyānāṃ samāropaṃ kariṣyati // [AgMsv_2.295]
mv-k10-v1364.quick_english: How could someone who hears only the word 'Devadatta' superimpose upon that limited word the meaning of entire previous sentences?

mv-k10-v1365.label: AgMsv_2.296
cite_parts:
kathaṃ cādhigamas tasya tāvato 'rthasya vākyataḥ /
tasmād eveti cet tarhi na padaśrotṛtā na ca // [AgMsv_2.296]
mv-k10-v1365.quick_english: And how could he understand so much meaning from the sentence? If one says, 'just from that,' then he is not merely a hearer of a word, nor—

tokens.grounds: of the object; initial a elided after sandhi
on the basis of the sentence

mv-k10-v1366.label: AgMsv_2.297
cite_parts:
tāvanmātrasya so 'sty artha itthaṃ prakṛtigocare /
samagraśivaśāstrārthajñaptyā saṃpūrṇarūpayā // [AgMsv_2.297]
mv-k10-v1366.quick_english: —is that the meaning of only that much. Thus, in the present domain, understanding must come through knowledge of the entire meaning of the Shaiva scripture in its complete form.

mv-k10-v1367.label: AgMsv_2.298
cite_parts:
yogasāṃkhyārhatanyāyapāñcarātraśrutismṛtīḥ /
yady eva śivatattvena saṃpūrṇaṃ parikalpayet // [AgMsv_2.298]
mv-k10-v1367.quick_english: If one were to construe Yoga, Samkhya, Arhata, Nyaya, Pancharatra, Veda, and Smriti as complete through the Shiva principle—

mv-k10-v1368.label: AgMsv_2.299
cite_parts:
tāvad astu na tu sphāras tāvāṃs tatreti carcitam /
jñaptiś ca śivatattvasya tatsaṃskārapuraḥsarā // [AgMsv_2.299]
mv-k10-v1368.quick_english: Let that be granted to that extent; but the full expansion is not there. It has been examined that knowledge of the Shiva principle must be preceded by the proper preparation.

mv-k01-v01.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v01.question: What opening invocation does the first section present?
premises: The verse names first section and parents.
It asks heart to shine as supreme nectar family.
mv-k01-v01.inference: The verse opens the work with an invocation to divine parents and heart.

mv-k01-v02.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v02.question: Whose shining knowledge rays make hearts blossom?
premises: The teacher's knowledge rays shine everywhere.
They make our hearts blossom.
mv-k01-v02.inference: The verse praises the guru whose knowledge illuminates all.

mv-k01-v03.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v03.question: What did the guru give to remove poverty?
premises: He gave floods of meanings.
Those meanings destroy poverty.
mv-k01-v03.inference: The verse thanks the guru for liberating teachings.

mv-k01-v04.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v04.question: Who is asked to be pleased with the devotee?
premises: Shambhunatha is pure and skilled toward devotees.
He is pleased by speech-flowers.

mv-k01-v05.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v05.question: Whom does the speaker salute as greater than teachers?
premises: He salutes Shricukhala.
Through that purification he stands freed from grasping.
mv-k01-v05.inference: The verse salutes a superior teacher and states liberation from grasping.

mv-k01-v06.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v06.question: Who is praised as bolder than the guru?
premises: Bhutiraja is glorious and great-minded.
He is bold in rescuing devotees.
mv-k01-v06.inference: The verse praises Bhutiraja's rescuing power.

mv-k01-v07.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v07.question: What compositions are said to conquer?
premises: They arise from Somananda and Utpala.
They spread joyful consciousness in all directions.
mv-k01-v07.inference: The verse praises a lineage of joyful consciousness texts.

mv-k01-v08.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v08.question: Whose speech is said to conquer?
premises: It belongs to teacher Lakshmanagupta.
It teaches recognition cutting the world cycle.
mv-k01-v08.inference: The verse praises Lakshmanagupta's liberating speech.

mv-k01-v09.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v09.question: What is satisfied by supreme enjoyment?
premises: The mind-bee is intoxicated by countless new tastes.
It is satisfied in supreme enjoyment.
mv-k01-v09.inference: The verse describes mind intoxicated and satisfied in supreme enjoyment.

mv-k01-v10.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v10.question: What blossoms when unity is attained in the self?
premises: Unity is attained in one's own self.
Various sound-riches blossom from it.
mv-k01-v10.inference: The verse links self-unity with blossoming sound-riches.

mv-k01-v11.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v11.question: Why does the speaker explain sentence meaning again?
premises: Good disciples requested it.
He explains sentence meaning in Shrimanmalini.
mv-k01-v11.inference: The verse states a repeated explanatory request.

mv-k01-v12.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v12.question: What is well established in this circulation?
premises: Fitness abandons the other.
Scripture and commentary circulate mutually.
mv-k01-v12.inference: The verse links fitness, scripture, and commentary.

mv-k01-v13.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v13.question: Whom do they bow to day and night?
premises: They shine beyond all range.
They bow to Abhinavagupta as Shiva moon rays.
mv-k01-v13.inference: The verse praises Abhinavagupta beyond ordinary range.

mv-k01-v14.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v14.question: What moon rays are said to conquer?
premises: They destroy opponents of world bliss.
They are knowledge moon rays from Paramesha's face.
mv-k01-v14.inference: The verse praises divine knowledge rays.

mv-k01-v15.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v15.question: What glory arises from unrestrained true being?
premises: Great knowledge was born before.
Its rays have glory.
mv-k01-v15.inference: The verse links unrestrained being with great knowledge and rays.

mv-k01-v16.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v16.question: How is the spread reality differentiated?
premises: It is free from maya's rejectable and acceptable.
It is differentiated only by various thought rays.
mv-k01-v16.inference: The verse describes a spread reality beyond maya distinctions.

mv-k01-v17.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v17.question: What is the heart of the supreme lord?
premises: It has nature of reflection.
Even there Maheshvara acts by own-self power.
mv-k01-v17.inference: The verse identifies the lord's heart as reflective.

mv-k01-v18.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v18.question: What happens when supreme absorption is reached?
premises: Contact leads to supreme absorption.
Then his supreme face becomes seat of emission expansion.
mv-k01-v18.inference: The verse describes absorption leading to supreme face.

mv-k01-v19.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v19.question: What seed stands for all?
premises: It is beautiful world bliss rising from supreme expansion.
It stands by non-difference of future face.
mv-k01-v19.inference: The verse identifies a seed of all reality.

mv-k01-v20.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v20.question: What is the supreme trika opinion?
premises: It concerns heart pulse vision and supreme flow.
It is undivided from all powers.
mv-k01-v20.inference: The verse states the supreme trika as undivided power.

mv-k01-v21.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v21.question: What three remain here after release?
premises: Release is from expansion and contraction doubt.
Only will knowledge action remain in own bliss absorption.
mv-k01-v21.inference: The verse reduces to three powers in bliss absorption.

mv-k01-v22.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v22.question: How did teachers describe the Shaiva view?
premises: Teachers described it thus in Shaiva view.
He stands absorbed in consciousness bliss experience.
mv-k01-v22.inference: The verse attributes a description to teachers.

mv-k01-v23.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v23.question: How do will knowledge and action occur?
premises: Will knowledge and action are proportionate.
They occur by harmony of three subtle powers.
mv-k01-v23.inference: The verse links the three powers to subtle harmony.

mv-k01-v24.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v24.question: What objection is raised about supreme consciousness bliss?
premises: It would be undivided from that.
But in such world-self, contraction is abandoned.
mv-k01-v24.inference: The verse raises an objection about contraction.

mv-k01-v25.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v25.question: How can scripture riches be rooted in conceptual construction?
premises: Scripture riches are said to be rooted in conceptual construction.
All this knowledge is made of consciousness radiance.
mv-k01-v25.inference: The verse questions scripture riches while affirming consciousness knowledge.

mv-k01-v26.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v26.question: What is the essential nature of the light that shines as awareness?
premises: Awareness is connected with the nature of light.
Because of that connection, it is essentially dense with conscious reflective awareness.
The light that shines has reflective awareness as its own nature.
mv-k01-v26.inference: Therefore the shining of light is inseparable from self-reflective consciousness.

mv-k01-v27.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v27.question: Why should that reflective light not itself be the flood of scriptures?
premises: The self-reflective light is the essence of awareness.
Scriptural knowledge does not ultimately depend on external displays of reasoning.
One pierced by the supreme goddess of speech abides in that reflective light.
mv-k01-v27.inference: Therefore that reflective light itself can be the flood of scriptures for one awakened by supreme speech.

mv-k01-v28.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v28.question: Is the scriptural light variegated by ordinary worldly and māyic letters?
premises: The supreme scriptural light is not composed of worldly or māyic letter-clusters.
The revered Recognition teaching states that what abides in the self shines forth.
Self-abiding manifestation does not depend on external letter-forms.
mv-k01-v28.inference: Therefore the true scriptural manifestation is an inner shining, not an arrangement of ordinary letters.

mv-k01-v29.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v29.question: Can manifestation occur without reflective awareness of will?
premises: Reflective awareness of will proceeds in manifestation.
Knowers recognize reflective awareness as the nature of manifestation.
Without reflective awareness, manifestation would lack its own nature.
mv-k01-v29.inference: Therefore manifestation necessarily includes reflective awareness and cannot occur without it.

mv-k01-v30.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v30.question: Is object-tinged light merely like an inert jewel, or does it involve conscious wonder?
premises: Light may appear object-tinged, like a jewel reflecting something.
Any reflective awareness falls within the range of the wonder of consciousness.
Conscious wonder distinguishes living awareness from inert reflection.
mv-k01-v30.inference: Therefore even object-tinged manifestation is not merely inert but belongs to conscious reflective wonder.

mv-k01-v31.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v31.question: How does reflective awareness become clear in experiences like joy and pain?
premises: Reflective awareness can take joy, pain, and similar states as its objects.
Within that reflection there arises a surging inner grasp.
The surge of inner grasp makes the reflective awareness explicit.
mv-k01-v31.inference: Therefore affective experiences become clear through the inner surge of reflective awareness.

mv-k01-v32.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v32.question: How does an experience become fully clear and established?
premises: Reflective awareness becomes fully clear afterward through its inner development.
The teacher has stated that pleasure and similar states are established by one's own awareness.
What is established by one's own awareness stands firm without external proof.
mv-k01-v32.inference: Therefore the clarity of experience is grounded in self-awareness.

mv-k01-v33.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v33.question: Why must an experience be accepted as established by self-awareness even if not known that way at determination?
premises: At the time of later determination, the experience is not known in the same immediate way.
The experience is nevertheless established by self-awareness.
What is established by self-awareness must be accepted even when later conceptualized differently.
mv-k01-v33.inference: Therefore self-awareness is the foundational proof of experience, prior to later determination.

mv-k01-v34.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v34.question: When does the level of universal non-difference become reflectively apprehended?
premises: The same process of later clarification applies here as well.
On the path of the rising of knowledge and related powers there is a level of universal non-difference.
That level becomes effective when it reaches reflective apprehension.
mv-k01-v34.inference: Therefore the non-differentiated ground becomes manifest through reflective apprehension on the path of knowledge.

mv-k01-v35.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v35.question: How does the primordial emission attain the status of scripture?
premises: The non-differentiated level becomes reflectively apprehended.
A noble reflective portion fitting that level becomes clear.
When that clarity arises, the primordial emission takes on scriptural form.
mv-k01-v35.inference: Therefore scripturehood arises when primordial emission becomes clearly reflective.
uncertainties: prāgvisargaḥ is doctrinally loaded; rendered literally as 'primordial emission'.

mv-k01-v36.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v36.question: Can any trace of practice be discerned even in the unconditioned supreme scriptural meaning?
premises: The supreme scriptural meaning is unconditioned.
Even there, some trace of practice can be discerned.
This supports the claim that scripture arises through reflective manifestation.
mv-k01-v36.inference: Therefore the account of scripture as reflective manifestation is fitting, even at the supreme level.

mv-k01-v37.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v37.question: How does a trace of practice develop into manifold scriptural powers?
premises: The trace of practice contains the future powers of knowledge and the rest in the abode of clearness.
Through coloring or conditioning, that trace becomes differentiated.
Differentiation expands it into manifold forms.
mv-k01-v37.inference: Therefore the manifold powers of scripture unfold from an initially subtle trace through conditioning.

mv-k01-v38.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v38.question: How can one reality appear in varied forms without losing its identity?
premises: A face appears differently in water, a mirror, a jewel, or a sword.
The appearances may be trembling, round, subtle, long, and so forth.
The variation belongs to the medium of manifestation, not to the face itself.
mv-k01-v38.inference: Therefore the supreme reality can appear in manifold forms through different media without losing its nature.

mv-k01-v39.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v39.question: What is the character of the treasures of knowledge in the supreme form?
premises: In the supreme form, treasures of knowledge arise.
They are beautiful with the unlimited triad of heart, seed, and self.
Their arising in the supreme form preserves their non-limited unity.
mv-k01-v39.inference: Therefore the supreme treasures of knowledge are unified expressions of the heart-seed-self triad.
uncertainties: hṛdayabījātmatraya is a technical Trika triad; rendered literally.

mv-k01-v40.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v40.question: What happens when Bhairava, expanded by power, desires to emit the floods of beings?
premises: Bhairava is expanded by power.
He may desire to emit floods of beings.
Those beings arise as inner waves of his own surging form.
mv-k01-v40.inference: Therefore manifestation of beings is an emission of Bhairava's own power, not an external creation.

mv-k01-v41.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v41.question: What happens to the treasures of cognition when manifestation is emitted?
premises: The same treasures of cognition remain present at the moment of emission.
They take on a constraint born from limiting conditions.
That constraint appears as slight activity and practice.
mv-k01-v41.inference: Therefore differentiated practice is an apparent conditioning of the same cognitive treasures, not a different reality.

mv-k01-v42.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v42.question: Does assuming identity with the waves of manifestation alter the ground of awareness?
premises: The cognitive treasures appear to assume identity with the flood of waves.
This occurs within awareness-Bhairava.
Awareness-Bhairava remains beautiful with the bliss of the world.
mv-k01-v42.inference: Therefore even apparent identification with manifested waves does not depart from the blissful ground of awareness.

mv-k01-v43.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v43.question: How can the power-holder state be set aside while power remains full?
premises: Awareness-Bhairava is satisfied with the mere fullness of being and possesses power.
By its own full power, the distinct state of the power-holder is set aside.
This setting aside occurs within the same powerful reality.
mv-k01-v43.inference: Therefore the distinction between power and power-holder is an internal play of the one full power.

mv-k01-v44.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v44.question: What kind of knowledge stream unfolds when reflective awareness becomes dominant?
premises: A stream of knowledge whose nature is reflective awareness unfolds.
Within that stream, delight arises through the teaching of enjoyment.
The unfolding is not dry cognition but reflective and blissful.
mv-k01-v44.inference: Therefore the unfolding of knowledge in this state is inseparable from reflective delight.

mv-k01-v45.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v45.question: How can even enjoyment become a state of liberation for the fortunate?
premises: Enjoyment can be nourished by confidence in the conduct of awareness.
For the fortunate, this confidence transforms the meaning of enjoyment.
Transformed enjoyment no longer binds but leads to the highest good.
mv-k01-v45.inference: Therefore even the multitude of enjoyments can become a path to liberation when grounded in awareness.

mv-k01-v46.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v46.question: What is said to be the deity's delight in worship in this context?
premises: A cited teaching describes the deity's delight in worship.
That delight is full of the stirring arousal of the deity's own primordial power.
It arises especially from among the Mothers.
mv-k01-v46.inference: Therefore worship here is grounded in the arousal of the deity's own power, especially as expressed through the Mothers.
uncertainties: mātṛmadhyataḥ refers to the Mothers; specific group left literal.

mv-k01-v47.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v47.question: How is the deity of cognitive greatness manifested and unfolded?
premises: By the surge of sovereign power, the lordly state is obtained.
The deity whose greatness is cognition becomes manifested.
This manifestation is unfolded as the present teaching.
mv-k01-v47.inference: Therefore the deity's unfolded form is the manifestation of sovereign cognitive power.

mv-k01-v48.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v48.question: Why does the joining and separating of infinite portions of beings become countless?
premises: Infinite portions of beings are joined and separated.
This occurs through connection with the non-difference of the prior state.
The prior non-differentiated ground prevents any fixed numerical limit.
mv-k01-v48.inference: Therefore the combinations of manifested beings are countless because they arise from a non-differentiated ground.
uncertainties: upāśrite is read as expressing attainment in this context; morphology is compact.

mv-k01-v49.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v49.question: How do scriptural ritual and cognitive powers spread without consciousness-knowledge?
premises: Simply by force of that adjunct they spread.
They are devoid of the consciousness-knowledge state.
They are the various powers of scripture action and knowledge.
mv-k01-v49.inference: Adjunct-force spreads scripture-action-knowledge powers devoid of saṃvit.
uncertainties: The that-adjunct referent carried from context.
Exact scope of powers left open.

mv-k01-v50.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v50.question: Why is the main world discussed as fivefold?
premises: The main world is discussed here.
It is treated as fivefold.
The truth remains undivided.
mv-k01-v50.inference: The fivefold discussion does not divide the one truth.
uncertainties: Token punctuation rows are editorial markers.

mv-k01-v51.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v51.question: How do these sentence collections establish the point?
premises: Active lordship is mentioned.
Directing the lacking is mentioned.
Desire cessation and self-abiding are mentioned.
mv-k01-v51.inference: The collections of sentences establish the point through these stated grounds.
uncertainties: Compound boundaries are interpreted for gloss only.

mv-k01-v52.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v52.question: Do place time and art differences arise in this context?
premises: The context is limited.
Place time and art made differences are considered.
They do not arise.
mv-k01-v52.inference: In this context, such differences do not arise.
uncertainties: The interjection om is treated as indeclinable.

mv-k01-v53.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v53.question: Is time principle merely a name here?
premises: Time principle is not merely manifested here.
Even great time power does not expand here.
mv-k01-v53.inference: Time is not operative as a real differentiator here.
uncertainties: vaibhavy may be read as greatness or manifestation.

mv-k01-v54.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v54.question: What is this grasp of speech reasoning?
premises: The undivided full self is considered.
Then after and again are questioned.
The other is invoked.
mv-k01-v54.inference: The verse questions the coherence of this speech reasoning.

mv-k01-v55.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v55.question: What do we say about reality and clear self?
premises: We say truth indeed.
In reality, in clear self.
Even in expanded principle creation and time.
mv-k01-v55.inference: The statement holds even in expanded creation and time.

mv-k01-v56.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v56.question: Why do prior and later alternatives not exist for awareness?
premises: These prior-later alternatives do not exist for awareness.
Time becomes differentiator as qualifier.
mv-k01-v56.inference: Awareness has no prior-later alternatives because time differentiates only as qualifier.

mv-k01-v57.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v57.question: How does qualifier become knowability by difference?
premises: That qualifier is said.
It goes to knowability by difference.
As blue lotus.
mv-k01-v57.inference: Qualifier becomes knowability by difference, like blue lotus.

mv-k01-v58.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v58.question: Why is awareness never knowable?
premises: Knowability of awareness is never possible.
Knowability is appearing-ness.
That comes by clarity grace.
mv-k01-v58.inference: Awareness itself is not knowable; knowability belongs to appearing clarity.
uncertainties: The relation of tat is compressed.

mv-k01-v59.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v59.question: Why would another awareness cause regress?
premises: Clarity and awareness are not separate.
If another awareness stood, clarity rules would proceed.
Surely regress would proceed.
mv-k01-v59.inference: Positing another awareness leads to regress.
uncertainties: The double sa is retained as given.

mv-k01-v60.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v60.question: Why are those deluded who call awareness non-first-appearing?
premises: Deluded ones call awareness non-first-appearing.
They say it is object-appearance-natured.
They are cheated by own words.
mv-k01-v60.inference: Such a view of awareness is self-defeating.

mv-k01-v61.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v61.question: Why is time not a differentiator of awareness?
premises: Time is not fit for differentiating awareness.
Nor is that time able to become differentiator of knowable.
mv-k01-v61.inference: Time cannot differentiate awareness or knowable.

mv-k01-v62.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v62.question: Why does the universe shine only as awareness?
premises: The universe is not different from awareness.
Otherwise it would not shine.
Pervaded by clarity, variegated being shines.
mv-k01-v62.inference: The universe shines only as non-different from awareness.

mv-k01-v63.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v63.question: How does universe clarity become eternal?
premises: Universe clarity would be thus.
It is eternal for all.
When clarity named awareness is present, it attains clarity-ness.
mv-k01-v63.inference: Universe clarity is eternal through awareness-named clarity.

mv-k01-v64.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v64.question: What if an unlit being is known as clarity-self?
premises: Even unlit being, if clarity-self, is known.
But that unlit being, thus, here refuge is darkness.
mv-k01-v64.inference: Calling unlit being clarity-self leads to darkness as refuge.

mv-k01-v65.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v65.question: What happens if unlit being-self is made clarity-self?
premises: Who is unlit being-self, if made clarity-self.
Surely that being would be destroyed.
From loss of self-clarity.
mv-k01-v65.inference: Making unlit being into clarity-self destroys it.

mv-k01-v66.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v66.question: Can rule make clarity not of that form?
premises: Even rule is not able to make clarity not of that form.
But this much, this being shines when clarity is present.
mv-k01-v66.inference: Clarity cannot be made otherwise; being shines in clarity.

mv-k01-v67.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v67.question: What if unlit becomes clarity-ness?
premises: Let this be indeed.
But thus unlit clarity-ness.
Of being and in unlit-ness, when made clear and present.
mv-k01-v67.inference: The verse poses the condition of unlit becoming clarity-ness.

mv-k01-v68.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v68.question: Why is a separately manifested entity not the state of things?
premises: manifestation is not separate from shiva
thing-state follows shiva's light
mv-k01-v68.inference: therefore shiva himself is the light

mv-k01-v69.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v69.question: Why is supreme shiva identified with light itself?
premises: light is shiva
shiva has inconceivable glory
freedom sways him

mv-k01-v70.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v70.question: Why is all-knowingness not suspected everywhere here?
premises: light shines through natures
state remains unfailing
all-knowingness is not suspected
mv-k01-v70.inference: therefore manifestation is stable without universal suspicion

mv-k01-v71.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mv-k01-v71.question: How do limited knowers differ in knowing pot and cloth?
premises: caitra knows pot not cloth
this one knows cloth not pot

mv-k03-v311.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

mv-k03-v315.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

they consider consciousness-only
agency is impossible

mv-k03-v317.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
