mv-k01-v126.plain_english: Yet even so he never at any time attains separateness in the ultimate sense — for he is all-at-once, of the nature of consciousness. But surely — O essence of densely packed being-awareness — in awareness, that what I do here is strange, or that I know: would not others too, ordinary Mitras and Caitras, do the same? Or how would they not know?
mv-k01-v126.sanskrit_cite:
na tathāpi ca yāti bhinnatāṃ
paramārthena kadācid eva saḥ /
yugapat sa hi saṃvidātmakaḥ

nanv ittham ekaghanabhāvavimarśasār saṃvedane yad aham eṣa karomi citraḥ /
jānāmi vā tad apare 'pi na maitracaitraprāyā vidadhyur athavāpi kathaṃ na vidyuḥ // [AgMsv_1.127]

mv-k01-v127.plain_english: 'Ah! Here, good sirs, is the very dense knot of māyā. This we declare: here there is neither own nor other, one undivided. 'I know' — that is but the manifestation of a pot-particular; manifold variegated forth-arisings shine in the supreme, thus it is told.
mv-k01-v127.sanskrit_cite:
aho māyāgranthir nibiḍatama eṣo 'tra bhavatām idaṃ hi prabrūmaḥ svaparam iha nāsty ekam abhidam /
ahaṃ vedmīty eṣā ghaṭatanuviśeṣaprakaṭatā prathāś citrākārāḥ paramahasi bhāntīti kathitam // [AgMsv_1.128]

mv-k01-v128.plain_english: Therefore in 'I know the pot' there is no difference at all. But surely — 'this pot appears to me' — difference does manifest! Not so — for him this very pot is Śiva, just so.
mv-k01-v128.sanskrit_cite:
tasmād ghaṭaṃ vedmy aham ity amutra bhedo na kaścin nanu me ghaṭo 'yam /
bhātīti bhedapratibhānam asti naitan na tasyaiṣa śivas tathāyam // [AgMsv_1.129]

mv-k01-v129.plain_english: Therefore those headed by Dvaipāyana declared in their own scriptural domains that mine-making itself is death — by way of giving refutation.
mv-k01-v129.sanskrit_cite:
ata eva dvaipāyanamukhyās teṣu svaśāstradeśeṣu /
mamakāram eva mṛtyuṃ khaṇḍanadāyitvataḥ prāhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.130]

mv-k01-v130.plain_english: Thus, born of the coloring produced by the time-reckoning adjunct, set forth beginning with 'that' — consciousnesses, even in the supreme principle.
mv-k01-v130.sanskrit_cite:
tad evaṃ kālakalanopādhijātoparāgajāḥ /
tadetyādi pratāyante paratattve 'pi saṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_1.131]

mv-k01-v131.plain_english: Therein, from being of full one nature, all is everywhere too — for otherwise, division being inapplicable, fullness would not be full.
mv-k01-v131.sanskrit_cite:
tatra pūrṇaikarūpatvāt sarvaṃ sarvatra cāpi tat /
anyathā khaṇḍanāyogān na pūrṇā pūrṇatā bhavet // [AgMsv_1.132]

mv-k01-v132.plain_english: Thence, in fullness, in the abode of all-enduring Bhairava: this five-natured teaching-meaning is the Śāmbhavas — on the abiding of śakti and atom-soul.
mv-k01-v132.sanskrit_cite:
tataḥ pūrṇatayā sarvaṃsahabhairavadhāmani /
pañcātmako 'yaṃ śāstrārthaḥ śāmbhavaḥ. śaktyaṇusthitim // [AgMsv_1.133]

mv-k01-v133.plain_english: Having established the supreme goddess, this one abides, surpassed in himself; thus, desirous of emitting beings, from the state of the emitter.
mv-k01-v133.sanskrit_cite:
nyakkṛtyaiṣa parāṃ devīṃ svātmany udrecya vartate /
itthaṃ sa visisṛkṣuḥ san bhāvān visraṣṭṛtāpadāt // [AgMsv_1.134]

mv-k01-v134.plain_english: Formerly he resorted to the surging-bliss-dense state; but in the emitter-state this one shares even in emission-absorption.
mv-k01-v134.sanskrit_cite:
pūrvam ucchalitānandaghanām abhajata sthitim /
visraṣṭṛtāpade tv eṣa visargāveśabhāg api // [AgMsv_1.135]

mv-k01-v135.plain_english: While about to become empty, he is still filled with the entry of bliss-power's partial emission.
mv-k01-v135.sanskrit_cite:
riktībhaviṣyann ānandaghanayā pūrṇayā citā /
tāvad ānandaśaktyaṃśavisargāveśanirbharaḥ // [AgMsv_1.136]

mv-k01-v136.plain_english: Present and full of his own power-flow, he became and will be power-depleted, as triple-self varied experience.
mv-k01-v136.sanskrit_cite:
vartamānaḥ svaśaktyoghapūrṇaś cābhūd bhaviṣyati /
riktaśaktir iti tryātmacitrasaṃvedanātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.137]

mv-k01-v137.plain_english: Then he, god of gods, would clearly stand in the creator station; what stands in the present portion, past and future?
mv-k01-v137.sanskrit_cite:
tadāsau devadevaḥ syād visraṣṭari pade sphuṭam /
nanu kiṃ vartamānāṃśe saṃsto bhūtabhaviṣyatī // [AgMsv_1.138]

mv-k01-v138.plain_english: What indeed is known by you? Even in independence, can past and future be divided by a present boundary?
mv-k01-v138.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃ nāma bhavatā jñātaṃ te svatantre 'pi ke cana /
vartamānāvadher bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyac ca vibhajyate // [AgMsv_1.139]

mv-k01-v139.plain_english: That which has not rested where cannot be divided; whence and how could a boundary state of the present be toward you?
mv-k01-v139.sanskrit_cite:
yac ca yatra na viśrāntaṃ tad vibhajyeta vai kutaḥ /
kathaṃ cāvadhibhāvaḥ syād vartamānasya te prati // [AgMsv_1.140]

mv-k01-v140.plain_english: How could boundedness of those two be, even toward that? Is the universe a boundary, or does it arise similarly? Not what?
mv-k01-v140.sanskrit_cite:
tayor avadhimattvaṃ vā tat praty api kathaṃ bhavet /
viśvasya viśvam avadhis tadvad vā jāyate na kim // [AgMsv_1.141]

mv-k01-v141.plain_english: Therefore past and future are rooted in present-named consciousness; if one brings rest there only.
mv-k01-v141.sanskrit_cite:
tasmād bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyac ca vartamānākhyasaṃvidi /
rūḍham eveti tatraiva yadi viśrāntim āvahet // [AgMsv_1.142]

mv-k01-v142.plain_english: If here only the whole array of conceptual rays is not expanded, for a moment one would stand with restrained own state.
mv-k01-v142.sanskrit_cite:
yadi cātraiva nikhilakalpanāraśmimaṇḍalam /
avisphārya kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhet saṃniruddhanijasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.143]

mv-k01-v143.plain_english: That obtains a single tasting of own nectar-expansion wonder, carrying supreme bliss-nectar abundance.

mv-k01-v144.plain_english: Thus indeed the moon would be full of sun-ray union; when then it does not again wish to emit sun-rays.
mv-k01-v144.sanskrit_cite:
tathā hi sūryaraśmyoghapūrṇaḥ syāc candramā yadā /
tadā sūryakarān bhūyo yāvan na visisṛkṣati // [AgMsv_1.145]

mv-k01-v145.plain_english: So long, resting well in enjoyment of its own orb for a moment, it is called a vessel for satisfying portions of inner world-gods.
mv-k01-v145.sanskrit_cite:
tāvat svamaṇḍalābhoge kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntisusthitaḥ /
antaḥsthaviśvadevāṃśatarpaṇāpātram ucyate // [AgMsv_1.146]

mv-k01-v146.plain_english: Thus, in the heart interior, the moon of own awareness is present, shone upon by the cluster of rays of the sun of being-light.

mv-k01-v147.plain_english: Rested in the beautiful inner abundant nectar of consciousness, filled with inner own nectar, it is not vomited outside, because.
mv-k01-v147.sanskrit_cite:
viśrānto 'ntaḥsthitodāracitsudhāsārasundare /
antaḥsthasvāmṛtāpūro vamyate na bahir yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.148]

mv-k01-v148.plain_english: From that, only inside, that one, revolving and rising, consists of I-awareness satisfying the inner wheel of gods.

mv-k01-v149.plain_english: As long as it is raised, so long the own sense-process arises, while restrained in the ray-sheet by union of prosperity and absence.
mv-k01-v149.sanskrit_cite:
jāyate yāvad uddāmyet tāvat svakaraṇakramaḥ /
niruddhe raśmipaṭale vibhavābhāvayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.150]

mv-k01-v150.plain_english: Past and future are not divided from the present; as long as there is non-division of those two, what is present-ness?
mv-k01-v150.sanskrit_cite:
na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyac ca vartamānād vibhajyate /
avibhāgas tayor yāvat tāvat kā vartamānatā // [AgMsv_1.151]

mv-k02-v151.plain_english: Time is divided by past and future; therefore, having rested in this limit of consciousness, one abides in a mere instant.
mv-k02-v151.sanskrit_cite:
bhūtabhāvisvabhāvābhyāṃ sā hi yāti vibhāgitām /
tad asmin saṃvidavadhau viśramya tuṭimātrakam // [AgMsv_1.152]

mv-k02-v152.plain_english: The yogin devoted to devouring time becomes a sky-mover in an instant; for time is the appearance of things, and that is of the nature of limitation.
mv-k02-v152.sanskrit_cite:
kālagrāsaparo yogī jāyate khecaraḥ kṣaṇāt /
uktaṃ hi bhāvābhāso yaḥ kālaḥ sa kalanātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.153]

mv-k02-v153.plain_english: Being and nonbeing are nothing other than the expansion of the rays of one's own consciousness; therefore, by stopping one's own rays, the whole sphere of paths is blocked.
mv-k02-v153.sanskrit_cite:
svasaṃvidraśmisaṃsphāro bhāvābhāvaḥ sa nāparaḥ /
tasmāt svaraśmisaṃrodhadvāraruddhādhvamaṇḍalaḥ // [AgMsv_1.154]

mv-k02-v154.plain_english: One who solely relishes the devouring of time becomes a sky-mover by himself; this is said by the Supreme Lord in the tantra called Śrīḍāmara.
mv-k02-v154.sanskrit_cite:
kālagrāsaikarasiko jāyate khecaraḥ svayam /
tad uktaṃ parameśena tantre śrīḍāmarābhidhe // [AgMsv_1.155]

mv-k02-v155.plain_english: Having restrained one's own circle of rays and drunk the unsurpassed nectar, one becomes happy in the present that is not limited by time or by both its extremes.
mv-k02-v155.sanskrit_cite:
niruddhya raśmicakraṃ svaṃ pītvāmṛtam anuttamam /
kālobhayāparicchinne vartamāne sukhī bhavet // [AgMsv_1.156]

mv-k02-v156.plain_english: Even restraint does not truly exist in that state free from contraction; and because of that absence, expansion does not exist either—so how could devouring and satisfaction exist there?
mv-k02-v156.sanskrit_cite:
rodho 'pi nāma naitasmin saṃkocaparivarjite /
tadabhāvān na visphāro grāsatṛptī tathātra ke // [AgMsv_1.157]

mv-k02-v157.plain_english: But by the method already described, restraint, expansion, devouring, and the rest do appear; yet from such appearance no other thing exists anywhere in the universe.
mv-k02-v157.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃ tūktanītyā saṃrodhasphāragrāsādi bhāsate /
na tathābhāsanāc cānyad vastu viśvatra kiṃ cana // [AgMsv_1.158]

mv-k02-v158.plain_english: Thus, enough of this extensive talk about the assembly of the khecarī circle; for in this teaching of Abhinavagupta, what yoga is there apart from the process of awareness?
mv-k02-v158.sanskrit_cite:
ity alaṃ khecarīcakragoṣṭhyālāpena bhūyasā /
ko vābhinavagupte 'smin yogaḥ saṃvedanakrame // [AgMsv_1.159]

mv-k02-v159.plain_english: Let us return to the topic: as far as the variegated consciousnesses emitted by the Goddess extend, so far above them is that higher and higher stream which is free from division.
mv-k02-v159.sanskrit_cite:
prakṛtaṃ brūmahe devīvisṛṣṭāś citrasaṃvidaḥ /
yāvat tāvad tad ūrdhvordhvaṃ sroto yad bhedavarjitam // [AgMsv_1.160]

mv-k02-v160.plain_english: From that stream arose scriptures such as the Saura and the Bhargaśikhā; and this is said in the Bhargaśikhā by the Supreme Lord.
mv-k02-v160.sanskrit_cite:
saurabhargaśikhādīni tataḥ śāstrāṇi tenire /
uktaṃ bhargaśikhāyāṃ ca devena parameṣṭhinā // [AgMsv_1.161]

mv-k02-v161.plain_english: ‘O beloved, this knowledge born of the upper stream is that supreme knowledge’—so it is taught by that which expresses higher and higher forms of consciousness on the supreme path.
mv-k02-v161.sanskrit_cite:
ūrdhvasrotodbhavaṃ jñānam idaṃ tat paramaṃ priye /
paramadhvaninordhvordhvasaṃvidrūpābhidhāyinā // [AgMsv_1.162]

mv-k02-v162.plain_english: It indicated a distinction from the Siddhānta issued from the face of Īśāna; and even here there are variegations produced by the unmixed aspects of earlier divisions.
mv-k02-v162.sanskrit_cite:
īśānavaktraniryātāt siddhāntād bhedam ādiśat /
atrāpi pūrvabhedāṃśavyāmiśrībhāvacitritāḥ // [AgMsv_1.163]

mv-k02-v163.plain_english: Those various treasures of knowledge extend into diverse scriptural manifestations; but here the chief lineage of scriptures is sixfold in nature.
mv-k02-v163.sanskrit_cite:
vijñānasaṃpadas tāṃs tāṃs tanvate śāstravibhramān /
iha yāvat tu mukhyeyaṃ ṣaḍātmā śāstrasaṃtatiḥ // [AgMsv_1.164]

mv-k02-v164.plain_english: Those Trika scriptures that belong to the first half of this lineage are the ones the teachers have clearly spoken of under the name Ṣaḍardha.
mv-k02-v164.sanskrit_cite:
etatpūrvārdhabhāgīni trikaśāstrāṇi yāni tu /
ṣaḍardhasaṃjñayā tāni gurubhir bhāṣitāny alam // [AgMsv_1.165]

mv-k02-v165.plain_english: But this mode of expression is not used merely because the doctrine is deeply secret; for in that case, why could one not also say ‘half of half of twelve’ and so on?
mv-k02-v165.sanskrit_cite:
na tu gūḍharahasyatvād evaiṣa vacanakramaḥ /
evaṃ hi dvādaśārdhārdham ityādy api na kiṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.166]

mv-k02-v166.plain_english: Here the triad of powers is primary; it constitutes a complete abiding without mutual obstruction, full and of the nature of full consciousness.
mv-k02-v166.sanskrit_cite:
atra śaktitrayaṃ mukhyaṃ saṃpūrṇasthiti kalpate /
ananyonyoparodhena pūrṇaṃ pūrṇacidātmakam // [AgMsv_1.167]

mv-k02-v167.plain_english: Beyond that, when in one power the triad takes on subordination and in another it partakes of subordination, that configuration is described as the yāmala.
mv-k02-v167.sanskrit_cite:
tataḥ paraṃ tu tritayaṃ kasyāṃcid guṇitājuṣi /
anyasyāṃ guṇatābhāji yāmalaṃ paribhāṣyate // [AgMsv_1.168]

mv-k02-v168.plain_english: Afterward, when the mass of objects has been emitted, through connection with the conditions of its variegation it appears in the five powers of one's own self, which are not divided into separate beings.
mv-k02-v168.sanskrit_cite:
paścād visṛṣṭe 'rthaughe tadvaicitryopādhiyogataḥ /
pṛthagbhāvaviyogāsu svātmaśaktiṣu pañcasu // [AgMsv_1.169]

mv-k02-v169.plain_english: In those five powers whose forms are consciousness, vibration, will, knowledge, and action, by the force of their own appropriateness and through the grace of the five Brahman-limbs, there arises what is born from the awareness of the flashing aspects of being.

mv-k02-v170.plain_english: That form, having attained the nature of scripture, unfolds indeed in a fivefold way; for first there is the unfolding of the mass of beings situated within Ananta.
mv-k02-v170.sanskrit_cite:
rūpaṃ śāstrātmatāṃ prāptaṃ pañcadhaiva vijṛmbhate /
tathā hi prāg anantāntaḥsthitabhāvaughajṛmbhaṇam // [AgMsv_1.171]

mv-k02-v171.plain_english: As long as the Lord brings about that unfolding, there is abiding in the face of Īśa, in the unfolding of the inward, undivided power of action.
mv-k02-v171.sanskrit_cite:
yāvat karoti bhagavāṃs tāvad īśamukhasthitiḥ /
antaḥsthāyā abhinnāyāḥ kriyāśakter vijṛmbhaṇe // [AgMsv_1.172]

mv-k02-v172.plain_english: As it opens gradually, this expansion extends; and when the expansion of the power of action becomes clear, it will attain the state of māyā.
mv-k02-v172.sanskrit_cite:
kramād unmiṣite tāvān eṣa sphāraḥ pratāyate /
kriyāśakteḥ sphuṭaḥ sphāro māyātvaṃ pratipatsyate // [AgMsv_1.173]

mv-k02-v173.plain_english: In the own form of maya-tattva, it will be said of shiva and ishani as makers of pure, pure-other, impure universes.

mv-k02-v174.plain_english: For the five-mantra-bodied shambhu, measurable impure association exists; indeed all is established at the prior extreme.
mv-k02-v174.sanskrit_cite:
pañcamantratanoḥ śambhor nirmeyāśuddhasaṃgatiḥ /
asty eva pūrvakoṭyāṃ hi sarvam eva vyavasthitam // [AgMsv_1.175]

mv-k02-v175.plain_english: Thus, for one wishing to go somewhere from his own house, at the first moment, whatever is to be gone, and the middle course, but.
mv-k02-v175.sanskrit_cite:
tathā hi svagṛhāt kvāpi yiyāsoḥ prathamakṣaṇe /
yāvat kiṃ cana gantavyaṃ yac ca tanmadhyavṛtti tu // [AgMsv_1.176]

mv-k02-v176.plain_english: Even at an instant's fall, all-knowing all-making power is gained from that for the steady skillful selves of special parts.

mv-k02-v177.plain_english: Thus, measured by birth-sword-edge touch, at the same time as shining, intellect draws forth special parts.
mv-k02-v177.sanskrit_cite:
tathā hi jātyakhaḍgāgradhārāsaṃsparśasaṃmitā /
sphurattvasamakālaṃ dhīr viśeṣāṃśān prakarṣati // [AgMsv_1.178]

mv-k02-v178.plain_english: The clear knower of jewel-tattva gathers those special parts seen like lightning, even among many jewels.
mv-k02-v178.sanskrit_cite:
ratnatattvasphuṭaprajño vidyuttatkāladarśitān /
tāṃs tān viśeṣāṃś cinute ratnānāṃ bhūyasām api // [AgMsv_1.179]

mv-k02-v179.plain_english: In the vina joined with many sound-material touches, variety is known in one expansion by one made of that.
mv-k02-v179.sanskrit_cite:
anekasvarasaṃbhārasparśalāghavayojite /
vīṇāyām ekavistāre vaicitryaṃ vetti tanmayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.180]

mv-k02-v180.plain_english: The hearing sense rested at the tip of dense practice stream indeed knows even that sound-part inner hearing less-more-ness.

mv-k02-v181.plain_english: Let it be; in this nondifference doctrine, this succeeds effortlessly, where even in difference shining real nondual.
mv-k02-v181.sanskrit_cite:
āstām abhedavāde 'sminn ayatnenaiva siddhyati /
etad yatra vibhāte 'pi bhede vāstavam advayam // [AgMsv_1.182]

mv-k02-v182.plain_english: In difference-only-living scripture, this is clearly stood; for by Patanjali in the pada named powers.
mv-k02-v182.sanskrit_cite:
bhedaikajīvite śāstre yāvad etad sthitaṃ sphuṭam /
tathā hi pātañjalinā pāde vaibhūtanāmani // [AgMsv_1.183]

mv-k02-v183.plain_english: It was formed, 'from intuition or all'; here by me too, in intuition at first opening, consciousness-formed undivided.
mv-k02-v183.sanskrit_cite:
nyarūpyata `prātibhād vā sarvam' atra mayāpi ca /
prātibhe prathamonmeṣe saṃvidrūpiṇy akhaṇḍite // [AgMsv_1.184]

mv-k02-v184.plain_english: Thus the all-shining self, source of all accomplishment, stands in the created world, where creation is accepted by force.
mv-k02-v184.sanskrit_cite:
sthitaḥ sarvasphurattātmā sarvasiddhiphalodayaḥ /
evaṃ jagati nirmeye nirmitsāsvīkṛtaṃ balāt // [AgMsv_1.185]

mv-k02-v185.plain_english: Even impurity, fit for varied forms of that shape, appears in common form as a part beautiful as difference-self.
mv-k02-v185.sanskrit_cite:
aśuddham api tadrūpanānāvaicitryayogy api /
sāmānyākārarūpeṇa dalaṃ bhedātmasundaram // [AgMsv_1.186]

mv-k02-v186.plain_english: This difference-nondifference state stands bloomed; therefore it is in sadākhya, the nature of knowledge-power.
mv-k02-v186.sanskrit_cite:
āste pronmiṣitaṃ saiṣā bhedābhedātmikā sthitiḥ /
ata eva hi sādākhye jñānaśaktisvarūpiṇi // [AgMsv_1.187]

mv-k02-v187.plain_english: From impurity-particle-stain, state becomes higher-lower; even those reaching higher station arise from what is enjoyed by the lord.
mv-k02-v187.sanskrit_cite:
aśuddhileśakāluṣyāt parāparatayā sthitiḥ /
teneśabhuktād etasmād apy ūrdhvapadabhāginaḥ // [AgMsv_1.188]

mv-k02-v188.plain_english: From eagerness to manifest māyā, those enjoying its impressions thus receive various counsel full of many action-beginnings.

mv-k02-v189.plain_english: Manifested from the great knowledge continuum and giving śiva, that state is there; another state is merged in the supreme state.
mv-k02-v189.sanskrit_cite:
prādurbhūtaṃ mahājñānasantateś ca śivapradam /
sa hi tatrāparo bhāvaḥ parabhāvanimīlitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.190]

mv-k02-v190.plain_english: But growth would not be attained in impure higher rite, like those fixed in other doctrines such as Vaiṣṇava and Buddhist.
mv-k02-v190.sanskrit_cite:
na tu rūḍhim upāgacched aśuddhordhvavidhāv iva /
tena vaiṣṇavabauddhādiśāsanāntaraniṣṭhitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.191]

mv-k02-v191.plain_english: As others are not properly liberated, so Śaiva-purified ones are not; they are in streams beyond path, order, triad, and others.
mv-k02-v191.sanskrit_cite:
yathā samyaṅ na mucyante na tathā śaivasaṃskṛtāḥ /
atimārgakramakulatrikasrotontarādiṣu // [AgMsv_1.192]

mv-k02-v192.plain_english: But for men properly initiated in the supreme lord's scripture, there is no difference at all in obtaining liberation.
mv-k02-v192.sanskrit_cite:
parameśānaśāstre tu ye samyag dīkṣitā narāḥ /
teṣāṃ naivāpavargasya lābhe bhedo 'sti kaś cana // [AgMsv_1.193]

mv-k02-v193.plain_english: Nor is there any means of liberation beyond this; only somewhere by effortless living-liberation order.
mv-k02-v193.sanskrit_cite:
na caitadatirikto 'pi mokṣopāyo 'sti kaś cana /
kevalaṃ kvāpy anāyāsāj jīvanmuktikrameṇa ca // [AgMsv_1.194]

mv-k02-v194.plain_english: Supreme accomplishment is indeed quick, as in our views; but somewhere, by the order of truth-series yoga, it comes only after long time.
mv-k02-v194.sanskrit_cite:
śīghram eva parā siddhir yathāsmaddarśaneṣv iti /
kvāpi tattvāvalīyogaparipāṭīkramāc cirāt // [AgMsv_1.195]

mv-k02-v195.plain_english: By those ritual parts the supreme fruit is obtained; therefore even here there is a kaulika view for destruction-seers.
mv-k02-v195.sanskrit_cite:
tais taiḥ kriyākalāpaiś ca labhyate paramaṃ phalam /
ata evāsti saṃhāradṛśām kauliky apīha dṛk // [AgMsv_1.196]

mv-k02-v196.plain_english: As stated, one should initiate dog-cookers at the beginning of time; the five consciousness-unfoldings formerly existed before difference.
mv-k02-v196.sanskrit_cite:
yathoktaṃ kālapādādau dīkṣayec chvapacān iti /
cidunmeṣādikāḥ pañca yāḥ pūrvaṃ prāgabhedataḥ // [AgMsv_1.197]

mv-k02-v197.plain_english: Declared in supreme Bhairava by union, those powers are differentiated through parts of being-limitation.
mv-k02-v197.sanskrit_cite:
proktāḥ parasmiṃś cinnāthe bhairave samavāyataḥ /
tā eva bhāvopādhyaṃśalabdhabhedavibhāvitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.198]

mv-k02-v198.plain_english: The difference-part alone is nourished, even by those enjoying before difference; thus rice-enjoyment nourishes the body.
mv-k02-v198.sanskrit_cite:
bhedāṃśam eva puṣṇanti prāgabhedajuṣo 'py alam /
tathā hy odanasaṃbhogo yo dehasyopacāyakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.199]

mv-k02-v199.plain_english: By phlegm accumulation that depletes the body; but even in god's world-self nondifference, from one's own fall.
mv-k02-v199.sanskrit_cite:
kaphasaṃcayapātena sa dehasyāpacāyakaḥ /
nanu devasya viśvātmābhede 'pi svāparicyuteḥ // [AgMsv_1.200]

mv-k02-v200.plain_english: Whence movement of capable limitations among changing things? Difference in Bhairava arises from being through that limitation-control.
mv-k02-v200.sanskrit_cite:
vikāriṣv eva yogyānām upādhīnāṃ gatiḥ kutaḥ /
tadupādhivaśād bhedo bhairave bhāvasaṃbhavāt // [AgMsv_1.201]

mv-k02-v201.plain_english: Thus it is not fitting to ascend our mind-ground; to say changing beings exist silently is indeed rashness.
mv-k02-v201.sanskrit_cite:
iti nāsmanmanobhūmāv upāroḍhum ivārhati /
tūṣṇīṃ vikāriṇo bhāvāḥ santīti hy atisāhasam // [AgMsv_1.202]

mv-k02-v202.plain_english: That god is indeed world-self and appears in such form; the undivided without limitation has divided limitation-appearance.
mv-k02-v202.sanskrit_cite:
devaḥ sa eva viśvātmā tathārūpeṇa bhāsate /
anupādher abhinnasya bhinnam aupādhibhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.203]

mv-k02-v203.plain_english: But thus that would be unreal; how is that very thing real? From such appearance, where is another real thing to be determined?
mv-k02-v203.sanskrit_cite:
nanv itthaṃ tad asatyaṃ syāt kathaṃ satyaṃ tad eva hi /
tathāvabhāsanād anyat kva kiṃ satyaṃ nirūpyatām // [AgMsv_1.204]

mv-k02-v204.plain_english: But thus is dream-world-cycle real? That indeed is devoid of desired action, unreal, yet conventionally used supremely.
mv-k02-v204.sanskrit_cite:
nanv evaṃ svapnasaṃsāraḥ kiṃ satyaṃ kiṃtv asau kila /
abhīṣṭārthakriyāvandhyo 'satyo vyavahṛtaḥ param // [AgMsv_1.205]

mv-k02-v205.plain_english: This is determined in detail ahead; therefore the unfolding power that was formerly undivided.
mv-k02-v205.sanskrit_cite:
etac cāgre prapañcena yuktiyuktaṃ nirūpyate /
tasmād unmeṣaśaktir yā pūrvam āsīd abhedinī // [AgMsv_1.206]

mv-k02-v206.plain_english: That being-unfolding nature has gone to that-person state; what is undivided is ungraspable, and what is grasping is the lord.
mv-k02-v206.sanskrit_cite:
bhāvonmeṣasvarūpāsau yātā tatpuruṣasthitim /
yad abhinnaṃ tad agrāhyaṃ yac ca grāhakam īśvaram // [AgMsv_1.207]

mv-k02-v207.plain_english: Now that standing is graspable from difference, its grasper of difference; called person, then declared from creation's beginning union.
mv-k02-v207.sanskrit_cite:
adhunā tat sthitaṃ grāhyaṃ bhedāt tadgrāhakaṃ bhidaḥ /
puruṣākhyaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ sṛṣṭeḥ prārambhayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.208]

mv-k02-v208.plain_english: From clear recognition the chief face is spoken; therefore here it destroys dispersion-being-state.
mv-k02-v208.sanskrit_cite:
susphuṭapratyabhijñānān mukhyaṃ vaktraṃ ca bhaṇyate /
ata evātra visarabhāvasthitivighātakam // [AgMsv_1.209]

mv-k02-v209.plain_english: Various disease-grasp aggregates and poisons are treated; many reasons split disease, calming and well-establishing.

mv-k02-v210.plain_english: Here beings that occur only in difference go to clarity; all being-ness indeed is this former-born face.
mv-k02-v210.sanskrit_cite:
atra susphuṭatāṃ yānti bhāvā bhedaikavṛttayaḥ /
bhāvatvam eva yat sarvaṃ tat tv idaṃ pūrvajaṃ mukham // [AgMsv_1.211]

mv-k02-v211.plain_english: From all and from excellence-rise, Ishana's upward-face-ness; in space-time-calculation void, not direction-difference imaginations.
mv-k02-v211.sanskrit_cite:
sarvataś ca guṇotkarṣād īśānasyordhvavaktratā /
dikkālakalanāśūnye na tu digbhedakalpanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.212]

mv-k02-v212.plain_english: Who indeed from which excellence-surpassing, thus upward will be; then beings when properly from desire-power.
mv-k02-v212.sanskrit_cite:
yo hi yasmād guṇotkṛṣṭa iti cordhvo bhaviṣyati /
tato bhāvān yadā samyag icchatīcchāvibhūtitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.213]

mv-k02-v213.plain_english: Ascended in that desire; if that desire is pure, by which through identity-union these touch consciousness-unity.
mv-k02-v213.sanskrit_cite:
tadecchāyāṃ samārūḍhāḥ sā cecchā caiva nirmalā /
yena tanmayatāyogāt saṃvidaikyaṃ spṛśanty amī // [AgMsv_1.214]

mv-k02-v214.plain_english: But beings hidden by limitation-superior desire-covering; then those beings stand, but god stands in own desire.
mv-k02-v214.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃtūpādhyuparaktecchāsaṃchādanatirohitāḥ /
te tadānīṃ sthitā bhāvā devas tu svaiṣaṇāsthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.215]

mv-k02-v215.plain_english: One who knows only outer consciousness does not dwell in the supreme full state, so he appears as if in deep sleep.
mv-k02-v215.sanskrit_cite:
parācīnitasaṃvittivaktro na ca parāṃ sthitim /
pūrṇām adhyuṣitas tena suṣupta iva bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.216]

mv-k02-v216.plain_english: He is not truly asleep, for his sleep is only a closing; ultimate Bhairava-bliss consciousness never sleeps.
mv-k02-v216.sanskrit_cite:
asuptaś ca prabuddhatvāt tasya svāpo nimīlanam /
na hy asti paramārthena bhairavānandasaṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_1.217]

mv-k02-v217.plain_english: When supreme light is present, where could closing shine except as its own measure?
mv-k02-v217.sanskrit_cite:
tasmin paraprakāśe hi nimīlattvam upāgate /
pralayāt tannimīlattvamitir vā kutra bhāsatām // [AgMsv_1.218]

mv-k02-v218.plain_english: No thing is unilluminated; even an imagined form shines in consciousness-light.
mv-k02-v218.sanskrit_cite:
anābhātaṃ ca no vastu vyomasadmagavākṣavat /
so 'pi vā kalpitākāraś citprakāśe prakāśate // [AgMsv_1.219]

mv-k02-v219.plain_english: This unblinking reality stands as if closing, for lords have unimaginable power that performs difficult things.
mv-k02-v219.sanskrit_cite:
tad amīlita evāyaṃ nimīlann iva tiṣṭhati /
prabhūṇām avikalpyā hi śaktir durghaṭakāriṇām // [AgMsv_1.220]

mv-k02-v220.plain_english: Some things happen with ease and some with difficulty; in this variety of appearance, he alone is autonomous.
mv-k02-v220.sanskrit_cite:
idaṃ sukhena ghaṭate duḥkhena ghaṭate tv idaṃ /
ity ābhāsanavaicitrye svatantro hi sa eva naḥ // [AgMsv_1.221]

mv-k02-v221.plain_english: His autonomy is the power called niyati; by it the bound soul is restrained and never finds autonomy.
mv-k02-v221.sanskrit_cite:
tad eva tasya svātantryaṃ śaktir niyatināmikā /
yayā ruddhaḥ paśur jātu svātantryaṃ naiva vindati // [AgMsv_1.222]

mv-k02-v222.plain_english: Because of dependence on that, difficult action is attributed to the lord; for the self of the universe nothing is easy or difficult.
mv-k02-v222.sanskrit_cite:
tadapekṣābalāt proktā patyau durghaṭakāritā /
na hi viśvātmanaḥ kiṃ cit sughaṭaṃ vātha durghaṭam // [AgMsv_1.223]

mv-k02-v223.plain_english: Why repeat this again and again when it is already established? Alas, for your forgetful nature, otherwise it would be useless.
mv-k02-v223.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃ muhur muhur etenāsakṛn nanu nirūpitam /
hantāvismṛtiśīlaṃ tvāṃ praty etat syād apārthakam // [AgMsv_1.224]

mv-k02-v224.plain_english: Effort aimed at one thing does not shine; rainy-season clouds do not arise for the prosperity of a single sprout.
mv-k02-v224.sanskrit_cite:
ekam uddiśya kiṃtv etatsaṃrambho na virājate /
kiṃ hy ekāṅkurasaṃpattyai prāvṛṣeṇyāḥ payomucaḥ // [AgMsv_1.225]

mv-k02-v225.plain_english: This is the vital spot here; the person to be instructed is pervaded in the heart-ground, drawn by a mass of action, through delicacy.
mv-k02-v225.sanskrit_cite:
marmasthānam idaṃ cātra vyutpādyo hi janaḥ sa ca /
vyāpto hṛdbhuvi karmaughakṛṣṭāyāṃ saukumāryataḥ // [AgMsv_1.226]

mv-k02-v226.plain_english: Endless sprouts and shoots rise from the maya seed, served by speech-fitness born of pride in difference.

mv-k02-v227.plain_english: As long as the great forest-fire of knowledge is not obtained, his duality grows again and again.
mv-k02-v227.sanskrit_cite:
yāvad vidyāmahādāvajvālayaiṣā punaḥ punaḥ /
nālabdhā tāvad asyaitad dvaitaṃ rohet punaḥ punaḥ // [AgMsv_1.228]

mv-k02-v228.plain_english: Split by sharp reason-axes kindled by true knowledge fire, the difference-tree never sprouts again.
mv-k02-v228.sanskrit_cite:
tīkṣṇayuktikuṭhāraughaiḥ sadvidyāvahnidīpitaiḥ /
nirbhinno bhedaviṭapī punar naiva prarohati // [AgMsv_1.229]

mv-k02-v229.plain_english: Even when god is seated in the deep-sleep portion, things go to false locality, like cavity and wood-apple.
mv-k02-v229.sanskrit_cite:
evaṃ deve suṣuptāṃśamadhyāsīne sthitā api /
asaddeśīyatāṃ yānti bhāvāḥ śvabhrakapitthavat // [AgMsv_1.230]

mv-k02-v230.plain_english: Here such own knowledge, laden with detachment, indescribable and unsupported, blooms by distinction.
mv-k02-v230.sanskrit_cite:
atra tādṛśam eva svaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyanirbharam /
nirupākhyaṃ nirālambaṃ vyajṛmbhata vibhāgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.231]

mv-k02-v231.plain_english: Those ornamented with skull garlands, dwelling in cremation grounds, and perceiving element aggregates turn away from this.

mv-k02-v232.plain_english: All enjoyable reaches the limit of disgust; the enjoyer is I. This body is only skin and bone, with no essence even in the smallest part.
mv-k02-v232.sanskrit_cite:
bhogyaṃ jugupsāvadhi sarvam eva bhoktā hy ahaṃ kaḥ kila deha eṣaḥ /
carmāsthimātraṃ na ca sāram atra leśāṃśabhāge 'pi kadācid asti // [AgMsv_1.233]

mv-k02-v233.plain_english: Thus practicing, they ascend the supreme wealth of detachment every moment and close, struck by that.
mv-k02-v233.sanskrit_cite:
ittham abhyasyamānās te parāṃ vairāgyasampadam /
pratikṣaṇam upāruhya nimīlanti tadāhatāḥ // [AgMsv_1.234]

mv-k02-v234.plain_english: Even sense-faculties rush toward suffering, yet mostly turn away from pleasure.
mv-k02-v234.sanskrit_cite:
kim etad iti dhāvanti duḥkhe 'pīndriyavṛttayaḥ /
etad evam iti prāyo virajyante sukhād api // [AgMsv_1.235]

mv-k02-v235.plain_english: With controlled mind, desirelessness toward seen and heard objects leads to desirelessness toward guṇas through knowledge of puruṣa.
mv-k02-v235.sanskrit_cite:
dṛṣṭānuśravikārthaughavaitṛṣṇye vaśatādhiyaḥ /
tatparaṃ puruṣakhyāter guṇavaitṛṣṇyam ity api // [AgMsv_1.236]

mv-k02-v236.plain_english: We ask, even without cause, what happens if anger does not arise, and what of the division-boundary.
mv-k02-v236.sanskrit_cite:
nanv akāṇḍe 'pi pṛcchāmaḥ kiṃ cid yadi na kupyate /
* kim akāṇḍe bhedakāṇḍabhedakāṇḍaghaṭāvadhau // [AgMsv_1.237]

mv-k02-v237.plain_english: If this consciousness is pure by nature, how does it exceedingly desire taste from impure enjoyments?
mv-k02-v237.sanskrit_cite:
tarhi saṃvid iyaṃ śuddhā svabhāvād eva cet katham /
aśucibhyo 'pi bhogebhyo rasāt spṛhayatetarām // [AgMsv_1.238]

mv-k02-v238.plain_english: Where has pride in the habit of non-forgetting gone now? Enough, or even this is said with intellect's reproaches.
mv-k02-v238.sanskrit_cite:
nanv avismṛtiśīlatvābhimānaḥ kvādhunā gataḥ /
alaṃ vā buddhyupālabdhair uktam apy etad ucyate // [AgMsv_1.239]

mv-k02-v239.plain_english: Consciousness is supremely real and luminous by nature; by union with world-illumination it appears, as explained.
mv-k02-v239.sanskrit_cite:
svabhāvād eva saṃvittiḥ prakāśaparamārthikā /
viśvāvabhāsayogena bhātīti hi vipañcitam // [AgMsv_1.240]

mv-k02-v240.plain_english: Therefore, in the world-circle of the consciousness-goddess, what arises from refutation in her rising within her own self?
mv-k02-v240.sanskrit_cite:
ataś ca saṃvido devyā viśvasmin bhāvamaṇḍale /
svātmany evocchalattvaṃ kiṃ khaṇḍanādāyi jāyate // [AgMsv_1.241]

mv-k02-v241.plain_english: Even when difference is manifested by the supreme lord's power, consciousness runs in beings and is distinguished.
mv-k02-v241.sanskrit_cite:
yadāpi parameśānaśaktyā bhedo 'vabhāsyate /
tadāpi saṃvid bhāveṣu dhāvatīti vivicyate // [AgMsv_1.242]

mv-k02-v242.plain_english: As the state of clod, pool, flame, breath, pot, and sky, so earth, ocean, great fire, wind, and infinite sky nature.

mv-k02-v243.plain_english: This measure-formed consciousness, risen in itself, gradually follows beings of the same consciousness-formed class.
mv-k02-v243.sanskrit_cite:
yāty eva mitirūpeyaṃ saṃvit svocchalitā kramāt /
saṃvidrūpasajātīyān bhāvān evānudhāvati // [AgMsv_1.244]

mv-k02-v244.plain_english: Just as this was shaped by some supreme lord, who is able to set low pond-water in motion?
mv-k02-v244.sanskrit_cite:
nyarūpyata tathā caitat kenāpi parameśinā /
nimnaṃ taḍāgapānīyaṃ kaḥ pravartayituṃ kṣamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.245]

mv-k02-v245.plain_english: When that is full, streams flow in every direction; indeed, what and which ones flow thus by the force of their own nature?
mv-k02-v245.sanskrit_cite:
paripūrṇe punas tasmin pravāhāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ /
nanu kiṃ kāṃś cid evetthaṃ saiṣā svaniyater balāt // [AgMsv_1.246]

mv-k02-v246.plain_english: Thus that runs, and her body is the essence of attachment; there too only a reflection of attachment should be held.
mv-k02-v246.sanskrit_cite:
itthaṃ dhāvati tac cāsyā rāgatattvātmakaṃ vapuḥ /
tatrāpi ca tathā rāgābhāsa eva sa dhāryatām // [AgMsv_1.247]

mv-k02-v247.plain_english: But let attachment exist in the conscious self, even of another color; if so, how indeed can she become detached anywhere?
mv-k02-v247.sanskrit_cite:
cidātmani tu rāgo 'stu ko 'py anyārūṣaṇātmakaḥ /
nanv itthaṃ cet kathaṃ nāma sā kutrāpi virajyate // [AgMsv_1.248]

mv-k02-v248.plain_english: Alas, this original argument has reached agreement: when consciousness itself is in a contracted state everywhere.
mv-k02-v248.sanskrit_cite:
hanta prakṛta evāyaṃ vādaḥ saṃgatim āgataḥ /
yadā hi citir evaiṣā sarvataḥ saṃkucatsthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.249]

mv-k02-v249.plain_english: Gradually from means of enjoyment, objects, and body, the enjoyer becomes empty like a part of great dissolution.
mv-k02-v249.sanskrit_cite:
krameṇa bhogopāyebhyo bhogyebhyo dehato bhujaḥ /
bhogād bhoktus tathā śūnyā mahāpralayabhāg iva // [AgMsv_1.250]

mv-k02-v250.plain_english: This destructive state arises in Rudra form because Sadyojata, Rudra, and Purusha are lord-natured.
mv-k02-v250.sanskrit_cite:
jāyate rudrarūpaiṣā daśā sāṃhārikī yataḥ /
sadyojātaś ca yad rudraḥ puruṣaś ceśvarātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.251]

mv-k02-v251.plain_english: Glorious Sadashiva, Deva, and Ishana are sung; Vishnu, Vama, Kajy, and Aghora will also be.
mv-k02-v251.sanskrit_cite:
śrīmān sadāśivo deva īśānaś ceti gīyate /
viṣṇur vāmaḥ kajy aghora iti caitad bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_1.252]

mv-k02-v252.plain_english: Because each has all power within, these Brahmas are called so by expansion, greatness, and universal expansion.
mv-k02-v252.sanskrit_cite:
antaḥsthasarvaśaktitvenaikaikasyāpi bṛṃhaṇāt /
brahmāṇy etāni kathyante bṛhattvād viśvabṛṃhaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.253]

mv-k02-v253.plain_english: Indeed, when other power is in excess and intended, each has a five-cause union.
mv-k02-v253.sanskrit_cite:
tadanyaśaktyudrekāṃśe hy ata eva vivakṣite /
pratyekam asti brahmādihetupañcakayogitā // [AgMsv_1.254]

mv-k02-v254.plain_english: That same power spreads distinctly in scriptures; therefore the primary fierce state stands in sadyojata.
mv-k02-v254.sanskrit_cite:
saiva śāstreṣu bhedena teṣu teṣu pratanyate /
ataś ca sadyojāte 'smin mukhyā raudradaśā sthitā // [AgMsv_1.255]

mv-k02-v255.plain_english: Even in contracted form it will be in consciousness expansion; the absorbed brahma and vishnu parts are forcibly lowered.
mv-k02-v255.sanskrit_cite:
sā ca saṃkocarūpāpi cidvikāse bhaviṣyati /
yallīnau brahmaviṣṇvaṃśau tenādhaḥkurute balāt // [AgMsv_1.256]

mv-k02-v256.plain_english: The state of absence of thing is the rudra presiding deity; it was described as a distinct object by Srimad Utpala.

mv-k02-v257.plain_english: Even when born in mere distinction, contraction is approached; then enjoyer and enjoyed are clearly exchanged here.
mv-k02-v257.sanskrit_cite:
jāto 'pi bhedatanmātre saṃkocaṃ yad upāgataḥ /
tato vyatinimīlete bhoktṛbhogyāv iha sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.258]

mv-k02-v258.plain_english: That universe appears here immediately as if unborn; therefore the sadyojata term is of empty consciousness nature.
mv-k02-v258.sanskrit_cite:
ajātam iva tad viśvam atra sadyo 'vabhāsate /
sadyojātapadaṃ tena śūnyasaṃvedanātmakam // [AgMsv_1.259]

mv-k02-v259.plain_english: As long as he wishes to distinguish within the empty term, the god himself makes the universe rise, standing in awareness.
mv-k02-v259.sanskrit_cite:
tataḥ śūnyapadasyāntar yāvat sa ca vivikṣati /
devas tāvat svayaṃ bodhe viśvaṃ procchalati sthitam // [AgMsv_1.260]

mv-k02-v260.plain_english: This expanding knowledge-power of the lord knows; absorption in the expanded consciousness abode is established for those two.
mv-k02-v260.sanskrit_cite:
jānāti seyaṃ nāthasya jñānaśaktir vikāsinī /
tayor vikāsiciddhāmni līnatvam upapāditam // [AgMsv_1.259]

mv-k02-v261.plain_english: The expansion of empty-form consciousness is indeed the universe; for it is full of deep sleep rest.
mv-k02-v261.sanskrit_cite:
saṃvidaḥ śūnyarūpāyā vikāso viśvam eva tat /
tathā hi ghanasauṣuptaviśrāntivaśanirbharaḥ // [AgMsv_1.262]

mv-k02-v262.plain_english: Those house and shop parts called dream state are known; therefore that is not creation but maintenance.
mv-k02-v262.sanskrit_cite:
tāṃs tān gṛhāpaṇādyaṃśān vetti svapnapadābhidhān /
ata eva na sā sṛṣṭiḥ sthitir eva tu sā tathā // [AgMsv_1.263]

mv-k02-v263.plain_english: In previously created beings that is indeed mere consciousness; thus dream arises by distinction from waking form.
mv-k02-v263.sanskrit_cite:
pūrvasṛṣṭeṣu bhāveṣu tad dhi vijñānamātrakam /
tathā ca jāgrato rūpāt svapno bhedena jāyate // [AgMsv_1.264]

mv-k02-v264.plain_english: But the waking state and the others each have many divisions, which will be determined later; therefore it is fitting that their shining forth takes the form of emanation.
mv-k02-v264.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃtu jāgratpadādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ bahubhedatā /
nirṇeṣyate tato yuktaṃ sṛṣṭirūpeṇa bhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.265]

mv-k02-v265.plain_english: Therefore, pervading those entities by his own awareness, the Lord causes that state of indifference of his to be abandoned through them.
mv-k02-v265.sanskrit_cite:
ato nijavibodhena tān bhāvān vyāpnuvan vibhuḥ /
etais tyājayate tāṃ svām audāsīnyadaśāṃ vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.266]

mv-k02-v266.plain_english: This is the expansion of the power of knowledge: entities abiding in the state of that knowledge attain fullness, with their own radiance unfolding.
mv-k02-v266.sanskrit_cite:
jñānaśakter iyaṃ jṛmbhā tajjñānasthitibhāvinaḥ /
bhāvāḥ prayānti pūrṇatvaṃ vikāsinijatejasaḥ // [AgMsv_1.267]

mv-k02-v267.plain_english: At the level of Sadyojāta there would indeed be supreme contraction, because firm abiding in their own nature does not arise for them.
mv-k02-v267.sanskrit_cite:
paramaḥ khalu saṃkocaḥ sadyojātapade bhavet /
yad eṣāṃ svasvarūpasya niṣṭhā naiva sma jāyate // [AgMsv_1.268]

mv-k02-v268.plain_english: Without rising into consciousness, how could distinctions like existence and nonexistence, inert and non-inert, or blue and non-blue ever be established?
mv-k02-v268.sanskrit_cite:
vinā saṃvidupārohaṃ sattāsattā jaḍo 'jaḍaḥ /
anīlaṃ nīlam ityādivyavasthā kalpatāṃ katham // [AgMsv_1.269]

mv-k02-v269.plain_english: As Utpalaguru said, just as the existent and the nonexistent have no intrinsic difference in their own nature, so too the inert and the non-inert do not; this is firmly established.
mv-k02-v269.sanskrit_cite:
yad uvācotpalagurur yathā sadasatāṃ tathā /
jaḍājaḍānāṃ na svātmaviśeṣa iti niścitam // [AgMsv_1.270]

mv-k02-v270.plain_english: Therefore, consciousness, in the fullness of its awareness, releases the states of self and other, and everywhere emits an animation of consciousness that is beautiful with bliss.
mv-k02-v270.sanskrit_cite:
tasmād bodhabharollāsavisṛṣṭasvaparasthitim /
cidanuprāṇanāṃ viṣvag vamann ānandasundarām // [AgMsv_1.271]

mv-k02-v271.plain_english: That God, whose one body is consciousness, desiring to make the universe his own within the self of consciousness by emitting his own power of awareness, is called Vāma.
mv-k02-v271.sanskrit_cite:
cidekavapuṣā viśvaṃ svīcikīrṣaṃś cidātmani /
svabodhaśaktivamanāt sa devo vāma ucyate // [AgMsv_1.272]

mv-k02-v272.plain_english: Although, by the surge of his own power of awareness, this deity bestows such a form upon beings, nevertheless, in ultimate truth, the matter stands otherwise.
mv-k02-v272.sanskrit_cite:
svabodhaśaktyudrekeṇa yady apy eṣa prayacchati /
bhāvānāṃ svavapus tādṛk tathāpi paramārthataḥ // [AgMsv_1.273]

mv-k02-v273.plain_english: Desiring to take back these beings into himself, he constructs their divisions; therefore, in the arrangement of difference, this supreme lord is called Vāma.
mv-k02-v273.sanskrit_cite:
svīkartum icchan saṃhāram eṣāṃ kalpayate bhidaḥ /
ato bhedavyavasthāyāṃ vāmo 'sau parameśvaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.274]

mv-k02-v274.plain_english: Here such knowledge spreads; fortune is called the acceptance of distinct beings.
mv-k02-v274.sanskrit_cite:
atra saubhāgyaniḥṣyandi tādṛg jñānaṃ pratāyate /
saubhāgyaṃ socyate teṣāṃ bhinnānāṃ svīkriyaiva yā // [AgMsv_1.275]

mv-k02-v275.plain_english: Consciousness springs up from its own power and playful glimpse among varied beings.
mv-k02-v275.sanskrit_cite:
bhāvānāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ bhogāṅgānāṃ svaśaktitaḥ /
svakautukakalālokād ucchalanty eva yā citiḥ // [AgMsv_1.276]

mv-k02-v276.plain_english: That same consciousness colors the universe by nature, since manifestation is its own form.
mv-k02-v276.sanskrit_cite:
saiva svabhāvarāgeṇa viśvaṃ rañjayate yataḥ /
vyakto hi rañjayed viśvaṃ vyaktiś cāsya svarūpataḥ // [AgMsv_1.277]

mv-k02-v277.plain_english: The risen state of acceptance-desire stands for a moment in ray-essence wealth with undivided mind.
mv-k02-v277.sanskrit_cite:
yaiva procchalitāvasthā svīkārecchābharodayaḥ /
tadraśmisārasarvasve kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhaty ananyadhīḥ // [AgMsv_1.278]

mv-k02-v278.plain_english: What does the yoga-knower not attract or manifest? Scripture says the uncolored does not color.
mv-k02-v278.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃ nākarṣati kiṃ naiṣa ca bhāvayati yogavit /
tata evocyate śāstre nārakto rañjayed iti // [AgMsv_1.279]

mv-k02-v279.plain_english: Desire, placed and goad-enclosed, should accomplish desires and yoke them into desires.
mv-k02-v279.sanskrit_cite:
kāmasthaṃ kāmamadhyasthaṃ kāmāṅkuśapuṭīkṛtam /
kāmena sādhayet kāmān kāmaṃ kāmeṣu yojayet // [AgMsv_1.280]

mv-k02-v280.plain_english: Desire is acceptance-desire; by covering union the desirer accomplishes the universe, because this is desire-principle.
mv-k02-v280.sanskrit_cite:
kāmaḥ svīkartum icchaiva tadācchādanayogataḥ /
viśvaṃ sādhayate kāmī kāmatattvam idaṃ yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.281]

mv-k02-v281.plain_english: Thus in the supreme self, steadiness is directly superimposed through the covering order of risen awareness.
mv-k02-v281.sanskrit_cite:
tathā hi parame svātmany adhyāsya sthairyam añjasā /
taducchalitasaṃbodhakalāsaṃchādanakramāt // [AgMsv_1.282]

mv-k02-v282.plain_english: The universe appears as servant under the desire-goad; by inner accomplishment method, this is understood in its own rise.
mv-k02-v282.sanskrit_cite:
viśvaṃ kāmāṅkuśādhīnaṃ kiṃkaratvena bhāsate /
adhyātmasiddhayā yuktyā tv anayaiva nijodaye // [AgMsv_1.283]

mv-k02-v283.plain_english: Life-force pervades body and eightfold city, drawing the universe because desire-principle manifests.
mv-k02-v283.sanskrit_cite:
prāṇaḥ puryaṣṭakaṃ dehaṃ vyāpya viśvaṃ prakarṣati /
tattvasya kāmatattvasya prakaṭīkriyayā yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.284]

mv-k02-v284.plain_english: Whether this secret is manifested in siddha circles, god spreads from void-bliss as risen-natured.
mv-k02-v284.sanskrit_cite:
siddhacakreṣv idaṃ gopyaṃ kiṃ vā na prakaṭīkṛtam /
śūnyānandāt prasṛtyaiva devaḥ procchalitātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.285]

mv-k02-v285.plain_english: Present, the lord proceeds by unfolding his own powers where he desires to enter, because the lord is covered.
mv-k02-v285.sanskrit_cite:
vartamāno nijāḥ śaktīr vikāsyaiva pravartate /
yatrāsya pravivikṣāsti yataś ca prāvṛtad vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.286]

mv-k02-v286.plain_english: That being remains after raising all powers in itself; then the consciousness-natured god appears as if submerged.
mv-k02-v286.sanskrit_cite:
sarvāḥ śaktīr asau bhāvaḥ svātmany udrecya vartate /
tataś cidātmako devo nyagbhūta iva bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.287]

mv-k02-v287.plain_english: These arisen powers shine as opening, desire, knowledge, and action; therefore that being appears even though endowed with four.
mv-k02-v287.sanskrit_cite:
udbhūtās tu vibhānty etāḥ pronmeṣecchāvidikriyāḥ /
ataś catuṣkayukto 'sau yady api pratibhāsate // [AgMsv_1.288]

mv-k02-v288.plain_english: Nevertheless, how could power-counting be real for it? Here only the art of uprooting parts of being-difference exists.
mv-k02-v288.sanskrit_cite:
tathāpi śaktigaṇanā vastuto 'sya bhavet kutaḥ /
atraiva bhāvabhedāṃśanirmūlanakalā yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.289]

mv-k02-v289.plain_english: Then conduct standing beyond world range occurs; from infinite power variety, uprooting and similar acts occur here too.
mv-k02-v289.sanskrit_cite:
sthitas tataḥ samācāro lokātikrāntagocaraḥ /
anantaśaktivaicitryād atrāpy uccāṭanādayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.290]

mv-k02-v290.plain_english: Even dissolution-play-predominant actions are established thus at the end of knowledge-power, with beings' body established.
mv-k02-v290.sanskrit_cite:
saṃhāralīlābhūyiṣṭhā api tās tāḥ kriyāḥ sthitāḥ /
tad itthaṃ jñānaśaktyante bhāvānāṃ vapuṣi sthite // [AgMsv_1.291]

mv-k02-v291.plain_english: Then final action-power respectfully withdraws them, as the most subtle power called opening at the supreme limit.
mv-k02-v291.sanskrit_cite:
kriyāśaktir athāntyaiva tān saṃharati sādaram /
yathā sūkṣmatamā śaktir unmeṣākhyā parāvadhau // [AgMsv_1.292]

mv-k02-v292.plain_english: By created being grossness it appears as gross form; thus this action-power is that in which beings are closed.
mv-k02-v292.sanskrit_cite:
sraṣṭavyabhāvasthaulyena sthūlākāreva bhāsate /
tathaivaiṣā kriyāśaktir yasyāṃ bhāvā nimeṣitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.293]

mv-k02-v293.plain_english: Some power established in its own form unfolds as if full; indeed there is action in which difference appears.
mv-k02-v293.sanskrit_cite:
svasvarūpasthitā kāpi pūrṇeva pravijṛmbhate /
nanv asty eva kriyā yasyāṃ bhedaḥ pratyavabhāsate // [AgMsv_1.294]

mv-k02-v294.plain_english: Not so: every action does not remove difference beforehand; thus on the ground of difference stand wood, fire, and rice.
mv-k02-v294.sanskrit_cite:
maivaṃ sarvā kriyā bhedaṃ praty uta prāg vyapohati /
tathā hi bhedabhūmau ye kāṣṭhajvalanataṇḍulāḥ // [AgMsv_1.295]

mv-k02-v295.plain_english: Those very things abandon difference in the state of cooking; if their natures were different, how could cooking unity arise?
mv-k02-v295.sanskrit_cite:
ta eva pākāviṣṭatve bhedaṃ projjhanti sādaram /
yadi bhinnasvarūpās te pākaikyaṃ tat kathaṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.296]

mv-k02-v296.plain_english: A different own-form of the parts is not reasonable; indeed cooking is not any thing that is many-formed.
mv-k02-v296.sanskrit_cite:
bhinnaṃ svarūpam aṅgānāṃ na hi yuktyopapadyate /
nanu pāko na kaś cit sa yat tan nānāsvarūpakam // [AgMsv_1.297]

mv-k02-v297.plain_english: Burning, moistening, burning and so on is called cooking; all different actions are established toward one fruit.
mv-k02-v297.sanskrit_cite:
jvalanakledadāhādi tat pāka iti śabdyate /
bhinnā eva kriyāḥ sarvāḥ phalam ekaṃ prati sthitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.298]

mv-k02-v298.plain_english: Cooking is said; no other action by name exists. How can many yield one desired fruit?
mv-k02-v298.sanskrit_cite:
pāka ity ucyate nānyā kriyā nāmāsti kācana /
etad eva kathaṃ bahvya ekaṃ phalam abhīpsitam // [AgMsv_1.299]

mv-k02-v299.plain_english: How would those accomplish it from the previously stated cause? Indeed, by eye, lamp, meaning, and mind-efforts, it is clearly so.
mv-k02-v299.sanskrit_cite:
kathaṃ saṃpādayeyus tāḥ. pūrvoktād eva hetutaḥ /
nanu locanadīpārthamanaskārair api sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.300]

mv-k02-v300.plain_english: One knowledge is born; so here it will be. That is this body become dirty through kneading mud.
mv-k02-v300.sanskrit_cite:
janyate jñānam ekaṃ tat tathaivātra bhaviṣyati /
so 'yaṃ kardamasaṃmardamalinībhūtavigrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.301]

mv-k03-v301.plain_english: A traveler runs toward mirage water in a desert; if one thing exists despite different forms, possibility is questioned.
mv-k03-v301.sanskrit_cite:
marau marīcikāmbhobhiḥ snānecchur abhidhāvati /
bhinnasvarūpād yady ekam asti vastv iti saṃbhavaḥ // [AgMsv_1.302]

mv-k03-v302.plain_english: Then difference is not ultimate by cause-difference; but if different form is accepted as one, the issue remains.
mv-k03-v302.sanskrit_cite:
tarhi kāraṇabhedena na bhedaḥ pāramārthikaḥ /
atha bhinnasvarūpaṃ tad ekaṃ cety upagamyate // [AgMsv_1.303]

mv-k03-v303.plain_english: Nature-difference would lead to difference; if that is abandoned, the vow is broken. Thus action should not be one agent like wood.
mv-k03-v303.sanskrit_cite:
svabhāvabhedo bhedāyety etat tyaktaṃ vrataṃ bhavet /
nanv itthaṃ sā kriyā mā bhūd ekā kāṣṭhādi kārakam // [AgMsv_1.304]

mv-k03-v304.plain_english: Let fruit be produced even so; there is no harm to us, because action is not another power.
mv-k03-v304.sanskrit_cite:
phalaṃ janayatām evam apy astu na hi naḥ kṣatiḥ /
kriyā hi nāma nāsmākam anyā śaktis tv asau yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.305]

mv-k03-v305.plain_english: Power arises by fruit-piercing arrangement from non-difference of being and self; that power is the lord's, and he is world-self-form.
mv-k03-v305.sanskrit_cite:
śaktiś ca phalabhitkḷptyā bhāvātmaivāvibhedataḥ /
sā ca śaktir vibhor eva sa ca viśvātmavigrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.306]

mv-k03-v306.plain_english: By fruit and agent difference, power is not ultimately different; even in the lord's undifferentiated self, difference appears.
mv-k03-v306.sanskrit_cite:
phalakārakabhedena na bhinnā paramārthataḥ /
svātmany abhinne 'pi vibhor evaṃ bhedāvabhāsanāt // [AgMsv_1.307]

mv-k03-v307.plain_english: Action-power is called that by which the great lord is agent; but how can bound souls act? Let that be explained.
mv-k03-v307.sanskrit_cite:
kriyāśaktir iti proktā yayā kartā maheśvaraḥ /
nanu yat paśavaḥ kuryuḥ kathaṃ tad upapadyatām // [AgMsv_1.308]

mv-k03-v308.plain_english: They, from having one life in difference, would perform differentiated action; enough of this, how bound souls act is clear.
mv-k03-v308.sanskrit_cite:
te hi bhedaikajīvatvāt kuryur bhedavatīṃ kriyām /
alam etena paśavaḥ kathaṃ kuryur iti sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.309]

mv-k03-v309.plain_english: That self-contradictory statement is like a barren woman's son; agency is never found in a pot-maker.
mv-k03-v309.sanskrit_cite:
sa eva svavacaśchinno vādo vandhyāsutādivat /
na hi kumbhakṛtaḥ kvāpi kadācit kartṛtā bhavet // [AgMsv_1.310]

mv-k03-v310.plain_english: If that is not non-different from the agent called great lord, then what is made by the potter? Is the pot made by the potter?
mv-k03-v310.sanskrit_cite:
yadi nāsau maheśākhyāt kartur avyatirekabhāk /
nanu kiṃ svit kulālena kumbho 'pi kriyate tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.311]

mv-k03-v311.plain_english: If the lord has world-agency, is there no agency in cloth? If so, cloth too is not made by the potter.
mv-k03-v311.sanskrit_cite:
īśasya viśvakartṛtve kiṃ paṭe 'pi na kartṛtā /
yady evaṃ tat kulālena paṭo 'pi kriyate na kim // [AgMsv_1.312]

mv-k03-v312.plain_english: If so, there is no other agent; for auspicious and inauspicious actions, toward whom is causality for producing their own fruit?
mv-k03-v312.sanskrit_cite:
nanv evaṃ sati no kartā ko 'py anya iti karmaṇām /
śubhāśubhānāṃ svaphalaṃ kartuṃ kaṃ prati hetutā // [AgMsv_1.313]

mv-k03-v313.plain_english: Thus it is, venerable one; for those who know thus, no fruit arises anywhere, auspicious or inauspicious.
mv-k03-v313.sanskrit_cite:
evam evaitad āyuṣmaṃs tathāhy evaṃ vijānatām /
na kiṃ cana phalaṃ kvāpi śubhāśubhasamudbhavam // [AgMsv_1.314]

mv-k03-v314.plain_english: Those who do not know thus enjoy; they are unwise. That very thing called action is impurity rooted in ignorance.
mv-k03-v314.sanskrit_cite:
itthaṃ ye tu na jānanti bhuñjate te 'vipaścitaḥ /
tad eva karmasaṃjñaṃ tu malam ajñānamūlakam // [AgMsv_1.315]

mv-k03-v315.plain_english: Approving this only, some consider consciousness-only, indeed a non-agent, because agency is impossible.
mv-k03-v315.sanskrit_cite:
etad evānumanyaiva kecit saṃvittimātrakam /
saṃmanyante hy akartāraṃ kartṛtvānupapattitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.316]

mv-k03-v316.plain_english: Consciousness-form is superior; that is called agency. From consciousness-superiority, inertness would be attributed to this.
mv-k03-v316.sanskrit_cite:
citsvarūpādhikaṃ hy asya yat tat kartṛtvam ucyate /
taj jāḍyam arpayed asmai cidādhikyaprasaṅgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.317]

mv-k03-v317.plain_english: Nature's agency in a person is indeed metaphorically called; those departed from the path of logic vainly debate this in the house.
mv-k03-v317.sanskrit_cite:
prakṛteḥ kartṛtā puṃsi nanu nāmopacaryate /
etan nyāyapathāpetair vṛthā jegīyate gṛhe // [AgMsv_1.318]

mv-k03-v318.plain_english: Figurative usage does not reach the real nature of a thing; such a designation may be empty of reality, so it cannot establish real agency.
mv-k03-v318.sanskrit_cite:
upacāro hi no vastutathātvaṃ pratipadyate /
vyapadeśaḥ paraṃ tādṛg vastuśūnyo 'stu tāvatā // [AgMsv_1.319]

mv-k03-v319.plain_english: Even if someone were called fire only figuratively, he would not remove the cold caused by snow, hail, showers, and wind.

mv-k03-v320.plain_english: Prakṛti is not called the seer of the self, and there is no other candidate left; so there is no one to whom agency could even be figuratively assigned.
mv-k03-v320.sanskrit_cite:
draṣṭuḥ puṃsaś ca na draṣṭrī prakṛtiḥ parigīyate /
na cānyo 'sti varāko 'taḥ kartṛbhāvopacārakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.321]

mv-k03-v321.plain_english: What purpose is served by talk of agency if it is only figurative? Such a designation need not be real and can simply be changed.
mv-k03-v321.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃ ca prayojanaṃ tasya kartṛtvavyavahārajam /
vyapadeśas tu nāvastu parivartayituṃ kṣamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.322]

mv-k03-v322.plain_english: Even those who, following their doctrine, accept the self as an agent must first answer this question that we put to them.
mv-k03-v322.sanskrit_cite:
ye 'py ātmānaṃ nayavidaḥ kartāraṃ samupāgaman /
te 'pi praśnam imaṃ tāvad asmākaṃ pratibhārpitam // [AgMsv_1.323]

mv-k03-v323.plain_english: Can the kind of agency known from ordinary action, which involves vibration, really belong to an all-pervading self that has no vibration?
mv-k03-v323.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃ yādṛglokasaṃsiddhakartṛtvaṃ karmayogataḥ /
spandātma tad vibhau spandahīne samupapadyate // [AgMsv_1.324]

mv-k03-v324.plain_english: The objection is: knowledge, desire to act, and effort form a triad belonging to the self, and that is what is called agency.
mv-k03-v324.sanskrit_cite:
nanu jñānaṃ cikīrṣā ca yatnaś ceti guṇatrayam /
samavaiti yad atrāsya tat kartṛtvam udāhṛtam // [AgMsv_1.325]

mv-k03-v325.plain_english: This kind of reasoning might deceive the childish, but even children are not without awareness.
mv-k03-v325.sanskrit_cite:
itthaṃ bālamatīnāṃ dhīr vipralabhyeta vañcakaiḥ /
dārakā api vā vidyur na saṃvedanavarjitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.326]

mv-k03-v326.plain_english: Knowledge is not agency, since it is present everywhere; and desire and effort too are generally found in everyone, so their mere presence does not amount to agency.
mv-k03-v326.sanskrit_cite:
tatra jñānaṃ na kartṛtvaṃ sarvatrāsty eva tad yataḥ /
icchāyatnāv api prāyaḥ saṃstaḥ sarvasya sarvataḥ // [AgMsv_1.327]

mv-k03-v327.plain_english: A potter distressed by not having a house may know, want, and try, yet still be unable to make a house for himself.
mv-k03-v327.sanskrit_cite:
kumbhakāro gṛhābhāvaparitāpitacetanaḥ /
jānann icchan sayatno 'pi kiṃ kuryān nātmano gṛham // [AgMsv_1.328]

mv-k03-v328.plain_english: The objection says: he does not know how to do it, so he does not want to do it and does not try; then how could he make the house?
mv-k03-v328.sanskrit_cite:
nanu kartuṃ na jānāti tataḥ kartuṃ na cecchati /
tasmāt kartuṃ na yatate tad gṛhaṃ kurutāṃ kathaṃ // [AgMsv_1.329]

mv-k03-v329.plain_english: If knowledge, desire, and effort are qualified by 'to do', what does that qualifier mean? Does it mean having vibration?
mv-k03-v329.sanskrit_cite:
kartum ity eva yad rūpaṃ jñānādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam /
karotes tatra ko 'rthaḥ syād yadi saspandatā kila // [AgMsv_1.330]

mv-k03-v330.plain_english: If 'to do' meant vibration, the statement would be that he knows and wants to vibrate; but such vibration cannot belong to an all-pervading self.
mv-k03-v330.sanskrit_cite:
tadāsau spandituṃ vetti prepsatīti bhaved vacaḥ /
tac ca svātmagataṃ nāsya spanditaṃ vaibhavodbhavāt // [AgMsv_1.331]

mv-k03-v331.plain_english: A knowledge without vibration would not be possible even for Śiva, and merely having knowledge, desire, and effort has been described only as an instrument, not as true agency.
mv-k03-v331.sanskrit_cite:
anyad aspanditaṃ jñānaṃ śarvasyāpi na saṃbhavet /
jñānecchāyatnavattvaṃ ca karaṇaṃ tasya bhāṣitam // [AgMsv_1.332]

mv-k03-v332.plain_english: When we analyze the meaning of 'the self is to do', it comes down to knowing, desiring, and striving — even striving to know, to desire, and to strive.
mv-k03-v332.sanskrit_cite:
ātmanaḥ kartum ity asya tato 'rthapravivecane /
jānātīcchan prayatate jñātuṃ yatitum eṣitum // [AgMsv_1.333]

mv-k03-v333.plain_english: Taken one by one, this analysis amounts to knowing to do and wanting to do; that makes one a desirer to act, but not truly an agent.
mv-k03-v333.sanskrit_cite:
pratyekam iti yo 'rthaḥ sa kartuṃ vettīti śabditaḥ /
cikīrṣitṛtvaṃ caitat syān na kartṛtvaṃ punar bhavet // [AgMsv_1.334]

mv-k03-v334.plain_english: If that were so, speech and bodily actions would be wrongly equated with mental ones; or else how could agency in speech and body belong to the same agent?
mv-k03-v334.sanskrit_cite:
tathātve mānasaiḥ sāmyaṃ bhaved vākkāyakarmaṇām /
vākkāyakarmabhir vāsya kathaṃ kartṛtvam āpatet // [AgMsv_1.335]

mv-k03-v335.plain_english: Even if that triad is present, explain how mental actions — and likewise actions arising from mind, speech, and body — can truly belong to him.
mv-k03-v335.sanskrit_cite:
mānasāny api karmāṇi kathaṃ tasyeti gīyatām /
tadguṇatrayasadbhāve manovākkāyasambhuvām // [AgMsv_1.336]

mv-k03-v336.plain_english: If one says the self is the sharer of accumulated actions, that too would be only figurative usage — and that has already been shown to be inadequate.
mv-k03-v336.sanskrit_cite:
karmaṇāṃ saṃciter eṣa karmabhāgīti cen nanu /
upacāro 'yam evaṃ syāt sa cāvastv iti varṇitam // [AgMsv_1.337]

mv-k03-v337.plain_english: Just because qualities such as motion, greatness, and others are present in relation to the self, does that make the self a locus of agency?
mv-k03-v337.sanskrit_cite:
kiṃ cātmagamahattvādidravyāntaguṇasaṃnidhau /
tāni santīti kiṃ so 'pi kartṛtvāyatano bhavet // [AgMsv_1.338]

mv-k03-v338.plain_english: That cannot be accepted, because then agency would arise even in liberation, and the same rule would apply when the qualities of another self are nearby.
mv-k03-v338.sanskrit_cite:
na cāstv ity upagantavyaṃ muktāv api hi tad bhavet /
anyātmaguṇasāṃnidhye samaś caiṣa vidhir yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.339]

mv-k03-v339.plain_english: Then, among selves, there would arise the faults of losing what has been done and gaining what has not been done; and what about the Lord's role in effects everywhere that require intelligence?
mv-k03-v339.sanskrit_cite:
ātmasv ataḥ pravarteran kṛtanāśākṛtāgamāḥ /
kiṃ ceśvareṇa sarvatra buddhimattāvyapekṣiṇi // [AgMsv_1.340]

mv-k03-v340.plain_english: If efficient causality is assigned to the Lord in a complexly arranged effect, what happens when that effect is already fully supplied by its own inherent and other causal factors?
mv-k03-v340.sanskrit_cite:
saṃniveśādhike kārye nimittatvaṃ kṛtaṃ yadi /
svaiḥ svaiś ca samavāyānyakāraṇāṃśaiḥ prapūrite // [AgMsv_1.341]

mv-k03-v341.plain_english: What partial contribution, like that of a potter, could be assigned as the Lord's causality? In the all-doer there is not even the slightest trace of such a partial role.
mv-k03-v341.sanskrit_cite:
kam aṃśaṃ kumbhakārādeḥ prātuṃ bhavatu hetutā /
na hi so 'sty aṃśaleśo 'pi sarvakartari yaṃ prati // [AgMsv_1.342]

mv-k03-v342.plain_english: Agency is nothing other than knowledge, will, and effort; therefore no one else can ever possess true agency.
mv-k03-v342.sanskrit_cite:
na jñānecchāyatnam asti kartṛtvaṃ nānyad ity api /
tasmān nānyasya kartṛtvaṃ kadācid api saṃbhavet // [AgMsv_1.343]

mv-k03-v343.plain_english: The wise understand that the Lord's autonomy is agency; thus, even amid the apparent differences of supreme lords or individual selves, agency is that same autonomy.
mv-k03-v343.sanskrit_cite:
īśvarād īśvarasyāpi svātantryaṃ kartṛtāṃ viduḥ /
tad itthaṃ parameśānāṃ bhede bhede 'pi vātmanām // [AgMsv_1.344]

mv-k03-v344.plain_english: Actions do not bind by their own nature; therefore this good or bad result does not arise merely from that action.
mv-k03-v344.sanskrit_cite:
prabhavanti na karmāṇi bandhanāya svabhāvataḥ /
tasmād idam amuṣmāt syāt karmaṇo vā śubhāśubham // [AgMsv_1.345]

mv-k03-v345.plain_english: That sovereignty belongs to the supreme Lord alone; this has been determined and I have explained it at length elsewhere.
mv-k03-v345.sanskrit_cite:
tad aiśvaryam amuṣyaiva vihitaṃ parameśituḥ /
nirṇītam etad anyatra mayaiva vitataṃ yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.346]

mv-k03-v346.plain_english: Enough of that; returning to the topic, this supreme power of action of the Lord is proclaimed Aghorā because of its non-terrifying nature.
mv-k03-v346.sanskrit_cite:
tad alaṃ prakṛtaṃ brūmaḥ kriyāśaktir iyaṃ parā /
aghoratvena devasya tata eva prakīrtitā // [AgMsv_1.347]

mv-k03-v347.plain_english: Therefore this power is benevolent: for beings who take refuge in Śiva it makes the path direct, and its action is not confined to a limited self.
mv-k03-v347.sanskrit_cite:
dākṣiṇyam ata evāsyā bhāvānāṃ śivasaṃśraye /
yato 'ñjasaiva mārgo 'yaṃ yā kriyā ca na sātmikā // [AgMsv_1.348]

mv-k03-v348.plain_english: One may object that no beings here are established in Śiva-hood as agents; true, but the one being instructed should understand the matter properly.
mv-k03-v348.sanskrit_cite:
nanu nātra sthitāḥ kecid bhāvā ye śivatāśritāḥ /
kartāraḥ satyam itthaṃ tu bodhyamāno 'vadhārayet // [AgMsv_1.349]

mv-k03-v349.plain_english: The Lord of gods is free from constructions of place, time, action, and form; likewise his power is of universal form.
mv-k03-v349.sanskrit_cite:
deśakālakriyākārakalpanāpathavarjitaḥ /
devadevas tathaivāsya śaktiḥ sā viśvarūpiṇī // [AgMsv_1.350]

mv-k03-v350.plain_english: That universe too is free from the stains of time and the rest, abiding in non-difference from Bhairava.

mv-k03-v351.plain_english: By that autonomy it is autonomous, surging forth and abiding within itself; and because it shines, it is never excluded from immersion in Śiva.
mv-k03-v351.sanskrit_cite:
tatsvātantryāt svatantraṃ tat svātmani procchalat sthitam /
yato bhāti tato 'py astaśivāveśabahiṣkṛtam // [AgMsv_1.352]

mv-k03-v352.plain_english: Therefore this supreme power has the form of both Dakṣiṇā and Aghorā, since it will be said to grant beings the fruit of Śiva's abode.
mv-k03-v352.sanskrit_cite:
ata eva parā seyaṃ dakṣiṇāghorarūpiṇī /
yad vakṣyate jantucakre śivadhāmaphalapradāḥ // [AgMsv_1.353]

mv-k03-v353.plain_english: The knowers declare the supreme powers of Śiva to be Aghorā; and elsewhere Śiva's power of action operates within the bound soul.
mv-k03-v353.sanskrit_cite:
parāḥ prakathitās tajjñair aghorāḥ śivaśaktayaḥ /
anyatrāpi kriyāśaktiḥ śivasya paśuvartinī // [AgMsv_1.354]

mv-k03-v354.plain_english: Abiding in its own path it binds, but when known it brings accomplishment; it is proclaimed as the expansion from A to Ha.
mv-k03-v354.sanskrit_cite:
bandhayitrī svamārgasthā jñātā siddhyupapādinī /
akārādihakārāntaḥ prasaro yaḥ pragīyate // [AgMsv_1.355]

mv-k03-v355.plain_english: That same expansion, proceeding from the abode of bindu and taking on non-vowel manifestation, is this unfolding of the power of action as the entire garland of letters.
mv-k03-v355.sanskrit_cite:
sa eva bindunilayād asvaratvam upāśritaḥ /
kriyāśaktivijṛmbheyaṃ samastavarṇamālikā // [AgMsv_1.356]

mv-k03-v356.plain_english: Embraced in the reflective awareness 'I', it abides there; from that arises the vivid flash of the full, supreme I-consciousness.
mv-k03-v356.sanskrit_cite:
kroḍīkṛtāv aham iti parāmarśasvarūpiṇī /
tiṣṭhaty eva. tataḥ pūrṇaparāhaṃkārasasphuraḥ // [AgMsv_1.357]

mv-k03-v357.plain_english: It devours the whole mass of bound souls from Ananta to Brahmā and draws the entire moving and unmoving world into the cave of its own belly.

mv-k03-v358.plain_english: Having swallowed the aggregate of individuals within the reflective awareness of its own consciousness, as long as it flashes forth, it does so by the nature of the power of action.
mv-k03-v358.sanskrit_cite:
svacaitanyavimarśāntar grastapudgalasaṃcayaḥ /
yāvad ullasitas, tāvat kriyāśaktisvarūpataḥ // [AgMsv_1.359]

mv-k03-v359.plain_english: Its state is pervaded by countless unconscious varieties, and its nature is divided into gentle and fierce forms such as endless activity and peace.

mv-k03-v360.plain_english: Even though its firm state is revealed by the glory of its own reabsorption, the splendor of Bhairava, by appropriateness, takes on various forms.
mv-k03-v360.sanskrit_cite:
api svagrāsamāhātmyaprakaṭīkṛtasusthiteḥ /
aucityād vividhākārā api bhairavatejasaḥ // [AgMsv_1.361]

mv-k03-v361.plain_english: They are variegated by the recurrence of empty, full, and mixed states, and are solely intent on reabsorbing their own portion, called the universe, into the nature of Śakti.

mv-k03-v362.plain_english: Conditioned to uproot states long rooted in world and time, the powers, from their own expansion, send forth each its own mass of rays.
mv-k03-v362.sanskrit_cite:
lokakālacirārūḍhabhāvonmūlanabhāvitāḥ /
śaktayo nijavisphārād raśmipuñjaṃ nijaṃ nijaṃ // [AgMsv_1.363]

mv-k03-v363.plain_english: Spreading forth, and relying on the true state of will, they manifest only what is fitting to them, in a way excluded from worldly left-hand practice.

mv-k03-v364.plain_english: They bring about scriptures that attain fullness, just like the first-arisen teaching in the sphere of transcending the world.
mv-k03-v364.sanskrit_cite:
ghaṭayanty eva śāstrāṇi yātāni paripūrṇatām /
yādṛk prathamasaṃbhūto lokātikrāntigocare // [AgMsv_1.365]

mv-k03-v365.plain_english: That same practice here would be one in which the state of difference is swallowed; this is the full great creation of the supreme Lord, established here.
mv-k03-v365.sanskrit_cite:
samācāraḥ sa evātra grastabhedadaśo bhavet /
pūrṇeyaṃ parameśasya mahāsṛṣṭir iha sthitā // [AgMsv_1.366]

mv-k03-v366.plain_english: In that creation, all the aspects of dissolution and creation exist in the middle; therefore it would not be fitting to call it the very first creation.
mv-k03-v366.sanskrit_cite:
yasyāṃ saṃhārasṛṣṭyaṃśā viśve te madhyavartinaḥ /
sā cādyā sṛṣṭir ity eva naiva vaktuṃ bhavet kṣamam // [AgMsv_1.367]

mv-k03-v367.plain_english: For in a principle beyond place and time, how could there be a first arising and so on? This waking state is the primary one, partaking of the state of unfolding.
mv-k03-v367.sanskrit_cite:
adeśakāle tattve hi katham ādyādisaṃbhavaḥ /
jāgraddaśeyaṃ sā mukhyā pronmeṣapadabhāginī // [AgMsv_1.368]

mv-k03-v368.plain_english: This Brahma is seated on the lotus of awakening of a portion of his own power; these powers unfold beginning from the auspicious Śiva form and extending finally to the form of Brahma.
mv-k03-v368.sanskrit_cite:
brahmaiṣa nijaśaktyaṃśasaṃbodhakamalāsanaḥ /
tā etāḥ sauśivād rūpāt prabhṛti brāhmam antataḥ // [AgMsv_1.369]

mv-k03-v369.plain_english: The powers of the Lord of consciousness unfold by taking form. Even if one might try to say, 'This god is only so much,' such a claim is considered possible.
mv-k03-v369.sanskrit_cite:
rūpaṃ kṛtvā vijṛmbhante saṃvinnāthasya śaktayaḥ /
etāvān eva devo 'yam iti yady api śakyate // [AgMsv_1.370]

mv-k03-v370.plain_english: It cannot truly be said, because the great Lord, whose nature is consciousness, is immeasurable. I have stated this clearly in the Prabodhapañcadaśikā.
mv-k03-v370.sanskrit_cite:
na vaktum aprameyatvāc cidrūpasya maheśituḥ /
prabodhapañcadaśikāmadhye tādṛṅ mayā sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.371]

mv-k03-v371.plain_english: It has been said that limited manifestation is indeed the characteristic of the inert; awareness is distinct from the inert because it is not measured.
mv-k03-v371.sanskrit_cite:
uktaṃ mitaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam /
jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate // [AgMsv_1.372]

mv-k03-v372.plain_english: Even so, the god, who is himself beyond measure, by the exercise of his own freedom makes himself into the moving and unmoving universe.
mv-k03-v372.sanskrit_cite:
tathāpi svayam etādṛg devo mānavivarjitaḥ /
nijasvātantryayogena kṛtvātmānaṃ carācaram // [AgMsv_1.373]

mv-k03-v373.plain_english: Through Īśa, Tatpuruṣa, and Aja, in their arisen and about-to-arise forms, combining as single ones, as six, as one, as a triad, and as three dyads,
mv-k03-v373.sanskrit_cite:
īśatatpuruṣājātair udbhūtair udbubhūṣubhiḥ /
ekakaiḥ ṣaḍbhir, ekena trikeṇa, dvyātmakais tribhiḥ // [AgMsv_1.374]

mv-k03-v374.plain_english: There arises a manifold state of the ten divisions of Śiva; indeed, this is due to the mixture of varied consciousnesses.
mv-k03-v374.sanskrit_cite:
jāyate śivabhedānāṃ daśānāṃ vividhā sthitiḥ /
ata eva vicitrābhyaḥ saṃvidbhyo miśratāvaśāt // [AgMsv_1.375]

mv-k03-v375.plain_english: Even in what is called Śiva, varied knowledges of difference were unfolded when the left and right aspects of the three faces came together.
mv-k03-v375.sanskrit_cite:
citrāṇy atra śivākhye 'pi bhedajñānāni tenire /
yadā trayāṇāṃ vaktrāṇāṃ vāmadakṣiṇasaṃgatiḥ // [AgMsv_1.376]

mv-k03-v376.plain_english: Then, as each becomes a distinct power through the future, present, and arisen modes, the six in a triad make the Rudra division established in eighteen forms.
mv-k03-v376.sanskrit_cite:
tadā pratyekaśaktitvaṃ bhaviṣyadbhavadudbhavaiḥ /
ṣaṇṇāṃ tritve rudrabhedas tenāṣṭādaśadhā sthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.377]

mv-k03-v377.plain_english: Since each is declared to be five-faced, what is divided into ten and eighteen becomes innumerable through further divisions.
mv-k03-v377.sanskrit_cite:
ekaikaṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca vaktraṃ yasmāt pragīyate /
daśāṣṭādaśabhinnasya tato bhedair asaṃkhyatā // [AgMsv_1.378]

mv-k03-v378.plain_english: Because in them the distinctions are determined by each one's own knowledge and action as stated before, there is no mere repetition.
mv-k03-v378.sanskrit_cite:
pūrvoditayathāsvasvajñānakarmavicitritāḥ /
nirṇīyante yatas teṣu tena no punaruktatā // [AgMsv_1.379]

mv-k03-v379.plain_english: For awareness, practice, and the sequence of action are indeed different in each case, as declared there; yet all of them lead to the abode of Śiva.
mv-k03-v379.sanskrit_cite:
anyānya eva bodho hi samācāraḥ kriyākramaḥ /
tatra tatra tathā proktaḥ sarvas tu śivadhāmagaḥ // [AgMsv_1.380]

mv-k03-v380.plain_english: Just as all drops of water come to rest in the great ocean, so all knowledges and actions come to rest in the great Lord, the ocean of consciousness.
mv-k03-v380.sanskrit_cite:
yathā jalakaṇāh sarve viśrāmyanti mahāmbudhau /
tathā jñānakriyāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvitsindhau maheśvare // [AgMsv_1.381]

mv-k03-v381.plain_english: Even limited water on earth is drawn up by the sun's rays and returns again to the great ocean through rain; so too, all knowledge and action in the world, some arising by themselves and some through others in succession, sink into the ocean of Śiva.
mv-k03-v381.sanskrit_cite:
mitam api jalaṃ bhūmau sūryāṃśubhiḥ kila pīyate / tad api ca punar vṛṣṭidvāraiḥ prayāti mahārṇavam /
jagati nikhilaṃ jñānaṃ karma sphuṭaṃ kim api svayaṃ / kim api ca paraiḥ pāramparyāc chivārṇasi majjati // [AgMsv_1.382]

mv-k03-v382.plain_english: And that heart-mark at the right end, regarded as the supreme heart, is also fully filled with all created beings taken within it.
mv-k03-v382.sanskrit_cite:
yac cānte dakṣiṇe hārdaṃ liṅgaṃ hṛt paramaṃ matam /
tad apy antaḥkṛtāśeṣasṛṣṭabhāvasunirbharam // [AgMsv_1.383]

mv-k03-v383.plain_english: And because it devours the rays of māyā that produce difference, that, as the dissolver of all, is dark and bears the form of darkness.
mv-k03-v383.sanskrit_cite:
bhedabhāvakamāyīyatejoṃśagrasanāc ca tat /
sarvasaṃhārakatvena kṛṣṇaṃ timirarūpadhṛt // [AgMsv_1.384]

mv-k03-v384.plain_english: Therefore it is stated in the Vijñānaśāstra by the great Lord: 'All space is dissolved in the head,' and so forth, referring to the darkness of the Lord.
mv-k03-v384.sanskrit_cite:
vijñānaśāstre kathitam ata eva maheśinā /
līnaṃ mūrdhni viyat sarvam ityādi timiraṃ vibhoḥ // [AgMsv_1.385]

mv-k03-v385.plain_english: Thus, on a dark night at the arrival of the dark fortnight, one should contemplate for a long time the Bhairava form, which is hard to name, by those who practice contemplation.
mv-k03-v385.sanskrit_cite:
evam eva durniśāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāgame ciram /
bhāvayed bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ bhāvayadbhir durābhidam // [AgMsv_1.386]

mv-k03-v386.plain_english: And it is said: where light, suffering, and darkness are covered by nonduality, there is no connection with ignorance and karma, because dependence and the like are not seen.
mv-k03-v386.sanskrit_cite:
uktaṃ ca yatra svar duḥkhaṃ tamo vādvayasaṃvṛte /
nāvidyākarmasaṃbandhaḥ pāratantryādidarśanāt // [AgMsv_1.387]

mv-k03-v387.plain_english: Therefore, in this Bhairava body of the form of darkness, the group of four faces shines fully by being inwardly dissolved.
mv-k03-v387.sanskrit_cite:
tad atra timirākāre bhairavīye vapuṣy alam /
antarlīnatayā bhāti yāvad vaktracatuṣṭayam // [AgMsv_1.388]

mv-k03-v388.plain_english: As about to emerge, emerged, about to withdraw, and withdrawn, this division therefore becomes simultaneously sixteenfold.
mv-k03-v388.sanskrit_cite:
udbubhūṣu tathodbhūtaṃ tirodhitsu tirohitam /
tato yugapad evaitadbhidā ṣoḍaśakātmakam // [AgMsv_1.389]

mv-k03-v389.plain_english: Entering the right, emissive, heart, and autonomous aspects in Śiva, the scripture named Bhairava becomes simultaneously an eight-times-eight system.
mv-k03-v389.sanskrit_cite:
dakṣe vaisargike hārde svatantre ca śive viśat /
aṣṭāṣṭakātmakaṃ śāstraṃ yugapad bhairavābhidham // [AgMsv_1.390]

mv-k03-v390.plain_english: Thus the scripture, named Rudra, Shiva, and Bhairava, is established as threefold in reality; for indeed this being of knowledge unfolds in a threefold way.
mv-k03-v390.sanskrit_cite:
itthaṃ tantraṃ rudraśivabhairavākhyaṃ sthitaṃ tridhā /
vastuto hi tridhaiveyaṃ jñānasattā vijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.391]

mv-k03-v391.plain_english: It unfolds by difference, by difference-and-nondifference, and by the full junction of nondifference; and likewise there are three principal powers of Shambhu, beginning with will.
mv-k03-v391.sanskrit_cite:
bhedena bhedābhedena pūrṇenābhedasandhinā /
tathā ca mukhyāḥ śāmbhavyas tisra icchādiśaktayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.392]

mv-k03-v392.plain_english: There indeed, by elaboration, there is the application of the five powers and so on; thus, though divided in the middle, that triad is indeed supreme.
mv-k03-v392.sanskrit_cite:
tatraiva tu prapañcena pañcaśaktyādiyojanam /
itthaṃ madhye vibhinnaṃ tat trikam eva paraṃ tathā // [AgMsv_1.393]

mv-k03-v393.plain_english: The scripture is established in our teacher's house through the lineage sequence; therefore, indeed, because of its nearness to the left and right scriptures.
mv-k03-v393.sanskrit_cite:
śāstram asmadgurugṛhe saṃpradāyakramāt sthitam /
ata eva hi naikaṭyād vāmadakṣiṇaśāstrayoḥ // [AgMsv_1.394]

mv-k03-v394.plain_english: The Kaula stream fully unfolds at the edge of the edge-stream; and from that, full with all the limiting conditions of beings withdrawn.
mv-k03-v394.sanskrit_cite:
dhārā prāntadharāprānte kaulikī pravijṛmbhate /
tato 'pi saṃhṛtāśeṣabhāvopādhisunirbharaḥ // [AgMsv_1.395]

mv-k03-v395.plain_english: Bhairava, whose activity is expanded by the rising fluid of supreme reality, embraces the triad of powers in sequence in those Ishana, left, and right channels, from Apara up to Para, and abides.
mv-k03-v395.sanskrit_cite:
bhairavaḥ paramārthodyadravabṛmhitavṛttikaḥ /
īśānavāmadakṣāsu tāsu śaktitrayaṃ kramāt /
aparādiparāprāntaṃ kroḍīkṛtyāvatiṣṭhate // [AgMsv_1.396]

mv-k03-v396.plain_english: It manifests that division of difference and makes it clear; and then they declare that infinite, reabsorbing form of the supreme lord to be, in reality, truly three-headed.
mv-k03-v396.sanskrit_cite:
tad vibhāvayati bhedavibhāgaṃ tatsphuṭatvakṛd atho tam anantam /
saṃgrasiṣṇu parameśvararūpaṃ vastutas triśira eva nirāhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.397]

mv-k03-v397.plain_english: The upper, left, and other tantras and kulas are established in that stream for the removal of the contraction of difference.
mv-k03-v397.sanskrit_cite:
ūrdhvavāmatadanyāni tantrāṇi ca kulāni ca /
rūḍhāny amuṣyāṃ dhārāyāṃ bhedasaṃkocahānaye // [AgMsv_1.398]

mv-k03-v398.plain_english: The triad-meaning, established threefold in supreme light, is uttered by the supreme lord as the knowledge-moon.
mv-k03-v398.sanskrit_cite:
paraprakāśaviṣayas trikārthas traidham āsthitaḥ /
sa eṣa parameśena jñānacandrākhyayoditaḥ // [AgMsv_1.399]

mv-k03-v399.plain_english: All scripture-meaning rests in the course of supreme speech, without unfolded distinctions of meaning and word.
mv-k03-v399.sanskrit_cite:
sa eva sarvaḥ śāstrārthaḥ paravāgvṛttisaṃśritaḥ /
anullasitatadvācyavācakādivibhaktikaḥ // [AgMsv_1.400]

mv-k03-v400.plain_english: Afterward, in the self where knowledge-power dominates, action-power remains very subtle within sadākhya lordship.
mv-k03-v400.sanskrit_cite:
paścāt tu jñānaśaktyaṃśaprādhānyasphuritātmani /
kriyāśaktau susūkṣmāyāṃ sādākhyaiśvaryasaṃpadi // [AgMsv_1.401]

mv-k03-v401.plain_english: In the paśyantī and madhyamā abodes, through the mention of stirring, it exists as word and sentence in letter form.

mv-k03-v402.plain_english: In the Svacchanda scripture it is said that Sadāśiva himself joined the tantra with prior and later words and sentences.
mv-k03-v402.sanskrit_cite:
svacchandaśāstre tenoktaṃ svayaṃ devaḥ sadāśivaḥ /
pūrvottarapadair vākyais tantraṃ yojitavān iti // [AgMsv_1.403]
